jobs.title: AI Research Scientist/ Research Engineer: Materials Discovery
jobs.description: At **Logical Intelligence**, our mission is to accelerate the discovery of materials that make the next generation of technology possible, from light emitters and semiconductors to batteries, electric vehicles, and the chips behind AI and robotics. Large language models alone are not enough to get there. Discovering new materials requires an understanding of chemistry and physics to guide the search, and energy\-based models let us build that understanding directly into our discovery loop. We work closely with industry and lab partners to shorten the path from research to real products. **About the Role** As a Research Scientist on our material discovery team, you will help turn that idea into new molecules. You will build the AI systems that propose and evaluate candidates, and work with our partner labs so that every synthesis and measurement teaches the models something. You will join a highly interdisciplinary team of chemists, physicists, and machine learning scientists and engineers, where the biggest impact comes from working together. **What You’ll Do** * Build and improve the AI systems behind our discovery loop, from candidate generation and screening to selecting which molecules to test next. * Develop energy\-based models that combine learned representations with physical and chemical knowledge to search chemical space more efficiently. * Own model evaluation, including benchmarks on held\-out chemical families, accuracy against both quantum\-chemistry calculations and experiment, calibration of uncertainty estimates, prospective tests where the model predicts before the lab measures, and tracking across model versions. * Compare AI predictions with measurements, investigate disagreements, and turn what you learn into concrete model changes, in collaboration with AI researchers and engineers. * Design experiments with our partner labs so that each round of synthesis and testing is as informative as possible. **You Will Thrive in This Role If You Have** * A background in machine learning, computational chemistry, physics, or a related field, with a PhD, or a Master’s plus relevant industry experience, and hands\-on experience building ML models for real scientific problems. * Familiarity with energy\-based models, diffusion or score\-based models, or similar generative approaches, and an interest in going deeper. * Knowledge of chemistry, or a genuine interest in learning it alongside our chemists. * Experience designing evaluations and experiments that correlate with downstream performance * A strong record of impactful research, shown through publications, patents, open\-source software, or methods used in real discovery programs. * Excellent scientific writing and communication, and comfort working in an interdisciplinary team. **Especially Strong Candidates May Also Have** * Hands\-on research experience with energy\-based models, or with methods that combine learning with search and optimization. * Experience with molecular ML, such as property prediction, generative molecular design, ML interatomic potentials, or quantum\-chemistry workflows (e.g. DFT). * Experience with closed\-loop design using real lab feedback logicalintelligence.com

jobs.title: AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **About Health Data Innovations** --------------------------------- Founded in 2010, Health Data Innovations (HDI) allows providers and payers to seamlessly integrate external administrative data into their internal systems. HDI’s tech\-enabled data management system and processes codify decades of knowledge to ingest, cleanse, standardize, and validate payer claims and administrative data. The system reflects HDI’s extensive experience with data from a broad spectrum of payers and vendors. By outsourcing data acquisition and integration to HDI, clients can spend more time working with the data and less time on data integration issues. In 2023, Hughes \& Company invested in HDI to build on the company’s success enabling healthcare providers in value\-based care arrangements. HDI provides clients with mission\-critical data that is necessary for contractual obligations and underpins programs of substantial value. As risk\-based arrangements proliferate and increase in complexity, HDI’s differentiated technology is a critical tool to enable the success of these programs. **The Role** ------------ We're looking for an AI Solutions Engineer to build and run the AI tools, integrations, and workflows that put AI to work across HD Innovations, and to lead our move to agentic AI. Our AI initiative is already live: enterprise AI assistants and coding tools, a private model gateway on Amazon Bedrock, custom connectors to our business systems, and local models running on our own GPU hardware. Our next step is AI agents that take action across our systems, and we want to get there quickly. This is a hands\-on role on a small team. Most of your time goes to building AI solutions and agents; the rest goes to the infrastructure they run on, including cloud services, identity, servers, and GPU hosts, all in a security\-first, HITRUST\-governed environment. **Why This Role** ----------------- * Build AI that does real work across the whole business, not just one department * Work directly with executives and every function at HDI to find where AI can make the biggest difference * Shape how HDI adopts AI — your ideas influence the roadmap * Build agents that handle complex work in a high\-stakes, regulated healthcare environment **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Work with business users to find processes where AI can help, and decide the right approach: an assistant, an AI\-assisted workflow, or an agent * Build and improve AI\-assisted workflows, skills, and plugins that put AI into everyday processes * Lead the move to agentic AI: design, build, and deploy agents and multi\-step workflows using tool use / function calling, prompt and context design, and agent frameworks * Build and support Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, database bridges, and Microsoft 365 integrations so AI tools and agents can safely reach the data and systems they need * Test and evaluate AI output for accuracy and reliability, and catch regressions before they reach users * Build in guardrails, least\-privilege permissions, human\-in\-the\-loop approvals, and audit logging, especially where AI touches sensitive healthcare data * Own AI solutions in production: monitor behavior, usage, and cost; troubleshoot issues; and version, maintain, and retire them * Write scripts and code, mainly in Python, managed through Git and pull\-request review * Track new models, agent frameworks, and vendor releases; run proofs of concept and recommend what to adopt * Support the infrastructure behind our AI services, including Amazon Bedrock, Entra ID / SSO, Linux and Windows servers, VMs, and GPU hosts * Write clear documentation, runbooks, and guides that stand up to compliance audits **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- **Required:** * 3\+ years in IT infrastructure, systems administration, DevOps, or software development * Hands\-on experience building with LLMs or AI agents (tool use, MCP, multi\-step workflows), from work, prototypes, or personal projects * Experience with LLM APIs or cloud AI platforms (Amazon Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI) * Solid Linux skills (RHEL or Ubuntu), plus working knowledge of Windows Server and Docker * Networking and security fundamentals: firewalls, segmentation, least privilege * Scripting and automation skills (Python preferred; PowerShell or Bash a plus) * Experience integrating with APIs, databases, and business systems * Familiarity with Git workflows and code review * Curiosity about AI and the discipline to turn experiments into reliable, documented systems * Ability to work independently, manage your own priorities, and support non\-technical users in a small\-team environment **Preferred:** * Building MCP servers or using agent frameworks * Experience taking an agent from prototype to production * Experience testing and evaluating LLM output * Software development experience in Python, Go, or TypeScript * RAG pipelines and vector databases (pgvector, Qdrant, Chroma, Milvus) * Experience with Entra ID / Azure AD, SSO, and OAuth 2\.0 / OIDC * Experience working under a compliance framework such as HITRUST, HIPAA, SOC 2, or ISO 27001 * AWS IAM, cost management, and Bedrock guardrails * Local AI experience: running open\-weight models with vLLM or llama.cpp on NVIDIA GPUs, including vGPU or GPU passthrough * Remote Desktop Services, Azure Arc, and virtualization (VMware, Proxmox, or Hyper\-V) * OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, or Grafana * MySQL Server or PostgreSQL administration * Microsoft Graph API * Terraform, Ansible, or Packer **Tech You'll Work With** ------------------------- Claude (Desktop, Code) · Amazon Bedrock · Model Context Protocol · Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft 365 · Azure Arc · Windows Server 2025 RDS · Forgejo · OpenTelemetry · Python and Go · Docker · Proxmox with NVIDIA vGPU · vector databases · VMware vSphere · RHEL and Ubuntu **In\-Office Expectations** --------------------------- While this is a hybrid role, periodic in\-office presence in Cleveland is required. This includes attendance at team meetings and onboarding/training sessions, as well as scheduled visits to collaborate with stakeholders during planning and rollout phases.

jobs.title: Engineering Generalist - Product Impact (Full Stack)
jobs.description: **About Pocket** *At Pocket, we’re building the future of human memory.* Some of the most valuable information in our lives disappears when a conversation ends: an idea, a decision, a detail we wish we could remember. Pocket helps us hold onto it. We’ve built an AI\-powered device that captures real\-world conversations and turns them into searchable transcripts, summaries and next steps. Backed by Accel and Y Combinator (W26\), we’ve already sold 500,000 devices. Our ambition goes beyond recording. We believe the things you learn, discuss and experience can become useful context for the AI tools you already use, and for products that don’t exist yet. **About the Role** Sometimes the most useful thing to build is a better onboarding flow. Sometimes it is a backend service, a faster API or the instrumentation that explains why customers leave. We’re looking for an engineer who can follow the problem across those boundaries. You’ll work across backend and frontend, ship changes end to end and measure whether they made the product better. You’ll work closely with product, design, marketing and support, without needing every task to fit one narrow specialty. **What You’ll Own** * Projects from instrumentation and data models through services, user interfaces, rollout and iteration. * Features and experiments that improve activation, retention, paid conversion and the core experience. * Backend APIs, pipelines, jobs and systems that stay reliable as usage grows. * Frontend improvements across the web product, internal tools, landing pages and onboarding. * Clear hypotheses and measurement, followed by the work needed to make successful experiments production\-ready. **What We’re Looking For** * 6–10\+ years shipping production software, ideally in a startup environment. * Strong backend fundamentals: APIs, databases, asynchronous jobs, caching, performance and reliability. * The ability to ship frontend changes in React/TypeScript or a comparable stack. * Product judgment: you can turn an unclear problem into useful work and explain the result. * Performance and reliability habits, including profiling, latency budgets, observability and graceful degradation. * A preference for simple systems, fast learning and responsible delivery over unnecessary complexity. **Bonus Points** Experience with experiments, analytics instrumentation, funnels or cohorts; internal tools; or building products from zero to one. **Our Stack** Flutter for mobile; React and TypeScript on the frontend; Go and Node on the backend; Postgres and Redis for data. **What Success Looks Like** Shipped work improves activation, retention or revenue. Production systems are observable and reliable. The architecture remains simple enough for the team to keep moving. **Why Join Pocket?** You’ll work close to the product and the people building the company. Your scope follows the problem, so you can connect a technical change to a customer or business result instead of handing it off at the edge of one codebase. Compensation Range: $200K \- $300K

jobs.title: Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: **About Pocket** *At Pocket, we’re building the future of human memory.* Some of the most valuable information in our lives disappears when a conversation ends: an idea, a decision, a detail we wish we could remember. That means capturing audio reliably, keeping files safe and getting recordings to their phone even when connections or operating conditions are imperfect. You’ll work on the firmware behind that experience. This role is for someone who wants to follow a problem all the way through: from a customer\-visible symptom to the driver, peripheral or hardware behavior underneath it, then back to a fix tested on a real device. **What You’ll Own** * Investigating and fixing embedded\-device issues across firmware, peripherals and host connections. * Reliable recording, storage and transfer behavior, including disconnects, retries and partial transfers. * Working across hardware and app boundaries to reproduce failures and verify fixes. * Maintainable firmware, useful tests and debugging practices grounded in real hardware. * Clear communication of tradeoffs, findings and remaining risks to the people working on adjacent parts of the product. **What We’re Looking For** * The ability to read schematics and datasheets, bring up peripherals and trace a problem across system layers. * Understanding of Bluetooth/BLE, USB or Wi\-Fi device\-to\-host communication, or the ability to learn it quickly. * Good Git habits, maintainable code and tests that catch failures on real devices. * Ownership of difficult, intermittent issues and clear communication across teams. * A degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience. We are open to any experience level. There is no minimum number of years: show us what you have built and how you approach embedded problems. **Bonus Points** * Audio\-device firmware, microphone/ADC signal paths, I²S/PDM, codecs and measurement of audio\-quality tradeoffs. * Zephyr or another RTOS, ARM Cortex\-M, Actions Semiconductor platforms, vendor SDKs or DSP components. * Flash/SD storage, FAT or LittleFS, recording recovery and safe concurrent recording and sync. * Low\-power electronics, bootloaders, signed updates, Python, CI or production test fixtures. * iOS/Android companion\-app integration, BLE GATT, interoperability debugging, or taking devices through manufacturing and supporting them in the field. **Why Join Pocket?** You’ll solve problems that people can hear and feel in a product they use. The work sits where hardware, audio and mobile software meet, and a reliable fix matters well beyond a test bench. Compensation Range: $160K \- $250K

jobs.title: Forward-Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About Alex \& the Role** -------------------------- Alex is an AI recruiter. Alex screens and interviews candidates over voice — on the web and over the phone — and it works inside the systems companies already recruit with: their applicant tracking system, their requisitions, their hiring process. Enterprises and staffing firms use it to run interviews at a volume they otherwise couldn't. Forward\-Deployed Engineers are the technical owners of every Alex deployment. When a customer signs, FDEs are the people who make Alex work inside their systems and their process — and keep it working. It is the most end\-to\-end engineering role at the company: you design the solution, build it, integrate it, ship it to production, and own it afterwards. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Design and build how a customer uses Alex.** Turn a hiring process described in a meeting into workflows that actually run — triggers, filters, interview guides, and the actions we take back in their ATS. When a customer needs something their setup doesn't do yet, you drive it: design, build, test, roll out, verify. * **Own the integration surface.** We integrate with roughly two dozen applicant tracking systems, some directly and some through a unified API partner. You'll build new integrations, maintain existing ones, and go deep on the ones you own — along with the other systems a customer's workflow reaches into, like assessment providers and identity verification. * **Run the technical side of onboarding.** Connection, permissions and scopes, job import, field mapping, workflow build, test interviews, go\-live — sequenced so nothing is discovered in front of a candidate. * **Own the deployments in production.** The team owns the support queue — for customers and candidates both — and diagnoses to root cause rather than working around it. You'll also build the monitoring that catches problems before a customer has to call. * **Be the technical voice of the customer.** You are the person who sees, across many accounts, where the product runs out. Turning that into an evidenced case our product engineering team can act on is part of the job. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * Real engineering ability. This role reads code, writes code, and ships changes. It is not a technical\-adjacent role. * Comfort working inside someone else's system with incomplete documentation. Much of this job is finding out what a third\-party API actually does, as opposed to what its docs claim. * Debugging instinct — the reflex to go get the evidence rather than reason from the symptom. * Direct customer contact without a buffer. You'll run your own working sessions and say hard things clearly. * Strong writing. A large fraction of the output of this role is a clear written explanation. ### **Nice to have** * Forward\-deployed, implementation, solutions, or integrations engineering experience — especially anywhere with a long tail of third\-party systems. * You've built against a messy enterprise API and lived with the result. * Fluency with observability tooling — logs, traces, dashboards, alerting you had to live with. **Why join** * High ownership and growth opportunities * Collaborate with a tight\-knit team of talented builders * Launch products that directly impact people’s careers * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * FSA, DCFSA, HSA options * Flexible paid time off (PTO) * 401(k) plan * Fully paid parental leave program If you've gotten this far and this role resonates with you, we want you to apply. Your first conversation will be with Alex, our AI recruiter. *Alex is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.* Compensation Range: $120K \- $180K

jobs.title: Founding Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **Minimum qualifications** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * 3 years of experience building or operating production infrastructure with Kubernetes and Docker. * 3 years of coding experience in Go, Python or a similar language. * Experience with Linux systems administration, networking, storage and troubleshooting distributed systems. * Experience deploying and managing infrastructure on AWS, GCP or Azure. **Preferred qualifications** * Experience operating GPU clusters for distributed training, inference or other compute\-intensive workloads, especially on top of SLURM, Volcano, or other schedulers * Experience with Kubernetes scheduling, autoscaling, resource quotas and multi\-tenant workload isolation. * Experience building containerized sandbox environments for running untrusted code, automated tests or AI agents. * Experience with infrastructure as code and deployment tools such as Terraform, Helm and Argo CD. * Experience building monitoring, logging and alerting with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana and OpenTelemetry. * A track record of improving infrastructure reliability, resource utilization or operating costs. **About the job** We're building infrastructure that lets AI agents run experiments, train models and solve problems at scale. These workloads involve much more than serving requests: agents launch containers, execute code, interact with environments and share expensive compute resources. Making this work reliably takes people who understand the systems underneath it. As a founding engineer on the team, you'll build and operate the infrastructure behind our training, inference and agent workloads. A workload might involve launching thousands of containerized environments, scheduling jobs across GPU nodes and collecting results for the next training run. You'll investigate why jobs fail, where resources sit idle and what slows down experiments, then build improvements that make the whole system more reliable and efficient. You don't need a machine learning background. We care most about strong infrastructure fundamentals and experience owning production systems. You'll pick up the ML side working with our researchers and ML engineers. Salary range: \[range] \+ \[bonus, equity, benefits] **Responsibilities** * Build and operate Kubernetes clusters for GPU training, model inference and agent execution. * Create and maintain Docker images and reproducible environments for research and production workloads. * Build systems to launch, monitor, clean up and recover thousands of concurrent containerized tasks. * Improve scheduling, autoscaling and resource allocation to reduce GPU idle time and infrastructure costs. * Automate infrastructure provisioning, deployments and upgrades using infrastructure as code and CI/CD. * Build monitoring and debugging tools that make failures and performance bottlenecks easy to investigate. * Troubleshoot issues across Linux hosts, containers, networking, storage and GPU infrastructure. * Implement workload isolation, access controls and resource limits for shared clusters and agent environments. * Work with researchers and ML engineers to turn experimental workflows into reliable systems. * Own incident response and root\-cause analysis, and make improvements that prevent recurring failures. Peano Labs is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** Companaut is a Washington, DC–based SaaS company building the infrastructure for accountable AI in innovation design—the complex, high\-stakes work of designing systems that bring together people, processes, and technologies across organizations. Our platform gives innovation and transformation teams a governed workspace where AI thinks with them, not for them. What We Are Looking For * 5\+ years building and operating production SaaS, including end\-to\-end ownership of a system as a senior engineer, tech lead, or hands\-on engineering leader. * Strong Python (FastAPI or a comparable async framework) and modern TypeScript/React. * Excellent relational database skills: PostgreSQL, SQL, data modeling, migrations, and ORMs. * Multi\-tenant SaaS architecture — tenant isolation, role\-based access control, organizational permissions, and secure API design. * Application security experience: authentication and authorization boundaries, secrets management, and hardening a system ahead of launch. * Real\-time and streaming systems — WebSockets, server\-sent events, and their failure modes. * Production experience building AI\-enabled features on model APIs with structured outputs. * Experience designing human\-in\-the\-loop systems where audit trails are preserved. * Cloud architecture, automated deployment, observability, and production incident response. * Automated testing, code review, Git, and CI/CD. * Responsible use of AI coding tools, including reviewing AI\-generated code for correctness, security, maintainability, and licensing. * Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline — or equivalent practical experience. Preferred * SOC 2, HIPAA, or comparable compliance work — building to controls and supporting a certification effort. * Speech\-to\-text or audio pipeline integration. * Data\-rich interactive web applications and collaborative enterprise workspaces. * Working with unstructured qualitative data — documents, transcripts, and research evidence. * Interactive data visualization for exploring patterns and relationships. * Security, privacy, and data\-retention practice in healthcare, finance, or another high\-stakes environment. jobs.title: Hardware Lead Engineer

Systems Thinking * Ability to understand and reason about complete system behavior. * Comfortable making engineering tradeoffs across hardware and software boundaries. * Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills. Leadership \& Ownership * Ability to independently drive projects forward as a hands\-on individual contributor. * Comfortable operating in environments with incomplete information. * Experience leading technical decisions and influencing engineering direction. * Strong communication and collaboration skills. **Nice to Have** * Robotics experience. * Embedded systems experience. * Experience with motors, actuators, and motion systems. * Experience working in startups or small engineering teams. * Experience taking products from prototype to production. * Medical device experience, particularly in hands\-on product development environments. * Experience with design documentation, quality management systems (QMS), or regulated product development processes. **What Success Looks Like** Successful hardware engineers at Andromeda are builders first. They thrive in fast\-moving environments, collaborate closely with teammates, and focus on delivering reliable solutions that work in the real world. **Why Join Andromeda?** At Andromeda, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a small, highly technical team tackling some of the hardest problems in robotics, software, and healthcare. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us:** Lovelace is the only provider of enterprise\-scale context engines capable of analyzing trillions of real\-time data points to create knowledge graphs that are usable by autonomous agents at the speed, scale, and accuracy required for mission\-critical analysis. Lovelace’s context engine platform, Elemental, uniquely integrates data ingestion, entity resolution, and graph building into a single pipeline that empower agentic deployments, delivering 1000X the investigative power for complex queries. With its proprietary ground\-breaking YottaGraph, Lovelace provides enterprises with real\-time, real\-world context, enabling agents to understand the impact of global intelligence on enterprise data for unmatched insights with millisecond precision. Founded in 2023 by Andrew Moore, former head of Google Cloud AI, dean of Carnegie Mellon’s School of Computer Science, and first AI advisor for U.S. CENTCOM, Lovelace currently works with some of the largest public and private enterprises in the world. **Job Summary:** * As a Machine Learning Engineer, you'll own ML problems end to end, from framing an ambiguous question to shipping a production system. There's no ticket queue and no narrow scope: everyone here, including newer engineers, stands up new jobs and makes changes across the codebase without close supervision. You'll decide what data matters, which models fit, and how the system around them should work. The role is roughly half research and half engineering, on a team that reports to our Chief Scientist. At Lovelace, every engineer is a manager of AI. Our engineers work alongside AI coding agents every day, and the most valuable thing you'll bring is judgment: knowing what to build, catching when an agent gets it wrong, and owning the design decisions. We're looking for people who ramp in weeks, not months. You don't need industry experience; strong research lab backgrounds are welcome. What matters is that you've owned hard problems and can think critically about your own work and your agents'. **Key Responsibilities:** * Frame ambiguous product needs as precise ML problems, and set your own requirements. * Decide what data is useful, which model types fit, and when to go beyond fine\-tuning. * Direct AI coding agents, review their output critically, and push back when their design decisions are wrong. * Design the systems around your models: data pipelines, serving, evaluation, and monitoring. * Choose metrics that reflect real outcomes, and catch when they mislead. * Stand up new jobs, make changes across the codebase, and ship NLP and LLM systems to production, owning their correctness. * Challenge assumptions, including teammates' and your own, to get to the right answer. **Qualifications:** * A track record of owning ambiguous problems end to end, in a research lab, a startup, or your own projects. * Strong ML fundamentals, from probabilistic foundations to modern deep learning and LLM architectures. * Experience building the system around a model, not just training it: data pipelines, evaluation, deployment, and how it behaves at scale. * Hands\-on experience with AI coding agents, and a clear sense of where they go wrong. * Expert\-level Python and a strong testing discipline. You understand how your code works. * The confidence to push back, with evidence, on requirements, teammates, and agents. **Preferred Skills:** * NLP, knowledge graphs, entity resolution, or agentic systems. * Go or other systems programming experience. * Open\-source contributions, side projects, or publications with working code. * Background from a strong research lab. A PhD is welcome but not required. **Benefits:** LovelaceAI offers competitive compensation packages, comprehensive benefits. We provide a supportive and inclusive work environment where your skills and expertise can make a significant impact on the safety and security of our communities. **Lovelace’s founding team includes:** **Andrew Moore**, who has a track record of building impactful AI systems, designing them with human rights impact assessments as a top priority, leading the AI division of one of the world’s foremost cloud companies, and actively participating in machine learning and AI research over the past two decades. **Toby Smith**, well known in the Pittsburgh Tech community for his engineering leadership and design skills, and who has led many of the most ambitious and complex system infrastructure projects in Google Pittsburgh and NetApp. Here is a note from Andrew Moore to people who are reading these Job Postings: “Hi folks, I’m so glad you are potentially interested in Lovelace AI. This area means a lot to me because while I am an AI optimist, I also think that we technologists owe it to a rightly skeptical world to show that modern intelligent systems can actually be useful. Usefulness comes in many guises: from life sciences to education and from transportation to entertainment and many others. For many of us, security and public safety is also very high on that list. That reasoning leads to this conclusion: I’m determined to make sure that the people building Lovelace AI gain a lot from the experience, including the chance to solve fascinating problems in computer science, AI, business development, customer success and product management. I also hope that we all learn from each other in a highly enriching work environment. But my main hope is that we have a shared sense of accomplishment as we see an increasing number of national security and public safety domains made safer through sensible and robust use of advanced computer science."

jobs.title: Mid-Level Full-Stack AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **Department** Software Development **Employment** Full\-time, exempt **Location** Hybrid / in\-person southern Maryland **About AlarisPro** =================== AlarisPro is the aviation industry’s only aviation\-minded, cloud\-based UAS fleet management platform. It replaces spreadsheets and disconnected tools with one powerful system that unifies safety, compliance, and operational intelligence through centralized tracking of flights, maintenance, parts, and aircraft configuration. Now we are building the future of Preventive Maintenance Artificial Intelligence. AlarisPro is evolving from a data provider into an AI solutions integrator—turning trusted operational data into intelligence, recommendations, and better decisions for UAS operators. **The Opportunity** =================== We are looking for a hands\-on, growing engineer who can strengthen the platform we operate today while helping build the intelligent products of tomorrow. This is not a narrow database, front\-end, or AI role. Working with experienced technical and product leaders, you will contribute across the current Microsoft\-based application stack, modern cloud services, APIs, user experiences, and emerging AI capabilities. You will be successful if you enjoy modernizing real production systems, learn the aviation domain, use AI coding tools fluently, and work with product and design partners to move from raw information to trusted decisions. This is a hybrid position based in Southern Maryland. Applicants must currently reside in the United States and be legally authorized to work in the U.S. Company\-paid relocation assistance is available for qualified candidates. Compensation will be competitive and commensurate with experience, qualifications, and technical expertise.. **What You Will Build?** ======================== * **Evolve the current platform.** Develop, optimize, secure, and maintain AlarisPro’s MSSQL, ASP.NET/.NET, IIS, API, and React capabilities. * **Create the modern AI stack.** Contribute to cloud\-native services, AI\-enabled workflows, retrieval and reasoning capabilities, model integrations, evaluation approaches, and production\-ready data pipelines. * **Applications that turn information into decisions.** Build experiences that surface risks, identify patterns, recommend actions, and support preventive maintenance and operational decision\-making. * **Connect the ecosystem.** Design secure, documented REST APIs and integrations that allow internal services, customers, partners, and AI agents to work with AlarisPro data and capabilities. * **Build usable front ends.** Create responsive, accessible interfaces that make complex safety, compliance, maintenance, and fleet intelligence understandable and actionable. * **Use AI\-assisted engineering responsibly.** Apply AI tools (e.g., Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) to accelerate discovery, prototyping, refactoring, testing, documentation, and delivery—with human review and production engineering discipline. **Core Responsibilities** ========================= **Production Platform \& Data** * Develop and optimize T\-SQL stored procedures, functions, triggers, views, schemas, indexes, and execution plans. * Monitor reliability and performance; troubleshoot deadlocks, blocking, long\-running queries, resource utilization, and application/database issues. * Maintain data integrity, security, availability, backup/recovery practices, and compliance controls. * Develop, debug, refactor, review, deploy, and support ASP.NET/.NET applications, React Native, and IIS\-hosted services. **AI, Cloud \& Integration** ---------------------------- * Prototype and deploy AI capabilities that use AlarisPro’s trusted operational data to improve maintenance, safety, compliance, and fleet decisions. * Build and consume secure REST APIs using appropriate authentication patterns, including JWT, OAuth 2\.0, API keys, and related controls. * Contribute to cloud architecture, deployment automation, observability, CI/CD, testing, and scalable service design, with an emphasis on AWS environments. * Help evaluate new models, frameworks, and coding agents; document findings, technical decisions, and measurable product outcomes. **Product, Design \& Collaboration** ------------------------------------ * Partner with customers and stakeholders to understand workflows, pain points, risks, and decisions—not simply requested features. * Use Design Thinking and product management methods to frame problems, prototype quickly, test assumptions, prioritize value, and iterate from evidence. * Bridge aviation operational requirements, product objectives, user experience, and technical constraints to develop effective, practical software solutions. * Contribute to roadmaps, requirements, acceptance criteria, code reviews, technical documentation, testing, and release readiness. **What We Are Looking For** =========================== **Required Experience** ----------------------- * Hands\-on development with C T APIs and working with cloud\-hosted applications, databases, or services. * Front\-end development experience; HTML, JavaScript, CSS, React or comparable modern frameworks are strongly valued. * Practical experience using Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar AI coding tools. * Working knowledge of Git, testing, secure development, code review, deployment, and production troubleshooting. * Ability to contribute across the stack, communicate clearly, ask good questions, reliably estimate tasks assigned, document work, and deliver reliably and on time in a fast\-moving environment. **Preferred Experience** ------------------------ * 3\+ years of professional software or data\-platform engineering experience, including meaningful hands\-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server and T\-SQL. * AWS architecture, application/API hosting, WebSocket’s, managed databases, and cloud observability. * SQL Agent automation, Microsoft SQL database administration, IIS configuration, high availability, and performance engineering. * Applied AI/ML, LLM integrations, retrieval\-augmented generation, automated integration testing, model evaluation, or MLOps/LLMOps. * Product discovery, Design Thinking, user research, prototyping, backlog prioritization, or product management practices. * Experience in aviation, UAS/drone operations, fleet operations of any type, preventive maintenance, safety, regulatory compliance, or other high\-reliability domains are a plus. **Our Approach to AI\-Assisted Development** ============================================ We value speed, curiosity, and strong tool fluency. We also expect engineering judgment. **AI\-generated code must be understood, reviewed, tested, secured, documented, and operated like any other production code.** The goal is not to generate more code; it is to deliver better outcomes faster. **Success in This Role** ======================== Success in this role means consistently delivering high\-quality software solutions that improve the AlarisPro platform and provide meaningful value to our customers. The ideal candidate will demonstrate: * **Ownership and Accountability:** Take responsibility for assigned projects and deliver reliable, well\-tested solutions on schedule with minimal oversight. * **Productivity and Execution:** Consistently make measurable progress, manage priorities effectively, and deliver results in a fast\-paced development environment. * **Problem\-Solving:** Independently analyze complex challenges, identify practical solutions, and exercise sound technical judgment. * **User\-Centered Design:** Apply Design Thinking principles to translate aviation operational requirements and customer needs into intuitive, efficient software solutions. * **Software Quality:** Develop maintainable, scalable, and secure code while minimizing defects, technical debt, and unnecessary complexity. * **Collaboration and Communication:** Work effectively with leadership, product stakeholders, and fellow engineers while proactively communicating progress, challenges, and solutions. * **Continuous Improvement:** Demonstrate initiative in improving existing functionality, development processes, and overall user experience. * **Business and Mission Awareness:** Understand how software development decisions affect customer operations, aviation safety, regulatory compliance, and AlarisPro's business objectives. **Why Join AlarisPro?** Join AlarisPro at an exciting stage of growth and innovation, where you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the future of unmanned systems. You'll help shape the continued evolution of a proven, industry\-leading platform at the intersection of aviation safety, cloud technology, and applied AI. Leveraging extensive real\-world operational data, you'll contribute to the development of next\-generation capabilities in predictive maintenance, reliability analytics, and intelligent decision support that improve aviation safety and operational efficiency.

Whether that’s evolving our streaming and digital products in new and immersive ways, powering worldwide advertising and distribution to maximize flexibility and efficiency, or delivering Disney’s unmatched entertainment and sports content, every day is a moment to make a difference to partners and to hundreds of millions of people around the world. **A few reasons why we think you’d love working here:** * **Building the future of Disney’s media business:** DE\&E Technologists are designing and building the infrastructure that will power Disney’s media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. * **Reach \& Scale:** The products and platforms this group builds and operates delight millions of consumers every minute of every day – from Disney\+ and Hulu, to ABC News and Entertainment, to ESPN and ESPN\+, and much more. * **Innovation:** We develop and execute groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms and enhance how audiences experience sports, entertainment \& news. **Media Engineering** is an innovative organization that is focused on providing the best possible video playback experience, art, and metadata to customers around the world, powered by exceptional technology. This strategic work requires streamlining and repurposing technology across different business and distribution channels – including streaming, linear, and theatrical – so that technology can ebb and flow across the needs of the business. jobs.title: Quality Management Architect, Trenchless Equipment
jobs.description: **Quality Management Architect, Trenchless Equipment** ====================================================== **Barbco, Inc. — East Canton, Ohio** **Question for you** -------------------- Do you want to inherit a binder—or design a quality system that actually changes how products are built? At Barbco, the answer is clear: we’re hiring someone to architect and own a practical, company\-wide quality system that helps us build better, faster, and with fewer surprises. **Who we are** -------------- Barbco is a family\-owned American manufacturer with decades of experience creating underground construction equipment for the trenchless industry. We are growing—expanding product lines, improving manufacturing systems, and investing in people for our next generation. **Your challenge** ------------------ This is not an ISO certification\-driven position. Your goal is to create a sustainable, floor\-ready Barbco quality system that reduces rework, strengthens accountability, and delivers better outcomes for customers. You will report to senior management and operate with company\-wide visibility. **What a win looks like** ------------------------- * Inspection steps and quality gates are simple, visible, and consistently followed from incoming through release. * Root causes are found fast; corrective and preventive actions stick. * Nonconforming material is contained, dispositioned rapidly, and used to drive systemic fixes. * Suppliers meet clear expectations; incoming quality improves measurably. * Welding, fabrication, machining, assembly, hydraulic, electrical, and finished\-equipment quality are supported with the right standards and checks. * Drawings, specifications, work instructions, inspection criteria, and engineering changes are understood and executed correctly. * Documentation is user\-friendly; employees are trained and coached to solve problems. * Quality is everyone’s job, and you have the authority to stop the process when it counts. * New\-product introductions move smoothly, enabling growth into new equipment and markets. **How you’ll partner** ---------------------- Work shoulder to shoulder with Production, Engineering, Operations, Purchasing, Dealer Support, and senior management to identify risk early and keep defects from traveling downstream. **What you’ve done** -------------------- * Led manufacturing quality on the floor and in leadership forums. * Built or substantially improved a QMS with real results. * Used structured problem solving (5 Why, 8D, FMEA, CAPA) to drive sustainable change. * Read prints, interpret specs and tolerances, and design inspection approaches that matter. * Applied measurement, inspection, and calibration knowledge in a production environment. * Worked directly with production teams, supervisors, engineers, suppliers, and customers. * Documented rigorously and made tough calls when quality demanded it. * Led change without creating tension between production and quality. * Pursued continuous improvement with an action\-first mindset. * Leveraged Lean, Six Sigma, APQP, and supplier quality practices where useful—valuing results over certificates. * Built credibility through experience, technical education, quality credentials, and leadership (degree helpful, not required). **A day you might live** ------------------------ Morning: You pause a machining job after spotting a potential tolerance stack. Midday: You and Engineering simplify a check fixture so assembly can self\-verify. Afternoon: You meet Purchasing to align supplier capability with new specs. Wrap\-up: You publish a one\-page visual standard that prevents today’s issue from recurring. **Why here, why now** --------------------- * Direct impact with leadership, engineers, skilled craftsmen, dealers, and customers—no corporate maze. * See your system in action and your metrics trend the right way. * Barbco is investing in new products and equipment platforms; manufacturing capabilities; technology and business systems; training and employee development; dealer and customer support; continuous improvement; and the next generation of Barbco. Quality at Barbco is how we design it, build it, document it, improve it, and stand behind it. If you want to help build something—and not just maintain it—we should talk. **Industry perspective** ------------------------ Research highlights the importance of QMS ownership, CAPA and root\-cause strength, audit leadership, technical drawing and fabrication literacy, and the ability to influence production. **Proficiencies** ----------------- * Quality Inspection Experience * Continuous Improvement * 5 Why (Root Cause Analysis Method) * Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) * Quality Control Experience * Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) * Precision Measurement \& Inspection * Blueprint Reading

jobs.title: Research Engineer - Voice Intelligence
jobs.description: **About Pocket** *At Pocket, we’re building the future of human memory.* Some of the most valuable information in our lives disappears when a conversation ends: an idea, a decision, a detail we wish we could remember. Pocket helps us hold onto it. We’ve built an AI\-powered device that captures real\-world conversations and turns them into searchable transcripts, summaries and next steps. Backed by Accel and Y Combinator (W26\), we’ve already sold 500,000 devices. Our ambition goes beyond recording. We believe the things you learn, discuss and experience can become useful context for the AI tools you already use, and for products that don’t exist yet. **About the Role** Real conversations are messy. People interrupt, rooms are noisy, speakers sound similar and a missed detail can change the meaning of a summary. You’ll improve the voice systems that make Pocket useful in those conditions. The work connects applied research to production: define the problem, build an evaluation, test an approach and ship what works. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About Absentia Labs** ----------------------- Absentia Labs is building the data and intelligence infrastructure that powers the next generation of biomedical discovery. We work at the intersection of biology, chemistry, machine learning, and large\-scale systems, transforming fragmented scientific data into reliable, machine\-learning\-ready knowledge. Biomedical data is dispersed, semi\-structured, and inherently noisy, yet deeply interconnected across experiments, assays, compounds, and biological systems. Extracting value from this complexity requires deliberate schema design, principled abstractions, and rigorous post\-processing pipelines that can support both scientific reasoning and large\-scale AI. We believe breakthroughs start with strong data foundations. This role sits at the architectural core of our platform, shaping how scientific data is modeled, validated, versioned, and served across the organization. **The Role** ------------ As a Senior Data Engineer, you will own the design and evolution of Absentia Labs’ biomedical data platform. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, making long\-horizon architectural decisions while remaining hands\-on in implementation. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys working in high\-ambiguity, research\-driven environments, and who understands that data engineering for AI is as much about representation and correctness as it is about scale. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Architect and lead the design of end\-to\-end data systems for large\-scale biomedical datasets (chemical, biological, toxicology, omics, assay, clinical, and experimental data). * Define and evolve schema\-driven data models that reconcile noisy, semi\-structured, and heterogeneous sources into coherent, interoperable representations. * Establish best practices for data quality, validation, provenance, lineage, and versioning suitable for scientific and ML workflows. * Build and maintain cloud\-native data infrastructure (data lakes, warehouses, object storage, streaming systems) with an emphasis on scalability and reliability. * Design pipelines that support both batch and streaming access for ML training, evaluation, and inference. * Partner closely with ML engineers, scientists, and product leads to translate research needs into durable data abstractions. * Make principled trade\-offs around performance, cost, flexibility, and correctness in production systems. * Provide technical leadership through design reviews, architectural guidance, and mentorship of other engineers. * Identify and proactively address systemic risks in data integrity, scalability, and operational complexity. **Who You Are** --------------- You are a data engineer who thinks in systems and interfaces, not just pipelines. You are comfortable owning poorly defined problems and converging on robust solutions through thoughtful design and iteration. You understand that biomedical data is rarely “clean,” and that schema design, normalization, and semantics are first\-order engineering problems—especially in AI\-driven settings. **You Likely Have** ------------------- * 5\+ years of experience in data engineering, platform engineering, or ML infrastructure roles, with clear ownership of production systems. * Proven experience designing and operating large\-scale, production\-grade data pipelines. * Strong proficiency in Python and data\-centric software engineering practices. * Deep experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including storage, compute, and security primitives. * Familiarity with distributed data processing and orchestration systems (e.g., Spark, Beam, Ray, Airflow, Dagster). * Experience supporting ML/AI workloads, including dataset generation, feature pipelines, and reproducible training workflows. * Strong architectural judgment and the ability to communicate technical decisions clearly across disciplines. **Bonus If You Have** --------------------- * Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity participation, allows you to share directly in the long\-term success and growth of the company. * Prior work with biomedical or life\-science data (e.g., omics, assays, molecular representations, clinical or toxicology data). * Experience with streaming platforms (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Kinesis). * Exposure to ontology\-aware data modeling or schema evolution in scientific domains. * Infrastructure\-as\-code and systems experience (Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes). * Experience in early\-stage startups or research\-heavy environments. * Open\-source contributions or technical publications. **What We Offer** ----------------- * A chance to architect the data backbone of an AI\-driven biomedical platform. * Direct impact on how scientific data is translated into machine intelligence. * High autonomy, high trust, and ownership over critical systems. * Flexible remote or hybrid work arrangements. * A deeply technical, low\-ego culture focused on learning and rigor. **How to Apply** ---------------- Please submit your resume and a short note on why this role resonates with you. Links to GitHub, technical writing, or relevant projects are encouraged. Compensation Range: $115K \- $200K

Join us in shaping the future of logistics technology, where your skills and dedication matter every day. **Who Your Internal Customers Are and How This Role Delivers Value to Them:** * **Leadership Team:** You translate strategic priorities into practical AI and technology solutions, giving leadership clear o able, and easy to use, you create products that meet and exceed their expectations. decision\-making across NewMile. * Integrate AI capabilities (LLM APIs, retrieval/RAG, tool use, Model Context Protocol and similar frameworks) into our web, mobile, and API services. * Build in evaluation, monitoring, and guardrails so AI features are accurate, secure, cost\-effective, and trustworthy in production. **Architect a robust, scalable, AI\-ready platform.** * Design and develop jobs.description: **Solution Sales Engineer** =========================== **About Revenova** ------------------ Revenova is a Chicago\-based provider of cloud transportation management solutions and the only TMS fully built on Salesforce. Since 2014, freight brokers, 3PLs, carriers and shippers have used Revenova to bring CRM, AI and logistics together on one platform. The platform covers load building and real\-time quoting with Artimus AI, lane and rate analytics with LaneIQ and RateIQ, carrier and fleet management, real\-time freight tracking, customer portals, accounting integration and advanced reporting. It supports multimodal freight, including LTL, FTL, flatbed, bulk and drayage, and connects with partners such as DAT, project44, Samsara and Cleo. **About the Role** ------------------ **Location:** Remote This is a dedicated Solution Sales Engineer role. You will be a trusted advisor to our prospects, the industry expert on our new business deals, and the bridge between Sales, Implementation and Product. Account Executives lead the discovery call and overview demo, then bring you in to take the conversation deeper. From there, you partner with them through close, so they can focus on running the deal while you prove how Revenova solves the prospect's problems. This is a consultative sale. You stay with each deal through long sales cycles, often three to six months, and act as an advisor, not just a technical resource, who shows prospects their future state in Revenova. Across teams, you make sure scope is clear before signing so Implementation can deliver on time, and you bring what you hear from prospects back to Product to help shape the roadmap. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Lead in\-depth, consultative sessions after the overview demo to uncover the root cause of each prospect’s operational and business pain (Critical Business Issues and Impact of those issues) * Turn those findings into a value\-based story and deliver tailored, in\-depth demos in the prospect's own language and industry context * Partner with Account Executives on deal strategy, technical positioning and next steps from the overview demo through close * Lead the preparation of Objectives Findings for the prospect highlighting what we learned, path to signature, assessment of critical issues and impact and how Revenova will uniquely solve those challenges to differentiate from competitors * Respond quickly to late\-stage needs, including follow\-up demos, executive presentations, and SOW and scope questions * Define accurate scope for each deal and provide a clean handoff to the implementation team * Track competitors' products and positioning so every demo addresses the alternatives a prospect is weighing * Serve as the bridge between Sales, Implementation and Product, sharing prospect feedback, scope details and market trends with each team * Help Account Executives build product and industry knowledge through enablement and coaching **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * 3\+ years of experience as a Solutions Engineer or Sales Engineer at a B2B or SaaS company, delivering software demos and/or supporting the full sales cycle * A consultative, trusted\-advisor approach, with the curiosity to keep asking questions until the real problem is clear * Strong presentation skills, with a track record of value\-based demos that lead with outcomes instead of features * Experience supporting complex, high\-value deals with sales cycles of three months or longer * The ability to manage several active deals at once and respond on the prospect's timeline * Clear communication with audiences from operations staff to executives **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience with Salesforce, including configuration or administration * Hands\-on knowledge of how freight brokerages, trucking companies and/or shippers operate day to day * Experience with TMS platforms and the transportation, broker and logistics workflows they support * Familiarity with consultative selling methods * Knowledge of freight accounting, carrier management or load quoting tools * Prior work in a hands\-on operational role at a brokerage, carrier or shipper **How Success Is Measured** --------------------------- * Win rates of greater than 50% on the deals you support * Average deal size of greater than $150,000 ARR on enterprise opportunities and \~$50,000 ARR on SMB * Clear, accurate scope at signing that leads to achievable expectations for the Revenova implementation team with achievable on\-time go\-lives * Strong partnership with Account Executives, who rely on you as a trusted advisor to their prospects * Prospects who see clear business value in Revenova before they buy

jobs.description: **Job Requirements** **Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product \& Technology** Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product \& Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world\-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. **Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here:** * **Building the future of Disney’s media:** Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. * **Reach, Scale \& Impact:** More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. This includes product engineering, media engineering, quality assurance, engineering behind personalization, commerce, lifecycle, and identity. **Job Summary:** Pixie and Pulse are the analytics platform that people across Disney\+, Hulu, and ESPN use to understand the business, from an analyst checking a metric to executives deciding what to do next. You'll be a senior engineer building it: the services and integration layer that turn our BI and data\-warehouse stack into trustworthy metrics, the APIs on top of them, and the React front end where that work becomes dashboards leaders act on every day. The platform is purpose\-built so data\-rich dashboards load fast, stay correct, and can be assembled and changed through configuration rather than one\-off code. Most of the job is core product and platform engineering: new metric and dashboard surfaces, the config and schema system behind them, the data integrations that feed them, performance under dashboard\-shaped traffic, and the correctness guarantees that let an executive trust a number. More people now start from a natural\-language question and let agents help assemble, explain, and explore the data, with people in the loop on what ships, and you'll help build those surfaces alongside everything else. You'll own significant features and components across that stack, taking them from ambiguous problem to production and ongoing operation. Evolve a configuration and schema\-driven system that lets new dashboards and metrics ship through config and CI validation rather than bespoke code, treating product surfaces as data. **Metrics, data integration, and trust** Build and extend the metric and dashboard surfaces the business runs on, from the query and semantic layer through to what renders on screen. Make correctness a property of the system, not a manual check: consistent metric definitions, validation in CI, and the observability to catch a number that has quietly gone wrong before a stakeholder does. **Design and technical judgment** Make and document the design decisions in your area (service boundaries, API contracts, data models, caching, state, rendering), and bring the ones with wider blast radius to the team's lead and principal engineers for review. Preferred Qualifications * Hands\-on experience building with LLMs or agents in a production product, for example natural\-language querying, agent\-driven insight generation, or prompt\-to\-dashboard. * Production experience with Python and/or Java services, data tooling, or integrations at meaningful scale. * Shipped production applications with high availability and throughput on a cloud platform (e.g., AWS), including the operational side. * Familiarity with BI and data\-warehouse stacks (e.g., Looker/LookML, Snowflake, Databricks) and partnering with data and analytics teams. * Experience with data visualization at scale: charting, large and high\-cardinality datasets, interactive and filterable dashboards. * Experience with configuration\-driven or schema\-driven systems (product defined as data or "as code"). * Working understanding of web accessibility (WCAG) fundamentals. * Broad knowledge of web and back\-end platform standards and emerging technologies. jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer, Conversational Agents
jobs.description: AssistCall, a product of Starling Global, builds AI receptionist and business calling software. The product connects live conversations with business information, appointments and human handoffs. In this role, you will improve the reliability, quality and operation of the systems behind those conversations. THE OPPORTUNITY You will lead the engineering of agent behavior across real\-time conversations, tool execution, retrieval and human handoff. This is a hands\-on staff role for someone who can turn an ambiguous product problem into a measured system, explain its failure modes, and carry it through production. The work includes distinguishing dialogue failures from telephony failures, controlling side effects, preserving tenant boundaries and measuring task completion beyond a convincing demo. INITIAL PRIORITIES * Establish a baseline for answer latency, interruption handling, task completion, incorrect tool execution and cost per successful call. * Ship a bounded workflow with explicit action permissions, confirmation rules, idempotent execution and a recoverable human handoff. * Build replayable evaluations and release criteria, then document a production incident or failed experiment with the evidence behind the fix. TECHNICAL CONTEXT Relevant experience includes real\-time model APIs, speech pipelines, retrieval systems, typed tool execution, event\-driven services and observability. Experience with WebRTC, SIP or telephony is useful. We evaluate architecture choices through measurements rather than assuming one vendor or orchestration framework is always appropriate. COMPENSATION US$220,000–285,000 per year (base salary). This is the expected base salary range for this role. An offer within the range is based on relevant skills, experience, the scope of the role and internal equity. Any separately offered bonus, equity or benefits are not included in this base salary range. WORK ARRANGEMENT Remote within the United States. Full\-time employee role. Working hours and any role\-specific operational coverage will be discussed during hiring. HOW WE HIRE Apply to this role through Indeed. Our hiring team can invite you into the AssistCall application process after reviewing your application. Share a résumé and a concise account of relevant work; public project, publication and portfolio links are optional. You can choose a recorded 15\-minute technical conversation with Ava, our AI interviewer, or request a human interview. Ava collects and transcribes answers for people to review; these technical roles do not use automated hiring scores, rankings or recommendations. Human reviewers determine next steps, which may include a project discussion, system\-design conversation or bounded role\-relevant exercise. Do not disclose confidential employer material or customer data. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY AND ACCESSIBILITY AssistCall considers applicants based on job\-related qualifications without unlawful discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or other status protected by applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available in the application process as required by law. Contact hello@assistcall.ai for hiring support, an alternative interview format or accommodation; no diagnosis is required in the initial request. We do not request salary history. See https://career.assistcall.ai/hiring\-process and https://assistcall.ai/privacy for information about application processing. RESPONSIBILITIES * Design dialogue state, structured tool contracts, retrieval boundaries and durable workflow state for live voice agents. * Implement cancellation, retries, timeouts and idempotency across model requests, telephony events and external business APIs. * Build evaluation sets from consented, appropriately handled examples; prevent train/test leakage and track scenario coverage. * Separate model reasoning from execution authority, including confirmation before payments, account changes and other consequential actions. * Diagnose latency across speech detection, model inference, tool calls and audio playback using traces and reproducible experiments. * Lead design reviews and mentor engineers while continuing to write and operate production code. QUALIFICATIONS * Deep production experience building LLM applications or conversational agents with measurable reliability requirements. * Strong Python or TypeScript engineering, asynchronous systems, API design and automated testing. * Practical experience with tool calling, structured outputs, retrieval, prompt\-injection defenses and evaluation design. * Ability to reason about state machines, distributed failure, authorization and multitenant isolation. * Evidence of leading a substantial technical project from design through production and operational follow\-through. * A degree in a relevant field or equivalent demonstrable professional experience; a specific degree is not required. Pay: $220,000\.00 \- $285,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote
