jobs.title: Lab & Integration Lead
jobs.description: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. **About the Team** Platform Engineering \& Integration (PEI) is the Chief Engineering integration function that brings strong subsystems together into a deployable platform. PEI owns the seams: platform architecture coherence, cross\-domain interfaces, integration risk, verification strategy, configuration maturity and readiness evidence across multiple autonomous airpower programs. The Platform Integration pillar owns the integration roadmap and its sequencing, the integration environments, the integrated build, and readiness for test and flight. We treat laboratories and rigs as capacity, not only as usage, and the most valuable thing we can say about any environment is what it actually proves and, explicitly, what it does not. **About the Role** You will be the technical lead for the integration lab fleet behind our flagship autonomous air vehicle: software\-in\-the\-loop and hardware\-in\-the\-loop rigs for vehicle management, flight controls and mission systems, plus an iron bird with hydraulics, loaded actuation and power. The fleet is being built and brought up now, on dates the first\-flight path depends on, and it will carry every software release through production lots. This is a player\-coach role with design authority. You will spend real time at the bench, hold the design bar for every rig, and lead a small team of lab and integration engineers. Rig build, operation and sustainment teams execute the hardware; software V\&V runs qualification tests; Test owns test execution; functional teams own their LRUs. You own the lab as a system: its architecture, its configuration, its capacity and its readiness. What you build on this program becomes the lab playbook the next program inherits. **What You'll Do** * **Own the lab architecture and rig design.** Define and baseline the lab architecture: rig block diagrams, lab network, HITL host and simulation, data recording, and the rig interfaces (rig\-to\-LRU, rig\-to\-sim, rig\-to\-ground\-station). Provide design oversight of every rig build, reviewing chassis, rack, power, harness and hydraulic interface designs before material is released, so rigs are built to an architecture rather than assembled one at a time. * **Lead bring\-up at the bench.** Be hands\-on through first light of each rig: safe\-to\-mate, power\-on and BIT, LRU checkout, and host/sim reference\-scenario runs. Debug across hardware, harness, network and software boundaries, and teach the team to do the same. * **Define what "operational" means.** Own a single rig operational\-readiness checklist, agreed with the build team, and run the readiness review before any rig is declared operational. Pre\-define fallback configurations (engineering LRUs, predecessor rigs) and the trigger for using them when a dependency slips. * **Keep every rig under configuration control.** Baseline each rig's configuration (LRU part and serial numbers, software and firmware versions, harness revisions, sim and model versions) with Configuration Management, audit it before the first for\-record run, and record as\-tested configuration for every formal run. Problems are discussed against a named build, not against someone's bench. * **Own lab capacity and the integrated lab schedule.** Model rig\-hours demanded against rig\-hours available by month. Build and run the integrated, rig\-by\-week schedule across software qualification, mission systems integration, iron bird integration and flight\-test support, and run the weekly Lab \& Integration board that resolves conflicts and closes decisions. * **Allocate hardware to rigs.** Own the LRU allocation plan, assigning engineering, qualification and flight LRUs to each rig, agreed with the avionics and mission systems teams, and keep it current as deliveries move. * **Say what each environment proves.** Set rig fidelity, the simulation and model validation approach, and test data capture standards. With Platform Verification \& Readiness, allocate verification between lab, aircraft and analysis so lab evidence is traceable to requirements and its limits are stated. * **Run integration on the rigs.** Set integration entry and exit criteria for each software release, run daily integration triage across software, avionics, mission systems and lab iss sified lab accreditation experience (RMF / ATO, JSIG) and familiarity with TEMPEST and secure lab design. * Experience standing up a multi\-rig lab from scratch with several builds in flight at once. * Lab automation and continuous integration on HIL rigs: automated regression, test frameworks and results dashboards. * Familiarity with MIL\-STD\-704, MIL\-STD\-461, and linking verification evidence to a system model. * Flight test or ground test support experience on a developmental aircraft program. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees, including: ### **Benefits** At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.* ### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams** Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information. To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind: * **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates. * **Please always verify communications:** + Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address. + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. * **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links. * **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts. ### **Data Privacy** To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant\-privacy\-notice/. By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third\-party service provider to conduct pre\-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third\-party service provider provides risk\-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public\-record information, and other lawful open\-source or commercial data sources. This third\-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Applied Scientist, Engineering
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** ------------------ The Discovery team at Anthropic is organized around the north star goal of building an AI scientist – a system capable of solving the long\-term reasoning challenges and basic capabilities necessary to push the scientific and technological frontier. We're expanding our work on engineering and the applied sciences. Our goal is to contribute to training Claude to invent, design, and engineer across every discipline and scale, reliably and safely: new manufacturing and experimental techniques, processes, materials, devices, instruments, machines, energy systems, and factories. We want this work to accelerate science and technology and benefit people widely. We're seeking exceptional researchers with deep expertise in one or more of these areas. In this role, you'll work at the intersection of frontier AI and your field, developing rigorous methods to measure and improve Claude's performance on complex engineering and scientific tasks. You'll collaborate closely with researchers, engineers, and partners across Anthropic and industry to build AI systems that can engage in all phases of research and development, and to test Claude's designs against real\-world feedback. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ * Design and implement evaluation methodologies for assessing AI model capabilities relevant to engineering and applied science research and applications * Design realistic tasks and training environments, and curate data from your field * Develop and validate simulations and computational tools for your field, and calibrate them against real\-world data * Work with industry partners, manufacturers, and labs to build and test what Claude invents, designs, and engineers, and bring that real\-world feedback into evaluation and training * Think through how Claude's engineering capabilities can permeate the real world: where they can have the most impact across industry and research, and what it takes to get them adopted * Advise the team on which problems, tools, and workflows matter most in your field * Collaborate with domain experts and partners to establish benchmarks and gather high\-quality data for training * Translate between engineering domain knowledge and machine learning objectives **Minimum qualifications** -------------------------- * Deep expertise and hands\-on R\&D or industry experience in an engineering or applied science discipline, such as mechanical, electrical, materials, chemical, aerospace, structural, industrial, or manufacturing engineering; applied physics; computational simulation * Experience with AI or machine learning, whether evaluating and training AI systems or applying these tools in your field * Track record of taking work from concept through to a working result, such as a product, process, device, experiment, or tool * Hands\-on proficiency with the computational design, analysis, or simulation tools used in your field * Basic programming proficiency, for example in Python * Ability to navigate ambiguity and develop solutions in a rapidly evolving research environment * Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with cross\-functional teams, and to explain your field clearly to people outside it * Commitment to using AI to accelerate engineering and scientific progress while maintaining high ethical standards **Preferred qualifications** ---------------------------- * 5\+ years of hands\-on R\&D or industry experience in an engineering or applied science discipline * Ph.D. in an engineering or applied science field, or equivalent industry experience * Industry experience in product design and manufacturing, or in developing engineering or scientific simulation software * Breadth across more than one discipline, or across several stages of the path from design to production * Familiarity with modern AI model training methods * Track record of building high\-fidelity solvers or simulation engines that were validated against real\-world data and used in practice * Experience working with manufacturers, vendors, contract research organizations, or academic labs * Experience managing data pipelines and working with large\-scale technical datasets * Publications, patents, or contributions to open\-source scientific or engineering software The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $320,000 \- $405,000 USD **Logistics** ------------- **Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Senior Principal Engineer - FW/SW Development
jobs.description: Astera Labs (NASDAQ: ALAB) provides rack\-scale AI infrastructure through purpose\-built connectivity solutions. As a Senior Principal / Distinguished Engineer, you'll operate across the full stack — from low\-level embedded firmware running on custom silicon to higher\-level software tools and frameworks that enable our customers to deploy and manage Astera Labs products at scale. You'll work at the intersection of hardware and software, collaborating closely with ASIC design, verification, applications, and systems engineering teams to deliver world\-class solutions spanning PCIe, CXL, and Ethernet connectivity. connectivity ASICs, including boot code, initialization sequences, and runtime firmware + Design and implement host\-side software, drivers, and SDK components that enable seamless integration of Astera Labs products into customer platforms + Define firmware/software architecture strategies that scale across multiple product lines and generations * **Cross\-Functional Technical Leadership** + Partner with ASIC design and verification teams to define hardware\-firmware interfaces and co\-design features for optimal system performance + Drive technical decisions spanning firmware, diagnostic tools, manufacturing software, and customer\-facing utilities + Collaborate with applications and field engineering teams to resolve complex system\-level issues at customer sites * **Quality \& Best Practices** + Establish and evolve firmware/software development processes, coding standards, and CI/CD practices across the engineering organization + Lead design and code reviews, driving a culture of engineering excellence and continuous improvement + Mentor and guide engineers across multiple teams, raising the overall technical bar of the organization * **Innovation \& Strategy** + Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to inform next\-generation firmware/software strategies + Contribute to product roadmap discussions, providing firmware/software feasibility analysis and effort estimation + Drive innovation in areas such as firmware update mechanisms, telemetry, RAS features, and manageability frameworks **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field * 12\+ years of experience in firmware and/or software development for semiconductor or systems companies * Strong proficiency in C and C\+\+ for embedded and systems\-level programming * Experience developing firmware for ARM\-based SoCs or custom ASIC platforms * Deep understanding of hardware\-software interfaces, register programming, and low\-level debug techniques * Experience with high\-speed interconnect protocols such as PCIe, CXL, or Ethernet at the firmware/driver level **Preferred Qualifications** * Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field * Experience with RTOS\-based and bare\-metal firmware development environments * Proficiency in Python for automation, tooling, and test development * Familiarity with Linux kernel development, device drivers, or platform firmware (UEFI/BIOS) * Track record of leading firmware/software efforts from architecture through production across multiple product generations * Experience in the data center, AI/ML infrastructure, or high\-performance computing domains The salary range for this position is $180,000 to $250,000 depending on experience, level, and business need. This role may be eligible for discretionary bonus, incentives and benefits. We know that creativity and innovation happen more often when teams include diverse ideas, backgrounds, and experiences, and we actively encourage everyone with relevant experience to apply, including people of color, LGBTQ\+ and non\-binary people, veterans, parents, and individuals with disabilities.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Incentives
jobs.description: **About Us** Hello, we're Augeo – we are a global leader in enterprise\-level engagement and loyalty platform technology, delivering compelling experiences and fostering meaningful connections for employees, consumers, members and channel partners across many industries and verticals. We serve hundreds of clients, including 70\+ Fortune 500 companies, representing millions of end users. We are thought leaders and disruptors who think differently and creatively, built by entrepreneurs, operators and innovators. At Augeo, we're passionate about providing an inclusive workplace that values diversity and our sustainability initiatives. Everyone is welcome \- our employees are comfortable bringing their authentic whole selves to work. Be you, reach your full potential. We work hard, we play hard and, most importantly, we care to our core about our teams and each other. We over\-communicate around everything… especially while we navigate our new hybrid world. **Summary** Augeo's Applied AI team builds THEO, the orchestration and intelligence layer behind the reward, recognition, incentive and advocacy programs our clients run. We are hiring a Product Manager to own the Incentives domain: the THEO capability set that brings intelligence and automation to performance incentive programs, enabling organizations to configure programs, evaluate participant performance, identify earned outcomes, and orchestrate rewards and payouts at scale. Today, THEO Reward capabilities power personalized reward search, discovery, and redemption in client marketplaces, with recommendations from an ML model trained on more than four million interactions. Within the next six to twelve months we expect to be in market with both THEO Incentives and THEO Recognition capabilities supporting new and existing clients, alongside continued expansion of personalized rewards and offers. The Applied AI team is organized into four capability pods. (1\) Intelligence/ML has a product manager and an AI architect/data scientist. (2\) Rewards, (3\) Recognition, and (4\) Incentives each have a product manager and an AI architect. You would lead the Incentives pod with the Incentives AI Architect and partner most closely with Intelligence/ML on the models and signals behind incentive decisions. THEO sits at Augeo's core, and its capabilities are built for every business unit rather than rebuilt inside each one. An incentive program for a Workplace client runs on the same THEO capability as an incentive program for an Advocacy client. This role works across all of Augeo's business units to identify shared requirements and to maintain the boundary between what THEO owns and what each unit builds on top of it. **Key Responsibilities** * Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Incentives domain, from problem discovery through shipped, measured outcomes. Your primary success metric is incremental engagement per reward dollar: more of the behavior a client is paying for, at a lower cost per action * Alongside our Intelligence and ML team, define how AI and ML models select, personalize, and sequence incentives (rewards, points, offers) to maximize engagement and program ROI for clients and partners * Partner with data science and engineering to specify the incentive decisioning engine: the inputs it draws from THEO's user profiles and behavioral signals, model evaluation criteria, and production quality bars * Translate incentive economics (budgets, redemption rates, breakage, partner cost structures) into product requirements that balance member value with program sustainability * Design and prioritize the incentive catalog and configuration experience so clients and partners can launch and manage programs with minimal manual overhead * Build the experimentation practice for incentives, using holdout tests and uplift modeling to measure what a reward actually caused rather than what merely correlated with it. Prove which incentive strategies change behavior, and kill the ones that don't * Evaluate where generative AI and agentic workflows can automate incentive content generation, catalog curation, or program configuration, then ship the highest\-leverage ones first * Turn client, partner, and internal stakeholder needs into precise, prioritized requirements with clear success metrics * Ensure incentive products meet privacy, consent, and data governance requirements across enterprise client environments * Represent the Incentives pod in cross\-team planning, clearly communicating tradeoffs, risks, and progress to engineering, design, and commercial leadership **What Sets You Up For Success** **Required Qualifications:** * 2–4 years of product management experience, including owning features from definition through launch and iteration. * Product fundamentals: writing clear requirements, prioritizing a backlog against limited engineering capacity, running discovery, and defining success metrics before you build. * Experience working on data\- or ML\-driven products, such as ranking, recommendations, personalization, or pricing, and comfort with a fast build\-measure\-learn cycle with frequent experimentation. * Working knowledge of AI/ML concepts and a desire to go deeper: you can work with data scientists and engineers on model evaluation, prompting, and system design without being an ML engineer yourself. * Analytical rigor: comfortable defining metrics, digging into data, and making prioritization calls from evidence rather than opinion. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience contributing to a generative AI or LLM\-based feature in production. * Experience with loyalty, rewards, incentive, or engagement platforms. * Exposure to experimentation and personalization methods such as A/B or holdout testing, uplift modeling, or recommendation systems. * Familiarity with incentive and reward program economics, such as points liability, breakage, or redemption modeling. * Hands\-on use of AI\-powered development and prototyping tools (e.g., Claude Code) to accelerate product discovery and delivery. **Benefits Of Joining Team Augeo** * We offer Medical, Dental and Vision coverage with additional perks through third party vendors offering more virtual and in person care at your fingertips (must be in select locations) * We offer paid Long\-Term disability and Life Insurance * HSA/FSA plans * We offer varying voluntary benefits such as critical, hospital, pet coverage and much more * Employee benefit education, campaigns and wellness opportunities * 401k retirement matching and financial planning resources * Education reimbursement * Several EAP resources * 13 paid holidays and PTO time * Rewards, incentives and gamification for birthdays, Work\-aversery's, professional and personal milestones, company involvement and kudos * Employee referral bonuses * Employee group opportunities * Fun, casual and flexible working environment that embraces the hybrid workstyle * Career growth opportunities Augeo is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.description: Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy\-grow\-and\-hold\-for\-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world. **About the role** ================== **Forward Deployed Engineer, Applied AI** Medicat builds MedicatOne, the EHR used by college health and counseling centers across the US. Banyan Software acquires and grows vertical software companies like ours, and we're investing in AI that reaches clinicians and students in production. This is an engineering role first. You will write production code most days: LLM integrations, automations, data workflows and the APIs that connect them to MedicatOne. You'll also sit close to our clinic customers and internal teams, turning what you see in their workflows into working software, often in days, not quarters. If you're happiest owning a roadmap and writing specs for others to build, this isn't the role. If you want to be the person who ships the feature, debugs it with the customer on the call, and hardens it for HIPAA, keep reading. **What you'll do** ================== Expect roughly 70% hands\-on engineering and 30% embedded with customers and internal teams. * **Build and ship AI features end to end.** Design, code, test and deploy LLM\-powered features in MedicatOne: prompt design, tool calling, retrieval where it earns its place, and evaluation harnesses. * **Pick the simplest reliable solution.** Sometimes that's an LLM, often it's plain code. * **Integrate with real clinical data.** Write the services, SQL and data pipelines that move PHI safely between MedicatOne, customer systems and model providers. * **Deploy alongside customers.** Join clinic implementation and discovery calls as the technical lead, scope what can be built, prototype against their data, and stay through go\-live. * **Embed with internal teams.** Find and automate repetitive work, and help analysts and developers get the most out of AI tools. * **Own production quality.** Instrument, monitor and debug what you ship: latency, cost, accuracy and failure modes. Write evals so regressions are caught before customers see them. * **Make AI safe for healthcare.** Implement HIPAA\-compliant patterns for PHI handling, logging, access control, de\-identification and vendor data boundaries. * **Harden internal tools.** Review and productionize AI tools built by non\-engineering teams before they touch customer data. * **Feed the roadmap with evidence.** Bring back what you learned in the field as working prototypes and technical recommendations, not slide decks. **What you bring** ================== * **3\+ years as a software engineer** shipping production code in B2B SaaS, with an individual\-contributor track record. You still write code every week. * **Strong in at least one backend language** (Python, C\#/.NET or TypeScript/Node) and comfortable reading the others. * **Hands\-on LLM API experience**: you've shipped production features on LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI), including prompt design and function/tool calling, and you know when not to use one. * **End\-to\-end system design**: you've designed a production system from the ground up, including data flow, security and multi\-tenancy. * **Solid data skills**: production SQL, schema design and data pipelines against relational databases. * **API and integration experience**: REST API design, authentication, webhooks and third\-party integrations. * **Production engineering habits**: Git, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, and deploying to a major cloud (Azure or AWS). * **Regulated or sensitive data experience**: you've built software that handles PHI, PII, financial or similarly protected data, with the access controls and audit trails it requires. * **Comfort with customers and colleagues**: you can explain a technical trade\-off to a clinic director or an analyst, then go build it. * Authorized to work in and resides in the US; we can't sponsor visas. **Nice to have** ================ * RAG, embeddings and vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone or similar), plus the judgment to know when retrieval is worth the complexity * HL7 v2, FHIR or EHR integration experience (we can teach this) * HIPAA experience specifically * Prior Forward Deployed, Solutions Engineering or implementation\-engineering experience at a software company * LLM evaluation and observability tooling (e.g., LangSmith, Langfuse, custom eval suites) * Agent frameworks or the Model Context Protocol (MCP) * College health, student health or behavioral health software * Open\-source contributions or a public portfolio of shipped AI projects Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Equal Employment Opportunity at Banyan: Banyan affirms that inequality is detrimental to our Global Teams, associates, our Operating Companies, and the communities we serve. We support an inclusive workplace where associates excel based on personal merit, qualifications, experience, ability, and job performance. **Please Note**: Banyan Software does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications submitted via email, LinkedIn, or other direct channels. All candidates must apply through our official Careers site to be considered for employment. jobs.title: Senior Staff Audio Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **Role Overview**Boston Dynamics is looking for a **Senior Staff Audio Machine Learning Engineer** to join the Spot Sensing team. In this role, your core mission will be driving the evolution of our Acoustic Change Detection (ACD) capability—taking beamformed and raw audio and turning it into actionable machinery prognostics. While **acoustic intelligence is your primary domain** , mechanical inspection on Spot is multimodal. Beyond mastering the audio pipeline, you will contribute to the integration of acoustic features with complementary modalities, such as image, video, and thermal, fusing multimodal representations with LLMs/VLMs to empower our end users with prescriptive maintenance actions, not indecipherable data. You will leverage the world’s largest fleet\-gathered industrial sensor dataset, utilizing Spot equipped with the Sorama L642 acoustic camera and SpotCAM2 . **Key Responsibilities*** **Acoustic ML \& DSP Ownership (Core Focus):** Design, refine, and scale digital signal processing and machine learning pipelines for our Acoustic Change Detection (ACD) system. * **Anomaly Detection \& Failure Classification:** Lead the improvement and modernization of our acoustic detection stack—transitioning from unsupervised models (e.g., BGMM) to state\-of\-the\-art anomaly architectures, and architecting our end\-to\-end supervised multimodal pipelines for automated fault diagnosis. * **Multimodal Integration \& Prescriptive Maintenance:** Partner with the broader Spot Apps organization to integrate acoustic insights with visual, thermal, and VLM/LLM data streams into unified machine health indicators, delivering both clear mechanical diagnoses and recommended corrective actions to plant operators. * **Industrial Deployment \& Verification:** Benchmark, optimize, ship, monitor, and continuously improve our solution for our industrial customers. **Qualifications \& Requirements** **Experience \& Domain Expertise*** **Experience:** 7\+ years of deep practical expertise in audio feature extraction, audio fingerprinting (e.g., Shazam, DMCA enforcement) and segmentation (e.g., DCASE), machine learning applied to audio data (beamformed and raw), preferably in industrial environments or another domain with similar problems, for the purposes of anomaly detection. **Technical Skills \& Hardware*** **Languages \& Core Tooling:** Advanced proficiency in Python and C\+\+, with mastery of numerical and scientific stacks (e.g., NumPy, SciPy, scikit\-learn, PyTorch). * **Acoustic Processing:** Expertise in time domain and frequency domain data analysis. * **Array Processing:** Expertise in multi\-channel array processing, including beamforming (Delay\-and\-Sum, MVDR, null\-steering), Direction of Arrival (DoA) estimation, and synthetic aperture techniques. * **Machine Learning \& Modeling Paradigms:** Expertise in unsupervised and supervised classification architectures for anomaly detection in real\-world conditions. **Bonus Points*** Hands\-on experience in cross\-modal fusion (combining audio representations with computer vision, thermal imaging, or multimodal foundation models/VLMs). * Background in rotating machinery health monitoring (bearings, gearboxes, pumps) and familiarity with mechanical vibration/acoustic failure standards. Familiarity with TypeScript/modern web services for integrating your work into Orbit, our fleet management software. * *We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position.* The base pay range for this position is between $180,000 to $220,000 annually. Base pay will depend on multiple individualized factors including, but not limited to internal equity, job related knowledge, skills and experience. This range represents a good faith estimate of compensation at the time of posting. Boston Dynamics offers a generous Benefits package including medical, dental vision, 401(k), paid time off and a annual bonus structure. Additional details regarding these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer for employment.

jobs.title: AI Product Engineer
jobs.description: At BBH, Partnership is more than a form of ownership—it’s our approach to business and relationships. We know that supporting your professional and personal goals is the best way to help our clients and advance our business. We take that responsibility seriously. With a 200\-year legacy and a shared passion for what’s next, this is the right place to build a fulfilling career. **Role Summary** The Capital Partners (CP) Artificial Intelligence (AI) Product Engineer will help convert approved AI concepts, requirements, and business needs into deployed, scalable, secure, maintainable AI\-enabled products and solutions. Working in partnership with the CP AI Strategy \& Transformation Leader, AI Design \& Enablement function, Product Owners, Business SMEs, Technology, Data, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Information Security, Change Management, Training, and Executive Leadership, this role will support the design, build, configuration, testing, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing improvement of CP's AI\-enabled products, agents, copilots, workflows, integrations, and platform capabilities. The role will be responsible for ensuring AI solutions are engineered into existing workflows where appropriate, supported by clear technical documentation, tested for readiness, aligned to approved requirements, and maintainable after release. This role serves as the bridge between AI strategy, product management, engineering, and operational deployment, helping CP move priority use cases from pilot concepts to production\-ready capabilities with measurable business value and sustainable support models. **AI Product Design \& Engineering** * Translate approved AI use cases and business requirements into solution designs, technical architectures, user interactions, system dependencies, agent configurations, integration patterns, and implementation plans. * Build, configure, test, deploy, and maintain AI\-enabled products, Copilot Studio agents, workflow automations, connectors, actions, and platform components in alignment with approved requirements. * Partner with Product Owners and Business SMEs to refine functional requirements, define user journeys, clarify acceptance criteria, and support backlog prioritization based on business value, readiness, and scalability. * Collaborate with Technology and Data teams to design and implement APIs, connectors, data access patterns, integrations, and platform capabilities needed for CP AI solutions. * Configure enterprise data connections, authentication approaches, access controls, and environment settings in partnership with appropriate technology and security teams. * Design AI\-enabled workflows that support operational processes, including future\-state workflow maps, handoffs, approvals, exception paths, human review, workflow controls, operational safeguards, and production support needs. **Technical Testing, Release Readiness \& Operational Support** * Develop and execute technical test plans, including functional testing, access testing, regression testing, integration testing, response\-quality testing, and release validation. * Document test results, defects, remediation actions, deployment dependencies, operational risks, and readiness considerations for review by appropriate stakeholders. * Provide implementation recommendations and technical tradeoff analysis relating to scalability, maintainability, usability, performance, and operational support requirements. * Prepare deployment plans, release checklists, runbooks, implementation evidence, known limitations, support requirements, and technical handoff materials to support controlled launch and sustainable operations. * Support monitoring and observability for AI\-enabled products, including usage patterns, user experience metrics, performance visibility, reliability trends, logging, exception tracking, issue triage, and support routines. * Troubleshoot grounding issues, workflow failures, connector issues, access concerns, performance defects, and production support items in partnership with AI Context Engineers and Technology teams. * Support platform enhancements and release iterations based on user feedback, monitoring results, and approved backlog priorities. **Governance, Cross\-Functional Delivery \& Continuous Improvement** * Collaborate with Information Security, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Technology, and Data partners to support secure\-by\-design implementation, approved access patterns, data protection expectations, and release practices. * Ensure technical designs, agent configurations, workflow automations, and integration approaches are documented clearly and aligned to approved requirements and operating model expectations. * Partner with the AI Design \& Enablement function to ensure new AI capabilities are accompanied by clear onboarding, communications, training inputs, and support materials. * Partner with AI Context Engineers to align solution configuration with approved knowledge sources, meta ns, technical testing, monitoring, and production support practices. * Ability to translate business requirements into buildable technical designs, backlog items, agent configurations, workflow specifications, and release artifacts. * Experience working with business, technology, data, operations, risk, compliance, legal, information security, change management, training, and leadership stakeholders. * Strong documentation skills, including solution designs, test plans, release checklists, deployment plans, runbooks, support guides, and technical decision records. * Copilot Studio agent build experience preferred. * Experience operating in regulated or complex environments is preferred. **Salary Range** $90,000 \- $130,000 base salary \+ annual bonus opportunity *BBH and its affiliates' compensation program includes base salary, discretionary bonuses, and profit\-sharing. The anticipated base salary range(s) shown above are only for the indicated location(s) and may differ in other locations due to cost of living and labor considerations. Base salaries may vary based on factors such as skill, experience and qualification for the role. BBH's total rewards package recognizes your contributions with more than just a paycheck—providing you with benefits that enhance your experience at BBH from long\-term savings, healthcare, and income protection to professional development opportunities and time off, our programs support your overall well\-being.* **We value diverse experiences.** We value diverse experiences and transferrable skillsets. If your career hasn’t followed a traditional path, includes alternative experiences, or doesn’t meet every qualification or skill listed in the job description, please do go ahead and apply. **About BBH:** Brown Brothers Harriman (BBH) is a premier global financial services firm, known for premium service, specialist expertise, technology solutions and partnership approach to client management. Across Investor Services and Capital Partners, we work with an enviable roster of sophisticated clients who make BBH their first call when they are tackling their hardest challenges. Delivering for our clients and each other energizes us. We believe that how we do our work is just as important as what we do. We are relentless problem solvers who know our best ideas come from collective debate and development—so we are never possessive about our ideas. Every day we come together as a diverse community of smart and caring people to deliver exceptional service and expert advice—creating success that lasts. No matter where you sit in the organization, everyone is empowered to contribute their ideas. BBHers can pick up the phone and call any colleague, and they are happy to help. Expanding your impact beyond your daily role is part of how we operate as trusted partners to one another. We believe stability is a competitive advantage, but being stable means having the knowledge, skill, and discipline to evolve, often—pushing the boundaries of innovation. As a private partnership, every investment we make is in the relationships, technologies, products and development we believe are in the long\-term interests of our clients and our people. Our long\-tenured leaders are experts in their areas and are actively involved in the day\-to day business, taking the time to provide guidance and mentoring to build the next generation of BBHers. Because we know, our success begins with yours. Go to BBH.com to learn more about our rewards and benefits, philanthropy, approach to sustainability or how we support you to thrive personally, physically and financially. We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, genetic information, creed, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under federal, state or local law.

jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer, Client Interfaces
jobs.description: Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. **About the Role:** The Client Interfaces team owns every surface customers and internal users touch when they use Crusoe Cloud: the Console and Admin Console, customer and admin CLIs, MCP servers, the Terraform provider, our docs, and the Intelligence Foundry / AI Studio. We're the glue between product, design, and the platform teams that power Crusoe Cloud. In 2026 our focus is *one experience, one quality bar* across every surface; a shared design system, a single API/CLI style guide extended to MCP and Terraform, and a foundation solid enough to support the polish, defaults, and micro\-interactions that make a developer cloud feel great to use. You'd be the first dedicated quality engineer on the team, and the person who defines what "one quality bar" means in practice. **What You'll Be Working On:** * **Test Strategy Ownership:** Own end\-to\-end test strategy across the Console, CLIs, Terraform provider and MCP servers. This includes Playwright E2E suites, Go\-based integration and acceptance tests (with real plan/apply/destroy lifecycles through terraform\-plugin\-testing), and contract tests against generated API clients. * **Framework Development:** Build automation frameworks from scratch and keep them reliable through parallel execution, flakiness reduction and GitHub Actions CI integration, so a red build always means a real bug. * **Cross\-Surface Consistency:** Verify that features shipping to Console, CLI, Terraform and MCP at the same time behave like one product, and build harnesses that catch drift automatically. * **Release Readiness:** Define quality gates and release criteria with engineering and product, balancing shipping speed against reliability. * **AI\-First Testing:** Use agents to generate test suites from OpenAPI specs and tickets, review AI\-generated tests to make sure the assertions are meaningful, and use AI triage to separate real failures from flakes. * **Exploratory Testing:** Cover what automation can’t, including micro\-interactions, empty states, error copy, accessibility, upgrade paths and docs that don’t match the product. * **Complex Problem Solving:** Tackle issues that span every surface, such as breaking\-change management in the Terraform provider, API contract changes that ripple through generated clients, and design system migrations. * **Coaching and Collaboration:** Help software engineers get better at test design through code review and pairing, and work directly with design, product and platform teams. * **Measurable Quality:** Turn “this should feel great to use” into concrete, testable criteria the team can build against. **What You'll Bring to the Team:** * **Quality Engineering Experience:** 5\+ years in quality engineering, test automation or SDET roles on customer\-facing products. * **Framework Building:** You’ve built, or helped build, a TypeScript automation framework from scratch and run it in CI. You can talk specifics about parallelization, retries, network interception, flakiness and what you’d do differently next time. * **Testing Beyond the Browser:** You’re comfortable testing HTTP APIs, CLIs and infrastructure tooling, and you’re willing to ramp up on Go and Terraform provider acceptance testing. * **AI Tool Fluency:** You use AI coding and testing tools (Claude Code or similar agents) every day to generate and maintain suites. You know where their output falls short and can teach others to use them well. * **Exploratory Instinct:** You find the bug the suite missed, then decide whether it’s worth automating. * **Clear Written Communication:** Your bug reports, test plans and release notes stand on their own. **Benefits:** * Competitive compensation and equity packages * Restricted Stock Units * Paid time off, paid holidays \& leave of absence programs * Comprehensive health, dental \& vision insurance * Employer contributions to HSA account * Paid parental leave * Paid life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability * Professional development \& tuition reimbursement * Mental health \& wellness support * Commuter benefits (parking \& transit) * Cell phone stipend * 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary * Volunteer time off * Global travel insurance \& emergency assistance * Daily meals allowance * Additional perks \& programs specific to location **Compensation Range** Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $170,000 \-$205,000 \+ Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: AI Engineer 4
jobs.description: AI Engineer 4 At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real\-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world\-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI \& ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world\-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high\-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build. **Team Description:** The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand\-in\-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers. Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI, in responsible and scalable ways for the highest leverage impact. **What You’ll Do:** * Partner with a cross\-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI\-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One. * Design, develop, test, deploy, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, agents and multi\-agent workflows, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc. * Leverage a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, PyTorch, and more. * Invent and introduce state\-of\-the\-art foundation model optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems. * Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One. * Own the end\-to\-end architecture for complex AI systems \- ensuring maintainability, observability, and ethical alignment * Define and maintain service\-level objectives (SLOs) for AI reliability, including latency, uptime, and model performance drift * Collaborate with infrastructure engineering to optimize GPU/TPU utilization and accelerate model inference pipelines * Lead cross\-functional technical reviews for new AI system deployments, ensuring security, data governance, and compliance standards are met * Mentor Principal and Senior Associates on scalable design, performance tuning and research\-to\-production translation **The Ideal Candidate:** * You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. ML follows best practices in Responsible and Explainable AI * Use programming languages like Python, Scala, or Java **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science, Machine operating large scale distributed systems (Spark, Ray) to prepare AI or Machine Learning data * At least 2 years of experience deploying and operating Machine Learning solutions in production and operating production services in the cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) and using Kubernetes to manage large scale containerized Machine Learning software systems **Preferred Qualifications:** * Master's or Doctoral Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or related field * 3\+ years designing, training, optimizing, and evaluating modern ML models across architectures (e.g., Transformers, CNNs, RNNs) and paradigms (supervised, unsupervised, reinforcement learning), including loss design, hyperparameter tuning, and diagnostic debugging. * 3\+ years architecting and scaling distributed, end\-to\-end ML systems, from production\-ready training/evaluation data pipelines to algorithm and infrastructure optimization. * 3\+ years managing ML workloads using Docker,
