jobs.title: Healthcare Process Engineer
jobs.description: .**POSITION OVERVIEW****:** The Healthcare Process Engineer collaborates with the Transformation Team to advance the Care Logistics mission. This involves aiding hospitals in overhauling their operations through a blend of mindset shifts, methodological approaches, and technological enhancements. The role contributes to achieving the organizational goals in Client Engagement and by also supporting Sales \& Marketing, and Product Management and Development. **ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES****:** **Client Engagement Functions** In partnership with the Executive Advisor and Solutions Engineer, drive the transformation effort for client engagements. Serve as the knowledge resource and detailed process expert for assigned client. · Participate in executive focus sessions and leader connect sessions, and present findings as needed. · Collaborate with hospital resources to implement Care Logistics' proven transformation methodology for assigned clients. · Assist with the documentation and analysis of current state processes using six sigma and lean methodologies. · Contribute to the design of future state processes and provide recommendations to achieve transformational results. · Assist in the development of Standard Operating Procedures as needed. · Provide input on application configuration to support future state recommendations. · Train client resources on process\-related aspects of the training curriculum. · Audit client's delivery of education/training for accuracy and completeness. · Support testing events to ensure that technical solutions meet expected future state and SOP targets. · Provide support during go\-live events, including operational and technical go\-lives. As a member of the Post Live Services team, assist clients who have implemented Care Logistics solutions by assessing hospital role responsibilities, processes, and technology through data analysis, observations, and interviews (visits may be onsite, remote, or a combination of both). · Assist in supporting software upgrades by updating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), participating in testing sessions, delivering training events, and providing support during go\-live events. · Conduct Post Live Visits to evaluate the impact of transformation efforts and make recommendations for further improvement. Assist in the development of transformation strategies that drive meaningful change. · Compile and analyze data to prepare executive presentations and reports presenting performance data. Ensure data accuracy and completeness, and present insights and recommendations to senior leadership. · Utilize data and analytics to evaluate client performance and identify opportunities for improvement. Collaborate with the team to develop and implement process improvement initiatives. · Provide support to Care Logistics' leadership and sales teams in managing customer accounts, and ensure ongoing customer satisfaction. Assist in the development of account management strategies and ensure timely and effective resolution of customer issues. **Product Management and Development** · Collaborate with Product Management to ensure a continuous feedback loop of subject matter expertise. Share insights on industry trends, market challenges, and customer needs to guide product development. · Conduct market research and analyze data to identify emerging trends and opportunities. Prepare reports and presentations summarizing research findings and insights. · Work with Product Management and Sales teams to clarify market problems that potential clients are facing. Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to develop solutions that address customer needs. · Act as the voice of the customer in guiding Product Management and Development teams in design decisions for technology. Provide insights and feedback to ensure products meet customer needs and expectations. **QUALIFICATIONS – EDUCATION, WORK EXPERIENCE, CERTIFICATIONS****:** **REQUIRED** * Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering or a related field * 1\-3 years of successful experience in healthcare process improvement **PREFERRED** * Healthcare business process redesign consulting experience preferred * Experience with Electronic Health Records, EHR, platforms including ADT, clinical and ordering processes preferred **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES****:** * Ability to form strong bonds and enhance team performance * Adaptability: ability to embrace change and shift focus when unexpected work arises * Time Management: ability to use discernment to prioritize tasks and decide what to focus on to maximize impact * Customer Service: ability to actively seek to understand the needs of others and provide a positive experience that addresses their needs, questions, and concerns * Strong organizational and quality management skills with ability to handle multiple, competing tasks and priorities * Strong interpersonal skills with ability to effectively communicate with a diverse group of stakeholders (prospects, clients, hospital executives, nurses, implementation staff, etc.) * Ability to maintain confidentiality, and use discretion * Able to effectively represent Jackson Healthcare/Care Logistics values and principles in decision\-making and actions * Healthcare business process redesign consulting experience required **TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS \& WORKING CONDITIONS****:** · 30\-70% travel required · The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job · Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions · While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; write; type; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; talk or hear; and smell · Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus Pay: From $81,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Referral program * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * How many years of healthcare process improvement experience do you have? * Do you have client\-facing support experience where you have led client discussions or sessions? * Will you now, or in the future, require sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g. H\-1B visa status)? Education: * Bachelor's (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Alpharetta, GA 30009

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** At Genworth and CareScout, we're on a mission to simplify and dignify the aging experience. The truth is, most of us will help a parent, spouse, family member, friend, or neighbor navigate aging and care at some point in our lives. We've been there ourselves. That's why we're building better ways to help people find, fund, and understand aging care all while being supported every step of the way. We're a team of curious problem\-solvers, compassionate listeners, and people who care about making a difference. We value diverse perspectives and are committed to fostering an inclusive culture where every team member feels respected, supported, and empowered to bring their authentic self. Our four values guide our strategy, our decisions, and our interactions: * **Make it human.** We care about the people that make up our customers, colleagues, and communities. * **Make it about others** . We do what’s best for our customers and collaborate to drive progress. * **Make it happen.** We work with intention toward a common purpose and forge ways forward together. * **Make it better.** We create fulfilling purpose\-driven careers by learning from the world and each other. If you’re looking to build a meaningful career while helping transform the aging experience for millions of families, we’d love to hear from you. **POSITION TITLE** Lead Software Engineer **POSITION LOCATION** Remote US (Eastern/Central Time) This position is available to Virginia residents as Richmond, Virginia in\-office applicants or remote applicants residing in states/locations under Eastern or Central Standard Time: Alabama, Arkansas, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, Washington DC, Vermont, West Virginia or Wisconsin. **YOUR ROLE** We are seeking a highly experienced and driven **Lead Software Engineer** to lead the modernization of our Assessment platform. This role requires deep expertise in modern software development practices, a passion for emerging technologies, and the ability to provide strong technical leadership and mentorship. You will play a critical role in shaping the future of the platform, ensuring it is scalable, resilient, secure, and maintainable for long\-term growth. **What you will be doing** * Responsibilities + Architect and implement a modern Assessment platform using technologies such as TypeScript, React, React Native, Flutter, and GraphQL. + Establish and champion best\-in\-class engineering practices to ensure systems are modular, scalable, resilient, and flexible. + Define and enforce coding standards, architectural patterns, and quality metrics to maintain high engineering standards. + Lead technical design discussions, perform code reviews, and provide hands\-on guidance across the engineering team. + Design and implement CI/CD pipelines and contribute to DevSecOps practices. Contribute to platform hosting, deployment, and runtime strategies, ensuring reliability and performance at scale. + * Deliverables / Results + A modernized, production\-ready Assessment platform supporting both B2B and B2C use cases. + Well\-documented, maintainable codebases aligned with agreed architectural standards. + Consistent, repeatable deployments enabled by standardized CI/CD pipelines. + Improved system performance, reliability, and scalability across web and mobile platforms. Strong technical foundations that support future feature development and platform expansion. + * Impact / Value Add + Raise the technical bar across the organization by modeling engineering excellence and best practices. + Reduce long\-term technical debt through thoughtful architecture and disciplined execution. + Accelerate delivery by enabling teams to build on a stable, scalable platform. + Improve customer and partner experiences through reliable, high\-quality applications. + Enable the business to confidently scale assessments, integrations, and transaction volumes. * Ownership + Own the technical vision and architecture of the Assessment platform. + Serve as a key decision\-maker for technology choices, architectural trade\-offs, and implementation approaches. + Take accountability for platform quality, performance, and long\-term sustainability. + Identify and proactively address technical risks, scalability challenges, and architectural gaps. * Collaboration + Partner closely with Product Managers and business stakeholders to translate requirements into robust technical solutions. + Collaborate with engineering peers, mobile and web teams, and shared services to ensure architectural alignment. + Mentor and coach engineers, fostering a culture of learning, quality, and continuous improvement. Work cross\-functionally with s bilities. The ability to anticipate technical risks and proactively design solutions before issues surface at scale. + * Qualities + Hands\-on technical leader who leads by example and is comfortable operating at both strategic and implementation levels. + Curious, pragmatic, and outcomes\-driven, with a passion for continuous learning and improvement. + Clear and confident communicator who can influence technical direction across teams and stakeholders. + Resilient and adaptable in fast\-moving environments, with a strong bias toward action and accountability. Collaborative mentor who elevates the capabilities and confidence of other engineers. + * Education + Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Advanced degree is a plus but not required. + * Skills + Expert\-level proficiency in modern application development, including: - TypeScript, Node.js, Next.js - React, React Native, Flutter - Swift and Kotlin + Strong experience designing and consuming GraphQL and REST\-based APIs. + Deep understanding of database design and performance, with hands\-on experience using PostgreSQL and MongoDB. + Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and contributing to DevSecOps practices. + Strong knowledge of mobile application delivery across iOS and Android, including release and store lifecycle management. + Familiarity with event\-driven and asynchronous systems, including messaging and queue\-based architectures. Experience integrating with third\-party platforms such as SSO providers, payment systems, and eCommerce services. + * Competencies + Platform and systems architecture + Technical decision\-making and trade\-off analysis + Code quality, testing strategies, and maintainability + Performance, scalability, and reliability engineering + Security\-aware design and implementation + Technical mentorship and engineering excellence + Cross\-team technical alignment and influence * Experience + 10\+ years of professional software development experience, with a significant portion in senior, staff, or principal\-level roles. + Proven success delivering large\-scale, high\-impact platforms in production environments. + Experience building B2B APIs, B2B portals, and assessment or transaction\-based systems. + Hands\-on experience with real\-time or near\-real\-time systems, including video or communication platforms. + Experience building and operating mobile applications with demonstrated adoption and quality outcomes. Track record of partnering effectively with product, design, and business stakeholders to deliver meaningful results. + **ADDITIONAL INFORMATION** National Range: $120,900 \- $187,000 NYC Range: $151,100 \- $234,000 Disclaimer: This role will be located in New York City. Actual compensation will vary based on geographic location, experience, skills, and other job\-related factors. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible to participate in a bonus incentive plan. Incentive compensation is based on individual and company performance and is not guaranteed. **ADDITIONAL** This role is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship. * **Employee Benefits \& Well\-Being** Genworth employees make a difference in people’s lives every day. We’re committed to making a difference in our employees’ lives. * Competitive Compensation \& Total Rewards Incentives * Comprehensive Healthcare Coverage * Multiple 401(k) Savings Plan Options * Auto Enrollment in Employer\-Directed Retirement Account Feature (100% employer\-funded!) * Generous Paid Time Off – Including 12 Paid Holidays, Volunteer Time Off and Paid Family Leave * Disability, Life, and Long Term Care Insurance * Tuition Reimbursement, Student Loan Repayment and Training \& Certification Support * Wellness support including gym membership reimbursement and Employee Assistance Program resources (work/life support, financial \& legal management) * Caregiver and Mental Health Support Services

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: Cascade Dafo, Inc is a manufacturing company located in Ferndale, WA that specializes in providing custom DAFOs (Dynamic Ankle Foot Orthosis) to patients all around the world. We are currently looking for a **DevOps Engineer** to join our team! The **DevOps Engineer** supports a hybrid Linux and cloud environment by designing, implementing, and maintaining the infrastructure, automation, and deployment processes that enable reliable software delivery. This role partners closely with development and IT teams to improve system reliability, automate manual work, and support secure, scalable operations across production environments. The position is hands\-on, collaborative, and focused on continuous improvement in a team setting, grounded in Cascade Dafo’s mission: **Helping Kids Lead Healthier, Happier Lives**. This is a full\-time position with hybrid work available after 3 months on\-site in Ferndale, WA. This role requires regular on\-site collaboration to support infrastructure, operations, and project work. The DevOps Engineer supports production systems and may occasionally require planned after\-hours deployment or maintenance activities. **What You’ll Do:** **Infrastructure and Server Management** * Administer Linux server environments, including provisioning, patching, hardening, monitoring, and performance tuning. * Provide occasional administration and support for Windows Server, Active Directory, and related Microsoft technologies. * Support hybrid infrastructure across on\-premises and cloud environments with a focus on production stability and service reliability. * Maintain monitoring, alerting, and observability solutions to support resilient operations. **Container Orchestration and Platform Engineering** * Support containerized platforms, including Kubernetes and Docker Swarm. * Design, deploy, maintain, and optimize Kubernetes clusters and supporting platform services. * Help establish standards for container image creation, vulnerability scanning, deployment, and lifecycle management. **CI/CD and Automation** * Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support efficient, reliable software delivery. * Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration management using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices and tools. * Reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency through scripting and automation. **Reliability, Security and Business Continuity** * Establish and monitor service level objectives (SLOs) and service level indicators (SLIs). * Lead incident response efforts, perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventative measures. * Support certificate lifecycle processes and related trust infrastructure in alignment with organizational security standards. * Help maintain security best practices: secrets management, network segmentation, and vulnerability remediation. * Support backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity processes as needed. * Assist with regulatory, compliance, and security audit requirements. * Follow, create and maintain technical documentation, operational runbooks, architecture diagrams, and standard operating procedures. **What We’re Looking For:** * We’re looking for someone who has a systems\-thinking approach with the ability to balance functionality, reliability, and feasibility. * Ability to resolve technical issues while communicating clearly with stakeholders. * Written and verbal communication: document systems, procedures, and technical decisions. * Comfortable in small, cross\-functional teams where collaboration and adaptability are essential. * Proficiency with cloud computing and resource management across multiple providers. * Extensive experience with Linux: performance tuning, patching, and security hardening. * Familiarity with Windows domain administration in a hybrid on\-prem/cloud environment. * Networking configuration: DNS, TCP/IP, VLANs, load balancing, routing, firewalls, and TLS/PKI. * Kubernetes and related container orchestration practices. (Preferred) * Infrastructure as Code (IaC), configuration management, and automation tools. * Proficiency with multiple scripting and automation languages. * Monitoring and observability platforms, including incident response. * Cybersecurity experience: access control, secrets management, and vulnerability remediation. * Must be able to communicate in English, written and verbal. * Must be comfortable with prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. * Must be able to lift 35 pounds. We encourage applicants from diverse backgrounds to apply, knowing that even without full expertise in all skills listed, there will be opportunity to grow further into the role and share knowledge with teammates. **Required Education and Experience:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and professional experience. * Minimum three (3\) years’ experience administering infrastructure and supporting users in a production environment. * Can demonstrate experience and proficiency across a portion of skills, duties and responsibilities outlined above. **Why You’ll Love Working Here:** Looking for meaningful work that makes a positive impact on the lives of others? Cascade Dafo offers that opportunity. Our work is team\-driven and purposeful, affecting families and communities all across the globe. From production to customer support to our digital teams, we take pride in making products that help kids lead healthier, happier lives, providing more opportunities to them and their families. Cascade Dafo is dedicated to the success of our team members; we offer on\-the\-job training and opportunities for advancement and growth throughout the company. We work hard to cultivate a respectful, supportive, and safe work environment, and offer competitive benefits to support a healthy work\-life balance for our team members. **As a Team Member at Cascade Dafo, You’ll:** * Make a real impact on the systems and infrastructure that makes the work that we do to improve quality of life for our customers possible. * Be part of a collaborative team that values your expertise. * Work in an environment that values respect, communication, and empowerment. * Receive a competitive compensation and benefits package. **Our Compensation and Benefit Package:** * **Expected Hiring Salary Range: $86,755\-$111,966 DOE; Position’s Full Salary Range: $76,141\-$128,450** * **Profit Sharing:** Cascade team members are eligible to share in the company’s profits each quarter. By sharing in the profits, our team members feel a sense of ownership; they reap the benefits of their hard work. In 2025, profit sharing added an average of 11\.5% to our team’s compensation. * **Healthcare Benefits:** We provide medical (including telehealth services), dental, and vision insurance to our full\-time team members. We offer a QHDHP with employer HSA contribution or a traditional PPO plan; with two different medical plans to choose from, our team members find a plan that best fits their needs. Because healthcare is so important, Cascade will share the cost of your family’s medical benefits with you. * **Time Off and Company Holidays:** Our teams are dedicated to their work; we know team member engagement requires time off to refresh yourself. From your first day of work, you’ll be earning PTO. PTO hours earned increase with seniority, starting with 2 weeks a year and growing to 5 weeks per year for long\-term team members. Our holidays schedule allows for rest time as well; we have a minimum of 10 paid holidays allowing you to relax and make memories with your friends and family. * **401(k):** Cascade offers a traditional or ROTH 401(k) plan to you after 90 days of employment. We fund a company match (up to 4%) per payroll and a 401(k) end of year contribution. * **Additional Benefits:** We provide our team members with short/long term disability, life insurance, and a confidential EAP service. **Ready to Make a Difference?** We invite you to apply today! Cascade Dafo, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We do not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law. We seek individuals who are passionate about delivering outstanding service and who align with our shared values. **Our Communication Commitment to You:** You will receive a message once your application has been received. Email updates will be sent to let you know as your application moves through the screening and review process. We will reach out to qualified applicants to schedule interviews via their preferred contact method. Thank you for considering working with us at Cascade Dafo! We are excited to meet you.

This role will drive all aspects of our automation strategy, governance, and roadmap while ensuring high regression coverage, stability, and reliability of automation solutions. prioritizing quality in deliverables. **Key Responsibilities** * Lead the development and implementation of the organization's automation strategy, governance standards, and long\-term roadmap for enterprise applications. * Act as the primary SME for test automation methodologies, tools, and best practices, ensuring scalability and alignment with organizational objectives. * Architect, design, and maintain extensible automation testing frameworks using UFT (VBScript), Selenium, and Katalon Studio. * Develop reusable test automation libraries, data\-driven testing assets, and modular automation reliability across multiple platforms. * Mentor and guide automation engineers to identify, develop, and roll out advanced automation solutions. * Serve as a champion for the adoption and scaling of enterprise automation standards company\-wide. * Foster a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement. * Partner with test teams, developers, product engineers, and business analysts to review requirements and design end\-to\-end automation solutions. * Work closely with stakeholders to monitor metrics such as regression coverage and defect leakage, ensuring alignment experience (4\+ years) in performing cross\-browser and cross\-platform automation testing to ensure robust product interoperability. * Proficiency in SQL for preparing test data and validating testing outcomes (4\+ years). * Must be able to pass a background check. May require additional background checks as required by projects and/or clients at any time during employment. **Minimum Skills:*** Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate in a clear, professional, and articulate manner. * Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. * Excellent organizational, analytical, and problem\-solving skills with high\-level attention to detail. * Proven ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast past environment with changing priorities; adaptable to change and a quick learner. * Must be self\-motivated and able to work well independently as well as on a multi\-functional team. * Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information appropriately * Proficient in MS Office, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Excel. **Preferred Qualifications:*** A cumulative 10\+ years of experience in advanced automation testing or software development. * 7\+ years of experience developing automation frameworks using a combination of UFT, Selenium, or Katalon, with strategic integrations into CI/CD pipelines. * Established expertise with CI/CD automation, evidenced by 5\+ years of framework integration experience with CI/CD tools like Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI/CD. * A strong grasp of Katalon Studio, with a minimum of 3\+ years of hands\-on experience. * Demonstrated measurable outcomes in automation, such as achieving: + - 65% regression automation coverage across enterprise solutions. - 5% test flakiness rates, ensuring reliability. * At least 2 years of experience supporting large\-scale benefit systems, including government services or enterprise\-scale solutions. * Desired Certifications: + Katalon Certified Professional + ISTQB Test Automation Engineer + Certified Selenium Professional, CP\-SAT, Foundation * Possession of a Master’s degree in a Business Administration, IT or Engineering . * In lieu of a Master’s degree, at least twelve (12\) years of cumulative experience performing performance testing or performance engineering for large scale enterprise systems as defined above. **Our Commitment to you / overview of benefits*** Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance; jobs.title: Designer III
jobs.description: Job Summary: CECO Environmental is a global leader in providing sustainable solutions for industrial air, water, and energy transition. Since 1966, we’ve been addressing the world’s most pressing environmental challenges. Our mission is to protect people, the environment, and industrial equipment, making a tangible impact across industries like renewable energy, semiconductor manufacturing, power generation, and water treatment. As a purpose\-driven company, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and integrity, ensuring that every project we undertake creates lasting positive change. At CECO, you’ll be part of a growing, dynamic team committed to a cleaner, safer, and more sustainable future. We are proud to share that CECO was named one of Newsweek’s America’s Greatest Companies for 2025 and that Forbes recognized CECO as one of America’s Most Successful Small‑Cap Companies for 2026, marking our third consecutive year on the Forbes list. CECO Environmental is a publicly traded company on the Texas Stock Exchange (TXSE) under the ticker CECO, reflecting our strong growth, financial performance, and commitment to delivering value to shareholders. As part of the CECO Environmental family of brands, **Industrial Air Solutions** plays a critical role in delivering specialized air solutions that protect both people and the environment. By joining our team, you’ll contribute to our shared mission of protecting global industrial operations and shaping the future of environmental stewardship. The Design Drafter III is responsible for developing product designs and fabrication drawings packages. This position will design thermal oxidizers manufactured by our Company and other companies. This position will facilitate internal workflow, as required. This position collaborates in person and remotely with Project Management and Engineering professionals to develop design concepts and engineering documents **Your Responsibilities Will Be:*** Receives, reviews, and interprets project requirements and design information including but not limited to Scope of Work (SOW), Engineering Specification Reviews (ESR), Calculations, Placement Sketch, Construction Notes, Controls Component Spec (\& Control’s location on vessel), and Internals order forms to complete designs. * Provides a timely and accurate response to all inquiries. * Interacts closely with both Project Engineers and Manufacturing Personnel to meet customer needs. * Produces 3D Parts, Assemblies, and Layouts created in CAD, General Arrangement (GA) and Fabrication drawings, Bills of Materials, and prototype designs to support customer requirements, using AutoDesk Inventor for modeling and drafting. * Makes necessary corrections to existing drawings following quality review process. * Determines appropriate methods to create drawings using either a CAD template customized to the client’s requirements, a standard template designed for the specific type of work, or by updating an existing CAD file. * Reviews drawings from other drafters to ensure alignment with scoping and corporate drafting standards. * Performs other duties of a similar nature and level as assigned. **Required Qualifications:** * An associate degree in Drafting or CAD Technology with 3\-5 years of experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential duties of the job such as those listed above (8 years of demonstrated experience in a mechanical engineering field in lieu of degree). * Working proficiency with AutoDesk Inventor is required. * Prior experience in the Engineering design is helpful. * Have a basic understanding of controls and instrumentation, ability to take concept to design. * Have a basic understanding of welding processes, callouts, and applications. **Travel Requirements (Requirement):*** Incumbents are expected to travel as needed to support assigned business lines(s) and must have the ability to travel across borders. **ADA Requirements:** **Work Environment** This position is located at our home office in Addison, TX. The candidate must be self\-motivated and able to manage boundaries between work and personal life effectively. Minimal physical requirements, primarily computer use, and communication via virtual platforms, are necessary. Flexibility to adapt to occasional scheduled video meetings and collaborative tasks is essential. **Physical Demands** Positions in this function typically require standing, climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, crawling, reaching, standing, walking, pushing, pulling, lifting, fingering, grasping, feeling, talking, hearing, seeing and repetitive motions. Concentrated mental and/or visual attention. The work involves performing complex tasks to very close accuracy and quality specifications, or a high degree of hand and eye coordination for sustained periods. Compliance with company attendance standards. Heavy Work: Exerting up to 100 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 50 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 20 pounds of forces constantly to move objects. Incumbents may be subjected to moving mechanical parts, electrical currents, vibrations, fumes, odors, dusts, gases, poor ventilation, chemicals, oils, extreme temperatures, inadequate lighting, workspace restrictions, intense noises, and travel **We Offer:** At CECO, we are committed to a culture where every employee is valued and respected for their unique experiences and perspectives. We believe a diverse and inclusive work environment contributes to the rich exchange of ideas and diversity of thoughts, that inspires innovation and brings the best solutions to our customers. **ABOUT US** CECO’s Commitment to Our People At CECO, our people are at the center of everything we do. Whether you’re a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring opportunities, or a recent graduate with an advanced degree, you’ll find your chance to make a difference with CECO. **ABOUT CECO** CECO Environmental is a leading environmentally focused, diversified industrial company whose solutions protect people, the environment, and industrial equipment across the globe, serving a broad landscape of industrial air, industrial water and energy transition markets. We serve these markets and our global customers through our key business segments: Engineered Systems and Industrial Process Solutions. Learn more about CECO by visiting About Us. Accessibility Assistance or Accommodation If you have a disability and are having difficulty accessing or using this website to apply for a position, please contact: hr@OneCeco.com.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **Location:** Van Wert, OH; Dublin, OH; Waltham, MA; Alpharetta, GA; Irving, TX **Work Model:** Hybrid or Remote based on location **Position type:** Full\-Time About the Company Central Insurance has been family owned and operating since 1876, and we’re just getting started. We’re a property and casualty insurance group that believes great work starts with Integrity, thrives on strong Relationships, and never settles for less than Excellence. With over $2B in assets and an A (Excellent) A.M. Best rating, we offer stability, opportunity, and a team you’ll actually enjoy being part of. We make a difference for our policyholders by providing excellent service and being there in the greatest times of need. About the Role We are a team of employees who are passionate to deliver best in\-class customer service and innovation in the industry. It's because we put Integrity, Relationships and Excellence in all aspects of our work. Our employees have the opportunity to fully utilize their talents and bring their best self. We believe that who you are is just as important as what you do! If you are a problem\-solver with a service first mentality and a passion for helping people, come join our team! As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will be instrumental by partnering with actuaries, data scientists, software engineers, and business stakeholders to design and deploy machine learning solutions. What we are looking for * Master’s degree with a background in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field * Or Bachelor’s degree with a background in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field and 2 years of related experience deploying, maintaining, and supporting machine learning models in production environments * Or 4 years related experience deploying, maintaining, and supporting machine learning models in production environments * Experience developing CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, model packaging, release management, and rollback processes for machine learning or software applications\- preferred * Experience with containerization, orchestration, or infrastructure automation tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, or similar technologies\- preferred * Experience with model monitoring, observability, logging, alerting, performance tracking, data drift detection, or production health monitoring\- preferred * Programming experience in Python or similar languages used for machine learning engineering, automation, API development, or data pipeline development\- preferred * Experience with SQL, data validation, data quality checks, and data pipeline support for model scoring, retraining, monitoring, or reporting workflows\- preferred * Experience developing or supporting APIs, microservices, batch scoring processes, or do * Designs, builds, tests, deploys, and supports machine learning solutions that are reliable, scalable, maintainable, and aligned to business objectives. * Partners with data scientists, actuaries, data engineers, software engineers, and business stakeholders to transition models from experimentation into production\-ready applications, services, and decision\-support workflows. * Develops and maintains automated deployment and CI/CD processes for machine learning models and pricing solutions, including model packaging, versioning, validation, release management, rollback procedures, automated testing, environment consistency, and repeatable release practices. * Develops and supports APIs, services, application integration patterns, and batch or real\-time scoring workflows that enable reliable model inference and consumption of model outputs by business systems. * Supports pricing data pipeline development and validation needed for model scoring, monitoring, retraining, and reporting; partners with data engineering teams on larger data integration needs. * Implements model monitoring, observability, and logging practices to track model performance, data drift, prediction quality, system reliability, latency, data dependencies, integration points, and other indicators of production health. * Contributes to model registry, feature store, experiment tracking, reusable engineering patterns, templates, tests, documentation, and related MLOps tooling to improve traceability, reproducibility, deployment consistency, lifecycle management, and ongoing support. * Applies compliance, operational, reliability, maintainability, and cost\-effectiveness requirements. * Troubleshoots production issues related to machine learning models, data dependencies, model outputs, and integration points in collaboration with software engineers; recommends improvements to reduce operational risk. * Maintains awareness of industry trends, emerging technologies, and modern MLOps practices; recommends practical improvements to Central Insurance’s machine learning engineering capabilities. * Provides technical guidance, peer review, and knowledge sharing to team members on production machine learning practices, deployment standards, monitoring approaches, and operational support. The full pay range is broader and is designed to provide employees with meaningful opportunities for salary growth as they develop their skills, increase proficiency, and advance in the role. Equal Opportunity Employer It is the policy of Central that all recruiting, hiring, training, compensation, overtime, job classification and assignment, facilities, promotions, transfers, employee treatment and all other terms and conditions of employment shall be maintained in a manner which will not discriminate against any person because of race, color, age, sex, national origin, ancestry, religion, marital status, military status, or disability. jobs.title: AI Agent Developer & Integration Specialist
jobs.description: **Job Title:** AI Agent Developer \& Integration Specialist **Location:** Sarasota, FL or Houston, TX **Reports To:** CIO **Compensation Range:** $140,000 \- $160,000 annually **Benefits:** Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with company match, paid time off, and travel opportunities **The Ceres Commitment** Ceres Environmental Services is a leader in crisis management, rapid response, and disaster recovery, committed to rebuilding stronger, safer communities. Founded in 1976, Ceres has secured more than $3\.4 billion in government\-funded contracts, reflecting decades of trust in bringing hope during times of need. We specialize in emergency response, environmental services, planning, and consulting, including debris removal, blue roofs, logistics, debris management, demolition, recycling, forest management, and coastal and marine restoration. As a licensed general contractor, we offer unparalleled expertise to restore stability where it’s needed most. **Driven by Purpose, Powered by People** At Ceres, we believe you're more than just an employee; you're part of a team with a purpose and a meaningful mission. Whether in management, field operations, or behind the scenes, every team member plays a vital role in restoring hope, helping communities recover and rebuild. We value initiative, respect diversity, and give our people the freedom to lead. We offer competitive pay, travel opportunities, and a culture built on resilience and teamwork. If you show up with compassion, share the commitment, react with urgency, and deliver solutions, you'll fit right in. We don't just respond to challenges; we rise to them. **What We Are Looking For** We are seeking an AI Agent Developer \& Integration Specialist to lead the design, development, deployment, and continuous improvement of enterprise AI agents and intelligent automation solutions across Ceres. This role sits within the Information Technology organization and serves as the bridge between business stakeholders and technology teams, partnering directly with subject matter experts to identify opportunities, gather requirements, build solutions, and drive user adoption. The successful candidate will own AI initiatives from concept through production, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, reliable, and aligned with business objectives. This role has no direct people management responsibilities but requires strong cross\-functional leadership and collaboration. Success during the first 12 months will be demonstrated through the deployment of multiple business AI solutions, measurable efficiency gains, strong stakeholder adoption, and the establishment of scalable AI governance and best practices across the organization. **What You Will Do** * Lead the design, development, testing, deployment, and support of enterprise AI agents and intelligent automation solutions. * Partner with business leaders and subject matter experts to identify process improvement and automation opportunities. * Facilitate requirement\-gathering sessions and document business, technical, and operational needs. * Build AI agents using approved enterprise AI platforms, frameworks, and development tools. * Integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications, databases, APIs, and data sources. * Develop prompts, workflows, orchestration logic, retrieval systems, and business process automations. * Conduct functional, integration, performance, and user acceptance testing to ensure solution quality and reliability. * Ensure compliance with organizational security, privacy, governance, and Responsible AI standards. * Monitor deployed AI agents, analyze performance metrics, and implement continuous improvements. * Manage the AI agent portfolio, including demand intake, prioritization, lifecycle management, adoption tracking, and ROI measurement. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent experience may be considered. * Three (3\) or more years of experience developing AI\-enabled applications, enterprise automation solutions, or workflow systems. * Experience building and deploying AI agents, large language model (LLM) applications, or intelligent automation solutions. * Proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript/Node.js, including API integration and automation development. * Experience with AI development platforms and frameworks such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, or similar technologies. * Proven ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions while communicating effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with enterprise cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). * Familiarity with retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, prompt engineering, and AI evaluation methodologies. * Experience with MLOps or LLMOps tools used for monitoring, testing, and optimizing AI applications. * Knowledge of enterprise business systems including ERP, CRM, finance, operations, or project management platforms. **What to Expect** This is a highly visible role that combines software development, AI innovation, business process improvement, and stakeholder engagement. You will spend time meeting with business leaders and subject matter experts to understand challenges, evaluate opportunities, and prioritize automation initiatives. You will also spend significant time designing, building, testing, and deploying AI agents that improve efficiency and support operational decision\-making across the organization. Success in this role requires balancing technical development with business partnership. You will manage multiple projects simultaneously, work across departments, and adapt to changing priorities as organizational needs evolve. Some projects will involve rapid prototyping and experimentation, while others will require structured development, governance reviews, and enterprise deployment planning. The pace is fast and collaborative, with a strong focus on practical problem solving, measurable business outcomes, and responsible AI adoption. Individuals who are curious, self\-directed, and excited about applying emerging technology to real\-world business challenges will thrive in this environment. Travel may be required periodically to collaborate with business teams, support implementations, facilitate workshops, or provide training at company locations throughout the United States. **Physical Requirements and Environment** Ceres provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and to applicants with sincerely held religious beliefs, as required by law. The physical requirements listed below reflect the essential functions of this role. If you need accommodation to perform these functions, please inform us during the application process. * Ability to sit, stand, and work at a computer for extended periods of time. * Ability to communicate effectively in person, virtually, and via telephone. * Ability to travel periodically to company offices, operational locations, and training events. * Ability to lift and carry up to 20 pounds with or without reasonable accommodation. * Commitment to following company safety standards, information security requirements, and operational protocols. **Why Join Ceres?** At Ceres, you won't just have a job, you'll have a mission. Your work will directly impact the speed and strength of community recovery after disasters. We offer: * A collaborative, mission\-driven culture. * Opportunities for professional growth and advancement. * The chance to make a lasting difference for communities across the U.S. * The opportunity to help shape and scale AI capabilities across a national organization. Ceres Environmental is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to age, race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability status, or protected veteran status. **E\-Verify:** We comply with Federal law by verifying employment eligibility.

jobs.title: Backend Software / Web Platform Engineer (Headless CMS)
jobs.description: **Backend Software / Web Platform Engineer (Headless CMS)** *US – Remote, with occasional group sessions at Sarasota, FL headquarters* The Certified Collectibles Group is looking for an experienced Backend Software Engineer to build and manage our web platform powered by Contentful headless CMS. In this role, you will lead backend engineering efforts to build a unified new website architecture, consolidate existing digital properties, and transfer and synchronize content across legacy platforms and our modern headless stack. Additionally, you will engineer real\-time audience personalization to deliver high\-converting, tailored user experiences. **ABOUT US** Certified Collectibles Group (CCG) is a global leader in the fast\-growing collectibles market. Founded in 1987, CCG provides third\-party authentication and grading services that protect the integrity of the hobby and empower confident buying and selling decisions. To date, more than 110 million coins, banknotes, comic books, magazines, trading cards, sports cards, stamps, video games \& home videos, and autographs have been certified by CCG. Trusted by collectors and dealers worldwide, CCG has locations in the United States, United Kingdom, Germany, United Arab Emirates and China. **WHAT YOU WILL DO AS A BACKEND SOFTWARE/WEB PLATFORM ENGINEER** * Architect, develop, and maintain server\-side applications, APIs (REST/GraphQL), and integration middleware connecting Contentful with front\-end web applications and downstream internal systems. * Lead content migrations and site consolidations, building robust scripts and pipelines to safely extract, transform, and transfer content between existing websites and the new platform. * Build and integrate backend services supporting dynamic website personalization, segmentation, and A/B testing alongside headless content delivery. * Validate, design, implement, and optimize Contentful content models, migration scripts, and webhook listener architectures for real\-time publishing workflows and cache invalidation. * Build resilient caching strategies using CDNs (Cloudflare, Fastly) and server\-side caches (Redis) to deliver sub\-second global content response times. * Develop event\-driven architectures, automated synchronization pipelines, and third\-party integrations (CRM, analytics, search engines such as Algolia/Elasticsearch, and digital asset managers). * Monitor system reliability, uptime, API latency, and security across cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure) and CI/CD pipelines. **WHAT MAKES YOU THE IDEAL CANDIDATE** * 3\-5\+ years of backend software engineering experience with strong proficiency in Node.js/TypeScript, Python, or Go. * Proven hands\-on experience working with headless CMS platforms (Content Delivery, Management, and Preview APIs). Experience with Contentful is a plus. * Experience implementing personalization frameworks, user segmentation, or feature\-flagging systems at scale. * Demonstrated track record of consolidating multiple web properties and migrating complex content and catalog structures. * Strong mastery of GraphQL and RESTful API architecture and design best practices. * Solid understanding of serverless computing, containerization, and modern caching mechanisms. * Familiarity with modern frontend rendering models (SSG, ISR, SSR in frameworks like Next.js or Remix) is a strong plus. **WHY YOU WILL LOVE WORKING WITH US** * Competitive compensation commensurate with experience * Comprehensive benefits including Medical, Vision, and Dental Insurance * PTO \& Paid Holidays * 401(k) retirement plan * Career Development \& Learning opportunities *We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. We believe that diversity strengthens our team and drives innovation, and we welcome candidates from all backgrounds to apply.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** ChartHop is the AI\-powered people operations platform helping organizations plan smarter, operate with clarity, and make confident decisions about their people. To bring this vision to life, integrations have been at the core of what makes that possible, from HRIS and payroll to ATS systems. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will help us drive this vision forward, by helping us build a new configuration\-driven integration system allowing us to connect new systems and create new integrations faster than before. You’ll also work on our AI initiatives, building AI functionality into the ChartHop product and extending it across our product areas. We are looking for someone who is excited to use AI tools in their own work and to experiment with what they can do for us. ### **You’ll Be a Great Fit If** * You have experience building and maintaining third\-party integrations (HRIS, payroll, ATS, business intelligence, or similar). Experience from outside HR tech is welcome if you’ve worked with comparable data. * You have experience with data pipelines or ETL. * You have strong back\-end software development skills. Kotlin or another JVM language (Java, Scala, Groovy) is a strong plus, and strong senior engineers from other backgrounds are welcome. * You have strong API experience, including REST, GraphQL, webhooks, OAuth, and data synchronization. * You can analyze and troubleshoot API issues. * You have worked independently on a small team. Experience at a startup, on a small R\&D team, or on a project you launched yourself is especially valuable. * You’re comfortable using AI tools in your development work. * You bring strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail. * You communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical audiences. * You manage your workload and priorities with minimal oversight. ### **What You’ll Do** * Design, build, and maintain integrations across HRIS, payroll, ATS, notifications, and business intelligence platforms. * Build and extend the configuration\-driven integration system, including the functionality it needs. * Design APIs and data pipelines that connect reliably with third\-party systems. * Contribute to AI features in the ChartHop product. * Own the full development lifecycle: research API documentation, plan, write robust code, deploy, and monitor integration health. * Write tests, conduct code reviews, and follow best practices for code quality and maintainability. * Work with product, customer success, and external partners to meet business and technical requirements. * Improve how we build and manage integrations, including developer tooling, monitoring, and alerting. ### **How You’ll Be Measured** * Integration reliability: uptime, error rates, and data accuracy across third\-party connections. * Code quality and maintainability: measured through code reviews and long\-term sustainability. * Feature delivery: features delivered on time and within scope. * Customer impact: fewer support tickets and less friction in the integration experience, with better data quality. * Team contribution: impact on team productivity, collaboration, and innovation. * Continuous learning: learning new technologies and sharing knowledge with the team. ### **The Details** ***Tech stack:***Kotlin and MongoDB on the back end, TypeScript and React on the front end, and AWS for infrastructure. We also use Valkey for caching and partner with Anthropic for AI models. Most of your work will be in Kotlin. **Interview process:** Intake call with our recruiter, hiring manager screen, culture interview, take\-home assessment, a live technical review of your assessment with two engineers, a team collaboration interview with our product manager, and a leadership interview with our CTO. Although we list what we generally look for, we are very likely missing other attributes and skills that you have that could make you a great addition, but are not currently listed. Research has shown this especially applies to women and other marginalized groups, who tend to apply only if they check 100% of every box, while others apply when they meet roughly 60%. The point: it does not hurt to take a chance and apply. We are an inclusive employer and value diversity at our company. Compensation Range: $160K \- $200K

jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description: **Cintal is a forward\-thinking global technology company that develops and provides cutting\-edge products and services to various industries such as heavy equipment, industrial, defense, agriculture, and medical. jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: **The application window is expected to close on:** 01/28/2027 Meet the Team Team Fusion develops embedded software for Cisco networking platforms, including hyperscaler\-class switches, ultra\-low\-end campus switches, and selected wireless devices; and is responsible for the HW security and manufacturing software for cloud dashboard products. Your Impact As a Software Engineer, you will design, develop, debug, and validate embedded software for Cisco networking devices. You will work close to hardware and silicon while partnering with platform, ASIC, systems, security, manufacturing, and product teams. * Develop bootloader, BSP, diagnostics, platform software, and low\-level device drivers for networking hardware. * Bring up new switch and wireless platforms on Linux and embedded systems, working across CPU, memory, buses, peripherals, storage, and networking components. * Debug complex hardware/software issues on prototypes and production devices using logs, traces, debuggers, serial consoles, and lab\-based test equipment. * Build automated hardware\-in\-the\-loop validation and regression infrastructure for real devices, including Python/Pytest test suites, testbed orchestration, power/thermal measurements, and stability testing. * Develop and maintain CI/CD workflows for compiling, testing, analyzing, signing, packaging, and releasing firmware. Minimum Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with 5 years of relevant experience, or a Master’s degree with 3 years of relevant experience. * Proficient programming experience in C for embedded, systems, firmware, or device\-driver development. * Prior experience developing, debugging, and validating embedded systems or platform software on Linux. * Prior experience writing software test plans and automated validation for hardware\-dependent software. * Strong ownership, communication, technical judgment, and ability to work effectively in a cross\-functional engineering environment. Preferred Skills * Knowledge of networking fundamentals and protocols, including Ethernet, TCP/IP, VLANs, MAC learning, Layer 2/3 forwarding, etc. * Experience with Linux kernel development or debugging, GDB/KGDB, JTAG, U\-Boot, Yocto, or embedded build systems. * Proficiency in Python and experience with Pytest or similar test automation frameworks. * Experience with Git, Jira, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or other CI/CD systems. * Familiarity with secure boot, hardware roots of trust, TrustZone, cryptographic signing, or product security processes. * Experience with wireless or radio\-connected embedded devices, such as Wi\-Fi, BLE. * Experience with power, thermal, performance, or reliability characterization of embedded or edge\-compute platforms. * Experience with C\+\+, Go, shell scripting, or AI/ML edge workloads. Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. Message to applicants applying to work in the U.S. and/or Canada: The starting salary range posted for this position is $155,000\.00 to $222,600\.00 and reflects the projected salary range for new hires in this position in U.S. and/or Canada locations, not including incentive compensation\*, equity, or benefits. Individual pay is determined by the candidate's hiring location, market conditions, job\-related skillset, experience, qualifications, education, certifications, and/or training. The full salary range for certain locations is listed below. For locations not listed below, the recruiter can share more details about compensation for the role in your location during the hiring process. U.S. employees are offered benefits, subject to Cisco’s plan eligibility rules, which include medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with a Cisco matching contribution, paid parental leave, short and long\-term disability coverage, and basic life insurance. jobs.description: **Description** **Principal Security Engineer, AI Security \& GenAI Data Protection** Citizens is seeking a Principal Security Engineer to lead the design, implementation, and enterprise rollout of its AI Security and Generative AI (GenAI) data protection capability. This individual will serve as the technical owner of the AI Gateway platform, driving evaluation, deployment, policy engineering, inline remediation, governance, and ongoing operations across sanctioned and unsanctioned AI usage. The role partners across Cybersecurity, Data Protection, Technology, Risk, Privacy, Legal, and business teams to reduce data loss risk while enabling responsible AI adoption. **Work Arrangement**: Hybrid – 4 days onsite, 1 remote in one of the following hubs: Johnston, RI \| Boston, MA \| Marlton, NJ \| Pittsburgh, PA \| Phoenix, AZ \| Irving, TX \| \| Cleveland, OH \| Columbus, OH \| Philadelphia, PA (We are open to considering remote talent requiring executive approval). **Key Responsibilities** * Own the end to end AI Gateway capability across evaluation, proof of concept, selection, deployment, configuration, policy tuning, operational support, and continuous improvement. * Develop and execute a phased rollout from monitor mode to warn and coach to targeted blocking, using observed AI traffic and risk metrics to establish baselines and control implementation. * Engineer and tune controls for GenAI prompts, file uploads, browser traffic, embedded copilots, and sanctioned and unsanctioned AI applications. * Implement inline remediation controls including redaction, quarantine, user coaching, warning, and blocking. * Establish instance aware controls that distinguish corporate from personal accounts and reduce data leakage risk. * Assess AI and agentic integration risks involving AI agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), non human identities, third party integrations, and emerging access paths. * Integrate AI Gateway telemetry with SIEM, SOAR, ITSM, identity platforms, data protection solutions, and evidence repositories. * Define and operationalize governance standards, policy lifecycle processes, exception handling procedures, escalation paths, and ownership models. * Measure and report program effectiveness through coverage, policy accuracy, false positive and false negative trends, remediation outcomes, audit evidence quality, and user experience metrics. * Partner with business leaders and AI platform owners to introduce coaching and enforcement controls with minimal disruption. * Stay current on AI security threats, GenAI data loss trends, agentic AI developments, MCP capabilities, and evolving security technologies. * Contribute to standards, procedures, training materials, and enterprise communications related to secure AI adoption. * Support risk, audit, and regulatory readiness through maintenance of defensible security evidence, policy decisions, exceptions, and enforcement outcomes. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent professional experience. * 7\+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity, information security engineering, or related technical disciplines. * 2\+ years of hands on experience with Data Protection, SSE, SASE, CASB, DLP, AI Security, GenAI Security, or similar inline security technologies. * Direct AI Gateway experience strongly preferred. * Deep understanding of GenAI data flows and security risks across prompts, uploads, browser traffic, embedded copilots, APIs, AI agents, and third party integrations. * Experience implementing enterprise security controls capable of monitoring, coaching, redacting, quarantining, or blocking risky data movement in real time. * Strong knowledge of SIEM, SOAR, ITSM, identity management, and security orchestration workflows. * Experience with identity and access management concepts including corporate versus personal instances, least privilege, non human identities, OAuth, OIDC, and service to service access. * Understanding of data protection, governance, risk management, and regulated industry control requirements. * Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical risks into actionable business guidance. * Proven experience leading cross functional security platform rollouts and balancing risk, usability, and business objectives. Preferred Qualifications * CISSP, CCSP, CISM, or comparable security certifications. * Experience with AI Security, DLP, SSE, SASE, CASB, DSPM, or related data protection platforms. * Experience with Cyera Omni, Netskope AI Security, AISecOps, or similar technologies. * Familiarity with Python, PowerShell, APIs, automation, reporting, and workflow orchestration. * Experience working in financial services, healthcare, or other highly regulated industries. * Experience developing governance standards, risk based enforcement models, exception management processes, and control evidence frameworks. * Experience securing agentic AI environments, MCP enabled integrations, AI agents, non human identities, prompt and upload workflows, and GenAI data leakage scenarios. **Pay Transparency** The salary range for this position is $130,000 to $195,000 per year, plus an opportunity to earn additional incentive earnings. LaGuardia offers more than sixty associate degree programs and more than fifty workforce training, ESOL, GED, and pre\-college programs. In 2023, LaGuardia served approximately 24,000 students. More than one\-third of LaGuardia’s degree\-seeking students are born outside the United States; they come from 136 countries and speak 43 heritage languages. Sixty percent are first\-generation college students. Virtually all LaGuardia students are ethnic minorities (89 percent), 58 percent are women, 27 percent are over the age of 25\. Forty\-six percent of associate degree students are Hispanic. Upon graduation most students transfer to four\-year colleges, typically in CUNY, to complete their baccalaureate degrees. Graduates of career programs such as Nursing, Computer Technology, and Veterinary Technology enter the workforce. jobs.title: Data Engineer-Integration Specialist
jobs.description: **Company Description** With a workforce of over 25,000 people, and opportunities in more than 1,000 different job categories, the City of Philadelphia is the fifth largest city in the United States and one of the largest employers in Southeastern Pennsylvania. As an employer, the City of Philadelphia operates through the guiding principles of service, integrity, respect, accountability, collaboration, diversity and inclusion. Through these principles, we strive to effectively deliver services, to resolve the challenges facing our city, and to make Philadelphia a place where all our residents have the opportunity to reach their potential. The Office of Innovation \& Technology (OIT) is the central IT agency for the City of Philadelphia headed by the Chief Information Officer (CIO). OIT oversees all major information and communications technology initiatives for the City of Philadelphia \- increasing the effectiveness of the information technology infrastructure, where the services provided are advanced, optimized, and responsive to the needs of the City of Philadelphia’s businesses, residents, and visitors. OIT responsibilities include: identifying the most effective approach for implementing new information technology directions throughout city government; improving the value of the city’s technology assets and the return on the city’s technology investments; ensuring data security continuity; planning for continuing operations in the event of disruption of information technology or communications services; and supporting accountable, efficient and effective government across every city department, board, commission and agency. **Job Description** Data Engineering at the City is a unique opportunity for meaningful, exciting work and professional development using state\-of\-the art technologies and software development best practices. This is a position on a diverse team of engineers, analysts, and GIS specialists, contributing to developing, maintaining, and optimizing our data pipelines and integration strategies, assisting departments and agencies in innovating, and enhancing the City’s service to its residents. The data engineer/integration specialist will develop an intimate understanding of the City’s diverse data and contribute to improving the City’s data engineering infrastructure, pipelines, models, and integrations. The team uses a blend of open source, custom developed and off\-the\-shelf tools, including Python, Bash, SQL, DBT, GIS, Docker, Terraform, Apache Airflow, Jenkins, Postgres, PostGIS, AWS, GitHub, Github actions, MuleSoft as an iPaaS and SAS API providers like ArcGIS Online and CARTO. Some prominent services the team is responsible for include DataBridge, OIT’s enterprise data warehouse, AIS, the City’s custom address information systems which supports public address search and internal geocoding, and Databridge\-Airflow, a custom workflow generator and orchestrator for departmental integrations (https://metadata.phila.gov/) and open data publishing (https://opendataphilly.org/).
