The team works from an AI maturity model that describes the move from individuals using AI every day (level 2\) to teams redesigning how their work gets done around it (level 3 and beyond). It partners with AI Champions in each function and builds rather than presents. Because CloudZero is an AI cost management company, every system the team builds is a proof point for what we sell: we instrument everything for cost and practice what we preach. **The role** ------------ We are hiring a Senior AI Enablement Engineer. This is a technical role on the IT and Security team, but it is not traditional IT. Your job is to help every team at CloudZero do more with AI, and to make sure we can do it safely. You will embed with teams like Finance, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, People, and Engineering, learn how their work really gets done, and then redesign it with AI. You will build the agents, automations, and tools that make that happen, and you will teach people to build their own. When you find that the foundations are missing, such as the right access controls, data connections, logging, evaluation, or cost tracking, you will build them or pick the right product and implement it. This is one of three related senior roles on our IT and Security team, each a single hire and each adding capacity. Our existing Senior IT \& AI Systems Engineer owns core IT systems, identity, and employee lifecycle automation. Our Senior AI Data \& Platform Engineer builds the data, retrieval, APIs, and agent runtime behind our AI. You focus on people and workflows: embedding with teams and shipping what they need on top of that foundation. An Associate AI Enablement Engineer will support all three. This posting is for one opening. You are a generalist who uses AI every day to do far more than you could alone. You like hard problems, you like people, and you would rather ship something that works than write a slide about it. We work automation first. A ticket is a signal that a system failed a person, and the third request for the same number is a data product that does not exist yet. Your job is to fix the upstream cause so the next ten people do not hit the same wall. **What you will do** -------------------- * Partner with business teams to map their workflows, find the friction, and agree on AI enablement goals and success metrics before building anything. * Design, build, and run AI\-powered workflows, agents, and automations that change how work gets done, from quick wins to production systems that teams rely on. * Integrate AI with the systems we run on (for example our CRM, finance, HR, support, collaboration, and data platforms) using APIs, MCP servers, iPaaS tools, and custom code. * Spot when a solution built for one team can help others and turn it into a reusable pattern, skill, or template. * Identify gaps in the platforms we need to deploy and govern AI safely, including identity and access, data access and classification, logging, evaluation, human review, and spend controls. Then build or buy and implement what is missing. * Own the build vs buy call for AI tooling: evaluate vendors, run trials, and make clear recommendations with cost and risk tradeoffs. * Work with Security, G\&A, and Engineering to write and maintain practical AI usage and data handling standards, and make the approved path the easy path. * Set up evaluations and monitoring so the workflows you ship keep working as models and systems change. * Track AI adoption, outcomes, and spend across the company, and report what is working to IT leadership. Use CloudZero to understand what our own AI spend is producing. * Raise AI fluency across the company through office hours, working sessions, playbooks, and one\-on\-one coaching. * Document everything you build so the work is repeatable and scalable. * Build the experience for internal agent builders: templates, deploy paths, docs, and office hours that turn one team's work into every team's capability. * Turn repeated requests into self\-serve tools and data products, working with our IT \& AI Systems Engineer on the systems and employee lifecycle automation that agents depend on. * Partner with our IT and data platform engineers so every agent runs with the permissions of the person who invokes it, never more, with no shared service accounts, and with its cost attributed to a team. **What you bring** ------------------ * 5\+ years in a technical role such as software engineering, IT or systems engineering, solutions/sales engineering, automation, or internal tools. * Hands\-on coding skills in Python, TypeScript, or similar, plus solid SQL and comfort working with REST APIs and webhooks. * Deep personal use of modern AI tools, including coding agents, LLM APIs, MCP, agent skills or custom GPTs, and retrieval patterns. You can show how your use has changed over the last year. * Ability to enable and train; confidence in facilitating workshops and trainings in an engaging manner that fosters continuous learning and development. * A track record of building tools, automations, or AI workflows that changed how a real team works, with specific examples and results. * Working knowledge of identity and access (SSO, SCIM, OAuth scopes, service accounts, least privilege) and how data permissions carry into AI tools. * The habit of defining what good output looks like, testing it, and owning the result. * Strong business sense and the ability to earn trust with non\-technical teams quickly. * Clear writing and teaching. You can explain technical ideas to a diverse set of audiences, both technical and non\-technical. * Comfort with ambiguity. You do not need a detailed roadmap to know where to start. * You reach for Claude Code, Claude Desktop, or Cursor before solving a problem by hand, and you can talk credibly about which models and tools are good at what, where they fall short, and how to prompt them well. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience as a forward deployed engineer, solutions engineer, or consultant who had to deliver results inside someone else's organization. * Experience with iPaaS or workflow tools (for example Workato, Zapier, n8n, or Make) and enterprise AI platforms. * Familiarity with AI governance frameworks such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, or with SOC 2 style security programs. * Experience with data warehouses, data pipelines, and retrieval systems. * Background in cloud infrastructure, cloud cost management, or SaaS spend management. * Experience leading change across skeptical teams or building internal training programs that stuck. **About CloudZero** CloudZero is the AI ROI Company. We built the financial control plane for AI: the system finance, IT, and engineering use to connect every AI dollar to the outcome it produced. Across every provider. In real time. AI spend is the fastest\-growing line on enterprise P\&Ls and the least understood. Only 14% of CFOs can prove AI ROI today. CloudZero answers the question no one else can: what did it cost to produce this outcome, for this customer, on this model. The largest cloud spenders on the planet already run on CloudZero, including Coinbase, Duolingo, DoorDash, and Shutterstock. We processed 14 trillion billing events in the last twelve months. We're the first listed partner on Anthropic's cost and usage API. We've raised over $119 million, including a $56 million Series C backed by leading venture capital firms. **Why Join Our Team?** At CloudZero, you’ll find a collaborative, fast\-moving environment where your work makes a direct impact. We’re a team that values ownership, creativity, and curiosity — and we’re tackling some of the most complex challenges in the cloud space. If you’re excited by working with cutting\-edge technology, driving meaningful outcomes, and growing with a company that’s scaling fast, we’d love to hear from you! Compensation Range: $150K \- $205K

jobs.title: Application Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Technology** **New York** --------------------------- The D. E. Shaw group seeks application security engineers to join its Information Security team within the Systems group. This team is dedicated to advancing the firm's security posture across a fast\-paced, large\-scale IT environment, supporting investment activity and technology development. As AI transforms traditional security review, this hands\-on individual\-contributor role combines partnering with developers on secure design and building the automated, AI\-enabled tools that shape how application security is done at the firm. **What you’ll do day\-to\-day** ------------------------------- * Design, build, and operate agentic security workflows that continuously review code changes, using existing analyzers and custom analysis to investigate findings and propose fixes. * Build evaluations, feedback loops, and guardrails that assess false positives, missed vulnerabilities, and the safety of proposed fixes, using known test cases and expert review. * Lead security and design reviews for new and existing software, working directly with developers to identify vulnerabilities and recommend practical remediation. * Help secure the firm's own use of agentic AI, assessing how developer agents and internal AI platforms handle identity, data access, and tool execution. * Partner with development teams to embed secure coding practices and strengthen the Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC). * Represent Information Security to engineering teams, turning findings into clear, actionable guidance for technical and, occasionally, non\-technical stakeholders. **What we’re looking for** -------------------------- * At least five years of experience in application security, product security, security engineering, or software engineering with a solid security focus. * A bachelor's degree or higher in computer science or a related technical discipline; jobs.description: Job Posting: Engineer, Water Resources Department of Water Resources JC\-537476* Engineer, Water Resources ENGINEER, WATER RESOURCES $6,488\.00 \- $12,152\.00 per Month New to State candidates will be hired into the minimum salary of the classification or minimum of alternate range when applicable. **Final Filing Date:** **11/19/2026** **Application Methods:**Electronic (Using your CalCareer Account) By Mail Drop\-off Print Job Save Job ### **Job Description and Duties** The Central Valley Modeling Section (CVM) in the Modeling Support Office, is responsible for developing and maintaining present and future levels of hydrologic inputs of CalSim models, the jointly developed water resources planning model by DWR and Reclamation to simulate operations of State Water Project (SWP) and Central Valley Project (CVP) as well as much of the water resources infrastructure in the Central Valley of California and Sacramento\-San Joaquin Delta region. Central Valley Modeling Section (CVM) is responsible for planning facilities, conducting studies, and implementing projects in the Sacramento \- San Joaquin Valley to improve water conveyance and State Water Project (SWP) water supply reliability, water quality, and fish protection. CVM staff conducts scenario studies, evaluates proposed improvements to existing SWP facilities, analyzes alternatives for new facilities, directs planning and permitting activities, prepares environmental documentation, coordinates activities with State and federal regulatory agencies, performs hydrologic and hydrodynamic computer modeling, and educates the public about Delta issues. Are you looking for a job that can support water resources management of the State of California with your insight, knowledge and modeling and data analysis skills? jobs.title: Operations Performance Engineer
jobs.description: At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet. Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple \- to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place. **Dow** has an exciting opportunity for an **Operations Performance Engineer** located in **Bristol (PA, USA).** As the Operations Performance Engineer, you serve as a vital resource for Wastewater Operations by applying technical skills to optimize plant operations, resolve plant problems, and enable safe and efficient regulatory compliance. This role provides technical support during maintenance planning, project execution, and unplanned event response, with decision\-making authority and the responsibility to escalate when needed. **Responsibilities \-**Duties, projects, tasks, and activities you would be responsible for in this role * Identify, prioritize, and implement improvement opportunities aligned with plant, global technology, and business objectives. * Lead and support capital and non\-capital improvement projects using defined work processes. * Provide leadership during plant maintenance, unplanned events, commissioning, start\-up, and project handover to Operations. * Support and drive EHS and process safety culture, compliance, and incident reporting. * Champion effective maintenance practices, operating discipline, and root cause problem solving. * Responds urgently to unplanned events and emergencies. Could include off hours and weekend support based on business need. * Acts as a unit technical expert during unplanned events and drives implementation of effective corrective and preventative actions through the root cause investigation process. * Technically mentor peers within the organization. * Ensures compliance with plant operating permits. **Qualifications \-** Required education, experience and abilities that are needed for this role (must haves) * A minimum of a bachelor’s degree in engineering. * A minimum requirement for this U.S. based position is the ability to work legally in the United States. No visa sponsorship/support is available for this position, including for any type of U.S. permanent residency (green card) process. **Skills** \- Specific abilities and expertise required to perform tasks effectively in this role * **Process Optimization**: Identifies and implements opportunities to improve wastewater plant performance, efficiency, reliability, and regulatory compliance. * **Root Cause Problem Solving**: Investigates operational issues and unplanned events to determine root causes and implement effective corrective and preventive actions. * **Project \& Maintenance Execution:** Leads and supports capital projects, maintenance activities, commissioning, start\-ups, and project handovers using established work processes. * **EHS \& Process Safety**: Promotes a strong environmental, health, safety, and process safety culture while supporting incident reporting and compliance with plant operating permits. * **Technical Leadership**: Serves as a unit technical expert during routine and unplanned operations, providing technical guidance, mentoring others, and making or escalating critical decisions as needed. **Additional Notes:** * This position does not offer relocation assistance. **Benefits – What Dow offers you** We invest in you. Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing. Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee: * Equitable and market\-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives. * Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well\-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it. * Competitive retirement program that may include company\-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial\-goals. + Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location). * Student Debt Retirement Savings Match Program (U.S. only). + Dow will take the value of monthly student debt payments and apply them as if they are contributions to the Employees’ Savings Plan (401(k)), helping employees reach the Company match. * Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations. * Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building. * Workplace culture empowering role\-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs. * Competitive yearly vacation allowance. * Paid time off for new parents (birthing and non\-birthing, including adoptive and foster parents). * Paid time off to care for family members who are sick or injured. * Paid time off to support volunteering and Employee Resource Group’s (ERG) participation. * Wellbeing Portal for all Dow employees, our one\-stop shop to promote wellbeing, empowering employees to take ownership of their entire wellbeing journey. * On\-site fitness facilities to help stay healthy and active (availability varies depending on location). * Employee discounts for online shopping, cinema tickets, gym memberships and more. * Additionally, some of our locations might offer: + Transportation allowance (availability varies depending on location) + Meal subsidiaries/vouchers (availability varies depending on location) + Carbon\-neutral transportation incentives e.g. bike to work (availability varies depending on location) Join our team, we can make a difference together. **About Dow** Dow (NYSE: DOW) is one of the world’s leading materials science companies, serving customers in high\-growth markets such as packaging, infrastructure, mobility and consumer applications. Our global breadth, asset integration and scale, focused innovation, leading business positions and commitment to sustainability enable us to achieve profitable growth and help deliver a sustainable future. We operate manufacturing sites in 30 countries and employ approximately 36,000 people. Dow delivered sales of approximately $43 billion in 2024\. References to Dow or the Company mean Dow Inc. and its subsidiaries. Learn more about us and our ambition to be the most innovative, customer\-centric, inclusive and sustainable materials science company in the world by visiting www.dow.com. As part of our dedication to inclusion, Dow is committed to equal opportunities in employment. We encourage every employee to bring their whole self to work each day to not only deliver more value, but also have a more fulfilling career. Further information regarding Dow's equal opportunities is available on www.dow.com. Dow is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and is committed to providing opportunities without regard for race, color, religion, sex, including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity, national origin, age, disability and genetic information, including family medical history. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may call us at 1\-833\-My Dow HR (833\-693\-6947\) and select option 8\.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **What we're building** ======================= We're empowering small teams with technology that makes it easier to market and grow businesses. Our current focus is to help consumer brands shift from "workflow automation" to "agent management" within their marketing operations. Shadow is the AI coordination layer — providing shared AI memory, centralized agent control, and model orchestration for marketing teams. **Why join Shadow?** ==================== * **Product Ownership** You'll ship production code daily and help steer key product and technical decisions. * **Shape the Engineering Culture** You'll influence how we work—tools, processes, standards, and hiring. * **Work with Challenger Consumer Brands** Talk directly to customers (CEOs, CMOs, VP's) of fast\-growing consumer brands—some doing $80M–$500M in revenue. **The agency behind the product** ================================= Shadow is built alongside Darkroom — a performance marketing agency that's been operating for 10 years, employs 100\+ people, runs 100\+ clients at a time, and has worked with over 1,000 consumer brands. The agency is both our proving ground and our first user, which means the data you build with is real marketing data at real volume from day one — not a synthetic demo. **This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone (9 AM–5 PM EST).** **The role** ============ You'll sit squarely at the intersection of back‑end and front‑end, ensuring seamless integration between APIs, databases, UIs, and ML services. You'll design, build, and scale features end‑to‑end, especially our AI/ML‑powered experiences, while mentoring peers and driving architecture decisions. **Core Tech \& Tools** * **Languages \& Frameworks:** Python, Node.js, React (TypeScript) * **Datastore:** PostgreSQL * **Cloud \& Infra:** Google Cloud Platform, Airflow, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes * **ML/AI:** LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering **What you'll own** =================== * Architect and implement full‑stack features, from database schema to React components, optimized for scale and reliability. * Build and maintain RESTful/GraphQL APIs, data pipelines, and distributed services in GCP. * Integrate, prompt, and debug LLMs and generative AI tools; own RAG or fine‑tuning pipelines. * Ensure front‑end and back‑end systems interoperate flawlessly, minimize friction, optimize data flow, and enforce contracts. * Collaborate with product, research, design, and infra teams to define requirements, iterate rapidly, and ship production‑grade code. * Monitor performance, reliability, and security. * Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, architecture reviews, and shared best practices. **Must haves** ============== * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience with end‑to‑end ownership in a full‑stack role. * Deep expertise in Python, Node.js, React/TypeScript, and PostgreSQL. * Able to be hands‑on with GCP, containerization (Docker/K8s), and building/supporting high‑traffic systems. * Proven experience integrating AI/ML models (LLMs, NLP, RAG) into production apps. * Familiarity or strong interest in working with MCP servers. * Exceptional problem‑solving skills and a product mindset: you think deeply about UX, performance, and business impact. * You sweat both technical details and end\-user experience. **Nice to haves** ================= * Experience with multi‑step or agentic AI workflows. * Background in AI infrastructure or tooling companies. * Contributions to open‑source AI/ML projects. **What It's Like to Work at Darkroom** ====================================== Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world\-class talent building something remarkable. We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. * **Unlimited PTO \+ US holidays:** Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp. * **Remote\-First Culture:** Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in\-office time. Hub locations include the Brazil and Spain. * **Health \& Wellness:** Company\-sponsored medical, dental, and vision coverage. * **Finances, growth, and retirement:** Darkroom offers a robust 401(k) program with company match and profit\-sharing opportunities to help you save and grow as the company grows. * **Parental Leave:** Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition. * **Growth:** Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry. **Compensation:** ----------------- The base salary range for this role is $120,000\-160,000 per year. This range represents the anticipated minimum and maximum for this position and applies to candidates based in New York, including New York City, in compliance with the New York State Pay Transparency Law and the New York City Salary Transparency Law. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on experience, skills, and qualifications. This role is also eligible for performance\-based compensation. A summary of benefits is listed above. **Equal Opportunity Statement** ------------------------------- Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

jobs.description: As a Sr. Solutions Engineer on the AI native team supporting the Digital Natives business, you will shape the future of the big data landscape by working with the most sophisticated data engineering and data science teams in the world. Reporting to the Field Engineering Manager, you will collaborate with customers, product teams, and the broader customer\-facing team to develop architectures and solutions using our platform and APIs. As well as validating integrations with cloud services, home grown tools, and other 3rd party applications * Collaborate with your fellow Solutions Architects, using your skills to support each other and our users * Become an expert in, promote, and recruit contributors for Databricks inspired open\-source projects (Spark, Delta Lake, and MLflow) across the developer community. **What we look for:** * 4\+ years in a data engineering, data science, technical architecture, or similar pre\-sales/consulting role * Experience building distributed data systems * Comfortable programming in and debugging Python and SQL * Have built solutions with public cloud providers such as AWS, Azure, or GCP * Expertise in one of the following: * + Data Engineering technologies (*Ex: Spark, Hadoop, Kafka*) + Data Science and Machine Learning technologies (*Ex: pandas, scikit\-learn, PyTorch, Tensorflow*) * Available to travel to customers in your region * \[Desired] Degree in a quantitative discipline (Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research) * Nice to have: Databricks Certification * Location: Remote (Pacific Time preferred; Mountain Time considered). Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio\-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics. **Compliance** **If access to export\-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.**

jobs.title: Senior Sales Engineer - AI Accounts
jobs.description: As a Senior Sales Engineer on Datadog's AI Accounts team, you'll serve as the technical lead for a small portfolio of the world's leading AI labs — accounts that today represent a meaningful share of Datadog's revenue and are growing faster than any cohort in our business. You'll own the technical relationship end to end, work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with customer engineering teams in production, and help define how Datadog shows up for a cohort whose buying behavior looks nothing like traditional enterprise. This team was piloted earlier this year and is now being formalized. You'll be joining early enough to shape the playbook rather than inherit one. **What You'll Do** * Own the technical relationship across a small portfolio of AI labs, go deep on how each customer trains, serves, and scales their models (and/or the downstream products and platforms), and become the person their engineers call first * Partner with your AE to drive expansion inside accounts that grow unpredictably and fast: identify new workloads and teams as they spin up, and get in front of them before a need becomes a ticket * Lead discovery inside flat, engineering\-led organizations where influence sits with individual contributors rather than titles, and where there are no formal scoping calls to rely on * Run full\-scale POVs in production rather than controlled pilots: instrument real workloads at real scale, prove value against the customer's own success criteria, and work through the operational realities of doing that safely * Act as an extension of the customer's engineering/observability team rather than an external operator \- this requires judgment about which standard gates serve the customer and which to break * Work Slack\-native and asynchronously as the default, with the responsiveness and proactive posture these accounts expect: flag new features, bugs, and incidents before they ask * Bring product and engineering in early and often, and close the loop fast — leadership needs near\-real\-time signal from this cohort, and you'll be a primary source of it * Deliver technical narratives that land with engineers who pay for capability first and rationalize cost second \- savings is a downstream conversation, not an opener * Build reusable assets and patterns from each engagement so the next lab onboards faster than the last * Keep activity, deal progress, and customer context documented and current **Who You Are** * 7\+ years in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a comparable technical customer\-facing role; equivalent depth gained inside an AI lab, AI infrastructure company, or ML platform team is equally welcome * Hands\-on depth in the AI/ML infrastructure stack: GPU fleet management, distributed training, inference serving, model and agent evaluation, and the observability challenges specific to each * Strong foundation in public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), Kubernetes, APM and distributed tracing, and modern, agentic observability practice and usage patterns (i.e. MCP) * Comfortable in flat organizations \- able to engage an IC and a founder in the same week and calibrate to both without reaching for hierarchy * Biased toward doing: you'd rather solve a customer's problem and explain the shortcut afterward than ask permission first, and you have the judgment to know where that line sits * Thrive in ambiguity and unpredictable growth \- scoping, timelines, and account trajectories will change under you, repeatedly * Actively coachable. The strongest people we hire ask for a dry run, take the feedback, and visibly change what they do on the next attempt * Persistent about access. Getting time with people operating at this pace is hard, and you treat that as an interesting problem rather than a demoralizing one * Demonstrated capability using AI tooling in your own workflow and scaling it to others — credibility with this cohort depends on being a practitioner, not an observer * Experience mentoring peers or contributing to team enablement * Willing to travel for multi\-day onsites with customer engineering teams and for industry and research conferences *Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- Catalyst Capital is a profitable, bootstrapped holding company building a diversified financial services group: education, publishing, software, wealth and tax planning tools, investment products and proprietary trading technology. Funded entirely from its own operating cash. We have never taken outside capital. The cash engine is Decentralized Masters, a DeFi education business that went from zero to 150\+ people, 4,500\+ paying members and roughly $48\.6M of FY26 revenue at \~25% earnings before tax in four years. That engine funds everything else on this page. **Role summary** ---------------- Catalyst Capital is hiring its first Chief Information Security Officer to own security across every brand in the group. You will set the strategy, build the program, and personally run the response when something goes wrong. The job is two halves. Half is the core of a CISO's role: incident response, identity and access, vendor risk, phishing defense, policy and audit readiness, and the judgment calls only a person can own. The other half is making security AI\-driven: mapping our full surface and building agentic systems that test, monitor and audit it with near\-total coverage, so security keeps pace as more of the company runs on AI. This is a player\-coach role: about half hands\-on, leading a small team of engineers. You report to Group leadership, brief the leadership team monthly, and are the person they trust to explain risk in plain language and make the call under pressure. **What you will own** --------------------- ### **Core security leadership (about half)** * Security strategy and program. Own the security strategy, roadmap and budget across Decentralized Masters, Legacy, Inflection Club, Sentinelis and future brands. Report posture, top risks and trends to leadership every month, with a risk register leadership can act on. * Incident response. Own IR end to end: detection, triage, containment, eradication, recovery and the postmortem. Lead the room during a live incident and coordinate with legal counsel, forensics firms, insurers and regulators. Keep runbooks current and run tabletop exercises. * Cloud and identity security. Own identity and access across the group: SSO, MFA, least\-privilege roles, admin redundancy and short\-lived credentials. Set the AWS security baseline. * Third\-party and vendor risk. Assess the security of every vendor and data provider we depend on, including their audits and attestations, and set the bar a vendor must clear before connecting to our systems or data. * Platform and customer account security. Set the standards for login protection and account\-takeover defense on our platforms, and work with the engineering teams that own each platform to build them in. * Phishing and impersonation defense. Own email security, staff training and phishing simulations. Run brand protection: find and take down fake domains and accounts impersonating our brands and leaders. * Policy, compliance and trust. Write and enforce policies people actually follow. Prepare the company for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 with Legal \& Compliance. Own the public security and trust story, including the trust page on our products. * Team leadership. Manage and develop our security engineers, decide what we build in\-house versus outsource, and grow the team only where automation cannot do the job. * Member scam awareness. Supply the security content behind scam\-awareness messaging to members, working with Community, Support and Marketing. Legal approves the wording. ### **AI\-driven security (about half)** * Full attack\-surface map. Build and maintain a living inventory of everything we run: internal apps, cloud, code repos, and every SaaS tool and integration (CRM, telephony, community, payments, data providers). Know what connects to what, who has access, and what is logged. * Agentic security harness. Design and run AI\-driven systems that approach 100% coverage: automated code and dependency review, continuous configuration and access audits, and vendor documentation review. Humans set direction and make the judgment calls; agents do the exhaustive work. * AI\-driven detection and logging. Own the security stack (SIEM, Rapid7; endpoint protection; email security; identity and device management), make sure every critical system sends usable logs, and use AI to triage alerts and hunt across them. * Secure AI and vibe\-coding standards. Set the rules for how teams build with AI: what can ship, what data AI tools may touch, and the review path before anything with customer data goes live. * AI agent security. As more of the company runs on agents and automations, secure them: scoped credentials and tool permissions, prompt\-injection defense, data exposure, and monitoring and guardrails for agents in production. Review high\-risk agents before launch, including our own security agents. **Scope** --------- This role protects our company, our platforms, our data and our brands. For members' personal wallets and accounts outside our platforms, our role is education: helping members recognize and avoid scams. **Requirements** **What you will bring** ----------------------- **Must have** ------------- * 10\+ years in security, including 3\+ years leading a security function as CISO, Head of Security or equivalent at a company of 100\+ people. * Has led live\-incident response, not just tabletop exercises, including briefing executives during the incident. * Has built or rebuilt a security program from an early stage: strategy, policy, tooling, training and incident response. * AI\-native operator. Uses AI agents daily to do the work: writing detections, reviewing code and configs, reading vendor documentation, drafting policy. Can show us the harnesses, workflows or automations you have built, and knows where AI stops and human judgment has to take over. * Deep, current knowledge of AI\-specific risks: prompt injection, over\-scoped agent permissions, credential and data exposure through AI tools, and insecure AI\-generated code. * Hands\-on with cloud security (AWS preferred), identity and access management, SIEM, endpoint protection and email security. * Writes code: scripts, tooling and automation, not only vendor UIs. * Experience in crypto, fintech or another high\-fraud industry, and deep knowledge of phishing, social engineering and impersonation attacks. * Can read the fine print: thorough with documentation, contracts and vendor security terms, and documents everything so nothing slips through. * Briefs executives in plain language, trains non\-technical staff, and writes policy people follow. * Player\-coach: comfortable spending about half your time hands\-on while leading a small, fully remote team across many time zones. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Has prepared a company for SOC 2 or ISO 27001\. * Has secured or evaluated AI agents and LLM\-based tools in production. * Has run a third\-party risk program covering financial data aggregators or similar providers. * Has run a brand protection or takedown program. * Experience with customer\-facing security features such as account\-takeover defense. * Experience with risk quantification (FAIR or similar) and presenting to a board. * Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GCIH or OSCP. **Benefits** **What We Offer** ----------------- * Competitive compensation package * Independent Contractor opportunity * Fully remote, globally distributed team * Team offsites (Dubai, Costa Rica, etc.) * Collaborative, forward\-thinking culture that values innovation and results

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, ML Performance, GenAI, DeepMind
jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or a related STEM field or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience in software development, systems programming, or applied ML engineering or equivalent education credit (e.g., internships, student research, pre\-graduate working experience). * 3 years of experiencewith performance optimization, systems data analysis, visualization tools, or debugging. * 3 years of experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Machine Learning and related frameworks. * 1 year of experience designing and launching production software products or foundation AI systems. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, or related technical field. * 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role setting architectural direction and guiding project teams. * Experience developing, evaluating, or serving large language models, agentic workflows, multimodal pipelines, or AI runtime APIs (e.g., PyTorch, JAX, Triton, vLLM, Gemini API). * Expertise or strong interest in the following areas: performance debugging and optimization of complex workloads, design of performance tools, compiler design and code optimization, high\-performance software development techniques, concurrent programming, or multi\-core computer architectures. **About the job** ----------------- At Google DeepMind our mission is to build the world's first general\-purpose learning agent. Central to this mission is the complex task of measuring the intelligence of our prototypes. As a Software Engineer, you will be working with the cutting edge AI agents developed by our exceptional team of Machine Learning and Neuroscience research scientists. Your responsibilities will include everything from creating systems for agent testing using 2D and 3D games to developing test problems within physics simulators. You will create graphical visualization of results, build competitive agent leaderboards and test new algorithms on robots. To succeed in this role you will need to have a strong foundation in software engineering and enjoy working on a wide range of challenging problems within a mission\-driven team. We focus on identifying and achieving performance improvements in production and research ML workloads, with an emphasis on LLM inference—including serving latency, throughput, and cost per token—as well as the emerging demands of agentic workflows on current and next\-generation TPU platforms. We work across the entire stack, ranging from model architecture and sharding strategies to Pallas/Mosaic kernels and XLA. Additionally, we partner closely with the Gemini modeling, Deployment, Compiler, and TPU hardware teams to shape the capabilities of next\-generation accelerators. Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high\-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority. We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Share these insights to influence future TPU hardware and compiler roadmaps. * Implement model compression techniques—such as quantization and sparsity—to reduce the cost\-per\-token for production Gemini models. Evaluate new architectures, optimizers, and training methods to achieve target quality with reduced compute requirements. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Francisco, CA, USA; Mountain View, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. * 8 years of experience in software development. * 5 years of experience testing, and launching software products. * 3 years of experience with software design and architecture. * 2 years of experience in reinforcement learning, imitation learning, multimodal generative modeling, training and inference, and large vision, vision\-language, video, and other multimodal models. * 1 year of experience building generative architectures or world models applied to video, robotics, or interactive simulation environments. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. * 8 years of experience with data structures and algorithms. * 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction. * 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross\-functional, or cross\-business projects. **About the job** ----------------- As a Research Engineer on the Companion Robots team, you will train expressive, emotionally legible motion—including gait, gaze, posture, and gesture that change visibly with the robot's internal state—and develop the metrics to evaluate its effectiveness. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Applied AI
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ San Francisco, CA **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- On\-site **Department** -------------- Engineering **Compensation** ---------------- * Software Engineer$173\.8K – $212\.4K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus • 10% Bonus This range is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills and experience. There may be instances where a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description. Please note that the compensation details listed on US role postings reflect the base salary only and does not include bonus, equity or benefits. **Company Overview** ==================== Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion\-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real\-time APIs for speech\-to\-text (STT), text\-to\-speech (TTS), and building production\-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300\+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice\-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self\-hosted and on\-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. **Company Operating Rhythm** ============================ At Deepgram, we expect an AI\-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day\-to\-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9\-to\-5\. **Team Overview** The Applied AI team takes on the voice AI problems that don’t have off\-the\-shelf answers. We work directly with enterprise customers and technology partners, from conversational AI and customer experience platforms to restaurant brands, and much of the work is zero to one. Current focus areas include robust ASR in noisy outdoor environments, self\-service fine\-tuning and model adaptation, domain\-aware voice agents for drive\-thru and phone ordering, agent scoring and evaluation, real\-time operational analytics, and on\-site hardware integration. We’re a small team that works in person in San Francisco, ships to production quickly, and stays close to the customers we build for. **Key Goals** * Ship production features in live voice agent products, such as drive\-thru and phone ordering, within your first quarter. * Own customer problems end to end: hear the issue, find the root cause, and get the fix into production. * Help build reusable agent modules, like ordering and reservations, so new customers and industries launch faster. * Make agents more accurate on real\-world menus and catalogs, keeping structured data consistent across hundreds of locations. * Contribute to fine\-tuning and model adaptation so customers get accurate results on their own vocabulary and domains. * Spot problems across the product before anyone asks, then fix them or bring a proposed solution. * Run experiments that show whether new functionality improves outcomes for customers. **Minimum Skills, Knowledge \& Capabilities** * Experience building and shipping backend services that run in production in the cloud. * Operates AI\-native: you build with modern AI coding tools as your default way of working, not occasionally, and use them to move fast without lowering the quality bar. * Learns quickly and takes on unfamiliar parts of the stack with little ramp\-up. * Finds work instead of waiting for it: you recognize problems, propose solutions, and follow them through. * Has taken something from idea to production, at work or on your own time. * Communicates clearly with teammates and is comfortable working directly with customers. * Builds for the customer’s outcome, with a high bar for quality and no over\-engineering. * Comfortable working across languages. Our stack is mainly Kotlin and Python, with TypeScript on the front end. **Preferred Qualifications (nice\-to\-have)** * Hands\-on experience training, fine\-tuning, or adapting models, through work, research, or substantial projects. * Experience building evaluation or scoring for models or agents. * Experience with audio, speech\-to\-text, or text\-to\-speech. * Experience as a founder or early startup engineer, or taking a system from zero to one. * Typically 2\+ years of engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated experience. ***Notice****: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @**deepgram.com* *email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.* Compensation Range: $173\.8K \- $212\.4K

jobs.title: Senior Advisor, Data Science
jobs.description: **Senior Advisor \- Data Science** Data Science is all about breaking new ground to enable businesses to answer their most urgent questions. Pioneering massively parallel data\-intensive analytic processing, our mission is to develop a whole new approach to generating meaning and value from petabyte\-scale data sets and shape brand new methodologies, tools, statistical methods and models. What’s more, we are in collaboration with leading academics, industry experts and highly skilled engineers to equip our customers to generate sophisticated new insights from the biggest of big data. Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a **Senior Advisor** on our **Data Science Team** in **Round Rock, Texas**. **What you’ll achieve** As a Data Science \- Senior Advisor, you will be responsible for contributing to business strategy and influence decision making based on information gained from deep dive analysis. 15%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. **Preferred:** * Master's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering or other analytical field, OR comparable direct work experience. * Significant experience with MLOps and associated serving frameworks (i.e., FastAPI, etc.) and orchestration pipelines (e.g., SageMaker Pipelines, Step Functions, etc.). * Significant experience working with open jobs.title: Data Engineering Lead
jobs.description: **Job Description:** **Lead the Data Teams Powering Modern Customer Experiences** You know great data engineering is about more than pipelines and platforms. It's about helping people make smarter decisions, creating reliable data foundations, and enabling meaningful customer experiences at scale. As a **Data Engineering Lead**, you'll guide talented engineering teams, shape technical strategy, partner with clients, and influence how modern data platforms are built and operated. You'll balance leadership with hands\-on technical involvement, helping teams solve complex challenges while delivering measurable business outcomes. This is a true **player\-coach opportunity** where you'll lead people, drive delivery excellence, and help define the future of data engineering, cloud platforms, AI\-enabled solutions, and customer data ecosystems. **What You'll Do** **Lead and Grow High\-Performing Teams** You'll support the development of Data Engineers by providing coaching, mentorship, career guidance, and opportunities for growth. You'll help create an environment where team members can learn, contribute, and thrive. **Drive Technical Delivery** You'll oversee complex data engineering initiatives, partnering with Solution Architects and stakeholders to deliver scalable, high\-quality data solutions. You'll help guide technical decisions, manage delivery risks, and ensure successful outcomes across multiple engagements. **Shape Engineering Excellence** You'll establish and promote best practices across data engineering, including CI/CD, testing, code reviews, observability, data quality, documentation, and governance. You'll help create repeatable approaches that enable teams to deliver consistently and effectively. **Partner with Clients and Stakeholders** You'll collaborate with client leaders, business stakeholders, architects, and delivery teams to translate business goals into actionable engineering solutions. You'll communicate complex technical concepts in a way that supports informed decision\-making and successful project outcomes. **Innovate with AI and Emerging Technologies** You'll help evaluate and adopt modern technologies, including AI\-assisted engineering tools, cloud\-native analytics platforms, warehouse\-native AI solutions, and next\-generation data architecture patterns. **What You'll Bring** **Required Qualifications** * 7\+ years of experience in data engineering, including cloud\-based data platforms, ELT/ETL processes, and production data pipelines. * Strong experience with platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, Google BigQuery, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, or Amazon Redshift. * Advanced SQL and Python skills. * Experience with orchestration and transformation tools such as dbt, Apache Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Dagster, Prefect, or similar technologies. * Experience designing data models and customer\-centric data solutions. * Understanding of data quality, lineage, observability, and governance best practices. * Experience with Git, CI/CD, and modern engineering workflows. * 2\+ years leading, mentoring, or managing data engineering teams. * Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with technical and non\-technical audiences. **Preferred Qualifications** Experience with any combination of the following is welcomed: * Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, Adobe Real\-Time CDP, Salesforce Data Cloud, or related certifications. * Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), Real\-Time CDP, Customer Journey Analytics, Salesforce Data Cloud, Braze, or other customer data platforms. * AWS, Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure, or Infrastructure as Code technologies such as Terraform. * AI/ML technologies, warehouse\-native AI capabilities, feature engineering, vector databases, or LLM\-ready data architectures. * Data privacy, governance, consent management, and secure data exchange practices. * Pre\-sales, solution design, technical estimation, or consulting experience. **Why You'll Love This Opportunity** **Make an Impact Beyond the Code** Your work will influence how organizations use data to better understand and engage their customers. The decisions you help make will drive business outcomes across analytics, customer data platforms, AI solutions, and customer experience technologies. **Grow as a Leader** You'll have the opportunity to mentor engineers, shape engineering culture, build delivery standards, and contribute to the long\-term growth of both the team and the broader practice. **Work with Modern Technology** From cloud data warehouses and customer data platforms to AI\-assisted engineering and emerging data technologies, you'll have exposure to innovative tools and platforms that are shaping the future of the industry. **We Encourage You to Apply** We recognize that talent comes from many different backgrounds and experiences. If you're excited about leading teams, building modern data solutions, and helping organizations unlock the value of their data, we encourage you to apply, even if your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed. Your unique perspective, experience, and ideas can help us build stronger teams, better solutions, and more meaningful outcomes for our clients. The annual salary range for this position is $94,000 \- $135K. Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law. Benefits available with this position include: * Medical, vision, and dental insurance, * Life insurance, * Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, * 401k, * Flexible paid time off, * At least 15 paid holidays per year, * Paid sick and safe leave, and * Paid parental leave. Dentsu also complies with applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act, in accordance with its plans and policies. For further details regarding Dentsu benefits, please visit www.dentsubenefitsplus.com. To begin the application process, please click on the “Apply” button at the top of this job posting. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and qualified candidates will be contacted for next steps. \#LI\-AJ1 **Location:** Chicago \- N. State**Brand:** Merkle**Time Type:** Full time**Contract Type:** Permanent Dentsu is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. We do this without regard to race, color, national origin, sex , sexual orientation, gender identity, age, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, ancestry, physical or mental disability, marital status, political affiliation, religious practices and observances, citizenship status, genetic information, veteran status, or any other basis protected under applicable federal, state, or local law. Dentsu is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to, among others, individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans. If you need an accommodation because of a disability to search and apply for a career opportunity with us, please send an e\-mail to ApplicantAccommodations@dentsu.com by clicking on the link to let us know the nature of your accommodation request and your contact information. We are here to support you.

jobs.title: Staff AI Architect
jobs.description: **Company Description** Domino’s is a purpose\-inspired, performance\-driven company powered by exceptional people who are committed to feeding the power of possible—one pizza at a time. Founded in 1960 as a single store in Ypsilanti, Michigan, Domino’s has grown into the largest pizza company in the world, with more than 22,300 stores across 90\+ markets. Our success is built on the strength of our people, technology, and franchise system. As a leader in innovation, we continue to transform the pizza and QSR industry while creating opportunities for team members to learn, grow and thrive. If you're ready to make an impact, build a meaningful career and help shape what's next, there's a place for you at Domino's. **Job Description** As Staff AI Architect, you own the technical architecture for Domino's enterprise AI platform – spanning classical AI, generative AI, and agentic AI. This is the senior individual\-contributor technical authority on AI: you set the direction for how AI capabilities are built, served, orchestrated, and governed, and you drive outcomes through design authority and influence rather than direct reports. You own the reference architecture and the paved road teams build on, and the build\-depth judgment for every incoming ask – production now, minimum viable, scaffolded as a contract for later, or deliberately deferred rather than quietly dropped. This is a deeply hands\-on role for an architect who has delivered AI platforms and solutions at enterprise scale – someone who knows why a technique works and when it survives contact with enterprise data, latency budgets, unit economics, and governance, and who still builds prototypes and reference implementations. Our environment is Azure\-primary with Databricks. **Responsibilities** Architecture Ownership and Direction * Own the enterprise AI reference architecture end to end, establishing scalable standards, principles, and design patterns across business groups. * Own the roadmap for agentic systems platforms, translating business objectives into sequenced technical strategy, milestones, and a build\-depth decision for every use case with explicit, traceable reasoning. * Design and maintain the paved road for AI development – golden patterns for building, serving, evaluating, and integrating models and agents, with an API\-first integration default, MCP by exception against explicit criteria, and guardrails inherited rather than bolted on per team – so teams ship without re\-solving solved problems. * Guide optimization of AI compute and token usage as adoption scales, and lead build\-versus\-buy, model, and framework decisions with evidence – benchmarks, cost per answer, real\-load latency. Semantic Search, Retrieval and RAG Architecture * Chunking, embedding and indexing: design chunking strategy per content type and tune size, overlap, and boundaries against measured retrieval quality; select and evaluate embedding models; own re\-embedding and versioning. * Query construction and hybrid retrieval: implement query rewriting, decomposition, and expansion; combine dense and sparse retrieval with fusion and re\-ranking; manage the recall\-versus\-precision and latency trade\-off explicitly. * Retrieval and response evaluation: instrument recall, precision and faithfulness against curated golden datasets; ground answers in the certified semantic layer and knowledge graphs where they outperform vector retrieval; design for graceful abstention over confident wrong answers. Generative AI Portfolio * Define prompt and instruction management standards – versioning, templating, context budgeting, and regression testing on prompt or model changes. * Own the AI gateway and multi\-model routing, matching each request to the right model on complexity, cost, latency, and quality, and own the benchmarking discipline for how models are compared, selected, and re\-tested as the landscape shifts. * Establish the evaluation harness as a launch gate – offline/online evaluation, LLM\-as\-judge with human calibration, A/B and shadow testing, and an explicit quality threshold we won't launch below. * Hold a clear, evidence\-based position on when prompt engineering suffices versus when fine\-tuning or customization is warranted, and define caching strategy as a deliberate cost and latency lever. Agentic AI Portfolio * Architect the orchestration layer that chains agents, tools, retrieval, and human review – orchestration as the enforced contract, domain agents scoped by journey and business context, and a reusable skills and tool layer where reusability actually lives. * Design memory and context management with an explicit position on what persists, for how long, and under what access rules; define enterprise standards for tool/function calling and MCP server contracts. * Establish agent guardrails – authorization scope, permission models, approval and escalation paths, sandboxing, fallback behavior, and safe failure – plus step\-level tracing, regressio data ingestion, transformation pipelines, chunking and indexing strategies, vector and hybrid retrieval, knowledge graphs, metadata models, lineage, provenance, data quality, and access controls, including grounding conversational experiences in structured data (text\-to\-SQL, multi\-turn dialogue). * Model evaluation and production lifecycle engineering. Experience establishing evaluation frameworks and benchmarks (recall@k, NDCG, groundedness, LLM\-as\-judge), automated testing, release controls, model and prompt versioning, observability, quality monitoring, incident response, rollback, and ongoing improvement using MLOps and LLMOps principles. * Security, privacy, responsible AI, and governance. Ability to build identity, authorization, privacy, model security, human oversight, regulatory controls, and auditability into the architecture from the start. Must understand AI\-specific threats such as prompt injection, sensitive\-data leakage, unsafe agent actions, and model or software supply\-chain risk. * Scalability, reliability, performance, and AI economics. Ability to make quantitative architecture decisions on latency, throughput, concurrency, availability, capacity, inference architecture, compute utilization, quality\-versus\-performance trade\-offs, consumption forecasting, and cost optimization, including AI FinOps at scale. * Business and value\-oriented solution architecture. Ability to translate business strategy into qualified AI use cases, measurable outcomes, target\-state architectures, investment priorities, and delivery roadmaps. Must separate value\-producing opportunities from technology demos and tie solutions to operational or financial KPIs. * End\-to\-end delivery with hands\-on technical credibility. Demonstrated ability to move from discovery and architecture through experimentation, production deployment, and operational improvement. Able to build or review prototypes (Python, SQL, Spark), validate assumptions, review implementation designs, diagnose cross\-layer failures, and defend technical trade\-offs, with production depth in DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes, and model serving. * Technical leadership and stakeholder influence. Experience defining reusable patterns and standards, leading architecture reviews, mentoring engineers and architects, and aligning product, data science, engineering, infrastructure, security, and business teams. Creates clarity in ambiguity, leads with integrity and humility, and communicates well with executives and practitioners alike. * Substantial enterprise AI delivery experience. A strong record of leading complex AI or ML solutions in production at enterprise scale, typically 10\+ years across software, data, or ML engineering with significant architecture leadership. **Preferred Qualifications** * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft environment: Azure (AI Foundry and Agent Service, Azure OpenAI, Azure ML, AI Search, API Management, Functions), Databricks and Copilot Studio; agent frameworks such as LangGraph or Semantic Kernel and MCP. * Experience in retail, restaurant, e\-commerce, or supply chain with high\-volume, real\-time workloads and streaming (Kafka, Event Hubs) and model risk management. * Production multi\-agent systems and agent runtimes, policy\-aware agent gateways with authenticated tool routing and server registries, and GPU\-accelerated serving stacks. * Contributions to open\-source AI projects, published work, or recognized community involvement. **Additional Information** Benefits: * Paid Holidays and Vacation * Medical, Dental \& Vision benefits that start on the first day of employment * No\-cost mental health support for employee and dependents * Childcare tuition discounts * No\-cost fitness, nutrition, and wellness programs * Fertility benefits * Adoption assistance * 401k matching contributions * 15% off the purchase price of stock * Company bonus All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

This is hands\-on work with immediate product impact at real\-world scale. **You're excited about this opportunity because you will…** ----------------------------------------------------------- * Work directly with leadership and see your work shipped to millions of users, with a small team and massive reach. * Move fast without bureaucracy, with rapid iteration, high autonomy, and no layers of politics. * Own features across the entire stack, from UI to infrastructure, rather than a narrow slice. * Have access to global data scale, robust compute, and a platform primed for AI transformation. * Shape how AI transforms commerce, building intelligent and adaptive experiences for Consumers, Merchants, and Dashers. **We're excited about you because you have…** --------------------------------------------- * Strong full stack engineering experience, with depth in modern frontend frameworks (e.g. React, TypeScript) and backend development (e.g. Python, Go, Kotlin, or Java). * Experience designing and shipping production systems, including APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure, with a focus on reliability and performance. * A track record of shipping user\-facing products quickly and iterating based on real usage. * Interest in AI and familiarity with integrating LLMs or AI APIs into products (prior agent or ML experience is a plus, not a requirement). * A builder mindset: you're energized by experimentation, move quickly, and stay close to the work. * Strong cross\-functional instincts and a natural ability to bridge product, design, and research. **About DoorDash** ------------------ At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more. **Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** --------------------------------------------- We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. Statement of Non\-Discrimination: In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital/domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on "protected categories," we also strive to prevent other subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (i.e., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non\-binary or gender non\-conforming, LGBTQIA\+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently\-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Thank you to the Level Playing Field Institute for this statement of non\-discrimination. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation. **If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.** **Notice Regarding Use of AI and Automated Tools:** To streamline our hiring process, DoorDash utilizes an automated recruitment tool called Metaview. **How it works:** Metaview assists our recruiting team by evaluating job related qualifications and characteristics in connection with hiring. optical character recognition. * Partner with Engineering, Fulfillment Operations, and other cross\-functional teams to identify opportunities, improve operational workflows, and strengthen the systems supporting lottery fulfillment. * Elevate engineering standards through code reviews, technical documentation, automated testing, and mentorship while contributing to the team's broader data infrastructure. ### **What you’ll bring** * A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, with at least 3 years of machine learning engineering experience. * Proven experience developing, deploying, and maintaining machine learning models in production environments. * Strong proficiency in Python and software engineering best practices, including automated testing, data validation, and asynchronous programming. * Hands\-on experience with computer vision, multimodal or vision\-language models, and machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT, or vLLM. * Experience with model fine\-tuning, prompt design, performance evaluation, and image processing tools such as OpenCV. * Experience with cloud\-based machine learning platforms, preferably Google Cloud, and familiarity with containerization, orchestration, and monitoring tools such as Docker, Kubernetes,
