(CCC) is a leading cloud platform for the multi\-trillion\-dollar insurance economy**,** creating intelligent experiences for insurers, repairers, automakers, part suppliers, and more. At CCC, we're making life just work by empowering more than 35,000 businesses with industry\-leading technology to get drivers back on the road and to health quickly and seamlessly. We're pushing boundaries with innovative AI solutions that simplify and enhance the claims and repair journey. Through purposeful innovation and the strength of its connections, CCC technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most. Learn more about CCC at www.cccis.com. **The Role** As a Senior AI Engineer you will own LLM\-powered systems and agentic workflows for our customers. These systems automate the routine parts of a claim and guide customers on the rest, so they have to earn that trust with a measured accuracy you can defend as models change and usage grows. Agents run as steps inside deterministic workflows, and privacy and security are design baselines, not review gates. Agentic coding tools are how you move fast. What you add is what they are worst at: system architecture, code quality, security, and the debugging nobody else gets to the bottom of. You own a product area end to end and define the eval bar it ships against. Salary range is: $180,000 \- 225,000 This position is bonus eligible. **Key Responsibilities:** * Own the delivery of LLM\-powered systems in Python and TypeScript, from an ambiguous customer problem, scoped with product managers and data scientists, through production operation. * Set the evals and guardrails strategy for your area: what gates a release, what production signals the team watches, and how a change is simulated against historical claims before it ships. * Raise the bar for how the team works with agentic coding tools: sharpen the specifications, instruction files, hooks, and permission policies they run under, and hold generated code to the same review standard before it merges. * Design the NLP pipelines that turn unstructured claim data into structured data customers can act on, choosing where semantic search, classical NLP, or an LLM fits. * Build and operate durable, event\-driven, multi\-tenant systems in which agents run as steps inside deterministic workflows, designing their failure modes, replay semantics, and cost profile before they show up under load. * Own tracing and audit for your area: every model call and agent step recorded, so any recommendation can be reconstructed and cited back to its sources by on\-call and auditors alike. * Set the privacy and security baseline every system in your area starts from: tenant isolation, least\-privilege access for agents and their tools, redaction, retention, and what data may reach a model provider. * Author the design documents for complex systems to get feedback and buy\-in, review other engineers' designs and code with the same care, and mentor the engineers in your area. * Take part in a shared on\-call rotation for the systems you own. **Requirements:** * 6\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including an LLM\-powered system you architected, shipped to external customers, and carried through at least one model or prompt migration. * Python and TypeScript at the level of setting a team's conventions: the async model, typing strictness, and test strategy for a shared codebase, plus a performance problem you profiled and fixed. * An evals and guardrails strategy you set for a product area others built in: where human approval was required, and how production corrections re\-entered the evals. * A clear account of how you constrain an agentic coding tool's context and verify its output, from daily use of Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar on production work, plus changes you turned back, and why. * Pipelines you designed that blend LLMs, semantic search, and classical NLP, including a retrieval design you can defend and a case where a classical technique beat an LLM on cost, latency, or reliability. * Durable, event\-driven systems you designed with deterministic orchestration around non\-deterministic model steps: compensating actions, idempotency, backpressure, and event\-sourced replay. * Data modeling and development across relational, document, and graph databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Neo4j, including when each type fits and the partition\-key, consistency, and tenant\-isolation calls you made. * Systems architected and operated on Azure or AWS, with CI/CD and infrastructure as code, and hands\-on time with a durable workflow engine such as Temporal or the Durable Task Scheduler. * Technical design documents you have authored for systems that span more than one team, used to get feedback and buy\-in before building, and that those teams then built to. * Clear writing and discussion for technical and non\-technical audiences: drawing out a customer's real problem and explaining the trade\-offs back to them. **Even Better if You Have:** * React and TypeScript experience, so you can deliver a full\-stack feature end to end, especially chat, streaming, and citation\-heavy AI experiences. * Experience with agent frameworks, LangGraph, PydanticAI, and the Microsoft Agent Framework among them, and with the ways agents reach their tools: the Model Context Protocol (MCP), the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol, command\-line tools, and microservices. * Experience with LLM observability and evaluation tooling such as LangSmith, Arize, or Braintrust, and with OpenTelemetry\-based tracing. * Experience designing A/B tests for AI features. * Exposure to the insurance, claims, or automotive repair domains. **What Success Looks Like:** * In your first six months, every model change in your area is gated by evals you designed, regressions are caught before a customer sees them, and you can show the accuracy number held or moved. * You are trusted with the high\-stakes, ambiguous problems, and you turn them into a roadmap, a shipped system, and a number you can put in front of a customer. * You are energized by what agentic coding tools make possible. jobs.description: * Engineering * Atlanta * Full\-time ### **Description** Fetcherr builds responsible AI that transforms market complexity into measurable profit growth. At the core of the company is the Market Model \- a proprietary AI\-powered model delivering accurate, granular demand predictions with 96% forecast accuracy and real\-time decision intelligence for commercial teams. Built on a glass\-box architecture, it uses market data \- not personal data \- with full transparency into logic and outcomes. First deployed in global aviation, the technology is industry\-agnostic and scales across volatile markets. Fetcherr delivers a consistent average profit uplift of 7%, with corporate partners including Delta, Virgin Atlantic, WestJet, Viva, and Azul. While Fetcherr initially focused on the airline industry, the company is now expanding into additional verticals, bringing its dynamic AI\-driven optimization capabilities to new industries such as travel, mobility, retail, e\-commerce, and beyond. **About the Role** This is not a pure research role but one that is actively involved in building our product. You will be joining a team of Data Science Engineers and you will be directly contributing to code. You will own well\- scoped modeling problems end to end, from exploring market data and designing features to validating models and getting them running in production, so that our pricing, inventory, and network optimization engines make better decisions in real time. This is a high\-impact individual contributor role at the intersection of applied AI and production software, working directly with other data scientists, ML and data engineers, and product teams. **What you will do:** * Develop, validate, and iterate on demand forecasting, pricing, and optimization models using large\-scale, high\-velocity market data. * Explore and analyze data from diverse internal and external sources to uncover signals, define features, and identify opportunities to improve model accuracy and business impact. * Design and run offline experiments, backtests, and online evaluations to measure model performance and profit uplift. * Write production\-grade Python code and work with ML and data engineers to productionize models, ensuring they are reliable, observable, and cost\-efficient. * Monitor deployed models for drift, accuracy, and data quality issues, and troubleshoot and fix problems quickly. * Keep our glass\-box principles front and center: build models whose logic and outcomes can be explained to commercial teams and customers. * Partner with product and commercial stakeholders to translate business problems into clear modeling approaches and communicate results. * Contribute to the technical direction of the modeling stack as Fetcherr scales across new customers, verticals, and product lines. ### **Requirements** * 5\+ years of full\-time experience as a Data Scientist, Applied Scientist, ML Engineer, or similar role building models that run in production. Lab, proof of concept, prototype, academic, and part\-time experience does not count toward this requirement. * Strong programming skills in Python, with production\-grade coding practices (testing, code review, version control). * Solid foundation in statistics, machine learning, and time\-series forecasting, with sound judgment on model validation and experiment design. * Strong SQL skills and experience working with large relational and non\-relational datasets. * Experience and comfort with AI\-assisted software development, along with the ability to write and reason about code yourself. * Experience with cloud platforms (GCP and BigQuery preferred) and modern data warehouse and lakehouse technologies. * Familiarity with orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster) and CI/CD practices for ML and data pipelines. * Strong analytical mindset and a pragmatic, get\-it\-done approach. * Excellent collaboration and communication skills, comfortable working cross\-functionally with engineering and product teams. **Nice to Have** * Experience with dynamic pricing, revenue management, or optimization problems. * Experience in travel, e\-commerce, logistics, or other real\-time decisioning domains. * Exposure to MLOps practices such as model registries, monitoring, and automated retraining. * Experience with real\-time OLAP engines such as ClickHouse. * Experience in a Software\-as\-a\-Service environment.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
jobs.description: Flexcompute is leading the transformation of engineering simulation with our revolutionary ultra\-fast simulation technology. Our flagship products, including the industry\-leading Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) software Flow360 and electromagnetic simulation software Tidy3D, are reshaping how simulations are conducted across diverse sectors. Founded by visionaries from Stanford and MIT and supported by top\-tier venture capital firms, we are a rapidly growing team dedicated to breaking boundaries and challenging the norms of the multi\-billion\-dollar engineering simulation market. ### **Role Overview** We are looking for a **Senior Backend Software Engineer** to join our team in Madison, Wisconsin, and help us design and implement scalable solutions that meet the growing demands of our advanced EM simulation platform. Additionally, the candidate will help us enhance our data management, frontend\-backend API unification, and cloud integration. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Contribute to general software development efforts, such as API unification, simulation data management (e.g., caching, syncing, storage), and scripting improvements. * Collaborate with EM and infrastructure teams to implement simulation\-specific solutions, including enhancements to back\-end/scheduler integrations and Python front\-end functionality. * Improve our task pipelines through an innovative design for a web API in a multi\-physical simulation context. * Develop and maintain hybrid cloud compute and storage solutions, integrating on\-premise HPC systems with modern cloud platforms. * Optimize and manage high\-performance computing clusters equipped with high\-speed interconnects This is a senior seat. We keep the team small and senior on purpose, so you will own real pieces of the platform end to end, with little direction and direct access to the founders. This role is on\-site at our Madison office. Working from the office is a requirement: our product and application engineers are based in Madison, and this hire works alongside them in person. It is not a remote or hybrid role. **Requirements** **What you need** * Strong backend engineering in at least one of Java, Python or C\+\+. Deep in one is enough. * Real production cloud experience, AWS preferred. * Distributed systems you have operated in production, not only studied. * Direct ownership of a production backend service, from design through deployment and operation. * Fluent professional English, spoken and written. * Able to work on\-site at our Madison, Wisconsin office. This is required. * Authorized to work in the United States. * A bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering or a closely related field. **What you can learn here** We hire for depth, not checklists. You do not need all of the following on day one: Kubernetes and Docker, Terraform or Ansible, monitoring and observability tooling, Linux troubleshooting, networking and security practices, our simulation stack, and HPC (preferred, not mandatory). We look for people who have entered a new domain before, learned it fast and reached ownership. **Bonus** * Load balancing, autoscaling, and queues or streaming systems such as SQS, SNS or Kafka. * Experience integrating cloud platforms with HPC environments or large compute clusters. * Familiarity with job schedulers or batch systems, distributed compute frameworks, or large\-scale data pipelines. * Experience supporting scientific computing or simulation platforms. * Knowledge of GPU infrastructure and resource scheduling. * Experience building developer platforms or internal infrastructure tooling. * A degree in computer science, computer engineering, mathematics, physics or a related field from a leading university. Hands\-on production experience matters more than where you studied. Innovative Mindset: Ability to learn quickly, adapt to new challenges, and innovate in a fast\-paced startup environment. **Example Projects** * Architect and deploy infrastructure that runs distributed simulation workloads across cloud and on\-premise compute * Design and implement scalable web APIs for simulation job orchestration and data access * Build CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure\-as\-code systems for reproducible deployments * Develop hybrid cloud solutions connecting on\-prem HPC clusters with AWS compute and storage * Implement monitoring and observability systems to track simulation performance and reliability * Improve platform scalability to support growing user traffic and compute demand * Design secure service architectures, authentication, and licensing systems * Optimize infrastructure utilization across CPU and GPU resources **Join Us** By joining Flexcompute, you'll be at the heart of a movement set to redefine the engineering simulation industry. You will play a key role in shaping the future, where our innovations in simulation technology pave the way for groundbreaking advancements. We are committed to fostering an innovative and collaborative culture where boundaries of possibility are re\-imagined, driven by creativity, expertise, and a shared vision of transforming the technological landscape. **How we hire** No online assessment. Two to three technical conversations with the engineering team, then a final conversation with a co\-founder. Bring your questions: the first conversation is not a pitch you sit through, you are welcome to send questions ahead, and technical disagreement is welcome. **Benefits** * Competitive base salary, plus RSUs granted on day one and vesting over four years. * Medical, dental, and vision health insurance. * 401(k) contribution. * Flexible paid time off, all US national holidays, and a company\-wide year\-end break. * $1,200 a year fitness stipend. * Company\-paid trips to our Boston headquarters to work with the core team. * Learning sponsorship and an AI tools budget (we pay for Claude, Cursor and similar). * Friendly, thoughtful, and intelligent coworkers.

jobs.title: Wireless System Administrator
jobs.description: **Your Job** Flint Hills Resources in Corpus Christi, Texas, is looking for a Wireless System Administrator to join our DCS/PLC team. This role will serve as the refinery's primary technical resource for the reliability, administration, and lifecycle management of critical industrial wireless infrastructure supporting field instrumentation, process monitoring, mobile connectivity, and other operational technologies. The Wireless System Administrator will be responsible for maintaining reliable wireless coverage and system performance, troubleshooting infrastructure issues, managing upgrades and obsolescence, and working with Instrumentation, IT/OT, Engineering, Operations, vendors, and project teams to ensure the wireless infrastructure continues to meet refinery needs. This position also provides a unique opportunity to develop broader industrial automation skills. As part of the DCS/PLC team, the successful candidate will have opportunities to gain experience supporting PLC and DCS systems, including control\-system hardware, industrial communications, troubleshooting, projects, commissioning, and lifecycle activities. **Our Team** The DCS/PLC team supports the specification, installation, configuration, maintenance, lifecycle management, reliability, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of the refinery's automation systems. Team members work closely with operations, process control engineers, IT/OT resources, project engineers, designers, instrument technicians, electricians, and other site stakeholders to deliver practical solutions across both control system and PLC\-supported equipment. The Wireless System Administrator will bring dedicated ownership and reliability focus to the refinery's industrial wireless infrastructure while having the opportunity to expand technical capabilities across PLC, DCS, safety\-system, and industrial automation technologies. **What You Will Do** * Serve as the refinery's primary technical resource and system owner for critical industrial wireless infrastructure. * Manage the reliability, availability, performance, and lifecycle of wireless networks supporting field instrumentation, process monitoring, mobile connectivity, and other operational technologies. * Administer, maintain, configure, and troubleshoot wireless access points, gateways, antennas, controllers, and associated network equipment. * Monitor system health, coverage, capacity, interference, redundancy, and communications performance; identify and implement improvements that reduce operational risk. * Perform or coordinate wireless coverage surveys and support network design, expansion, optimization, and commissioning activities. * Develop lifecycle strategies for wireless infrastructure, including equipment condition, obsolescence, upgrades, software and firmware management, spares, and replacement planning. * Maintain accurate wireless network topology, asset, coverage, configuration, backup, cybersecurity, and lifecycle documentation. * Partner with Instrument Technicians to troubleshoot communication paths between field instrumentation and the site wireless infrastructure. * Work with IT/OT teams on wireless controllers, servers, networks, cybersecurity requirements, access management, redundancy, patching, and infrastructure maintenance. * Partner with Project Engineers, design teams, vendors, and contractors to define wireless and fiber requirements, equipment selection, installation standards, coverage expectations, testing, and turnover requirements. * Support Management of Change, incident investigation, root\-cause analysis, corrective actions, and reliability improvement initiatives associated with wireless systems. * Develop working knowledge of the refinery's PLC and DCS platforms through cross\-training, troubleshooting support, project participation, commissioning, and lifecycle activities. * As capability develops, assist with PLC/DCS support activities. * Participate in the DCS/PLC team on\-call support rotation as required. **Why This Role Matters** Reliable industrial wireless infrastructure is increasingly critical to refinery monitoring, instrumentation, connectivity, and operational decision\-making. This role provides ownership of that infrastructure and helps ensure it is reliable, secure, supportable, and prepared for future site needs. The position also offers a development path into PLC, DCS, safety\-system, and broader industrial automation support as part of the DCS/PLC team. **Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)** * Two or more years troubleshooting, administering, or maintaining industrial wireless or networking equipment, such as wireless field instrumentation, access points, gateways, radios, antennas, switches, and controllers. * Ability to troubleshoot across instrumentation, electrical, networking, IT/OT, and control\-system disciplines. * Ability to read technical documentation such as network drawings, wireless coverage maps, P\&IDs, instrument loop drawings, and architecture diagrams. * Ability to participate in the DCS/PLC team on\-call rotation and respond to operational needs as required. * Ability to work in an industrial refinery environment and follow applicable safety, security, and site access requirements. * Ability to perform field walkdowns, access operating areas, and work around installed wireless and communications infrastructure as job duties require. **What Will Put You Ahead** * Four or more years of experience supporting industrial wireless or other operational technology in a refinery, chemical plant, manufacturing facility, or similar industrial environment. * Hands\-on experience with WirelessHART, ISA100, industrial Wi\-Fi, LoRaWAN, private LTE/5G, or other wireless technologies. * Working knowledge of PLC, DCS, or SIS platforms, including servers, workstations, controllers, processors, and I/O. This role is subject to the Transportation Workers Identification Credentialing (TWIC) rule and requires the successful candidate to obtain a TWIC identification badge, allowing for un\-escorted access to the facility within a specific time period. At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. We're looking for an **AI Engineer** to own this system end to end: design, develop, test, and **deploy the graph layer to Production on a Google Cloud Platform–native stack**, and build the agent\-facing serving layer on top of it. You will turn raw industrial event data into a governed, traversable graph that powers Ford's next generation of engineering, manufacturing, quality, and supply\-chain agents. **Graph Layer** * Design, develop, test, and deploy the ISDP knowledge graph from the domain event store to Production using cloud\-native data pipelines. * Model and evolve the graph's entities and relationships as new data sources are onboarded. **MCP serving layer** * Design, build, and operate the **MCP server** that exposes the ISDP graph layer and event store as tools to consumers — including GQL graph query, event\-store query, and schema/DDL discovery. * Define tool contracts, context, and guardrails so agents produce grounded, accurate, non\-hallucinated responses over the graph. * Ensure low\-latency, secure, and cost\-efficient serving for interactive and batch agent workloads. **Reliability, monitoring \& observability** * Own **monitoring and observability** of the graph layer and the MCP server — data freshness, pipeline health, query latency/cost, tool\-call success rates, and answer quality. * Instrument SLOs, dashboards, alerting, and tracing; jobs.description: Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost\-effective, multi\-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form! In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by *TIME* as a “Best Invention”, *MIT Technology Review* as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and *Fast Company* as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron\-air batteries is underway at our first high\-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia. Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now \- right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing \- might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better. **Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading \- you’ve come to the right place.** **Role Description** -------------------- Form Energy is hiring a Mechanical Engineer II, R\&D to join our Core Technology Hardware team, where you will own the design of the hardware that lets us evaluate and refine our iron\-air battery technology. As a Mechanical Engineer II, you will play a critical role in turning electrode and battery concepts into physical test vehicles, from standard platforms to custom builds for novel experiments. You will drive designs from concept through CAD, fabrication, and assembly, with growing independence, and deliver working hardware to the scientists and engineers who use it to accelerate discovery and development. Your work will help us build and validate a complex, novel product that supports a more reliable electric grid. ### **What you'll do:** * Design standard and custom test vehicles, balancing jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: Fuse Energy is an energy startup on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first\-principles thinking with cutting\-edge technology to build a radically better energy system. We've raised over $200M from top\-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber. We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, using AI across the business, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers. We’re building a cutting\-edge AI team, and this role is for an engineer who wants to apply AI to real problems in energy. As an Applied AI Engineer, you’ll help build our **Product Factory**: an agentic pipeline that takes software from requirements and design through code review, deployment and monitoring, with human review where the risk calls for it. You’ll also ship customer\-facing features using VLMs and LLMs, and build AI tools and agents that make teams across Fuse more productive, from customer support to warehouses and back office. This is an applied engineering role, not pure research: you’ll own what you build, from spec to production. ### **Responsibilities** * Ship AI features for customers, such as personalised energy recommendations and onboarding from an energy bill. * Build LLM applications and agents for support, engineering, warehouse and back\-office teams, including multi\-agent systems and durable workflows (e.g. Temporal). * Build the engineering around them: cloud infrastructure, integrations, and access control so users and agents only reach what they should. * Own evaluation: datasets, golden answers, human and LLM judges, A/B tests. Know whether a change genuinely helped. * Choose models by performance, latency and cost, and revisit as models improve. * Work with trading, operations and backend teams so models reflect real\-time market conditions, energy pricing and demand and weather forecasts. * Monitor AI systems in production and keep them reliable. **Requirements** * 3\+ years of experience, with requirements varying by role level. * Experience owning an applied AI system end to end, ideally in a startup or small team, and able to explain what broke and how you knew it worked. * A software engineer who moved into applied AI, or an ML engineer who writes production code. We value both. * Strong Python (or similar) and experience deploying LLMs or VLMs into production. * Solid understanding of cloud technologies, containerisation and scalable AI applications. * Analytical, rigorous and quick to learn. You don’t need our exact tools, just the ability to pick them up. * **Bonus:** PyTorch or TensorFlow; forecasting, weather and demand modelling; energy markets and trading; fine\-tuning or RL; vision, document or NLP pipelines; agent runtimes. **Benefits** * Competitive salary and eligibility for equity * Biannual bonus scheme * Fully expensed tech to match your needs * Private health insurance * Breakfast and dinner allowance for office\-based employees As we hire globally, benefits may vary by location.

jobs.title: Energy & Controls Specialist
jobs.description: **About GHR Engineers \& Associates, Inc.** GHR Engineers \& Associates, Inc. is a mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection (MEP) consulting firm. Since 1949, we have built our reputation through quality work, integrity, and service. We design the systems that make buildings functional, sustainable, and safe, working across healthcare, K–12, commercial, municipal, and specialty building types. We’re a close\-knit team of about 20 people. We treat our employees like people with lives and commitments outside the office, and our retention speaks to that. Our team includes people who have been with us from one to thirty years. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities. We benefit from the many perspectives our people bring, and we’re committed to continuing to grow. **About the Role** We are seeking an Energy \& Controls Specialist to join our MEP team. This role is a good fit for someone with hands\-on experience in building automation, HVAC service, testing and balancing, or energy analysis who wants to move into design and consulting. An engineering degree is not required, but is certainly worth considering. Practical knowledge of how buildings and their systems actually operate is also viewed as a valuable skill. We’re not a large corporation. You’ll be a meaningful contributor to real projects from the start, not just another hire. **Responsibilities** *Energy Modeling* * Building whole\-building energy models to compare design options and support system selection * Preparing energy code compliance documentation (IECC / ASHRAE 90\.1, COMcheck) * Supporting utility incentive applications and sustainability goals *Temperature Control Design* * Writing sequences of operation for HVAC systems * Developing control diagrams, points lists, and building automation system (BAS) specifications * Reviewing controls shop drawings and submittals and answering RFIs *Commissioning* * Developing commissioning plans, pre\-functional checklists, and functional performance tests * Conducting on\-site testing of HVAC and control systems and tracking issues to resolution * Reviewing BAS trend data and supporting retro\-commissioning of existing buildings *General* * Coordinating with our mechanical and electrical designers * Visiting sites for field verification, testing, and commissioning; frequency varies with project phase * Staying current with relevant codes and standards, including ASHRAE 90\.1, Guideline 36, IECC, and IMC **Qualifications** * Experience in one or more of the following: energy modeling, building automation and controls, HVAC service or startup, testing and balancing, or commissioning * Working knowledge of HVAC systems and how they’re controlled * Degree or certificate in HVAC, building automation, energy management, engineering technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience * Comfortable learning new software * Takes ownership of their work and stays on top of their own workload * A clear, collaborative communicator, comfortable working with contractors and building owners in the field * Genuine interest in building a long\-term career in building performance **Helpful but Not Required** * Experience with energy modeling software such as eQUEST, TRACE 3D Plus, EnergyPlus, or IES VE * Familiarity with BAS platforms such as Johnson Controls Metasys, Siemens, Trane Tracer, or Niagara\-based systems * Commissioning or energy credentials such as CCP, CxA, BEMP, CEM, or LEED AP * Engineering degree or EIT certification * Familiarity with Revit or AutoCAD **Compensation \& Benefits** * Salary: $60,000–$70,000, commensurate with experience * Year\-end bonus: Discretionary, reflecting company performance and individual factors including merit, seniority, and expertise * Hybrid work schedule, negotiable * Flexible hours * Health, dental, \& vision insurance * FSA: Pre\-tax dollars for medical \& dependent care * 401(k) with employer match * PTO: Vacation time that grows with tenure, paid holidays, parental leave * Professional development: Employees who choose to pursue certifications are reimbursed for exam fees and renewals **Life in Champaign\-Urbana** Not local? jobs.title: Principle Systems Engineer - Autonomy Behavior Validation
jobs.description: **Job Description** **The Role** ------------ As a Principal Autonomy Behavior Systems Engineer, you will be the technical authority for how GM's autonomous vehicle behavior is defined, evaluated, and judged ready for release. Your scope covers the full range of driving behaviors, from routine maneuvers to rare, safety\-critical events. It also covers the whole validation lifecycle, from product requirements through launch and continuous monitoring in the fleet. You will bring broad, deep expertise in autonomous driving. You know how the autonomy stack produces behavior, where it fails, and what evidence a behavior needs before it is ready for a self\-driving fleet. You will work across Behavior, Software, Simulation, Safety, Legal, Product, and Operations to build a validation system that supports sound safety and launch decisions and earns the trust of the engineers and leaders who depend on it. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Set the long\-term technical strategy and systems engineering approach for autonomy behavior validation across capabilities, programs, and releases. This includes behavior decomposition, metrics, acceptance criteria, coverage, confidence, and traceability. * Define what "ready" means for autonomous behavior. Connect safety claims, hazard analysis, and requirements to the evidence behind supervised release, driverless launch, and continuous release decisions, and present those recommendations to senior leadership. * Act as the organization's go\-to expert on autonomous driving behavior. Diagnose complex issues across perception, prediction, planning, and controls, and lead the work to close behavioral escapes and coverage gaps using fleet and incident data. * Design validation strategies that combines simulation, road data, closed\-course testing, human references, and expert review. Make deliberate trade\-offs among coverage, confidence, fidelity, runtime, and cost. * Guide validation tools, data pipelines, scorecards, and AI\-assisted or agentic workflows toward repeatable, scalable products used by many teams. * Lead cross\-functional technical reviews, mentor engineers, and raise the bar for systems engineering and validation across the AV organization. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Master's degree in systems engineering, mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, electrical engineering, computer science, robotics, or a related field, and 10 or more years of professional experience in autonomous vehicles, robotics, simulation, systems engineering, or safety\-critical validation. * A proven record of evaluating autonomous vehicles for a self\-driving fleet, launch, supervised release, or other high\-consequence product decision, including owning or materially shaping the go/no\-go recommendation. * Deep, end\-to\-end expertise in autonomous driving: how each part of the stack (perception, prediction, planning, and controls) shows up as on\-road behavior across a wide range of scenarios, road users, and operating conditions. * Deep systems engineering fundamentals, including decomposition, ODD definition, requirements strategy, V\&V planning, and traceability, plus experience leading simulation evaluation at scale. * Strong Python and agentic workflow experience. You are comfortable designing and reviewing production\-quality analysis and validation software and using code to investigate an engineering question quickly. * Demonstrated technical leadership across organizational boundaries, including setting direction adopted beyond a single team and explaining results, assumptions, and limitations clearly to engineers and senior leaders. **What Will Give You a Competitive Edge** ----------------------------------------- * Experience as a technical lead for validating a driverless commercial launch or an expansion into new operating domains. * Experience evaluating learned or end\-to\-end driving systems, including how to characterize their behavior, regressions, and generalization. * Experience with human benchmarking (such as attentive\-human benchmarks) and counterfactual or replay methods, and how they fit within a broader validation strategy. * Experience building or using a safety case, and familiarity with hazard analysis methods (STPA, FMEA, fault trees) and standards such as ISO 21448 (SOTIF), UL 4600, or ISO 26262\. * Experience with risk quantification and risk acceptance, and with turning legal or regulatory expectations into a defensible compliance strategy. jobs.title: Staff ML Engineer - Embodied AI Scaling Foundations
jobs.description: **Job Description** At General Motors, we're turning today's impossible into tomorrow's standard. Our vehicles already move millions of people every day, and we're building the autonomy that will drive them \- L2 through L4, on real roads, at real scale. Making self\-driving safe at that scale is one of the hardest AI problems there is. The Data Scaling team owns the data flywheel for AV foundation model pre\-training and SFT. We determine what data the AV needs in order to learn driving behaviors at scale, and we define what data quality means across the loop. The team delivers ML models that move the product up the data scaling curves, turning better data composition into measurably better driving behavior. We work with the very large datasets GM already has and we define the next generation of highest\-value datasets GM collects. With each major release we aim to 10x the *effective* data behind our models: more scale, more diversity, and more value extracted from every example. **Why Join Us?** * Train on driving data almost nobody else has \- real\-world miles from GM's fleets, plus synthetic sim data \- scaling into billions of examples. Then decide which ones are worth it: ten thousand near\-identical highway miles teach the model less than one unprotected left turn in the rain. Mixture design, curation, mining, and evaluation are how you find out which is which, working alongside other MLEs and research scientists. * Work on questions with no textbook answers yet. Scaling laws for language are well mapped by now; for embodied driving data \- heavy\-tailed, safety\-constrained, closed\-loop \- they aren't. You'd be helping write them, and we support publishing what you find. See your results in the world rather than on a leaderboard. The models this team ships change how the vehicle behaves on real roads, and that behavior comes back as the evidence for your next iteration. * As a Staff AI/ML Engineer in the Embodied AI Data Foundations organization, you will be an individual contributor developing data\-centric AI solutions that directly improve autonomous driving performance. jobs.description: **About Generalist** ==================== At Generalist, we are on a mission to build general intelligence for the physical world and make it useful to everyone. We believe the industries and homes of the future will depend on humans and machines working together in new ways. Robots can help us build more and get more done. We build embodied foundation models, starting with a focus on dexterity. This requires advancing the frontiers of data, models, and hardware, to enable robots to intelligently interact with the physical world. The company embraces both large\-scale AI and robotics as core to its DNA. Our team of researchers, roboticists, and company builders come from OpenAI, Boston Dynamics, Google DeepMind, and other frontier labs—with a track record of shipping AI breakthroughs. Before Generalist, we pioneered large embodied multimodal models and vision\-language\-action models (PaLM\-E, RT\-2, Gemini Robotics), launched and scaled ChatGPT and GPT\-4 to hundreds of millions of users, engineered the foundations of autonomous driving, built next\-generation robots (Atlas, Spot, Stretch) and pushed the limits of what they can do (from parkour to manipulation, and testing robustness). We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. **About the Role** ================== Generalist trains very large robot foundation models. This requires utilizing very large numbers of the latest generation GPU hardware and infrastructure (currently Nvidia) to run distributed training jobs and researcher experiments. jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a specialized field (e.g., Optics, Sensors, Audio/DSP, etc.), or equivalent practical experience. * 3 years of experience developing, sustaining, or integrating semiconductor fabrication processes in an research and development (R\&D) or cleanroom production environment. 3 years of experience in temporary wafer bonding, laser/thermal debonding, thin wafer handling, or back\-end packaging processes. * ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or a related field (e.g., Optics, Sensors, Audio/DSP). * Experience mitigating mechanical stress, bow, warp, and micro\-cracking in ultra\-thin silicon substrates, integrated with backside thinning and dicing\-on\-tape workflows. * Experience executing 3D Integration technical roadmaps, executing complex development and process integration projects. * Excellent collaborative leadership skills, and experience leading technical evaluations with equipment vendors, managing joint development projects, and cross\-training/mentoring engineers and technicians. * Expertise in polymer adhesives, temporary bonding materials, and release processes. * Ownership qualifying automated temporary bonding, lamination, and laser/mechanical debonding tools. **About the job** ----------------- Google Quantum AI is building quantum computing for otherwise unsolvable problems. The full potential of quantum computing will be unlocked with a large\-scale computer capable of complex, error\-corrected computations. Our roadmap is focused on advancing the capabilities of quantum computing and enabling meaningful applications. In this role, you will lead the development, integration, and Release to Production of temporary wafer bonding, thinning, and debonding (TB/DB) processes for Google Quantum AI’s next\-generation quantum processors. Responsibilities include developing and implementing process flows featuring advanced adhesive bonding chemistries, manufacturable debonding systems, and thin\-wafer handling. You will partner with equipment vendors and cleanroom module owners to bring up automated bonding and debonding equipment, coordinate evaluation runs, and transition validated processes into baseline process flows for upcoming milestones. You will establish robust process controls to mitigate wafer stress, bow, warp, and other downstream process integration issues across ultra\-thin substrates. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $159000 \- $230000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Develop, integrate, and transition to production temporary adhesive bonding and laser debond processes and equipment for advanced 3D Integration of quantum devices.. * Specify, bring up, and qualify required clean room equipment and advanced metrology capabilities, establishing baseline operational recipes and documentation. * Drive process integration activities around wafer thinning, thin\-wafer handling, and stress/warp mitigation. * Coordinate vendor evaluations, off\-site demos, technology transfers, and Release to Production of tools and processes into quantum device production processes. * Troubleshoot processing anomalies, improve yield, and train cleanroom personnel and technicians on standard operating procedures. jobs.description: Inside Solution Engineer \- Edge AI and Advanced Compute Practice **Description \-** **Role Summary** ================ The Inside Solution Engineer provides remote technical support to HP's field Solution Engineers, helping them validate solutions, resolve technical issues, and advance customer engagements. This role serves as a technical liaison between the field and the Global Business Unit (GBU), connecting customer requirements and field findings with product management, engineering, and support teams. The engineer performs hands\-on lab validation and troubleshooting, coordinates escalations, and maintains technical continuity from issue intake through verified resolution. By turning field experience into reusable guidance and actionable product feedback, this role improves field productivity and solution readiness. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **Field Solution Engineer Support** ----------------------------------- * Provide remote technical assistance with solution design, product capabilities, configurations, compatibility, and deployment considerations for Edge AI and Advanced Compute engagements. * Support demonstrations, proofs of concept (POCs), pilots, and deployment readiness through lab preparation, configuration reviews, technical validation, and troubleshooting. * Develop technical responses, configuration guidance, bills of materials, and supporting documentation in partnership with field Solution Engineers. **Field Issue Resolution** -------------------------- * Triage field issues based on customer impact, urgency, and deployment risk; gather environment details, logs, configurations, reproduction steps, and expected behavior. * Reproduce and isolate hardware, firmware, driver, operating system, application, networking, and integration issues in lab environments. * Develop and validate workarounds with the appropriate teams, document findings, and confirm fixes with the field before closing issues. * Maintain clear issue records, owners, next steps, and status updates so field teams can communicate accurately with customers. **GBU Coordination and Escalation** ----------------------------------- * Serve as the field technical liaison to GBU product management, engineering, and support teams for product questions, defects, compatibility gaps, and solution limitations. * Prepare actionable escalation packages that include business impact, technical evidence, reproduction steps, troubleshooting completed, and the support needed. * Track escalations through resolution, coordinate follow\-up and fix validation, and communicate confirmed support guidance and timelines to field Solution Engineers. **Solution Validation and Field Enablement** -------------------------------------------- * Maintain representative lab configurations and test new platforms, firmware, drivers, software releases, and ISV integrations against field use cases. * Create and maintain troubleshooting guides, known\-issue summaries, validated configurations, reference architectures, and reusable demo and POC assets. * Share technical updates and lessons learned with the field through training, office hours, and knowledge\-sharing sessions. * Identify recurring field issues and provide structured feedback to the GBU to improve product quality, documentation, serviceability, and solution readiness. **Required Qualifications** =========================== * 3–5 years of experience in solution engineering, technical presales, technical support, systems engineering, AI infrastructure, or a related discipline. * Hands\-on experience configuring, testing, and troubleshooting enterprise compute solutions across hardware, firmware, operating systems, networking, and software integration. * Working knowledge of Edge AI or accelerated computing, including CPUs, GPUs, NPUs, AI inference workloads, containers, and related infrastructure. * Ability to reproduce technical issues, analyze logs and diagnostic data, isolate likely causes, and validate corrective actions. * Experience coordinating technical escalations with engineering, product management, or support organizations and following issues through closure. * Clear written and verbal communication, strong technical documentation skills, and the ability to explain complex findings to field teams and cross\-functional partners. * Ability to prioritize multiple requests, work independently, and collaborate effectively with geographically distributed teams. **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * Experience with HP compute platforms, enterprise support processes, and GBU or product engineering collaboration. * Experience with Linux, Windows, Kubernetes, APIs, scripting, and automated testing or diagnostics. * Familiarity with NVIDIA and other accelerated computing ecosystems, AI inference frameworks, computer vision, or generative AI workloads. * Experience supporting ISV integrations, customer POCs, production deployments, and repeatable solution validation. **What Success Looks Like** =========================== Field Solution Engineers receive timely, accurate technical guidance. Issues reach the GBU with the evidence needed to act, and fixes are validated and communicated clearly. Reusable tools and documentation reduce repeat troubleshooting, while field feedback helps improve product quality and the customer deployment experience. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: **A path for every ambition.** At HUB, we believe the best work happens when people are given real space to grow and then given the autonomy to exercise it. We power progress and protect ambition: for the clients who count on us, and equally for the people who make that possible every day. We’re creative thinkers and determined doers, guided by values that show up in how we work together: with empathy, adaptability, accountability and a genuine commitment to one another’s success. We foster bold ideas, celebrate curiosity and share what we know. Because when people grow, the work they do grows with them. Our purpose is deeply human: to help people navigate the world on their terms, at their speed, toward their future. We hold that same commitment to the people building careers here. Whether you’re starting out or leveling up, you’ll find the resources to evolve, the support to take on more and a team ready to back you at every stage. Your ambition has a home here. **About Us** ============ At HUB International, we are a team of entrepreneurs. We believe in protecting and supporting the aspirations of individuals, families, and businesses. We help our clients evaluate their risks and develop solutions tailored to their needs. We believe in empowering our employees to learn, grow, and make a difference. Our structure enables our teams to maintain their own unique, regional culture while leveraging support and resources from our corporate centers of excellence. HUB is a global insurance and employee benefits broker, providing a boundaryless array of business insurance, employee benefits, risk services, personal insurance, retirement, and private wealth management products and services. With over $5 billion in revenue and almost 20,000 employees in 600 offices throughout North America, HUB has grown substantially, in part due to our industry leading success in mergers and acquisitions. **Position Overview** ===================== HUB is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to serve as the senior technical individual contributor for the AI Engineering function within our centralized technology organization, part of HUB’s AI \& Automation organization. This is the most senior hands\-on engineering seat in the function. The role builds the hardest work, sets the technical standards the rest of the team builds to, and owns the enterprise standards and governance for HUB’s skills, plug\-ins, and MCP connections wherever they are used across HUB. This is an individual contributor role. It carries no direct reports. It does carry technical authority, and the person in it is expected to lead through standards, architecture, code review, and mentoring rather than through reporting lines. A significant portion of that influence extends to engineers outside the function, including builds executed by other engineering teams to the standard this role sets. The role builds on the Claude AI platform: creating reusable skills and plug\-ins, composing them into governed AI applications, standing up retrieval over governed enterprise data, and professionalizing experimental prototypes into governed, tested, enterprise\-ready applications. HUB runs Claude as its primary model today and the stack is expected to evolve toward agentic systems. Where a build requires deep engineering, such as net\-new backend, new infrastructure, or complex integration, Enterprise Engineering executes it to the standard this role sets and returns it to the catalog to be governed and published. This role does not build or host foundational models and does not perform core machine learning or model training. **How this differs from the AI Engineer role.** AI Engineers build and ship against an established standard. This role establishes that standard, owns the technical decisions behind it, resolves the problems the team cannot, and is accountable for the reliability and governance of the function’s output as a whole. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **Build the Hardest Work** -------------------------- * Build reusable skills, package them as plug\-ins, and compose them into governed AI applications used across HUB business lines * Configure and tune foundational models for HUB use cases, including system and prompt design * Build retrieval\-augmented generation, embeddings, vector store, and multi\-step workflow implementations over governed enterprise data * Take business\-built AI prototypes and productionize them into reliable, governed applications * Own the engineering decisions behind cost, latency, and reliability tradeoffs across the AI estate **Set the Technical Standard** ------------------------------ * Define and document the engineering standards the function builds to, covering architecture patterns, testing, logging, documentation, and release discipline * Review architecture and code across the team, and raise the quality of what ships through that review * Mentor AI Engineers and contract engineers, deliberately transferring  ernance, and delivery * Curiosity and adaptability as the AI stack evolves toward agents **What We Offer You** ===================== At HUB International, we’re invested in your success, both inside and outside of work. Our benefits include: * Competitive base salary plus performance\-based bonus * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * 401(k) with company match * Paid time off and company holidays * Hybrid work arrangement based out of our Chicago office * Professional development and certification reimbursement * Opportunity to set the technical direction for HUB’s enterprise AI engineering function and its asset platform, across a modern stack spanning Claude, retrieval, evaluation, and agentic tooling **JOIN OUR TEAM** Do you believe in the power of innovation, collaboration, and transformation? Do you thrive in a supportive and client focused work environment? Are you looking for an opportunity to help build and drive change in a rapidly growing and evolving organization? When you join **HUB International**, you will be part of a community of learners and doers focused on our Core Values: entrepreneurship, teamwork, integrity, accountability, and service. *The expected salary range for this position is $ 130,000 to $190,000 and will be impacted by factors such as the successful candidate’s skills, experience and working location, as well as the specific position’s business line, scope and level.* *HUB International is proud to offer comprehensive benefit and total compensation packages which could include health/dental/vision/life/disability insurance, FSA, HAS and 401(k) accounts, paid\-time\-off benefits such as vacation, sick, personal, floating holidays and company holidays. In addition, eligible annual bonuses, equity and commissions may be available for some positions.* **What we offer you** We invest in your growth. HUB offers structured training, licensing support, and ongoing development opportunities designed to accelerate your career. Benefits and programs vary based on employment status, role, location, and applicable eligibility requirements. * Competitive pay with comprehensive health benefits, retirement savings matching, and company\-paid life and disability plans * Generous paid time off, paid parental leave and a wellbeing program designed to support real work/life balance * A collaborative, high\-performing culture with meaningful engagement, community impact through HUB Gives and genuine room to grow your career **The HUB difference** HUB International is one of North America’s largest insurance brokers, delivering risk management, insurance, employee benefits, retirement and wealth management solutions to businesses and individuals across the United States and Canada — through locally led teams backed by national expertise, giving you the agility of a local partner and the reach of a global organization. **Equal Employment Opportunity:** HUB International Limited is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. **Reasonable Accommodations:** HUB International Limited is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and hiring process. If you need a reasonable accommodation to access our career site, complete an application, or participate in any part of the hiring process, please contact the Recruiting Team at HUBRecruiting@HUBInternational.com. This contact information is for accommodation requests only and should not be used to inquire about the status of an application. **E\-Verify:** HUB International Limited participates in E\-Verify. Please refer to Our Recruiting Process \| Applicant Notices: E\-Verify Program for additional information.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Senior Full\-Stack Software Engineer / Technical Lead **Company:** Zolara Care **Location:** Remote **Job type:** Full time **Compensation:** Competitive salary based on experience, plus performance based bonuses About the opportunity Zolara Care develops software that helps clinics manage their operations and deliver better patient experiences. We are seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Software Engineer who can take technical ownership, contribute directly to development, solve complex problems, and provide practical leadership to our development team. This is a hands on, full time role with meaningful responsibility. You will work closely with company leadership and help ensure our software is reliable, secure, maintainable, and ready for continued growth. We value sound engineering judgment, clear communication, and the ability to follow through from identifying a problem to delivering a verified solution. What you’ll do * **Take technical ownership:** Understand the application, evaluate priorities, and turn business needs into clear, achievable engineering work. * **Build and improve software:** Contribute across the backend and frontend, with particular attention to reliability, performance, data accuracy, and maintainability. * **Solve problems thoroughly:** Investigate complex issues, identify their root causes, and verify that changes work across the complete user experience. * **Review code and validate changes:** Provide thoughtful code reviews, strengthen testing, and help ensure releases meet appropriate quality standards. * **Support dependable operations:** Help maintain reliable development, testing, and production environments, including deployments, monitoring, and recovery procedures. * **Guide the development team:** Mentor developers, clarify technical requirements, and provide practical feedback that improves the quality of their work. * **Maintain useful documentation:** Record technical decisions, setup procedures, and operational knowledge so the team can work effectively. * **Communicate clearly:** Explain progress, priorities, tradeoffs, and risks to company leadership in straightforward language. What we’re looking for * Proven professional experience developing and maintaining production web applications at a senior level. * Strong hands on backend engineering skills and experience working across modern frontend applications. * Solid understanding of APIs, relational databases, data integrity, authentication, and access controls. * Experience with cloud environments, version control, automated testing, and software deployment. * Strong debugging skills and the ability to assess unfamiliar code independently. * Experience reviewing code and providing technical guidance while remaining actively involved in development. * Good judgment about when to improve existing code, when to simplify it, and how to make changes safely. * Clear written and verbal communication, dependable follow\-through, and the ability to work effectively in a remote team. Experience that would be especially valuable * Supporting and improving an established SaaS product. * Working on healthcare or business software where accuracy, reliability, and data security are essential. * Providing technical leadership within a small engineering team. * Translating business priorities into focused, manageable development work. What you can expect * A remote, full\-time role with direct access to company leadership. * Meaningful responsibility for software quality and technical delivery. * Input into technical priorities and engineering decisions. * Competitive salary based on your experience and capabilities. * Performance\-based bonuses tied to agreed goals and results. * The opportunity to make a visible contribution to the quality and growth of Zolara Care. How to apply Apply through Indeed with your résumé and a brief introduction describing: * A production application you helped build or maintain and your personal responsibilities. * A challenging technical problem you solved and how you verified the outcome. * Your experience reviewing code or guiding other developers. * Your time zone, availability for full time work, and earliest start date. You may include a portfolio, public code samples, or project summaries that you are authorized to share. Our selection process Shortlisted candidates will participate in a technical interview. Finalists will be invited to complete a short, paid practical assessment followed by a walkthrough of their approach. We will share the assessment’s scope, expected time commitment, and compensation in advance. We will evaluate technical judgment, problem solving, code quality, verification, and communication. Pay: $30\.00 \- $50\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Hike Medical** ---------------------- Hike Medical is building the defining company in musculoskeletal care. We sit at the intersection of AI, robotics, and healthcare, operating across three product lines: a proprietary AI\-vision platform that turns a 30\-second, web\-based foot scan into custom 3D\-printed orthotics; an AI agent platform that automates the entire DME workflow from pre\-visit processing through claims and revenue cycle; and SoleForge, our vertically integrated 3D\-printing factory producing custom medical devices at a scale the industry has never seen. Insoles today, full DME tomorrow, bionics by 2040\. Custom insoles are just the wedge. Our long\-term vision is bionics: AI\-designed, robotically manufactured orthotic and prosthetic devices at scale, replacing a fragmented, manual industry that hasn’t changed in decades. Read the full vision at bionics2040\.com. We've stealthily raised $22M through Seed and Series A, backed by top\-tier investors who backed companies like OpenAI, Anduril, and Mercury early. We run a fast, results\-first, high\-ownership culture out of our new SF Rincon Hill office. If you want to work at the frontier of AI, manufacturing, and healthcare, this is the place. **The Role** ------------ As a Software Engineer, you will build and ship the systems behind Hike’s AI healthcare platform, across our clinical software, AI agents, and manufacturing. You will own features end to end, from understanding the problem to running it in production. We care more about how you think and what you ship than about any specific language or framework. **Why this is career\-defining** * Your code will turn into real devices that help people move without pain. * You will own real features from day one, with the autonomy to build, ship, and see the results. * You will grow fast alongside a high\-performing team of engineers and AI researchers. * You will work at the frontier of AI, manufacturing, and healthcare. **What you will work on** * Build and ship product features end to end across backend, frontend, and mobile. * Build the APIs, integrations, and data pipelines that connect our clinical, manufacturing, and back\-office systems. * Help take AI features from prototype to reliable production. * Work directly with product, design, and customers to make sure what you build solves the real problem. **What we look for** * 2\+ years shipping production software, or an exceptional track record of building things people use. * Our core platform is TypeScript and Node.js, with NestJS APIs and PostgreSQL through Prisma, running on AWS. * Strong fundamentals in backend or full\-stack development. * Fluency with modern cloud and tooling and experience putting AI into production * Product\-minded: you think about how your work affects real users. * A strong communicator who challenges assumptions and collaborates across engineering, AI, and product. * Mission\-focused: you are not here to optimize ad clicks, you want to build technology that changes lives. **What we ask** * In person in our San Francisco Rincon Hill office, 5 days a week. * This is a hard job with a high bar. In return, you will grow faster than almost anywhere else. Compensation Range: $175K \- $225K

jobs.description: Wayne, United States of America \| Full time \| Hybrid \| R1578614 ### **CloudOps Engineer** **Location:** Wayne, Pennsylvania **Work Arrangement:** Hybrid **Schedule:** Full\-time, 40 hours per week **Job Overview** ---------------- IQVIA is seeking a CloudOps Engineer to support the operation, reliability, and continuous improvement of a cloud\-based data platform. DevTools or comparable browser\-based debugging tools. * Understanding of authentication protocols, including OpenID and OAuth. * Knowledge of HIPAA or other healthcare\-related security and compliance requirements. * Experience working in an Agile or Scrum environment using Jira or a similar work\-management platform. **What Will Help You Succeed** ------------------------------ * Strong continuous\-improvement mindset and an interest in learning new technologies. * A desire to improve platform reliability through monitoring, automation, root\-cause analysis, and permanent corrective action. **Why Join IQVIA?** ------------------- At IQVIA, you will have the opportunity to work with modern cloud and data technologies while contributing to high\-impact projects. jobs.title: Senior Director, Embedded Systems
jobs.description: What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity? At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life\-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients. Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible. **Senior Director, Embedded Systems** ===================================== Research \& Development \| San Diego, CA (global team including Singapore) **Position Summary** Illumina is seeking a Senior Director, Embedded Systems to lead the multidisciplinary engineering organization building the embedded architecture of our DNA sequencing instruments: the electronics, firmware, FPGA, custom silicon, and system engineering that acquire signals from novel sensors, drive precision motion, fluidics, thermal, and optics subsystems, and move high volumes of data from sensor through analysis. The Embedded Systems organization is a global team of electrical, FPGA, firmware, firmware test, hardware test, systems, and compute engineers across San Diego and Singapore that delivers the embedded platforms for every new Illumina sequencer and supports the installed base. In addition, this leader owns the architecture of the on\-instrument compute platform and leads a cross\-functional effort to define a compute roadmap that delivers the performance next\-generation sequencing demands at a sustainable cost. The role sits at an exciting intersection of genomics, advanced sensing, embedded systems, and high\-performance computing. As sequencing throughput continues to increase, we are pushing the boundaries of compute performance, memory and storage bandwidth, networking, and real\-time processing, as compute has become a major driver of instrument cost. The development of novel sensors and custom ASICs also creates opportunities to optimize the entire architecture from signal acquisition through genomic data processing. The Senior Director will define the technology strategy, build a world\-class engineering organization, and deliver embedded platforms that are reliable, secure, compliant, and manufacturable at scale. **Responsibilities** **Technical Leadership** ------------------------ Oversees the functional managers for electrical engineering, FPGA, firmware, systems engineering and test. Sets technical direction and standards, holding a high bar for architecture and design reviews, and manages process over technical decisions and escalations. * **Architecture and roadmap:** Define the embedded systems architecture and multi\-generation technology roadmap, including electrical architecture, power distribution, interconnects, embedded control, sensor interfaces, FPGA\-based data paths, and system management. This strategy includes platform reuse across programs, build\-vs\-buy and partner decisions, technology investment priorities, the cost and performance roadmap, and setting structure that enables strong execution and delivery. * **Electrical, FPGA, and firmware engineering:** Set technical direction and design standards for board\-level analog, digital, mixed\-signal, power, and high\-speed design, component selection, SI/PI, design for manufacturing, and supplier technical engagement through design release; for FPGA\-based data acquisition and processing from sensor to host, including FPGA design, drivers, data\-path bring\-up, benchmarks, and test frameworks that ensure data\-path robustness; and for the instrument firmware architecture and common codebase (RTOS\-based, spanning data path, precision motion, fluidics, optics, thermal, and power) and the agile development and release process that delivers it. * **Custom silicon and novel sensors:** Define what is possible for next generation custom devices. Partner with sensor and fabrication teams on interface architecture, test features, silicon bring\-up, and hardware/firmware integration of custom mixed\-signal ASICs. * **Compute platform and strategy:** Own the on\-instrument compute architecture (topology, modularity, CPUs, accelerators, memory, storage, and high\-speed I/O), sized from first\-principles models of the full data path, and partner with software and algorithm teams on hardware/software co\-design, including hardware acceleration of data\-intensive workloads. Lead a cross\-functional team spanning R\&D, software, supply chain, mechanical engineering, and operations to define a compute roadmap that balances performance, cost, and supply resilience, weighing architecture alternatives, off\-the\-shelf versus custom designs, sourcing strategy, and component lifecycle in a fas peed digital hardware, including analog, mixed\-signal, and power design * + Embedded firmware, RTOS, and real\-time control * + FPGA architecture and high\-bandwidth data acquisition * + Custom ASIC and/or advanced sensors * + Embedded and high\-performance computing architectures, including CPUs, accelerators, memory, storage, PCIe, and high\-speed networking * + Linux\-based embedded systems * + Systems engineering, integration, and verification * + Product safety, EMC, and global certification * + Cybersecurity, secure boot, and hardware root of trust * Demonstrated ability to make system\-level architectural trade\-offs spanning hardware, firmware, software, performance, power, thermal design, reliability, cost, supply continuity, and schedule. * Experience leading complex products from architecture through integration, verification, manufacturing, commercial release, and sustaining. * Experience developing technology roadmaps and working with semiconductor and computing technology partners. * Proven ability to build high\-performing technical organizations and develop engineering leaders. Strong executive communication and cross\-functional leadership skills. * The estimated base salary range for the Senior Director, Embedded Systems role based in the United States of America is: $224,900 \- $337,300\. Should the level or location of the role change during the hiring process, the applicable base pay range may be updated accordingly. The range reflects long‑term growth in the role; therefore, most candidates are hired between the minimum and middle of the range. Built on a strong foundation, Illumina has always prioritized openness, collaboration, and seeking alternative perspectives to propel innovation in genomics. We are proud to confirm a zero\-net gap in pay, regardless of gender, ethnicity, or race.
