Extensive analyses are performed in order to determine specific root causes of discrepant device performance. * Continuously improving quality, reliability, cost, and yield using a feedback loop through Integration and Module engineers to address targeting, variability reduction, and containment of poorly performing line segments * Developing solutions to challenging technical problems utilizing a combination of fundamental knowledge of solid\-state physics, statistics, and formal problem\-solving methodologies. * Independently identifying improvement opportunities and driving implementation * Summarizing complex problems using formal problem\-solving strategies and communicating technical reasoning, project timelines, and help needed to senior leaders Engaging with senior leaders from multiple teams, such as product engineers, assembly test engineers, and technology development engineers to understand and implement process improvement opportunities. * The ideal candidate would exhibit the following behavioral traits: * Highly motivated with leadership qualities * Strong interpersonal skills with understanding of how to work with others to accomplish organizational goals * A collaborative and inclusionary mindset * Highly developed written and verbal communication abilities to influence a wide variety of groups at all levels of the organization * Excellent organizational skills with a strong attention to detail * Experience with setting goals and achieving them on schedule * High tolerance of ambiguity in a rapidly changing, fast\-paced work environment with the ability to quickly adjust priorities as necessary * Ability to develop creative solutions to challenging problems * Candidate must be able to effectively run meetings at all levels of the organization in order to effectively solve problems as a team and communicate progress to senior leaders **Qualifications:** ------------------- You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. Experience listed below would be obtained through a combination of your school/ work/ classes/ research and/or current job role within the semiconductor manufacturing environment. **Minimum Requirements:** * Bachelor's of Science in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Material Science, or related STEM field AND 2\+ years relevant experience in the semiconductor industry. Master’s of Science in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Material Science, or related STEM field * **Preferred Qualifications:** * A comprehensive understanding of device physics, semiconductor processing, familiarity with failure analysis techniques, basic coding/scripting ability in JSL/SAS/Python, experience in data extraction, statistical process control, statistical data analysis and interpretation, familiarity with statistical software packages such as JMP or Minitab, and familiarity with DOE techniques * Familiarity with latest machine learning tools applied to process and device analysis to accelerate root cause determination * Experience in semiconductor process integration, yield engineering, process development, or technology development. * Strong understanding of FEOL and/or BEOL manufacturing processes. * Demonstrated experience in project execution, including design of experiments (DOE) and process improvement, in areas of yield improvement, defect reduction, or process capability enhancements in a production environment. * Proficiency in statistical analysis methods including DOE, SPC, Cp/Cpk analysis, and root\-cause methodologies. * Experience supporting technology qualification, manufacturing ramp, and high\-volume production. Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical projects across multiple engineering disciplines. * **Job Type:** ------------- Experienced Hire **Shift:** ---------- Shift 1 (United States of America) **Primary Location:** --------------------- US, Arizona, Phoenix **Additional Locations:** ------------------------- **Posting Statement:** ---------------------- All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance. **Position of Trust** --------------------- N/A **Benefits** ------------ We offer a total compensation package that ranks among the best in the industry. It consists of competitive pay, stock bonuses, and benefit programs which include health, retirement, and vacation. Find out more about the benefits of working at Intel . Annual Salary Range for jobs which could be performed in the US: $89,010\.00\-146,440\.00 USD The range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your preferred location during the hiring process. **Work Model for this Role** This role will require an on\-site presence. \* Job posting details (such as work model, location or time type) are subject to change. * ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: Intel is committed to Responsible Business Alliance (RBA) compliance and ethical hiring practices. We do not charge any fees during our hiring process. Candidates should never be required to pay recruitment fees, medical examination fees, or any other charges as a condition of employment. If you are asked to pay any fees during our hiring process, please report this immediately to your recruiter.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
jobs.description: Intellibus Consulting is a boutique engineering and AI transformation firm that builds mission\-critical platforms for global financial institutions. We operate at the intersection of engineering excellence, business outcomes, and executive\-level delivery. At Intellibus, our leaders are hands\-on builders who understand technology deeply, engage confidently with senior executives, and take ownership of client success. We believe successful technology transformation requires leaders who can connect business strategy, architecture, engineering, and execution **Job Description** We are looking for exceptional **Forward Deployed Engineers** with deep hands\-on software engineering expertise, particularly in Java, backend engineering, full\-stack development, microservices, and distributed systems. This is a highly technical, client\-facing engineering role that requires someone who can move seamlessly between architecture, software development, solution delivery, and executive\-level client engagement. You will work directly with client engineering teams, technology leaders, and business stakeholders to understand complex challenges, design technical solutions, and lead the development and implementation of enterprise\-grade platforms. Beyond engineering delivery, you will play an important role in expanding strategic client relationships by identifying technology opportunities, recommending solutions, demonstrating technical capabilities, and helping grow existing accounts. We are specifically looking for engineers who have worked in technology consulting or professional services environments and are comfortable taking ownership of both technical delivery and client relationships. **Key ResponsibilitiesHands\-on Software Engineering \& Architecture** * Design, develop, and deliver scalable enterprise applications using Java and modern software engineering technologies. * Demonstrate deep hands\-on expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Spring Framework, REST APIs, and backend application development. * Build complex microservices\-based architectures, distributed systems, and event\-driven applications. * Develop full\-stack solutions with strong backend capabilities and practical frontend development experience. * Work across the entire software development lifecycle, from architecture and design through coding, testing, deployment, and production support. * Lead technical implementation while remaining actively involved in writing and reviewing code. * Develop reusable components, APIs, integrations, and enterprise application frameworks. * Troubleshoot performance bottlenecks, scalability challenges, concurrency issues, and complex production defects. **Backend, Frontend \& Full\-Stack Development** * Build backend services using Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, JPA, and related technologies. * Design and implement RESTful APIs, microservices, and enterprise integrations. * Develop frontend applications using React, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. * Integrate frontend applications with backend services and enterprise platforms. * Work with relational and NoSQL databases, including PostgreSQL, Oracle, MongoDB, or similar technologies. * Implement authentication, authorization, security, and API integration patterns. * Ensure application performance, maintainability, reliability, and scalability. **Microservices \& Cloud\-Native Engineering** * Design and implement microservices architectures and distributed application platforms. * Work with messaging and event\-streaming technologies such as Apache Kafka. * Build asynchronous processing, event\-driven integrations, and resilient distributed services. * Apply design patterns for service discovery, fault tolerance, circuit breakers, and distributed transactions. * Deploy and operate applications on AWS, Azure, or GCP. * Work with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure automation. * Apply observability practices using logging, monitoring, tracing, and performance management tools. * Understand cloud\-native architecture, scalability, availability, and system reliability. **AI \& Agentic Engineering** * Explore and implement AI\-powered enterprise applications and intelligent workflows. * Integrate LLMs and AI capabilities into existing enterprise applications and platforms. * Develop AI agents, tool\-calling workflows, and agent orchestration capabilities. * Work with retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, and enterprise data integrations. * Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to solve client business and technology challenges. * Build practical prototypes and take successful AI solutions through production implementation. **Client Consulting \& Strategic Account Growth** * Work directly with client CTOs, CIOs, engineering leaders, architects, and business stakeholders. * Understand client technology environments, business priorities, and strategic challenges. * Translate business problems into technical solutions ading, concurrency, collections, JVM fundamentals, and performance optimization. * Experience with REST APIs, Hibernate, JPA, and enterprise application development. * Strong knowledge of backend architecture and enterprise integration patterns. **Full\-Stack Development** * Experience building frontend applications using React, JavaScript, and TypeScript. * Ability to independently work across backend and frontend components. * Strong understanding of API integration and application architecture. **Microservices \& Distributed Systems** * Deep experience designing and implementing microservices architectures. * Strong knowledge of Kafka, event\-driven systems, messaging, and distributed computing. * Understanding of scalability, resiliency, fault tolerance, and high\-availability architecture. **Cloud \& DevOps** * Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP. * Hands\-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and cloud\-native deployments. * Familiarity with Terraform or other infrastructure\-as\-code tools is preferred. **AI \& Modern Engineering** * Exposure to LLM integrations, generative AI, AI agents, and agentic workflows. * Experience integrating AI capabilities into enterprise software is highly desirable. **Required Consulting \& Client Engagement Experience** * Previous experience working for a technology consulting firm, systems integrator, or professional services organization is mandatory. * Demonstrated experience delivering technology solutions for external enterprise clients. * Ability to manage multiple technical stakeholders and work across different client environments. * Strong executive communication and presentation skills. * Ability to identify additional technology opportunities and contribute to account expansion. * Comfortable operating in fast\-paced consulting environments where priorities and client requirements can evolve. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * Significant professional software engineering experience, ideally 8\+ years. * Extensive hands\-on Java and backend engineering experience. * Proven experience building enterprise\-grade microservices and distributed systems. * Full\-stack development experience with modern frontend frameworks. * Previous consulting or professional services experience is mandatory. * Experience working in financial services, banking, fintech, or other regulated industries is strongly preferred. **What Success Looks Like** * You can independently design, code, and deliver complex enterprise applications. * You bring deep technical expertise in Java, backend engineering, full\-stack development, and microservices. * You can engage with client engineering teams and senior executives with equal confidence. * You identify opportunities to solve broader client challenges beyond the immediate assignment. * You help strengthen client relationships and contribute to expanding strategic accounts. * You take ownership of solutions from initial discovery through architecture, implementation, and production deployment. **Who Should Apply?** We are looking for engineers who are not limited to writing code against predefined requirements. You should be someone who can understand a client's business, challenge existing technical approaches, design better architectures, build production\-ready solutions, and work with stakeholders to identify the next opportunity. **We want engineers who can build the technology, lead the technical conversation, and help grow the business.** **Our Hiring Process** * 15\-minute introductory call with Intellibus leadership * Proctored GQ assessment \+ Slideware (presentation) evaluation * Technical \& Delivery Leadership Interview (30–45 min) * Executive Interview * Offer If you are interested in reaching out to us, please apply, and our team will contact you within the hour. Pay: $80\.00 \- $95\.00 per hour Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer – Event-Driven Architecture
jobs.description: Intellibus designs and engineers platforms trusted by some of the most established FinTech and financial trading firms in the world. Our engineering teams build systems that power high\-volume trading, real\-time financial data, and mission\-critical infrastructure. We expect our engineers to operate at a level where technical depth, sound judgment, and clear communication all carry weight — the problems are complex, the systems are production\-critical, and the people you work with will hold you to a high standard. **The Staff Engineer Role** We are hiring a Staff Engineer to design, build, and own full\-stack systems powering financial platforms — from frontend architecture to backend services to distributed event\-driven infrastructure. This is not a role where you pick up tickets and ship features. You will be expected to think end\-to\-end: to understand the business problem, design the system, make the trade\-offs, and deliver production\-grade software that performs reliably under heavy load.You will work directly with senior stakeholders across technical and non\-technical functions, often navigating competing priorities, ambiguity, and high\-pressure timelines. The ability to communicate clearly, manage complexity across people and systems, and maintain a high quality bar when things get difficult is essential. If you have built and shipped systems that mattered — at a startup, at a large company, or somewhere in between — and you are looking for a role where you will be challenged technically while also growing your ability to operate in complex, high\-stakes environments, we want to hear from you. **What You Will Do**Frontend Architecture * Build scalable frontend platforms using React, Next.js, and TypeScript. * Design modern UI architectures: server\-side rendering, component\-driven design, performance optimization, and state management patterns. * Develop reusable component systems and scalable frontend frameworks. Backend Engineering * Build backend services using Node.js and NestJS. * Design and implement REST APIs, microservices, asynchronous workflows, and high\-performance data processing systems. * Work with SQL and NoSQL databases using TypeORM, and optimize for throughput and reliability. Event\-Driven \& Distributed Systems * Design distributed systems built on event\-driven architecture using Kafka, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, and messaging/queue systems. * Build services that process high\-volume financial events and real\-time trading data. Cloud \& Infrastructure * Deploy and operate systems on Microsoft Azure, including Azure App Services, Azure Data Fabric, messaging platforms, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and Linux environments. * Design infrastructure that supports resilient, scalable distributed systems. **What Sets You Apart** We are looking for engineers who demonstrate several of the following: * You have designed and operated event\-driven distributed systems that process high\-volume real\-time data. * You have a deep understanding of algorithms, data structures, and time complexity — and you apply that understanding to build systems, not just pass interviews. * You have built full\-stack platforms using React/Next.js and Node.js/NestJS that run reliably in production. * You have hands\-on experience with message queues, streaming platforms, and asynchronous workflows — Kafka, Azure Service Bus, BullMQ, or similar. * You reason clearly about system trade\-offs: latency vs. throughput, consistency vs. availability, speed vs. reliability. * You have operated systems in cloud environments like Microsoft Azure, including debugging production incidents and improving performance under pressure. * You design systems end\-to\-end and take ownership of architecture and production outcomes — not just the code you wrote. * You have mentored other engineers and contributed to architecture reviews, engineering standards, and technical decision\-making. * You communicate well under pressure. You can hold your ground in a room full of stakeholders, explain a technical decision to a non\-technical audience, and navigate situations where the right path forward is not obvious. **Technology Ecosystem** **Frontend:** React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, TailwindCSS, HTML5, CSS3 **Backend:** Node.js, NestJS, REST APIs, Microservices, BullMQ, TypeORM **Event\-Driven:** Kafka, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid **Infrastructure:** Microsoft Azure, Azure Data Fabric, Docker, CI/CD, Infrastructure\-as\-Code, Linux **Data:** SQL, NoSQL, Azure Data Fabric **Our Process** * 15\-minute video call with someone from our team * 4 Proctored GQ Tests (under 2 hours) * 30–45 minute final video interview * Job offer If this sounds like the kind of work you want to be doing, apply now. Our team will be in touch within the hour. Pay: $75\.00 \- $85\.00 per hour Application Question(s): * Have you built and shipped production systems using React/Next.js and Node.js/NestJS, and were you responsible for architectural decisions — not just implementation? * Have you designed or operated event\-driven systems using messaging platforms like Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or similar technologies to process high\-volume data? * Have you worked directly with senior stakeholders or clients in high\-pressure environments where you had to balance technical trade\-offs against competing business priorities? * Have you deployed, operated, and debugged production systems in Microsoft Azure or a comparable cloud environment? Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer, Release Engineering
jobs.description: Job Description: At ICE, we are driven by a shared mission and a commitment to continuous progress. Our team comprises dedicated problem\-solvers who begin with our customers’ needs, address their challenges, and turn them into valuable opportunities. With a start\-up mindset, we remain agile, adaptable, and ready to act quickly. The Senior Engineer is a full\-stack engineer with strong AI and large language model (LLM) expertise, embedded within the Release Engineering Development team. This team designs and maintains processes that improve infrastructure delivery through application development, data management, and automation. In this role, you will build and continuously evolve an internal, AI\-powered developer platform. Central to this work is a genuine drive to advance the application of agentic AI frameworks by designing reliable agents, prompts, MCP integrations, and building our AIDLC (AI Development Life Cycle) while staying ahead of emerging LLM capabilities. You will build and operate the agentic AI platform that is the core of our AIDLC which automates development, release, and operational workflows across engineering. This includes agents, skills, and MCP integrations that act across CI/CD, source control, ticketing, and deployment systems, with the security, evaluation, and auditability required for privileged access. **Responsibilities** * Agent Platform + Design, build, and maintain the platform \- including the agent API, MCP integrations, and intent\-routing logic. + Build MCP integrations that connect agents to CI/CD, source control, ticketing, and deployment tools, with clear schemas, robust error handling and logging, and defined scope boundaries. + Build and maintain the skill and agent registry that matches user intent with the appropriate agent and context at runtime. + Maintain a modular architecture so new agents, skills, and MCP integrations can be added without disrupting existing capabilities. * AI Development Life Cycle (AIDLC) \- Agentic Workflows + Design multi\-step, tool\-using agents that select tools, reason across context, and produce reliable, structured output. + Author, test, and iterate on prompts, skill definitions, and context structures while managing context windows and token budgets. + Design for failure by anticipating how agents fail, context degrades, and prompts drift \- and by defining how the system recovers. + Build release and CI/CD agents for pipeline triage, release\-readiness checks, change documentation, and rollback assistance in partnership with release and development teams. + Curate and maintain the AIDLC, outlining best practices, and championing the process across the company. * Security, Governance, and Human Oversight + Enforce least\-privilege, zero trust, access for agentic automation, with clearly defined identities (user or service account) and per\-tool permissions. + Design human\-in\-the\-loop approval workflows for high\-risk actions such as deployments, promotions, and rollbacks. + Protect against prompt injection, data leakage, and overprivileged agents. + Ensure audit logging, compliance, and data\-handling controls for all agent actions and model inputs. * Evaluation, Reliability, and Cost + Build and operate evaluation frameworks, including evaluation sets, prompt regression tests, and quality metrics for agents and skills. + Evaluate and select models while managing routing, caching, token budgets, and cost attribution. + Instrument agent runs with tracing and structured logging so incorrect decisions can be diagnosed after the fact. + Own platform reliability through health checks, runbooks, and explicit failure modes \- support release tooling, CI/CD pipelines, and AI workflows in production. * Adoption and Collaboration + Contribute to developer\-facing interfaces, including chat integrations within existing communication tools and the skills catalog. + Drive adoption by mentoring teams, documenting reusable patterns, and gathering feedback from both skeptical users and early adopters. + Translate workflow needs from Engineering, Infrastructure, and release teams into effective agents and skills. + Track emerging models, agentic use cases, and prototype the technologies that matter. + Write clean, tested, and secure code. Participate in code and design reviews. Document agent designs, prompt strategies, and platform decisions. **Knowledge and Experience** * Engineering + Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience. + 5\+ years of professional experience in software engineering, DevOps, or release engineering, including platform or internal tooling work. + Hands\-on experience with CI/CD and Git\-based source control platforms such as GitHub or Bitbucket (GitHub preferred). * AI, Agents, and LLMs + Understanding of agentic patterns, including planning, tool selection, multi\-step tasks, agent\-loop design, and failure modes. + Strong prompt\-engineering and context\-window management skills, including experience with skill definitions or scoped system prompts. + Working knowledge of AI security risks, including prompt injection. + Daily use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, or similar products. **Preferred Knowledge and Experience** * Experience with agentic technologies such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LiteLLM, or AutoGen, along with the judgment to determine when a leaner custom approach is more appropriate. * Experience in Node.js/TypeScript, Go, and/or Python * Demonstrated experience building and delivering at least one production or near\-production agentic automation/process that uses LLM APIs, such as Anthropic, OpenAI, and LiteLLM, with tool calling and structured output. * Practical experience with MCP or equivalent tool\-calling frameworks, including schema design, agent\-tool integration, and scope management. * Experience evaluating LLM outputs by using evaluation sets, regression testing, and quality metrics. * Experience with retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) and vector databases. * Experience with cloud AI platforms such as Amazon Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI. * Experience with internal developer platforms or platform\-as\-a\-product models. * Frontend development experience with React or Angular. * Relational database design experience. * Experience with LLM observability tools. * Experience with infrastructure as code and configuration management tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Puppet, or Chef. * Experience working in regulated or audited environments. * Experience with Agile practices and automated testing. * Experience with containers and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes or OpenShift, along with proficiency in Linux environments. * Experience troubleshooting distributed systems (e.g., Kubernetes workloads, CI/CD pipelines, message queues). **What We Look For** * An engineer who treats agentic AI as a design discipline and has a demonstrated record of applying emerging LLM and agent capabilities in practice. * A platform thinker who views agents, skills, MCP integrations, and the registry as one cohesive developer product. * Someone who takes ownership of reliability, security, and quality, and makes failure modes explicit. * A collaborative partner who reduces friction across the broader engineering organization and can build trust with skeptical teams. \#LI\-SH3 \#LI\-ONSITE \-: Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: **DevOps Engineer** =================== **About the Position** ---------------------- International Logic Systems (ILS) is seeking an experienced **DevOps Engineer** to support application deployment, configuration, monitoring, maintenance, and infrastructure operations in Windows environments. The candidate will collaborate with development, infrastructure, and security teams to ensure reliable application deployments, system performance, and compliance with established security requirements. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, CK Money
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ It is a pivotal moment in the modernization of consumer finance, and CK Money sits at the forefront of it. CK Money is the neobank within Intuit Credit Karma, delivering Checking and Savings accounts to 3\+ millions members. We're building the future of money movement — transforming how households and individuals interact with their finances through instant, low\-cost, unified payment rails — and connecting that experience into the broader Intuit ecosystem alongside QuickBooks and TurboTax. As a Staff Software Engineer on CK Money, you'll own the systems that hold our members' money: account origination and onboarding, deposits and transfers, card and payment flows, and the real\-time messaging backbone that keeps balances, notifications, and downstream systems consistent. These are systems where correctness, latency, and availability are not negotiable, and where the blast radius of a design decision is measured in millions of members and real dollars. You'll join a team building cloud\-native, AI\-native software on a modern stack: Scala and TypeScript on the back end, GraphQL at the API layer, Kafka for event streaming, all running on Google Cloud. We ship continuously, instrument everything, and lean into AI both in the products we build and in how we build them — including agentic development workflows that raise the whole team's velocity. If you're a hands\-on builder with depth in payments, banking, or distributed systems, who wants to raise the engineering bar around you and take end\-to\-end ownership of ambiguous, high\-stakes problems, this role is for you. **Responsibilities** * **Own critical banking systems end\-to\-end.** Drive significant technical initiatives across every layer of the stack — from data model and ledger design through GraphQL API contracts to the member\-facing experience — for Checking, Savings, and money movement. * **Architect for scale, correctness, and trust.** Create robust, scalable, and secure technical designs for high\-volume, low\-latency financial systems, balancing short\-term delivery against long\-term architectural health, and ensuring high availability and optimal performance. * **Stay hands\-on.** Spend roughly 60–70% of your time writing high\-quality, performant, production code while setting the technical direction for your team. * **Lead the event\-driven backbone.** Design and evolve Kafka\-based messaging and event\-streaming patterns that keep balances, transactions, notifications, and partner integrations consistent and idempotent at scale. * **Drive AI\-native innovation.** Identify high\-impact opportunities to apply AI and agentic capabilities — both in the product and in how we engineer — take AI\-powered features to production, and evaluate their impact with the right metrics. Coach the team on using AI development tools effectively and responsibly. * **Act as the technical subject\-matter expert.** Lead the design of complex features, run technical design reviews, and lead a small group of engineers through hard programming and design problems. * **Lead technical execution.** Own requirements gathering, technical design, project sequencing, and test planning; sequence complex dependencies and manage risk across multiple systems and teams. * **Partner with bank and network partners.** Work with our sponsor bank, processors, and payment network partners to integrate new capabilities and data, meeting the compliance, auditability, and regulatory obligations that come with holding member deposits. * **Champion engineering quality.** Set the bar on automated testing, CI/CD, observability, performance, security, and accessibility, and own quality through the full lifecycle — QA, pre\-production, production, and post\-release. * **Elevate engineering talent.** Provide clear goals, mentor senior engineers to the point where they lead initiatives independently, and give actionable feedback. * **Solve systemic gaps.** Partner with cross\-functional leads and managers to systematically tackle technical debt, tooling deficiencies, and skill gaps that slow the team down. * **Communicate with clarity.** Produce crisp technical documents and design reviews, and communicate design choices persuasively to technical and non\-technical audiences, including executives. **Qualifications** * 7\+ years delivering enterprise\-class applications, with a strong focus on backend software development, API design, and robust client/server contracts. * 5\+ years designing complex distributed systems that operate at scale. * BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * **Core languages:** strong proficiency in TypeScript and/or Scala (or another functional/JVM language with demonstrated ability to ramp quickly — we code primarily in Scala and TypeScript). * **APIs:** deep experience designing and consuming web APIs, with hands\-on GraphQL schema design and federation experience (REST and gRPC also relevant). * **Architecture \& infrastructure**: expertise in scalable microservices architectures, messaging patterns, container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), and infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform). * **Event streaming \& messaging**: production experience with Kafka (or Pub/Sub, SQS, RabbitMQ) and the design of idempotent, exactly\-once\-effective, event\-driven workflows. * **Cloud**: hands\-on development in a public cloud environment — Google Cloud strongly preferred (GKE, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Spanner/Cloud SQL). * **Data**: strong relational schema design, NoSQL, and high\-volume low\-latency data pipelining. * **AI capability**: proficient in — or highly capable of — integrating and evaluating AI in production, including LLM prompting, tool/function calling, and agentic development workflows; a high\-level understanding of model types, their limitations, and how to measure accuracy. * **Foundational excellence**: solid grounding in OOP and functional design, algorithms, design patterns, test automation (TDD, unit/integration/functional), and CI/CD. * **Technical leadership:** a track record of setting direction, running design reviews, mentoring senior engineers, and serving as the cross\-functional go\-to person without relying on direct authority. * Communication: excellent written and verbal skills; able to explain complex technical topics clearly and persuasively to technical and non\-technical audiences alike. Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender. The expected base pay range for this position is: New York $202,500 \- $274,000

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: * Sunnyvale, CA, United States * Not Remote * Engineering * JOB218860 ### **Company Description** It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide. We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world. The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life. If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here. ### **Job Description** Our team designs and builds the embedded platform software infrastructure that supports critical performance, safety and user\-facing features of the da Vinci™ Surgical System, Intuitive’s flagship product. We’re looking for a high energy, experienced embedded software engineer to take technical ownership across our embedded platform software stack. In this role, you will lead board bring\-up initiatives, drive architectural decision for our next\-generation platforms, and serve as a technical anchor for the team – mentoring junior engineers and collaborating cross\-functionally with hardware, system software, and FPGA teams. You will own critical subsystems supporting video networking, UI display, and machine learning capabilities of Da Vinci 5 while driving improvements in robustness, reliability, manufacturability, and serviceability. **Essential Job Duties** * Lead board bring\-up activities for next generation\-based platforms including bootloader configuration, BSP customization, peripheral driver integration and system validation – taking end\-to\-end ownership from initial power\-on through production readiness. * Own development and drive the technical direction of embedded software for video networking, UI display, and machine learning applications on Linux\-based systems – including architectural decisions, code review and performance optimization. * Design and own comprehensive test strategies to validate board functionality, peripheral interfaces, and system performance metrics – including defining acceptance criteria and driving resolution of complex hardware\-software integration issues. * Partner with and technically guide hardware engineers to identify, root\-cause and resolve board\-level issues during early development phases – serving as the primary software interface for cross\-functional hardware bring\-up * Architect and lead the development of automated test frameworks for board validation and regression testing – establishing scalable infrastructure usable across multiple platform variants. * Mentor junior and mid\-level engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, and hands\-on debugging support – actively contributing to the growth of the team. * Author and maintain technical documentation including design specifications, bring\-up procedures, and failure analysis reports in compliance with FDA\-regulated development processes. ### **Qualifications** **Required Education, Skills \& Experience** * Minimum of 8 years of related experience and a Bachelor's degree; or 6 years experience and a Master's degree; or a PhD with 3 years of experience; or equivalent experience * Expert\-level proficiency in C and C\+\+ for embedded systems development, including memory management, real\-time constraints, and performance\-critical code * Deep expertise in embedded Linux, including kernel internals, custom device driver development, BSP bring\-up, and user space application development * Proficiency with embedded development and debugging tools including GDB, JTAG, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and cross\-compilation toolchains – with a demonstrated ability to root cause complex hardware\-software interactions * Proven hands\-on experience with hardware interfaces and protocols (i2c, SPI, UART, USB, Ethernet, CAN) – including bring\-up debugging, and driver development for each * Exceptional debugging and root\-cause analysis skills, with a track record of resolving complex, multi\-layer Hardware\-FPGA\-software integration failures in time\-critical environments * Demonstrated ability to mentor and technically develop junior and mid\-level engineers * Experience working in an FDA\-regulated or other safety\-critical development environment, including familiarity with design controls, traceability, and risk management processes * Effective written and verbal communication skills for techni QNX RTOS or other real\-time operating systems in safety\-critical applications. * Proficiency in Python and bash scripting for test automation, bootup design, and build system integration * Demonstrated experience in and comfort with all phases of the product development lifecycle including design, implementation, debug, verification, validation, and transfer to manufacturing * Experience designing software products in an FDA or other regulated industry or for mission critical applications; comfortable with concepts of design input, design output, traceability, risk analysis, and mitigations ### **Additional Information** Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID\-19\. Details can vary by role. Intuitive is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws. Mandatory Notices U.S. Export Controls Disclaimer: In accordance with the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR §743\.13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U.S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status. Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U.S. Government on your behalf (note: the government’s licensing process can take 3 to 6\+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan (“TCP”) (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process). For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee’s start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes. Day to day, that means designing simulation environments, generating large volumes of labeled synthetic data, and working with ML engineers to close the sim\-to\-real gap for robotic surgery. It's a hands\-on engineering role at the intersection of 3D simulation, machine learning, and robotics. **What You'll Do** * Design and build high\-fidelity simulation environments for surgical tasks. * Generate scalable synthetic datasets including photo realistic imagery, segmentation masks, depth, optical flow, and kinematic state — and own their quality, versioning, and delivery. * Implement domain randomization and procedural scene generation to maximize sim\-to\-real transfer. * Model deformable soft\-tissue physics, tool\-tissue contact, and instrument kinematics that match Intuitive's platforms. * Partner with ML engineers to define task curricula, reward functions, and evaluation benchmarks. * Develop and refine sim\-to\-real transfer strategies, and validate simulated behaviors against benchtop phantoms and real systems. * Build reusable tools, APIs, and documentation so the broader team can spin up new tasks without deep simulation expertise. ### **Qualifications** **What You Bring** We care more about real depth in a few of these than shallow coverage of all of them. * **Strong software engineering.** You write maintainable, tested code in Python, C\+\+ and/or C\#, and you're comfortable in a Linux / Git / Docker / GPU workflow. * **Hands\-on simulation or graphics experience.** You've built things in a physics simulator, game engine, or rendering/VFX pipeline — robotics simulators, real\-time engines, and offline graphics pipelines all count. * **A feel for data and models.** You've produced data that trained an ML model (or worked closely alongside that), and you understand how data quality and distribution show up in model behavior. * **Working knowledge of 3D and physics fundamentals** — coordinate frames, rendering, rigid\-body and contact dynamics — enough to reason about why a simulated scene does or doesn't look and behave correctly. jobs.title: Growth Engineer
jobs.description: **About Krea** -------------- At Krea, we are building next\-generation AI creative tools. We're dedicated to making AI intuitive and controllable for creatives \- our mission is to build tools that empower human creativity, not replace it. We believe AI is a new medium that allows us to express ourselves through various formats \- text, images, video, sound, and even 3D. We're building better, smarter, and more controllable tools to harness this medium. We recently took this a step forward with the launch of Krea 2, our first foundation model, built completely from scratch for aesthetic diversity and stylistic control, and with Krea 3 \- our new image editing model. We've raised over $83M and are backed by world\-class investors such as a16z, Bain Capital, and Abstract. We work full\-time and in\-person at our waterfront office in San Francisco. We care about creativity: our team includes musicians, designers, visual artists, and engineers. **This role** ------------- We're looking for a Growth Engineer to build the product surfaces and systems that drive how creatives discover, adopt, and pay for Krea. You'll sit on our growth team, working closely with our Head of Growth, product engineers, and designers, and you'll own growth problems end to end: from spotting the opportunity in the data, to shipping the experiment, to measuring the result. This is a hands\-on engineering role with real product and business ownership. You'll work primarily in SvelteKit and TypeScript (React experience also fine), with deep use of our event data in ClickHouse and Postgres. Success here is measured in activation, conversion, retention, and revenue, not tickets closed. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Own the funnel in code:** Build and iterate on signup, onboarding, activation, and upgrade flows so new users reach their first great creation faster and stay. * **Run experiments at speed:** Design, ship, and analyze A/B tests across pricing, paywalls, onboarding, and lifecycle touchpoints, and build the experimentation tooling that lets the whole team move faster. * **Build growth infrastructure:** Own event tracking, attribution, and analytics pipelines (ClickHouse, Postgres) so the growth team can trust its numbers on acquisition, ROAS, and retention. * **Scale acquisition channels with engineering:** Build programmatic SEO/AEO surfaces, shareable and remixable outputs, referral loops, and integrations that turn Krea creations into new users. * **Power lifecycle and monetization:** Ship triggered email and in\-product messaging, plan and billing improvements, and usage\-based nudges that lift conversion and expansion. * **Support launches:** Partner with product, marketing, and content on our ambitious launch calendar, building landing pages, waitlists, and launch mechanics that hold up under spikes in traffic. * **Automate with AI:** Use AI and agents to build internal tools and workflows that multiply the output of a small, high\-leverage growth team. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * 3\+ years of full\-stack engineering experience, ideally including time on a growth, monetization, or activation team at a fast\-growing consumer or prosumer product * Real, significant Svelte or React experience: this isn't a pure\-backend role * Strong quantitative instincts: you're comfortable writing SQL, designing experiments, and separating signal from noise in the results * A track record of shipping changes that moved a metric, and the ability to explain exactly how and why * Comfort owning things end to end, from hypothesis to shipped, measured impact * High ownership and speed: you think like a founder and thrive in an ambitious, low\-ego culture * AI\-native: you actively use AI and agents to multiply your output * Clear written and verbal communication * Taste: a strong, well\-developed point of view on what good creative work and good product experiences look like **Nice to have** * Experience with experimentation platforms, feature flags, product analytics, or attribution tooling * Experience with billing and subscription systems (e.g. Stripe) * Programmatic SEO or lifecycle marketing infrastructure experience * A creative background (design, art, architecture, or similar) **Our stack** ------------- * SvelteKit, TypeScript, Python, Postgres (AWS Aurora), Redis, ClickHouse, Docker, Kubernetes, FluxCD **What we offer** ----------------- * **Team**: Work alongside a world\-class team building the future of AI creative tooling * **Impact**: Significant scope and company\-wide impact * **Competitive compensation**: generous salary \& equity packages * **Health \& wellness**: 100% health \& 99% dental/vision insurance premiums covered for employees, health FSA accounts, \& long\-term disability coverage * **Time off**: Flexible PTO policy * **Financial planning**: 401k with a 4% company\-sponsored match * **Meals in the office**: breakfast, lunch, dinner \- you name it, we'll cover it * **Transit**: Ubers covered to \& from the office * **Sponsorship**: We're open to sponsoring international visas where we can (e.g., STEM OPT, OPT, H\-1B, O\-1, E\-3\). * And more! *Please note the above benefits \& perks are for full\-time employees*

jobs.title: Senior iOS Developer
jobs.description: ### **Description** **The Opportunity** KWI is hiring a Senior iOS Developer to help build and run KWI POS. Store associates at specialty retailers like Pandora, Bluemercury and Tom Ford use this native Swift app on iPhone and iPad to ring sales. If it goes down, our clients can't take money, so reliability is part of the product. Your main job is the iOS app. Most POS features also touch the web services behind it, written in Java or Go, so you will have the opportunity to develop down the stack and ship the service changes your screens depend on. You will also help modernize a mature codebase: retire legacy Objective\-C, harden offline mode, and make releases more predictable. And you will do it with AI\-assisted, spec\-driven development as your normal way of working. **The Company** We are a small team with a big vision: to be the premier provider of cloud technology solutions for retailers. KWI offers a complete, unified commerce solution from a single database, specifically designed to help specialty retailers grow their business. Our portfolio of customers includes Pandora, Bluemercury, Tom Ford, and many other globally recognizable brands. We combine Point of Sale, Merchandising, Order Management, eCommerce, CRM, and Loss Prevention into one cloud\-based platform. We are a Values and Mission driven organization, and we believe that if we develop and demonstrate leadership in our strategy, operations, and people, we will continue to drive product innovation and service excellence. **Who we are** We have the stability of a company that has been around for 40\+ years and the energy of a startup that is still figuring out how to do things better every day. We move fast, we question the status quo, and we expect everyone on the team to do the same. If you are genuinely curious, have a better\-than\-average level of common sense, and get excited by solving real problems rather than just doing your job description — KWI is for you. We do not have a lot of bureaucracy and we do not want people who need it. What we do have is a team that shows up, figures things out, and takes pride in the work. **AI at KWI** We are serious about AI. Not as a buzzword, but as a real part of how we work. We expect every member of our team to actively use AI tools to work smarter, move faster, and do more with less. We are not looking for someone who has heard of AI. We are looking for someone who can walk us through how they use it day to day: in their current role, in how they organize their work, and in how they solve problems. Curiosity and a willingness to experiment are non\-negotiable.### **The impact you'll make** * Design, build and ship features in the KWI POS app for iPhone and iPad, mostly in Swift, using Xcode * Work with the lead developer on app architecture, and own the iOS side of each feature: state management, error handling and test coverage * Build intelligence into the POS: AI\-driven features that help associates sell * Work from specs written with Product, Design and QA, and help sharpen those specs before code starts * Use AI coding tools every day to write, test and refactor code, and help the team improve how we use them * Make offline mode more reliable: keep stores selling without a network, then reconcile cleanly when it returns * Build and support integrations with payment devices and store hardware, including card readers, receipt printers and scanners * Retire legacy Objective\-C and move the app toward modern Swift patterns, including SwiftUI and Swift concurrency where they fit * Improve performance, stability and crash rates, using the telemetry we already collect * Troubleshoot production issues in client stores, including problems that only show up with a specific client's configuration * Review code, mentor other engineers, and work as a technical partner to our offshore development team * Develop down the stack: take on changes to the Java or Go web services your screens call as you grow in the role ### **What you will bring** * BS in Computer Science or Engineering, or equivalent work experience * 6\+ years of professional software development, including 5\+ years building native iOS apps in Swift that shipped to production * Enough Objective\-C to read, debug and safely migrate legacy code * Deep knowledge of UIKit and the iOS app lifecycle, plus working experience with SwiftUI and Swift concurrency (async/await) * Experience integrating iOS apps with RESTful APIs, and a clear understanding of how the app and its services work together * Experience building offline\-first apps: local persistence (SQLite or Core Data), sync and conflict handling * Daily, hands\-on use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot * Strong testing habits: unit and UI tests with XCTest, and a commitment to automated testing * Experience with Git, CI/CD for iOS (Jenkins, Fastlane or similar), code signing and App Store or enterprise distribution * Experience with Agile delivery (Kanban or Scrum) and tracking work in Jira * The discipline to work in a codebase where a mistake can stop a store from selling, and clear communication when something goes wrong **Nice to have*** Backend development in Java or Go * Card\-present payments: payment gateways, EMV devices, tender types, gift cards, certification cycles * Retail or point\-of\-sale domain experience * React Native experience (we also maintain a React Native app) * Experience with Bluetooth or external accessory integrations on iOS * Observability tooling such as OpenTelemetry or crash reporting * Experience working with offshore or distributed teams * Shipping AI features in a mobile app: Core ML, Apple's Foundation Models framework, or integrating LLM APIs ### **As a member of the KWI team you will receive** * Full Medical, Dental and Vision * Annual bonus eligible * Free gym in the building * Generous PTO policy * Summer Fridays....all year round * Tuition Reimbursement * Discount from building café * 401(K) with a 50% company match (up to 6% of employee contribution) * Employee Referral Program * (1\) Volunteer day each year **Our work space** We understand that our teams need flexibility, which is why we follow a hybrid schedule. Our in\-office days of Monday, Tuesday and Thursday, and employees are allowed to work remotely on Wednesdays and Friday. We are also a collaborative group and believe that getting together in person allows our team to do their best work. Together we enjoy monthly events, bagels every Thursday, a state\-of\-the\-art coffee machine, a full snack pantry and many more surprise and delight moments throughout the year. **Our commitment to you** At KWI, we know that cultivating diversity and fostering an inclusive work environment is critical to our impact and success. We create an environment where no individual is advantaged or disadvantaged because of their background. We offer equal opportunity employment regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability status, age, marital status, or protected veteran status. With a commitment to maintaining a bias\-free environment in which harassment is prohibited, we respect cultural diversity and comply with the laws of the places in which we operate. We expect our business partners, suppliers, clients, and all our team members to uphold these commitments.### **About KWI** KWI helps retailers maximize sales by uniting their online and in\-store capabilities to deliver delightful shopper experiences. With KWI **Merchandising and mobile POS**, retailers can execute omnichannel flawlessly, and right at their fingertips — clienteling, endless aisle, mobile checkout with the latest payment options, **inventory management, and ecommerce**.

jobs.title: Founding GTM Engineer
jobs.description: Here at Magic, we're personalizing real world experiences. Our first product, Loyalist, is an agentic CRM for restaurants. We partner with 1,000\+ venues across 180\+ cities, from Carbone to 4 Charles to Eleven Madison Park. We're expanding into members clubs, hotels, and more. We sell in person. Our team walks into restaurants, hosts dinners for operators, and shows up at the industry's events. We're looking for a founding GTM engineer to build the system behind that motion. You'll own the data, tools, and AI agents that tell our team which groups to meet, who runs them, and what each event and conversation actually produced. This is a builder role. You'll run our enrichment and programmatic outbound, and you'll build the internal tools that sales, customer experience, and growth use every day. You'll report to our Head of Growth and work closely with the marketing and growth team, as well as founders, sales, and customer experience. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Build and manage our internal GTM platform. Develop our data enrichment processes and build the agents that power our go\-to\-market motion * Build and run programmatic outbound, including cold email, end to end: targeting, sequencing, and reply handling, plus the infrastructure behind it (sending domains, warmup, and deliverability) * Own lead scoring and lifecycle. Score every account on signals like new openings, chef and GM changes, and groups switching reservation or POS systems, then build the lifecycle automations that move it from first touch to closed, onboarded, and expanding * Build tools that make sales and customer experience feel superhuman, e.g. a context transfer layer between the two teams or a meeting scheduler for the sales team * Partner with marketing and growth to turn our data into campaigns, events, and programs that drive pipeline, and support on SEO / AEO * Own GTM reporting and connect our tools, so sales, customer experience, and growth work from the same data and can see what each channel and event produced **What you'll bring** --------------------- * 3\+ years of experience across GTM engineering, engineering, demand gen, or RevOps * Some background in marketing and growth preferred * Experience with data enrichment. You know the providers, waterfalls, and how to get a clean, verified list * You can build distributed systems * Experience running programmatic outbound, including cold email at scale, with the deliverability to match. You understand the statistics of domain, IP, and copy health * High competence with Claude and Clay. You've built real workflows and tools with both, not just prompts in a chat window, and you have a strong point of view on the best tools and integrations for each task * You enjoy supporting teammates. You turn what sales, customer experience, and marketing ask for into tools they actually use * You care about data quality. Duplicates and wrong location counts bother you * High ownership and a bias toward shipping * Bonus: experience in or around restaurants or hospitality **Who thrives here** -------------------- * You want to be early and own a system end to end * You'd rather ship a working tool this week than a perfect one next quarter * You like being close to the field. You'll join walk\-ins and events to see how the data gets used **What we offer** ----------------- * Salary range $150,000\-$190,000 and equity * We work in person 5 days a week in our SoHo office * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance for you and all your dependents (FSA and HSA plans available) * Lunch daily from the best restaurants in NYC; you choose all the restaurants your first week * A day trailing a restaurant, so you see what our customers live every day * Unlimited PTO Compensation Range: $150K \- $190K

jobs.description: At MCG, we lead the healthcare community to deliver patient\-focused care. We have a mission\-driven team of talented physicians and technical experts developing our evidence\-based content and innovating our products to accelerate improvements in healthcare. We cultivate a work environment that nurtures personal and professional growth, and this is a thrilling time to become a part of our organization. With dynamic roles that offer meaningful impact, you'll be able to fully realize your potential. Plus, you'll enjoy world\-class benefits and the security, stability, and resources of our parent company, Hearst, with over 100 years of experience. Working with Data Scientists, Clinicians, Software Engineers, and Product, this role translates model\-quality and operational improvement opportunities into scalable technical solutions. and develop practical solutions when established approaches or frameworks are insufficient. * Establish reusable engineering patterns, standards, and best practices that improve the quality, jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Miso** MISO develops technology that elevates human lives in the commercial kitchen. We’re engineering production\-ready robotic systems that tightly integrate perception, real\-time decision making, and electromechanical controls to automate the most dangerous, least desirable tasks in food preparation. That means building software that understands the physical world as it actually behaves, and hardware that can execute precisely in the face of chaos. Success is measured in uptime, throughput, and trust from our customers, not demos. Our flagship platform, Flippy, is already operating in high\-volume restaurant kitchens across seven states. applications using React, TypeScript, and JavaScript * Build responsive, intuitive dashboards and interfaces that transform complex restaurant and robotics data into clear operational insights * agentic software development tools * AI coding tools effectively for implementation, debugging, refactoring, automated testing, documentation, and learning unfamiliar code * Strong experience developing modern web applications using React, TypeScript, and JavaScript * Understanding of front\-end architecture, reusable component design, state management, responsive interfaces, and written and verbal communication skills ### **Preferred Qualifications** * React visualization and dashboard libraries * SaaS or enterprise web applications * Data engineering, ETL/ELT pipelines, analytics platforms, or data warehouses * Integrating LLMs or AI\-powered capabilities into applications * Developing applications that interact with robotics, IoT, telemetry, or real\-time systems robotics testing is planned, developed, executed, and analyzed. * Use Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and similar tools to accelerate test development, debugging, documentation, and analysis. * Apply AI\-powered testing tools to generate test cases, identify edge cases, expand coverage, and reduce manual work. * Build automated test frameworks using Python and modern testing tools. * Use AI to analyze telemetry, system logs, test results, and failure patterns. * Develop automated hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL), simulation, and physical robot regression tests. * Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to catch defects earlier. * Evaluate new AI technologies and testing methods to improve speed, coverage, and quality. ### **Technical Leadership \& Quality Strategy** * Provide thought leadership in robotics quality, test automation, reliability, and AI\-assisted engineering. * Define testing strategies, quality standards, and release readiness criteria. * Identify product risks early and influence engineering designs to improve reliability and testability. * Establish quality metrics and dashboards for defect trends, test coverage, reliability, and release quality. * Use data and AI\-assisted analysis to prioritize testing and recommend improvements. * Work with engineering leadership to balance development speed with product quality. * Mentor engineers in testing, automation, debugging, and effective use of AI tools. * Promote engineering ownership, continuous improvement, and practical problem\-solving. * Clearly communicate quality risks, technical findings, and recommendations to engineering teams and leadership. **Requirements** ---------------- * **3\+ years of hands\-on professional experience testing both hardware and software in robotic systems. Robotics testing is required.** * Hands\-on work with physical robots, including robotic arms, motors, sensors, controllers, or electromechanical systems. * Strong skills in hardware/software integration testing, debugging, and root\-cause analysis. * Understanding of functional, integration, regression, system, and reliability testing. * Python, C\+\+, or similar programming skills for test automation and debugging. * Proficiency with modern AI coding assistants, AI\-powered testing tools, or intelligent automation. * Ability to independently plan tests, analyze results, and drive issues to resolution. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills across hardware and software. * Technical leadership, initiative, and ability to influence engineering practices. * **Excellent written and verbal English communication skills are required.** * BS in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. * **Must be physically located in the Pasadena, CA area and work on\-site five days per week. No H\-1B sponsorship is available.** **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Commercial robotic products deployed in real\-world environments. * Multi\-axis robotic arms, motion control, kinematics, and robot safety systems. * ROS/ROS 2, Gazebo, NVIDIA Isaac Sim, or similar robotics tools. * Python, PyTest, and automated testing frameworks. * Hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, test fixtures, and automated test equipment. * Computer vision, perception, AI/ML, and sensor integration. * CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions or Jenkins. * AI\-driven testing platforms such as TestSigma. * Robotics safety standards and industrial automation practices. * Telemetry analysis, data visualization, and performance monitoring. * Reliability engineering, failure analysis, and endurance testing. * Leading technical initiatives and mentoring engineers. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- You will help Miso deliver more reliable robots by catching problems earlier, reducing field failures, and improving release quality. Through automation, AI\-driven analysis, and practical engineering leadership, you will make testing faster, more repeatable, and more effective while helping the team continuously improve how robotic systems are built and validated. **Compensation** $120,000–$150,000 per year \+ Benefits *The stated compensation range reflects the targeted base salary range for candidates residing in the Los Angeles Metro area and does not include additional compensation or benefits. If your salary requirements fall outside this range, we still encourage you to apply.*

The position involves hands\-on inspection of electrical and piping materials, coordination with warehouse and construction teams, and follow\-up on material discrepancies and nonconforming items. purchase orders, drawings, and manufacturer documentation. * Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify, document, and communicate material discrepancies. * Ability to maintain organized inspection records and coordinate effectively across multiple teams. * Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and Outlook. * Ability to work in warehouse and active construction environments and comply with site safety and PPE requirements. **Preferred Qualifications:** ----------------------------- * Associate or bachelor's degree in engineering, materials science, construction management, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * Experience inspecting both electrical and piping materials. * Experience supporting semiconductor facilities, cleanrooms, or other advanced manufacturing projects. * Familiarity with material traceability, material test reports, certificates of compliance, and nonconformance reporting. * Familiarity with relevant ASTM, ASME, UL, or NEMA standards as applicable to the materials being inspected. * Experience with electronic inspection records, inventory systems, or document control platforms. **Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO):** --------------------------------------- Marketech International Corporation USA is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Embodied AI Real2Sim Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Job Description:** **Core Objective:** Build the digital pipeline from the real world to simulation space. Reconstruct and calibrate visual and physical properties of robots, objects and scenes, and deliver SimReady interactive assets to reduce the sim\-to\-real gap, supporting algorithm training, simulation evaluation and policy transfer to real hardware. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Own the end\-to\-end Real2Sim workflow based on Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, Genesis, Blender and other simulation platforms, including 3D reconstruction, appearance reconstruction, dynamic identification, calibration of contact, friction and inertia parameters, to align dynamic and perceptual behaviors between simulation and real robots. * Create, validate and iterate SimReady assets following USD / URDF / MJCF standards. Configure joints, collision shapes, mass/inertia, joint limits, semantic labels and affordance properties for robots and interactive objects, to achieve physical parameter calibration of simulation assets, ensuring stable usability in simulation training. * Process multi\-modal real\-world captured data: camera calibration, point cloud \& mesh processing, texture and PBR material calibration. Leverage 3DGS / NeRF and related reconstruction methods to digitize real scenes and export assets compatible with simulation engines. * Develop automated tools for calibration, data processing and asset quality inspection. Document asset specifications, calibration workflows and evaluation metrics to improve pipeline throughput and sim\-real alignment accuracy. * Collaborate with perception, robot learning, simulation engine and hardware teams, design quantitative sim\-real benchmark experiments, identify simulation bias, and continuously improve calibration protocols and asset standards for closed\-loop data iteration. * Design excitation trajectories for robot system identification, collect time\-series dynamic data from physical robots, calibrate and reproduce non\-ideal dynamic behaviors including nonlinear joint friction and transmission backlash. **Requirements** ---------------- ### **Must\-have** * Proficiency in at least one simulation/graphics tool such as Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, Genesis or Blender, with solid understanding of computer graphics and rigid\-body dynamics. Familiar with physics simulation engines such as PhysX and Newton. * Hands\-on experience with Real2Sim pipelines and SimReady asset standards; capable of independently building, configuring and validating robot or object assets including joint setup and physical property tuning. * Knowledge of 3D reconstruction, camera imaging, point cloud processing and camera calibration; fundamental understanding of system identification, parameter calibration and contact/friction models for physical simulation. Familiar with PBR rendering and material creation. * Ability to decompose requirements, implement technical solutions, run comparative experiments and root\-cause sim\-real mismatches from visual reconstruction or physical simulation. * Capable of designing dynamic system identification experiments, analyzing measured hardware data, and quantifying sim\-real errors introduced by nonlinear dynamics. **Nice\-to\-have** ------------------ * Proven track record delivering Real2Sim projects, especially for robotic arms, dexterous hands or humanoid robots. * Deep familiarity with USD / URDF / MJCF, experience building asset libraries and automated asset validation pipelines. * Skilled in Python / C\+\+ for calibration scripts, engine extensions and data processing tools. * Experience with 3DGS, NeRF, PBR reconstruction and photogrammetry. * Background in system identification, excitation trajectory design, dynamic parameter estimation and contact model tuning. * Understanding of Sim2Real, reinforcement learning and embodied AI closed\-loop systems. * Experience with motion capture, multi\-sensor calibration and real robot hardware experiments. * Familiar with nonlinear friction models such as LuGre and Stribeck, with experience modeling and tuning joint hysteresis and backlash. **Default Benefits:** ===================== * Health insurance * Vision care * Dental coverage * 401(k) * Paid holidays * PTO (Paid Time Off) * Sick leave
