The team is responsible for managing cybersecurity, IT risks and vulnerabilities, physical security, and more. In this fast\-paced, mission\-driven environment, you’ll join outstanding teammates to expand your skills, collaborate across the organization and implement innovative approaches to safeguard MetLife when it matters most. Ready to make an impact? Join us if you want to embrace the rapidly evolving environment and use transformative technology to integrate and build security into the foundation of key initiatives across MetLife. **The Opportunity** The Cyber Platform Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise security solutions within MetLife’s environment. This hands\-on role partners with cross\-functional teams to ensure security platforms are effectively engineered, integrated, and operated in alignment with MetLife’s security policies and regulatory obligations. The candidate will identify and implement opportunities to strengthen security capabilities, troubleshoot complex issues, and improve the automation, integration, reliability, and operational maturity of MetLife’s security platforms across a complex global environment. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and implement enterprise security platform solutions that strengthen MetLife’s security posture and improve operational effectiveness. * Develop and maintain scripts, integrations, and automated workflows to reduce manual effort, improve efficiency, and increase the scalability and reliability of security operations. * Evaluate and apply AI and emerging technologies to enhance platform capabilities, accelerate security workflows, and identify opportunities for intelligent automation. * Lead technical implementations, upgrades, change management, documentation, and lifecycle activities in collaboration with global and cross\-functional teams. * Provide advanced technical support and troubleshooting for complex security platform issues and business\-impacting incidents, serving as a senior escalation resource. **Required Qualifications** * 7\+ years of experience in IT security engineering, platform engineering, or security architecture within a complex enterprise environment, including experience implementing and supporting enterprise security technologies. * Demonstrated scripting and automation experience using languages such as PowerShell, Python, or Bash to automate security engineering and operational workflows. * Experience troubleshooting complex technical issues across security platforms, infrastructure, endpoints, networks, or cloud environments, including working within formal change management processes. * Demonstrated AI fluency, including the ability to effectively use AI\-assisted technologies to improve engineering, automation, troubleshooting, analysis, and operational workflows while applying appropriate security and data\-handling practices. * Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and partner effectively with technical and cross\-functional teams in a global enterprise environment. **Preferred Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience; relevant industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GIAC, or similar are a plus. * Experience with enterprise security platforms, cloud technologies, DevOps/DevSecOps practices, APIs, scripting, and security automation in a large\-scale or global environment. * Experience applying AI, machine learning, or AI\-assisted development and automation capabilities to security engineering, platform operations, or cybersecurity workflows. \#LI\-WRAPJOB Location Expectation: This is a hybrid role **requiring a minimum of 3 days per week** in office. *The expected salary range* *for this position is $100**,000 \- $125,000**. This role may also be eligible for annual short\-term incentive compensation. All incentives and benefits are subject to the applicable plan terms.* **Benefits We Offer** Our U.S. benefits address holistic well\-being with programs for physical and mental health, financial wellness, and support for families. We offer a comprehensive health plan that includes medical/prescription drug and vision, dental insurance, and no\-cost short\- and long\-term disability. We also provide company\-paid life insurance and legal services, a retirement pension funded entirely by MetLife and 401(k) with employer matching, group discounts on voluntary insurance products including auto and home, pet, critical illness, hospital indemnity, and accident insurance, as well as Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and digital mental health programs, parental leave, paid time off, paid holidays, volunteer time off, tuition assistance and much more! For more information regarding MetLife’s U.S. benefits, please **click here****.** **About MetLife** Recognized on Fortune magazine's list of the "World's Most Admired Companies", Fortune World’s 25 Best Workplaces™, as well as the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For®, MetLife, through its subsidiaries and affiliates, is one of the world’s leading financial services companies; providing insurance, annuities, employee benefits and asset management to individual and institutional customers. With operations in more than 40 markets, we hold leading positions in the United States, Latin America, Asia, Europe, and the Middle East. As part of our New Frontier strategy, MetLife is building an AI\-enabled, people\-centered future. We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, adaptability, and a growth mindset as we use AI to enhance how we serve customers, support communities, and evolve the way work gets done. At MetLife, AI is a responsible partner that supports human judgment, creativity, and continuous improvement while helping us build trust, inclusion, and long\-term value. jobs.description: Are you looking for a unique opportunity to be a part of something great? Want to join a 17,000\-member team that works on the technology that powers the world around us? Looking for an atmosphere of trust, empowerment, respect, diversity, and communication? How about an opportunity to own a piece of a multi\-billion dollar (with a B!) global organization? We offer all that and more at Microchip Technology Inc. People come to work at Microchip because we help design the technology that runs the world. They stay because our culture supports their growth and stability. They are challenged and driven by an incredible array of products and solutions with unlimited career potential. Microchip’s nationally\-recognized Leadership Passage Programs support career growth where we proudly enroll over a thousand people annually. We take pride in our commitment to employee development, values\-based decision making, and strong sense of community, driven by our Vision, Mission, and 11 Guiding Values; we affectionately refer to it as the *Aggregate System* and it’s won us countless awards for diversity and workplace excellence. Our company is built by dedicated team players who love to challenge the status quo; we did not achieve record revenue and over 30 years of quarterly profitability without a great team dedicated to empowering innovation. People like you. Visit our careers page to see what exciting opportunities and company perks await! **Job Description:** The **Microchip FPGA Software Engineering team** delivers a comprehensive software suite for designing Microchip’s FPGAs and managing the entire design flow from entry, to synthesis, through place\-and\-route, timing, power analysis, and simulation. Within the Software organization, the Timing, Power, and Modeling group is responsible for developing high\-quality and user\-friendly software for modeling and evaluating FPGA performance, both for speed and power consumption. These are key sign\-off tools, distributed along with the hardware to a wide range of customers and are also used internally for the exploration of new FPGA architectures. We research and implement cutting\-edge fast and scalable algorithms with the objective of helping FPGA architects meet the product performance requirements and customers extract the best performance out of these FPGA products. To meet these goals, we draw from a variety of EE, CE, and CS domains, including numerical optimization, linear programming, graph theory, modeling non\-linear electronic components, large data processing and machine learning based regression and classification methods. As a member of this R\&D team, you will leverage your solid foundations in computer science to develop next generation performance evaluation (timing and power) algorithms. Your work will used by thousands of well\-known customers, and your achievements will improve the overall solution, both internally and externally. **Primary Job Responsibilities:** * Design, develop, test, debug, and maintain static timing analysis software * Modeling complex electronic digital components, including high\-speed IOs * Developing solutions tailored towards supporting very large graph representation. * Optimizing architecture processing and analysis in terms of run\-time and memory footprint. **Secondary Job Responsibilities:** * Integrate some of the capabilities in an internal flow to evaluate future FPGA architectures. * Participate to the R\&D exploration activities on advanced topics such as OCV, SSTA, IR Drop * Help with the enforcement of Microchip’s Software Development Processes * Perform design reviews, unit testing, and code reviews * Own and sustain product features and provide customer support * Continue learning latest EDA discoveries and contribute to the team discussions **Requirements/Qualifications:** * Bachelors in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Engineering * 0\-3 years of experience in a related field * Strong Qualifications:** * Masters in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Engineering * Experience with source code management systems (Git, bitbucket, Jira) * Exposure to parallel programming techniques, like TBB * Familiarity/knowledge/experience with any of the following would be a plus: FPGA architectures, AI/ML\-driven applications, AI\-based code development **Successful candidates are expected to demonstrate:** * Employment stability, reliability, and sustained accountability in prior roles. * Effective teamwork and cross\-functional collaboration. * Integrity and accuracy in representing qualifications, experience, and credentials. **Travel Time:** 0% \- 25%**Physical Attributes:** Feeling, Hearing, Other, Seeing, Talking, Works Alone, Works Around industry. jobs.title: Information Security Engineer – Global Security Infrastructure
jobs.description: Job ID JR116695 **Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.** Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. Micron is expanding and modernizing its global footprint, and physical security technology has to keep pace. Sites today run a mix of systems at different ages and maturity levels. Our goal is a consistent, standards\-based security infrastructure everywhere we operate, covering video surveillance and analytics, access control, intrusion detection, visitor management, and perimeter protection. Modern security systems are connected, technology\-based platforms, and we want them deployed on predictable schedules and managed as a product, not a collection of one\-off projects. In partnership with the Global Security Operations leadership team, you will own that rollout end to end: planning, sequencing, site readiness, execution, and measurement. You will treat security operators and site leaders as your customers, gather their requirements, and make sure what we deploy works for them. **Responsibilities:** * **Own the global rollout program.** Build and run the multi\-year, multi\-site deployment plan for physical security infrastructure upgrades. Sequence sites by risk and readiness, manage scope, schedule, budget, and dependencies, and keep simultaneous projects across regions moving. * **Turn standards into repeatable deployments.** Partner with security engineering to translate technology standards and reference designs into deployment playbooks, site readiness checklists, and acceptance criteria so that every site rollout looks the same and gets faster over time. * **Bring a product mindset.** Gather requirements from security operators, site security leaders, and regional teams. Run the program with agile practices: prioritize a backlog, define what "done" looks like for each site, iterate on the playbook, and measure whether deployed systems deliver the expected operational outcomes. * **Build AI\-enabled tooling and automation.** Develop or adopt tools for deployment tracking, configuration standards checks, device health monitoring, and asset and lifecycle management across the global fleet. Use AI tools and agents to speed up program work such as site assessments, status reporting, risk identification, and documentation. Ensure deployed systems, including AI video analytics, produce data that integrates cleanly with the team's security operations data platform. * **Coordinate partners and integrators.** Manage external integrators and contractors through statements of work, schedules, and quality checks. Coordinate closely with IT and network teams, Information Security (for device hardening and network segmentation), Facilities and construction teams (especially for new fab builds), and EHS. * **Govern and verify.** Establish a governance cadence for the program, track site compliance against security technology standards, and run post\-deployment audits to confirm systems are installed, configured, and operating as designed. * **Manage risk and change.** Identify and raise program risks early, drive decisions to resolution, and plan for operator training and cutover so new systems are adopted, not just installed. * **Report to leadership.** Build clear metrics and dashboards on rollout progress, spend, site compliance, and system health. Present status, risks, and trade\-offs to senior leadership in concise, executive\-ready form. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience, plus 5\+ years in software product management or software engineering, including ownership of delivering a product or platform to users. * Experience leading cross\-functional delivery with multiple teams and external partners, including managing scope, schedule, and budget. * Working knowledge of networked systems, APIs, and integrations, plus scripting or data analysis skills sufficient to build tooling, automate reporting, and hold technical conversations with engineers and integrators. * AI proficiency: hands\-on use of generative AI tools (e.g., copilots, LLM\-based assistants, or agents) in day\-to\-day work, with judgment about where AI output needs human review. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including building executive\-level status reports and presentations, and willingness to travel domestically and internationally. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience rolling out technology across many sites or regions with global teams (for example IoT or edge device fleets, enterprise infrastructure, or manufacturing systems). * Experience with device fleet management, configuration management, or monitoring and observability tools, including applying AI/ML for anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, or automated workflows. * Experience with construction, facilities, or capital projects, including managing integrators or contractors through SOWs and acceptance testing. * Exposure to physical security systems such as video surveillance, access control, or intrusion detection, ideally in semiconductor, manufacturing, or other high\-security industrial environments. * Agile certification (e.g., CSM, PSM, SAFe, or PMI\-ACP). jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Developer Platform
jobs.description: Mirage is an AI video company focused on making creation dramatically easier. Our team tackles some of the hardest creative and technical challenges in generative media. All of this comes together in Captions, our creative workspace for generating, editing, and designing video. The technology behind Captions is now available more broadly: Tesseract gives any AI agent native video\-editing capabilities, while developers can integrate our models into their own products through APIs. **Explore our work** Captions — Our flagship creative workspace Tesseract — Our professional video engine for AI agents Research — The foundation models we build in\-house Updates — The latest from Mirage TechCrunch, Forbes, Fast Company — Press **Our Investors** We’re very fortunate to have some the best investors and entrepreneurs backing us, including **Index Ventures, Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia Capital, Andreessen Horowitz,** **General Catalyst**, Uncommon Projects, Kevin Systrom, Mike Krieger, Lenny Rachitsky, Antoine Martin, Julie Zhuo, Ben Rubin, Jaren Glover, SVAngel, 20VC, Ludlow Ventures, Chapter One, and more. *Please note that most of our roles will require you to be in\-person at our NYC HQ (located in Union Square)* **About the role** Mirage is hiring a backend engineer to rebuild how we ship software as AI agents dramatically increase the volume of code we produce. You’ll treat our development infrastructure like a product—working directly with engineers to understand friction, measure bottlenecks, and build tools they want to use. You’ll also ship features across our AI video products and developer platform, grounding those improvements in firsthand experience. engineers across our video creation software, video rendering engine, and developer platform, identifying where our development systems slow them down * Turn those insights into tools, agents, and streamlined workflows that engineers choose because they’re the fastest way to ship * Rebuild CI/CD to support 100x the change volume through fast incremental builds, test selection, automated flaky\-test detection and quarantine, merge queues, and preview environments * Make deployments safe by default through progressive rollouts, automated canary analysis, feature flags, and automatic rollback, catching bad changes within minutes before they affect users * Own the environments coding agents work in, including sandboxes, ephemeral stacks, and the tooling agents need to build, test, and verify their own work * Build an AI review pipeline with agent reviewers tuned to our codebase, risk\-based routing that directs risky changes to humans, and automated policy checks that gate merges * Run continuous, agent\-driven penetration testing against our applications, APIs, and infrastructure, moving beyond point\-in\-time annual audits and turning findings into pull requests with proposed fixes * Integrate security into the development pipeline through secrets, dependency, and supply\-chain scanning, AI\-assisted vulnerability triage, and automatically generated fix PRs * Secure agents’ access to code, infrastructure, and data through least\-privilege permissions, short\-lived credentials, sandboxing, audit logs, and prompt\-injection guardrails * Measure and improve the development lifecycle, with early priorities including reducing PR\-to\-production time as weekly merged PRs grow 10x, replacing long\-lived credentials in CI and agent environments, and driving flaky tests close to zero through automated detection, quarantine, and fix PRs **What Makes You a Great Fit** * 5\+ years of professional experience building backend or full\-stack software, with a systems * Hands\-on experience with CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, or security, and the drive to go deep; specialists and product engineers ready to specialize are both welcome * Extensive use of coding agents in your current work, with informed opinions about where they break * Strong security instincts, including thinking through how a system could be attacked while you’re building it * A practical, measurement\-driven approach—you measure before you fix and would rather ship an effective solution this week than wait a quarter for a perfect one * Comfort owning build, deployment, review, and security together, working across layers and defining a roadmap where no playbook exists * An interest in staying close to product, shipping to production every week, and using firsthand experience to guide infrastructure improvements * A preference for making the right path easy to follow through useful tools and thoughtful defaults **Even better if...** * You’re a product engineer jobs.title: Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: The Embedded Firmware Engineer I will support the development and sustaining engineering of embedded systems used in radiation measurement and medical\-device instrumentation. This early\-career role works at the intersection of firmware, electronics, instrumentation, and software. The engineer will begin with well\-defined firmware, hardware abstraction layer (HAL), driver, debugging, test, and documentation assignments under the mentorship of a senior firmware engineer, then grow into broader ownership of embedded platforms and legacy product knowledge. Key Areas of Responsibility * Develop, modify, debug, and maintain embedded C/C\+\+ firmware for microcontroller\-based products. * Implement well\-defined firmware features, HAL components, low\-level drivers, device interfaces, initialization, configuration, and error/status handling. * Support hardware bring\-up and troubleshoot issues spanning firmware, electronics, communications, and host software. * Read schematics and component datasheets and use standard bench equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and digital multimeters. * Support serial, USB, and other embedded command/response communications between devices and host applications. * Build firmware from controlled repositories and follow established branching, peer\-review, configuration\-management, and release practices. * Develop and execute unit\-level and firmware\-level tests; support design acceptance testing, defect investigation, and regression testing. * Create clear design notes, interface documentation, test records, and change documentation for regulated product development. * Participate in design and code reviews and collaborate with electrical, software, systems, test, manufacturing, and quality engineers. * Learn existing Sun Nuclear firmware architectures and progressively assume sustaining responsibility for established products. **Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a closely related technical discipline. * Coursework, internship, co\-op, project, hobby, or professional experience with embedded systems. * Working knowledge of C or C\+\+ and basic understanding of microcontrollers and embedded software concepts. * Ability to read basic electrical schematics and electronic component datasheets. * Familiarity with common interfaces such as UART, SPI, I2C, USB, or CAN. * Experience with source control such as Git or an equivalent system. * Structured problem\-solving skills, clear technical communication, and willingness to work directly with laboratory hardware. * Experience with STM32 or NXP microcontrollers and related development tools. * Exposure to interrupts, timers, DMA, ADCs, RTOS concepts, memory\-mapped peripherals, FPGA\-to\-MCU interfaces, or reusable driver/HAL design. * Experience with IAR Embedded Workbench, STM32 development tools, Visual Studio, Python, C\#, or scripting for test automation. * Exposure to medical devices, regulated product development, design controls, or IEC 62304\.

jobs.title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: In the Technology division, we leverage innovation to build the connections and capabilities that power our Firm, enabling our clients and colleagues to redefine markets and shape the future of our communities. This is a Lead Site Reliability Engineering position at Vice President level, which is part of the job family responsible for overseeing the production environment, ensuring the operational reliability of deployed software, and implementing strategies to optimize performance and minimize downtime. Morgan Stanley is an industry leader in financial services, known for mobilizing capital to help governments, corporations, institutions, and individuals around the world achieve their financial goals. Interested in joining a team that’s eager to create, innovate and make an impact on the world? Read on. The Vice President, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), is responsible for driving the stability, resiliency, availability, and operational excellence of critical Wealth Management Technology platforms. This leader will own end\-to\-end production reliability, champion SRE best practices, and partner closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, Operations, and Business stakeholders to ensure seamless client and advisor experiences. **What you’ll do in the role:** **Drive Reliability Engineering Practices** * Champion SRE principles, including Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Error Budgets, and operational risk management frameworks. * Define and track reliability metrics that measure platform health, customer experience, and operational effectiveness. * Lead initiatives focused on reducing Mean Time to Detect (MTTD), Mean Time to Identify (MTTI), and Mean Time to Restore (MTTR). **Own Production Reliability** * Provide leadership for the proactive detection, triage, and resolution of production issues impacting business\-critical applications and services. * Serve as the primary owner for escalated production incidents, driving resolution efforts across application, infrastructure, vendor, and external partner teams until service is restored and client impact is mitigated. * Establish a culture of operational excellence focused on stability, resiliency, and continuous service improvement. * Ensure clear, concise, and timely communication during outages, providing accurate business impact assessments and recovery updates to senior leadership. **Digital Asset \& Ledger Integration** * Support blockchain\-connected infrastructure, node operations, digital wallet security systems, or distributed ledger technology (DLT) pipelines within a regulated framework. **Production Governance \& Change Management** * Serve as a key gatekeeper for the production environment, ensuring adherence to change management policies, release controls, operational readiness standards, and risk management practices. * Assess the operational impact of technology changes and ensure appropriate testing, rollback strategies, monitoring, and support models are in place prior to production deployment. * Partner with development teams throughout the software lifecycle to ensure reliability, observability, and operational supportability are built into new applications and services. **Automation \& Operational Efficiency** * Identify opportunities to eliminate manual effort and operational toil through automation, self\-healing capabilities, and AI\-driven operational workflows. * Lead the development and adoption of automation solutions that improve reliability, reduce risk, and increase operational efficiency across the organization. * Promote a culture of engineering\-led operations and continuous process optimization. **Operational Readiness \& Knowledge Management** * Establish and maintain a comprehensive knowledge management framework, ensuring runbooks, troubleshooting guides, standards, and operational procedures are accurate, current, and accessible. * Drive operational readiness programs that improve first\-level diagnosis and reduce dependency on development teams for routine issue resolution. Create End\-to\-End Know your system diagrams. * Ensure support teams maintain high\-quality documentation and standardized troubleshooting practices to accelerate incident resolution. **Technical Leadership** * Act as a senior technical leader and trusted advisor for reliability, resiliency, observability, and production support strategies. * Provide guidance on architecture reviews, platform scalability, capacity planning, disaster recovery, and resiliency testing initiatives. * Partner with engineering teams to identify systemic risks and implement long\-term solutions that improve platform stability and customer experience. **What you’ll bring to the role:** * 10\+ years of experience in a production environment with a solid software development background and understanding of performance tuning, end\-to\-end troubleshooting, networking fundamentals and appropriate attention to detail * BS/MS or equivalent, p  experience with supporting/deploying applications in AWS/GCP Cloud technologies. * 2\+ years’ experience working with Digital Assets/Blockchain\-connected infrastructure, digital wallet security systems, distributed ledger technology pipelines. * Experienced, technically hands\-on professional that understands both code and infrastructure. * Strong experience in scripting language (Shell scripting, Python, Perl, etc.) and cloud driven development. * Hands\-on with AI and implementation of AI tools for operational efficiency. * Strong database skills with DB2, Sybase or Oracle. * Working knowledge on any of the DevOps \& observability tools (Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk, Kibana). * Solid analytical skills, problem determination, and resolution recovery processes. * Ability to interface and cultivate excellent working relationships with technology teams, business analysts, and vendors. * Should be a fast learner of technologies in a quick paced environment. * Is driven to learn about new technologies, techniques and what it takes to be an integral member of this team. * Hands\-on experience administering large\-scale, high\-availability systems and the tools to monitor performance and availability. * Excellent communication and writing skills specific to technical discussions across the management layers. * Experience with incident “on call” and ability to respond to emergencies on a 24/7 basis. * Strong ownership mentality with a focus on customer satisfaction. * Be able to manage an outage incident, coordinating user communications, and other teams to help resolve an incident. * Experience working within Financial Services Industry area will be a plus. **WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM MORGAN STANLEY:** At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values \- putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back \- aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work\-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work. To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about\-us/global\-offices into your browser. Expected base pay rates for the role will be between $155,000 and $215,000 per year at the commencement of employment. However, base pay if hired will be determined on an individualized basis and is only part of the total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may also include commission earnings, incentive compensation, discretionary bonuses, other short and long\-term incentive packages, and other Morgan Stanley sponsored benefit programs. Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Autonomous Vehicle Performance Metrics
jobs.description: Motional is a leading autonomous driving company on a mission to make driverless vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. Backed by Hyundai Motor Group, Motional is at the forefront of the physical AI revolution. Motional isn't just building first\-of\-its\-kind technology; we are transforming transportation to create safer streets and more sustainable mobility options. The Systems Readiness and Performance team is the crucial bridge between software development and real\-world deployment. We are responsible for driving system design, for verifying and validating the autonomy stack, and for defining, measuring, and validating system performance targets. We work closely with stakeholders in autonomy, infrastructure, and operations to build the definitive safety case for the commercial launch of our fully driverless IONIQ 5 robotaxis in Las Vegas later this year. **Mission Summary:** We are seeking a highly skilled Software Engineer to play a critical role in evaluating and improving the performance of our autonomous vehicle (AV) technology. This engineer will be responsible for developing and implementing metrics and software tools, primarily using Python, to effectively measure, analyze, and report on the performance of our AV systems. Their work will directly contribute to accelerating the development of safe and reliable autonomous technologies by transforming complex AV data into actionable insights for the organization. **What You'll Be Doing:** * **Drive Technical Strategy \& Roadmap:** Define a long\-term, high\-impact technical roadmap for the team, working closely with leadership and product managers to optimize Engineering traction and prioritize deliverables that de\-risk the deployment of our AV systems. * **Design AV Performance Analysis Pipelines:** Define, design, and implement key pipelines to extract on\-road and simulated events and evaluate autonomous vehicle performance (e.g., lane change capability, oscillation/braking metrics, VRU emergence from occlusion). * **Develop Metrics Software and AI\-Powered Tools:** Leverage strong Python skills to develop frameworks, AI\-powered tools, and systems for calculating, aggregating, and visualizing AV performance metrics from large datasets. * **Collaborate \& Influence Cross\-Functionally:** Proactively partner across systems, software, AI, controls, simulation, and validation teams to break down silos, gain cross\-functional alignment, and drive improvements in critical systems like Perception, Prediction, and Planning. * **Ensure Exceptional Data Quality \& Reliability:** Hold yourself and the team accountable to a high bar for quality and reliability. Identify major areas of the codebase that need attention, anticipate impacts to system reliability, and lead solutions to ensure the accuracy and integrity of data used for performance evaluation. * **Document and Share Knowledge:** Create clear documentation for metrics and analysis tools, and share best practices with the engineering team. * **Advance Technical Expertise:** Proactively evaluate and integrate new technologies and methodologies relevant to autonomous vehicles and software engineering. * **Provide Technical Thought Leadership \& Mentorship:** Act as a role model and mentor to Senior Engineers and team members. Create comprehensive documentation, lead design and architectural reviews, and share knowledge through internal tech talks to elevate Motional's engineering culture. **What We're Looking For:** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience and a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field; a Master's degree is a plus. * Expert\-level proficiency in Python and a strong understanding of modern software development principles and best practices. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, particularly in the context of complex system performance evaluation and data analysis. * Proficient with Git and standard version control workflows. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts and results to diverse audiences (engineers, product managers, leadership). * Proven ability to work both independently and effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team. * Strong attention to detail and a commitment to data quality, accuracy, and rigorous testing. * Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, agile, continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) environment. **Bonus Points (not required):** * Experience working in software development of autonomous vehicles, or robotics * Experience in perception, prediction, planning, or controls * Experience with Python data analysis \& visualization tools (e.g., Pandas, matplotlib, seaborn Jupyter notebooks. )for early data analysis \& validation * Knowledge of statistical analysis and machine learning techniques relevant to performance evaluation. **Success Metrics:** * Drive quarterly and multi\-quarter success for team goals. * Successful design and implementation of key autonomous vehicle performance metrics. * Improvement in the efficiency and effectiveness of AV performance evaluation processes. * Timely and accurate delivery of data and insights to AV development teams. * Contribution to the overall advancement and safety of our autonomous vehicle technology. **Physical Demands:** While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit, talk, or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand and at times for long periods; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and move up to 50 pounds. **Travel Requirements (greater than 20%)**: Expected to travel for 1\-2 weeks each quarter visiting all of our testing sites \- mostly to LV, but also domestically as needed for the business. **Working Environment:** The work environment characteristics described here represent those a team member encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The team member is regularly exposed to mechanical and computer parts. The team member is occasionally exposed to fumes and/or airborne particlesThe noise level in the environment is low to moderate. *Motional AD LLC is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and we welcome all qualified applicants. All applicants will receive impartial consideration without regard to race, sex, color, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic data, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation or other legally protected status. Motional AD LLC is a Drug\-free workplace.* \#LI\-KS1 **Motional is a driverless technology company making autonomous vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. We're driven by something more.** **Our journey is always people first.** We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places to live, work, and connect. Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move. **Higher purpose, greater impact.** We're creating first\-of\-its\-kind technology that will transform transportation. To do so successfully, we must design for everyone in our cities and on our roads. We believe in building a great place to work through a progressive, global culture that is diverse, inclusive, and ensures people feel valued at every level of the organization. Diversity helps us to see the world differently; it's not only good for our business, it's the right thing to do. **Scale up, not starting up.** Our team is behind some of the industry's largest leaps forward, including the first fully\-autonomous cross\-country drive in the U.S, the launch of the world's first robotaxi pilot, and operation of the world's longest\-standing public robotaxi fleet. We're driven to scale; we're moving towards commercialization of our technology, and we need team members who are ready to embrace change and challenges. Formed as a joint venture between Hyundai Motor Group and Aptiv, Motional is fundamentally changing how people move through their lives. Headquartered in Boston, Motional has operations in the U.S and Asia. For more information, visit www.Motional.com and follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube. *Motional AD Inc. is an EOE. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. To comply with Federal Law, we participate in E\-Verify. All newly\-hired employees are queried through this electronic system established by the DHS and the SSA to verify their identity and employment eligibility.*

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: **Who we are:** Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks. Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector. Visit gomotive.com to learn more. ### **About the Role:** As a Mechanical Engineer at Motive, you will lead mechanical design and development for automotive\-grade connected\-device products, with a focus on connector and ruggedized waterproofing design. You will help drive NPI from early requirements and concepts through detailed design, validation, manufacturing readiness, and production ramp. You will solve technical challenges, develop prototypes and test solutions, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver products that meet product objectives and provide an exceptional customer experience. You will bring hands\-on mechanical engineering expertise, creative problem\-solving, systems\-integration experience, and a strong understanding of mechanical systems, design processes, tooling, and materials. You will work iteratively, adapt designs as requirements evolve, and support multiple projects across the product lifecycle. ### **What You'll Do:** * Lead mechanical design and NPI execution for automotive\-grade connected\-device products, translating product requirements and field\-use conditions into design inputs, milestones, validation plans, and production\-ready hardware. * Deliver detailed part and system design, CAD models, drawings, and design documentation from initial concept through mass production. * Own connector and waterproofing design from concept through production, including automotive\-grade connector selection or customization, terminals, retention features, cable exits, overmolds, gaskets, O\-rings, vent membranes, connector caps, and ruggedized enclosure interfaces. * Develop cable harnesses and interconnects, including wire and terminal selection, crimp requirements,material and gold plating spec, shielding, grounding, bend\-radius control, strain relief, routing, retention, and supplier manufacturing requirements. * Apply technical expertise to resolve design issues; lead failure analysis and validate corrective actions during development and for production or field failures, including connector, harness, sealing, and structural failures. * Lead mechanical design discussions with internal and external cross\-functional teams—including industrial design, EE, RF, antenna, camera, audio, manufacturing, quality, and suppliers—to make effective tradeoffs across performance, reliability, cost, and schedule. * Manage mechanical design schedules, supplier milestones, technical risks, and issue resolution; provide hands\-on support during NPI builds at manufacturing partner sites. * Travel as needed to offshore factories to support NPI builds and production readiness, and to customer sites to investigate critical field issues and lead failure analysis (FA). * Conduct design reviews, research materials and mechanical systems, and communicate project status and technical decisions to leadership as needed. * Support design for manufacturability and process validation for injection\-molded plastics, sheet metal, die casting, machining, and relevant joining or sealing processes. * Create and review 2D drawings with GD\&T, datum schemes, CTF dimensions, material and finish callouts, and inspection requirements. Perform tolerance stack analysis and collaborate with manufacturing/process engineering and supplier quality on CPK, FAI, SPC, and process capability. ### **What We're Looking For:** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field. * Experience designing waterproof enclosures and connector interfaces for harsh environments, including sealing strategies such as gaskets, O\-rings, overmolds, and cable exits, and validating designs to IP67/IP69K requirements. * Familiarity with USCAR, SAE, ISO 16750, IEC 60529, IEC 60068, or OEM\-specific requirements. * 8\+ years of experience in automotive product and mounting design, including hands\-on mechanical product development and NPI. * 8\+ years of experience in product validation, including shock/drop, cycle, vibration, and environmental testing. * 8\+ years of 3D CAD experience; proficiency in Creo/Pro/ENGINEER or comparable mechanical CAD, with the ability to create production\-ready 3D models and detailed 2D drawings. * Strong working knowledge of GD\&T, tolerance stack analysis, and mechanical design documentation; able to apply worst\-case and statistical tolerance methods appropriately. * Experience with thermal and structural analysis or simulation, and the ability to interpret results and apply them to design decisions. * Knowledge of FMEA, tooling and material/process validation, including SPC, Cp, and Cpk; experience defining CTF dimensions and supporting FAI and supplier process capability. * Strong mechanical design\-for\-manufacturing experience with injection\-molded plastics and tooling; working knowledge of sheet metal, die casting, machining, and related supplier processes. * Analytical problem\-solving skills, including experience with 8D, Six Sigma, DOE, or similar methods. * Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across global, cross\-functional teams. * Ability and willingness to travel internationally to offshore manufacturing sites for NPI support and to customer sites for critical field issue investigation. *Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is one of Motive's core values. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.* *Please review our Candidate Privacy Notice* *here**.* *UK Candidate Privacy Notice* *here**.* *The applicant must be authorized to receive and access those commodities and technologies controlled under U.S. Export Administration Regulations.* *It is Motive's policy to require that employees be authorized to receive access to Motive products and technology.* *Regarding US\-based roles, depending on your role and primary work location, Motive Technologies, Inc. ("Employer") discloses candidates may be required to execute a non\-compete covenant with the Employer. This requirement does not apply to lawyers, interns, or employees working in CA, MN, MT, ND, OK, or where otherwise prohibited by law.* *Non\-compete covenant terms in all other jurisdictions will be subject to the applicable statutory requirements, including but not limited to, procedures, industry related prohibitions, or salary and compensation thresholds.* *All job postings are for existing vacancies. Please note; some interviews or new\-hire training sessions may be held in person at one of our global offices.*

jobs.title: Project Coordinator, Control Systems

If you thrive in a fast\-paced engineering environment, enjoy keeping projects organized, and are eager to grow professionally while collaborating with cross\-functional teams, we'd love to hear from you. **What You'll Do** ------------------ As the Project Coordinator – Control Systems, you'll provide the coordination and administrative support that keeps technical projects moving forward. preferred. * 2–5 years of project coordination, engineering project support, automation, controls, or related technical project experience. * Experience supporting control systems, automation, workflows. * Experience supporting vendor coordination and project financial tracking. * Knowledge of document control systems and technical drawing management. * Experience with continuous improvement initiatives and workflow optimization. * Problem\-solving mindset with the ability to identify issues and help develop practical solutions. * Proactive follow\-up and ownership, with the ability to anticipate project needs, track outstanding items, and ensure tasks are completed. * Ability to read and interpret quotes, purchase orders, and basic technical documents. * Experience using an ERP system preferred. **Why Join MSHS Pacific Power Group?** -------------------------------------- At MSHS Pacific Power Group, you'll join a team that delivers innovative power generation, across supported facilities. * Develop corrective and preventive maintenance recommendations based on M\&D findings. * Support outage planning by identifying equipment concerns, inspection identified issues. * Maintain clear documentation of findings, recommendations, plant responses, and case resolution. **Reporting \& Customer Support** * Prepare regular M\&D reports summarizing open instrumentation\-out\-of\-service reports and identify instrumentation issues affecting monitoring or diagnostic capabilities. * Prepare outage equipment worklist recommendations based on identified equipment conditions. * Support customer discussions regarding equipment health, performance, and M\&D findings. **M\&D System Development \& Plant Onboarding** * Support onboarding new plants into NAES Monitoring \& Diagnostics services. * Review historian data availability, tag quality, instrumentation, and equipment configuration. * Assist with development and validation of equipment models compressors, heat exchangers, cooling systems, and balance\-of\-plant equipment. + Experience with data integration and system onboarding * **Preferred Experience:** Experience with plant historians environment + Willing to travel periodically to support site onboarding and ROC development. **Physical Requirements and Working Conditions** * Primarily office\-based role within a control room / operations center environment * Occasional travel to plant sites and NAES offices * Extended periods of sitting, computer use, and monitoring multiple screens. **NAES Safe** Safety is a core value of jobs.title: Flight Software Engineer I
jobs.description: **Job Details** =============== New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL. Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus\-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence. **Responsibilities:** If you are passionate about spacecraft design, we invite you to join the **Flight Software \& Systems Engineering Section**. We provide flight software and systems engineering for the design and implementation of spacecraft for the laboratory's key flight projects. Our work spans spacecraft systems engineering, flight software, fault protection and autonomy design, and landing systems design. The **Instrument Flight Software Group** is the lab\-wide leader in embedded real\-time software systems definition and implementation, responsible for the design, development, testing and delivery of embedded flight software for instruments needed by JPL/NASA to enable missions in astrophysics, and planetary, Earth and remote sensing experiments and observations with highly complex or specialized operations and science requirements. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, AI Safety Evaluations
jobs.description: NVIDIA has helped redefine what computers can do. Now, generative AI is opening new possibilities for how people learn, create, and tackle problems. Realizing that potential means answering some of the hardest questions in AI: Where do models fall short? Which risks are we missing? How do we know our safeguards are working? As an expert in machine learning for Evaluations, you’ll help establish the evidence that guides the next generation of safer AI. Your curiosity and scientific judgment can shape what we test, what we learn, and what we build next. We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer / AI Researcher / Data Scientist to join our AI Safety and Responsibility efforts within Enterprise Risk Management. Engaging directly in engineering tasks, you will apply your data science and statistics skills. You will turn open research questions into rigorous benchmarks, inventive experiments, and tools that reveal how multimodal large language models behave under pressure. Working with researchers and platform engineers, you’ll connect those discoveries to better training methods and safeguards, with reproducible results that inform technical reviews and executive decisions. If you love asking the question no one has thought to test, and building a convincing way to answer it, come help us define what progress in AI safety looks like. **What You Will Be Doing:** * Safety Benchmarking: Design and maintain safety benchmarks for large language and multimodal models, translating risk scenarios into test cases, datasets, and scoring rubrics. * Evaluation Methodology: Define metrics and protocols that assess safety alongside model usefulness, using baselines, uncertainty estimates, and failure analysis to distinguish meaningful improvements from noise. * Reproducible Evaluation: Build reusable Python pipelines with versioned datasets, model configurations, and experiment tracking to reproduce results and compare performance across model releases. * Automated Red\-Teaming: Develop tools to discover failure modes and expand evaluation coverage, incorporating human review to validate automated scoring and provide additional judgment. * Failure Analysis: Investigate model failures with researchers, document actionable findings, and develop regression tests to assess whether model changes resolve identified issues. Results and Communication: Partner with platform engineers to store and aggregate evaluation results, and clearly communicate findings, limitations, and emerging risks to researchers and decision\-makers. * **What We Need To See:** ------------------------ * Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, with 6\+ years in the field of machine learning engineering or evaluation. * Evaluation Design: Experience developing benchmarks, metrics, and statistically sound comparisons for ML systems, including selecting baselines and interpreting uncertainty. Ability to translate ambiguous evaluation questions into testable experiments. * Engineering: Strong Python skills and experience building maintainable shared tools, data pipelines, and experiment\-tracking workflows. * Analytical Rigor: Ability to assess dataset quality, identify limitations in metrics and scoring methods, and support conclusions with reproducible evidence. Communication: Clearly explain findings and tradeoffs to researchers, engineering partners, and executives. * **Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:** ------------------------------------- * Evaluation: Experience evaluating LLMs, multimodal models, or agentic systems through adversarial testing or automated red\-teaming. * Community Contributions: Contributions to public benchmarks or evaluation frameworks. * Research Publications: A publication track record and interest in continuing to publish at top tier venues. * Human\-Aligned Evaluation: Experience validating model\-based evaluators against human judgments or designing human\-in\-the\-loop evaluation workflows. * Statistical Rigor: Strong model evaluation skills and a commitment to sound statistical practices, including confidence intervals. Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job\-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are: 184,000 USD – 287,500 USD for Level 4; and 224,000 USD – 356,500 USD for Level 5\. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 9, 2026\. This posting is for an existing vacancy. NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Autonomous Vehicles
jobs.description: Self\-driving cars need to detect the road’s course instantly, without relying on prior maps. We build an online mapping system that transforms raw sensor data into an accurate, live 3D model. This model shows lanes, boundaries, crosswalks, intersection structure, and traffic control semantics that the driving stack depends on. This is a software engineering role is central to that system. The algorithms are only as good as the software that runs them, so we need an engineer who obsesses over quality, performance, and architecture, and who can turn algorithmic ideas into safe, fast, maintainable code that runs in production vehicles on NVIDIA DRIVE Orin and Thor. The software you write will meet ASIL\-B/D requirements and ship across L2\+\+, L3, and L4 programs. You won’t be developing the algorithms from scratch, but you’ll need a strong grasp of them. You’ll work closely alongside algorithm engineers, and you need to understand what the code is doing to implement, optimize, and test it well. **What you’ll be doing:** * Build and own core online mapping software operating in the car, from architecture through implementation to deployment. * Write production C\+\+ for real\-time embedded systems, with a focus on correctness, determinism, and maintainability. * Build software architecture and frameworks that promote code reuse, clean interfaces, and long\-term maintainability across vehicle programs. * Improve performance of C\+\+ and CUDA code running on NVIDIA DRIVE Orin and Thor, employing profilers to detect and address bottlenecks and to meet real\-time budgets. * Use GPU parallelism (CUDA) to make compute\-heavy mapping components fast and efficient. * Implement and incorporate algorithmic solutions from the mapping team into the core of NVIDIA’s AV stack, collaborating with algorithm engineers to understand and improve them. * Develop according to automotive safety standards (ASIL\-B/D). Employ thorough static analysis and adhere to coding guidelines committed to safety. Reach 100% line and branch coverage through detailed unit and integration tests. * Handle real\-time system signals from vehicles operating around the world, building software that is robust to varied conditions and failure modes. Collaborate with perception, localization, planning, and infrastructure groups to incorporate online mapping into the complete AV stack across L2\+\+, L3, and L4 programs. * **What we need to see:** * BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of validated experience building robust, production\-quality software. * 3\+ years of professional C\+\+ development experience, including modern C\+\+ and a strong grasp of memory management, concurrency, and performance. * Experience designing software architecture and APIs for large, long\-lived codebases. * A quality\-first mentality: comfortable with static analysis, unit testing, and high\-coverage test strategies. * Solid understanding of algorithms and data structures, and the ability to work with algorithm developers and understand their work. * Strong communication and analytical skills, and the ability to work optimally across multiple teams. Autonomous and responsible, demonstrating outstanding teamwork while enjoying solving hard problems. * **Ways to stand out from the crowd:** * Software development on embedded, real\-time, or automotive platforms, including experience with real\-time operating systems (e.g., QNX, Linux RT). * Experience with functional safety standards and processes (ISO 26262, ASIL\-B/D), MISRA or AUTOSAR C\+\+ coding guidelines, and safety\-qualified toolchains. * Experience achieving high or full structural coverage (line and branch, ideally MC/DC) on production code. * Experience with GPGPU programming (CUDA) and GPU performance tuning. Strong skills in runtime profiling and optimization of CPU and GPU code. * \#AutonomousVehicles Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job\-related factors. jobs.description: Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart The Opportunity Are you passionate about open\-source technologies and solving deeply complex distributed systems challenges? Joining our Acropolis Hypervisor (AHV) team at Nutanix as a Software Engineer 2 offers the exciting opportunity to contribute directly to the development of an enterprise\-grade hypervisor. In this role, you will work with cutting\-edge kernel\-level technologies to drive the foundation of our cloud infrastructure, pushing for improved reliability, performance, and security across the stack while making a highly visible impact on the core software solutions that our enterprise customers rely on daily. About the Team At Nutanix, you will be a vital part of the Acropolis Hypervisor (AHV) team, a highly specialized group of systems engineers dispersed across the US and APAC regions. AHV is the enterprise\-grade hypervisor powering the core of the Nutanix Cloud infrastructure. Our culture is deeply collaborative, proactive, and technically rigorous, where open communication, peer mentorship, and cross\-functional teamwork are highly valued. The mission of this team is to ensure the seamless operation and evolution of the AHV software stack to effectively support our broader architectural objectives and deliver exceptional reliability. You will report directly to the Sr. Engineering Manager of the AHV team, a leader who strongly encourages a collaborative and communicative work environment. The manager focuses on aligning the team's technical goals with your individual career aspirations, emphasizing prompt responses, hands\-on mentorship, and active engagement from all team members to ensure you have the support needed to tackle complex kernel\-level challenges. This role does not require any travel, allowing you to maintain a steady routine and focus deeply on your systems engineering work in a collaborative local office setting without the disruption of mandatory travel commitments. Your Role* Contribute directly to the core development of Nutanix's Acropolis Hypervisor (AHV). * Design, develop, and deploy new AHV features using C, Golang, Rust, and Python. * Troubleshoot, maintain, and resolve complex issues in existing AHV codebase and features. * Drive continuous improvements in the reliability, performance, and security of the hypervisor. * Engage and interact with open\-source communities to align with broader kernel developments. What You Will Bring* 1\+ years of experience with a BS/MS in Computer Science or a related technical field. * Strong proficiency in C/Golang/Rust, and Python programming languages. * Deep knowledge of OS internals, particularly UNIX/Linux. * Familiarity with x86 architecture, virtualization, storage, and network management. * Experience developing software for Unix/Linux/BSD operating systems at the kernel level. * Strong debugging skills in Linux kernel modules, multi\-threading, algorithms, and data structures. Learn More About the Technology: https://www.nutanixbible.com/ Work Arrangement This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in\-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Vancouver, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in\-office resources. jobs.title: Packaging Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description – Packaging Engineer** **Job Summary:** The Packaging Engineer is responsible for developing, improving, and supporting packaging systems, materials, equipment, and processes used in the manufacture of packaged lubricant products. This role focuses on ensuring safe, efficient, cost\-effective, and high\-quality packaging operations for bottled, cased, pail, drum, and tote products while supporting continuous improvement, capital projects, new product launches, and operational excellence. The Packaging Engineer works cross\-functionally with Operations, Maintenance, Supply Chain, Quality, Procurement, Marketing, and Sales to optimize packaging performance, reduce costs, improve equipment reliability, and ensure customer requirements are consistently met. **Duties/Responsibilities:** * Develop and maintain packaging specifications for bottles, caps, labels, cartons, dividers, shrink film, pallets, stretch wrap, and related packaging materials. * Maintain packaging standards and engineering documentation. * Support new product introductions by designing packaging configurations that meet customer, regulatory, and operational requirements. * Evaluate new packaging technologies and materials to improve product protection, sustainability, manufacturing efficiency, or cost savings. * Ensure packaging designs are compatible with existing production equipment whenever practical. * Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on reducing downtime, scrap, changeover time, and labor requirements. * Perform root cause analysis on packaging defects and recurring production issues. * Support development of standardized operating methods for packaging processes/equipment. * Assist Maintenance with troubleshooting chronic equipment issues. * Recommend equipment upgrades to improve reliability and productivity. * Develop equipment specifications for new packaging systems. * Lead packaging\-related capital projects from concept through startup. * Develop project scopes, budgets, timelines, and ROI analyses. * Coordinate equipment vendors, contractors, and internal resources. * Manage Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and Site Acceptance Tests (SAT). * Ensure projects are completed safely, on schedule, and within budget. * Provide technical guidance during new equipment installations. * Work closely with Procurement to qualify new packaging suppliers. * Investigate packaging failures and supplier quality issues. * Support compliance with OSHA, EPA, DOT, and applicable industry regulations. * Assist Quality in investigating customer complaints related to packaging. * Participate in Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), risk assessments, and corrective actions. * Participate in plant continuous improvement teams. * Perform other duties and responsibilities assigned. **Required Skills:** * Strong knowledge of automated packaging systems, packaging equipment, and manufacturing processes used in high\-volume production environments. * Working knowledge of packaging materials, including plastic containers, closures, labels, corrugated packaging, stretch wrap, and palletization systems. * Experience leading engineering projects, including capital equipment specification, installation, commissioning, and startup. * Strong mechanical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot packaging equipment and manufacturing processes. * Working knowledge of automated control systems and packaging line integration, including familiarity with PLC\-controlled equipment. * Experience developing equipment specifications, standard operating procedures, engineering documentation, and technical reports. * Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects while meeting deadlines in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment. * Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to make sound engineering decisions. * Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to effectively collaborate across Operations, Maintenance, Quality, Supply Chain, Procurement, and external vendors. * Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications; experience with AutoCAD, SolidWorks, project management software, and ERP systems (IFS Cloud preferred) is highly desirable. * Thorough understanding of industrial safety principles, OSHA regulations, machine guarding, and risk assessment practices. * Demonstrated ability to identify opportunities for process improvement through Lean Manufacturing, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement methodologies. **Education and Experience:** * Bachelor's degree in Packaging Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or related engineering discipline. * Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or higher * 3\+ years of engineering experience in a manufacturing environment. * Experience with automated packaging equipment * Demonstrated success leading capital projects from concept through implementation. * Experience in lubricants, chemicals, food \& beverage, consumer packaged goods (CPG), or related process manufacturing preferred. * Experience with high\-speed bottling, packaging operations. palletizing and warehouse automation preferred. **Physical Requirements:** * Ability to work in both office and manufacturing plant environments. * Ability to walk throughout production facilities and climb stairs, ladders, and platforms as needed. * Required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) such as safety glasses, steel\-toe boots, or hearing protection when in manufacturing or production areas. * Ability to occasionally lift up to 25 pounds. * Ability to work around industrial machinery, noise, heat, and varying environmental conditions. * Occasional travel (\<15%) to suppliers, equipment manufacturers, and company facilities.

If you do your best work when you're trusted to take ownership, you might belong here. **The Best Developers of Tomorrow Won't Just Write Code** AI is changing software development at an extraordinary pace. We believe the value of manually writing code will continue to decline as AI becomes increasingly capable. The most valuable developers won't necessarily be those who type the fastest. They'll be the ones who think the best. The people who can: * Identify opportunities others overlook. * Invent better architectures and solutions. * Direct AI agents to execute complex work. * Critically evaluate, challenge, and improve AI\-generated code. * Refactor systems for simplicity, performance, and reliability. * Make exceptional technical and product decisions. * Turn ambitious ideas into working products. We aren't looking for developers who compete with AI at writing code. We're looking for developers who can make AI extraordinarily productive. Your judgment, creativity, initiative, and ability to solve problems matter more to us than how many lines of code you personally write. **Seven Days a Week. Because the Opportunity Won't Wait.** We're not going to pretend this is a conventional nine\-to\-five opportunity. We're building at an extraordinary pace. Our founders and team members are making enormous personal sacrifices because we believe in what we're creating. We're looking for people who share that intensity: people willing to work seven days a week during critical periods because they genuinely want to move the mission forward, not because someone is watching them. We value ownership, initiative, and extraordinary output, not performative hours. No surveillance. No micromanagement. No corporate theater. We want people who choose to give their best because they believe the opportunity is worth it. Sustainable performance, necessary rest, and applicable employment requirements still matter. But if your primary goal is a predictable, low\-intensity job, this probably isn't the right opportunity. **But There's a Catch** We're asking candidates to make a short\-term sacrifice. Our selection process includes a demanding 30\-day evaluation, with compensation terms agreed in advance and structured to comply with applicable employment laws. * There are no guaranteed job offers. * No promises that we'll become a billion\-dollar company. * No certainty that the next 30 days will lead to a permanent position. But if you demonstrate exceptional ability, contribute meaningful value, and earn a place on our team, we're prepared to offer a healthy six\-figure annual salary, equity of up to 0\.5%, and competitive benefits. We're not asking you to tell us you're exceptional. We're asking you to show us. **Who We're Looking For** We're not particularly interested in your university, certifications, or how impressive your résumé looks. We care about what you can accomplish. We want developers who: * Think independently and act without waiting for permission. * Constantly generate ideas for improving products and systems. * Understand how to leverage AI to multiply their productivity. * Have exceptional technical judgment and problem\-solving ability. * Challenge bad decisions, including ours. * Take responsibility for outcomes, not just assigned tasks. * Build quickly, intelligently, and with high standards. * Are ambitious enough to want ownership in what they create. We don't need another employee who waits for instructions. We need another entrepreneur who happens to be an exceptional developer. **One Final Question** Most developers will spend their careers working on someone else's vision. Some will help build companies worth billions. A much smaller number will have the opportunity to own a meaningful piece of what they helped create. We're six people. We're profitable. We're ambitious. And we're convinced that AI is creating one of the greatest opportunities in the history of technology. We might succeed spectacularly. We might fall short. But we're going to find out. And we're looking for a few extraordinary people who want to find out with us. Are you one of them? **How to Apply** Send us your résumé and a short introduction. Tell us: * **What have you built?** Show us your most impressive work. * **What would you improve?** Tell us about an idea, system, or product you've made significantly better. * **Why are you exceptional?** What makes you confident you belong among the top 1% of developers? * **Why this opportunity?** What excites you about building an AI company with extraordinary ambitions? Include your GitHub, portfolio, or examples of your work. No lengthy cover letters. No corporate nonsense. We don't care how good you are at applying for jobs. We care how good you are at building the future. **ARE YOU THE 1%?** Billion\-Dollar AI Ambitions. No Guarantees. Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Work Location: Hybrid remote in Windermere, FL 34786

file deliveries. * Build and manage GCP data infrastructure that meet business requirements for performance, scalability, availability, and security. * Integrate data across on\-premises and cloud optimizing SQL and pipeline performance, and managing cloud resource costs. * Collaborate with business, product, analytics, and leadership teams to translate requirements into practical data solutions and resolve technical issues. * Enable analysis of key business metrics, including operational efficiency and customer acquisition. * Develop and operationalize machine learning models for internal process improvements and redesign infrastructure for greater scalability, optimized data delivery, and automating manual processes. * You build infrastructure required for optimal extraction, transformation and loading of data from various data sources using Google and SQL technologies. * You build analytical tools utilizing data pipelines to, provide actionable insight into key business performance metrics, operational efficiency and customer acquisition. * You work with stakeholders including Executive, Product, Data and Design teams supporting data infrastructure needs and assist
