jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), Cyber - NYC
jobs.description: Forward Deployed Engineering \- New York City and San Francisco **About the team** OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team builds with customers to bring frontier AI into production. Our Cyber FDEs partner with the security and engineering teams that defend globally critical systems, from enterprise software to the core infrastructure it runs on. Cyber FDEs work closely with our Product, Research, and Go\-to\-Market teams to adapt our products and models to what customers need to defend their systems. **About the role** You’ll build systems that give defenders an advantage at a scale few engineering teams encounter. You might help an enterprise identify, test, and deploy patches across hundreds of thousands of code repositories, or help a security team analyze petabytes of logs for signs of malicious agents or coordinated attacks. Across these deployments, you’ll build tools that customer engineers can trust to support consequential security decisions. You’ll work directly with customer security teams, from CISOs to frontline analysts. As AI changes how attackers operate, you’ll help these teams determine where their defenses need to evolve, prioritize what to build, and validate solutions with the engineers who will operate them. Alongside OpenAI’s account teams, you’ll translate security priorities into deployed systems that help defenders cover more ground. You’ll also help shape what OpenAI builds next. When you identify a gap between what defenders need and what today’s models or products can do, you’ll partner with Research and Product to define, build, and test capabilities that address it. This role is based in New York. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 50% is required. **In this role you will:** * Partner with customer security leaders and OpenAI’s Go\-to\-Market team to scope engagements, establish responsibilities, and define measurable success criteria. * Lead technical design and implementation alongside customer engineers. Integrate agents into security workflows, establish access boundaries, and determine which actions require human review. * Build evaluations grounded in the decisions defenders make. For a patching agent, test whether a fix blocks a known exploit while preserving expected application behavior. For a detection system, replay historical attacks alongside normal traffic to measure detection speed and false\-positive rates. * Guide production rollout with the engineers who will operate the system. Provide the observability and controls they need to understand system behavior, intervene when necessary, and expand adoption with confidence. * Translate successful approaches across deployments into reusable tools and engineering practices that other defenders can adopt. **You might thrive in this role if you:** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, including building and shipping production software. * Experience protecting production systems through work in security engineering, infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or product engineering. * Experience building and evaluating AI agents for software engineering workflows. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines and practices that maintain code quality, reliability, and security. * Ability to navigate unfamiliar codebases and contribute maintainable, production\-quality changes. * Ability to communicate technical concepts and trade\-offs to engineering teams and senior security stakeholders. **Additional experience** Cybersecurity spans many disciplines, and while we’re primarily looking for strong engineering generalists, we’d love to hear about deeper experience in any of the following areas: * **Security curiosity and experimentation:** You read CVE write\-ups because you want to understand how things break. You may have built an agent honeypot to test a hypothesis—or prove a point—and enjoy turning a security question into a hands\-on experiment. * **Security community engagement:** You enjoy exchanging ideas with defenders, whether that’s discussing security strategy with a CISO at Black Hat or comparing technical approaches with frontline practitioners. * **Application security:** You’ve written CodeQL queries or Semgrep rules, built fuzzing harnesses, or discovered and responsibly disclosed vulnerabilities. * **Automated remediation:** CI/CD is your happy place. You’ve built tooling that turns security findings into tested patches, dependency upgrades, or configuration changes across large codebases. * **Detection engineering:** You’ve written and deployed detections using Sigma, YARA, Splunk, or KQL and tested them against attacker behavior. * **Cloud and identity security:** You’ve designed cloud IAM architectures and investigated abuse of workload identities, role hierarchies, or cross\-account trust. * **Security research:** You’ve reverse\-engineered malware, developed exploit reproductions, or contributed to vulnerability research. * **Agent security:** You’ve tested agents for prompt injection, tool misuse, or credential exposure and built defenses against them. **About OpenAI** OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general\-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employeration, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable lawation technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non\-compliant. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology. **Compensation** $185K – $300K \+ Offers Equity The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factorsance\-related bonus(es) for eligible employees, and the following benefits. * Medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family, with employer contributions to Health Savings Accounts * Pre\-tax accounts for Health FSA, Dependent Care FSA, and commuter expenses (parking and transit) * 401(k) retirement plan with employer match * Paid parental leave (up to 24 weeks for birth parents and 20 weeks for non\-birthing parents), plus paid medical and caregiver leave (up to 8 weeks) * Paid time off: flexible PTO for exempt employees and up to 15 days annually for non\-exempt employees * 13\+ paid company holidays, and multiple paid coordinated company office closures throughout the year for focus and recharge, plus paid sick or safe time (1 hour per 30 hours worked, or more, as required by applicable state or local law) * Mental health and wellness support * Employer\-paid basic life and disability coverage * Annual learning and development stipend to fuel your professional growth * Daily meals in our offices, and meal delivery credits as eligible * Relocation support for eligible employees * Additional taxable fringe benefits, such as charitable donation matching and wellness stipends, may also be provided. More details about our benefits are available to candidates during the hiring process. This role is at\-will and OpenAI reserves the right to modify base pay and other compensation components at any time based on individual performance, team or company results, or market conditions.

jobs.title: Lead Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Mentors teams and leads the architecture of highly scalable, interdependent distributed systems. Identifies and removes performance/scalability bottlenecks for hyper‑scale workloads; defines scalability requirements with stakeholders; and designs elastic, high‑impact systems while advancing innovation in data plane platforms. Engineers and oversees fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable designs; optimizes resilience mechanisms ; and sets SLO‑aligned durability and availability standards across dependent services. Establishes KPIs and advanced telemetry; applies formal verification for complex features; and develops robust replication/synchronization strategies. Advises and leads resolution of complex production issues, sets operational readiness and SOP standards, and directs incident response and RCAs. Architects advanced security controls, drives remediation and compliance, and delivers enterprise‑level automation (IaC) and change strategies enabling safe, automated patching, updates, and rollbacks. Key Responsibilities System Design \& Architecture \- System Scalability: –Mentor the team in the architecture and design of highly scalable, interdependent distributed systems, ensuring horizontal and vertical scalability and overall performance, including leveraging distributed state management tools. –Lead the identification of performance and scalability bottlenecks and recommend solutions to optimize code and/or systems for large\-scale data processing and high\-throughput requirements to improve performance for hyper\-scale systems. –Lead collaboration with stakeholders to define system scalability requirements, ensuring the defined requirements meet customer expectations. –Leverage deep expertise to design high\-impact, interdependent systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down). –Drive innovation in the use of data plane platforms. –Evaluate whether systems are meeting nonfunctional scalability requirements, and proactively anticipate growing business needs within the business unit. System Design \& Architecture \- System Reliability Design: –Design and oversee the implementation of fault\-tolerant, interdependent systems capable of withstanding in\-service updates by implementing sophisticated redundancy, replication, and automatic failover capabilities. –Lead the design and implementation of systems that effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance. –Guide the optimization of advanced mechanisms to handle network unreliability, including load\-shedding, throttling, and rate\-limiting. –Design interdependent systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), driving standards for availability and durability of other computing services within the organization System Design \& Architecture \- System Reliability Performance: –Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify risks, gaps, or cyclical dependencies in running, interdependent systems. –Drive the creation and customization of highly complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms, proactively ensuring system health and reliability. System Design \& Architecture \- Correctness / Availability: –Maintain expertise in industry standards for verifying correctness and apply existing techniques to interdependent systems. –Formally verify complex features (e.g., via TLA\+) to ensure system design correctness for various interdependent systems. –Develop advanced strategies for data replication and synchronization, ensuring robust data integrity and availability Operational Troubleshooting \& Incident Management: –Advise on efforts to diagnose, debug, and resolve complex issues in active, interdependent systems to support ongoing operation. –Develop and implement comprehensive strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. –Maintain expertise in dependencies, dependents, and owned systems to drive effective troubleshooting and performance. –Set standards for operational readiness and standard operating procedures within the department, and hold third\-party partners accountable for meeting those standards. –Oversee operational support rotations, providing expert guidance in incident response and leading root cause investigations to prevent future occurrences. Compliance \& Security: –Architect advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi\-tenant environments, and lead initiatives to enhance data and application protection. –Guide the execution of comprehensive remediation plans to address identified security vulnerabilities. –Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations, and guide documentation efforts across projects. Automation \& Change Management: –Develop enterprise\-level automation tools and strategies (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) and oversee their implementation. –Drive alignment of change management plans and organizational initiatives for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and design interdependent systems to allow for automation of these processes. Problem Solving: –Leads specialized, advanced problem\-solving efforts, serving as an escalation point for complex issues. Guides others to leverage innovative data\-driven techniques to address ambiguous or novel issues, identify root causes, and drives the implementation of solutions that prevent future issues. Continuous Improvement: –Develops innovative solutions and drives the implementation of ideas that increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across the organization. Evaluates effectiveness of updated approaches and methods for continued improvement to enhance efficiencies and ensure changes align with organizational goals. Designs and develops metrics to measure success of improvement initiatives.

jobs.title: Senior Platform Software Engineer
jobs.description: Job Description At **Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)** , we are building the next generation of cloud services for autonomous and intelligent robotics. The **OCI Robotics Cloud** team is developing a secure, scalable, cloud\-native robotics platform that enables customers to onboard, manage, monitor, and operate heterogeneous robot fleets across industries. Our platform provides cloud services for **robot registration and identity, fleet and mission management, telemetry and observability, digital twins, simulation, software lifecycle management, and AI\-powered robotic applications** . A key focus of the team is an **AI\-assisted, spec\-driven robot onboarding platform** designed to simplify how robots from different vendors connect to cloud services. Through standardized service contracts, edge specifications, reusable adapters, SDKs, and AI\-assisted developer tools, we are turning robot integration into a repeatable software engineering workflow. We are also developing capabilities that connect **robot simulation, operational data, AI models, and continuous learning** , enabling developers to build, evaluate, deploy, and improve intelligent robotic applications using both simulated and real\-world environments. Our vision is to make **robot onboarding as simple and repeatable as cloud onboarding** while building the cloud foundation for increasingly intelligent robotic systems. As a **Senior Platform Software Engineer** , you will own the design and implementation of production cloud services and robotics platform components. You will translate product and technical requirements into high\-quality software and work closely with engineers across cloud infrastructure, AI, and robotics to deliver capabilities from design through production. If you enjoy building distributed systems and want to apply those skills to **AI\-native intelligent robotics** , we’d love to hear from you. Responsibilities * Own the **design and implementation** of production Robotics Cloud services and platform components. Design, implement, test, deploy, and operate cloud\-native services supporting robot onboarding and identity, fleet management, mission orchestration, telemetry, digital twins, simulation, and software lifecycle management. * Build scalable backend services and APIs using modern distributed systems and microservice architectures. * Develop secure APIs, SDKs, service contracts, and edge integration components for heterogeneous robots. * * Contribute to **AI\-assisted, spec\-driven robot onboarding** , including integration specifications, adapters, SDK generation, validation, and developer workflows. Build integrations with robotics frameworks, simulation environments, autonomous systems, AI models, and edge devices. * * Develop components that connect **simulation, robot telemetry, AI evaluation, and deployment workflows** . * Contribute to platform capabilities supporting **VLM/VLA, multimodal, embodied AI, and agentic robotics applications** . Improve service reliability, scalability, observability, security, and performance. * Write high\-quality, maintainable, and well\-tested production code. * Participate in technical design discussions, code reviews, debugging, testing, and production operations. * Collaborate with engineers across robotics, AI, cloud infrastructure, security, and product teams. * * Use an **AI\-native engineering process** throughout design, implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation to accelerate development and rapid iteration while maintaining high engineering quality. Minimum Qualifications BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Robotics, or a related technical field. * 3\+ years of software development experience building backend services, distributed systems, cloud platforms, robotics software, or related production systems. * * Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as **Python, Go, Java, or C\+\+** . Experience developing APIs, backend services, or distributed systems. * * Familiarity with cloud\-native technologies including **Kubernetes, containers, CI/CD, and container orchestration** . Experience developing reliable, maintainable, and well\-tested production software. * Ability to own the design and implementation of meaningful software components. * Strong software design, debugging, and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills. * Preferred Qualifications MS in Computer Science, Robotics, AI/ML, or a related field. * * Experience with robotics frameworks such as **ROS 2** . * Familiarity with robotics and industrial communication technologies such as **DDS, MQTT, OPC UA, VDA5050** , or similar protocols. * Experience with robot simulation environments such as **NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, Gazebo, Webots** , or similar platforms. * Experience using simulation or synthetic data for **robot development, testing, validation, evaluation, or learning** . * Exposure to **vision\-language models (VLMs), vision\-language\-action (VLA) models, multimodal foundation models, embodied AI, or agentic robotics systems** . Familiarity with AI/ML approaches for robot perception, planning, navigation, manipulation, task understanding, or control. * * Familiarity with **reinforcement learning, imitation learning, continual learning, online adaptation, or sim\-to\-real workflows** . Experience integrating robots, autonomous systems, IoT devices, or edge systems with cloud services. * Understanding of robot navigation, localization, perception, teleoperation, mission execution, fleet management, or digital twins. * Familiarity with secure robot/device identity, edge computing, OTA software deployment, workload identity, or zero\-trust architectures. * Experience developing APIs, SDKs, adapters, plugins, or developer tools. * * Demonstrated ability to **continuously learn and rapidly apply emerging technologies** , including AI\-assisted software engineering tools and workflows. Why Join Us OCI Robotics Cloud is building the **cloud and developer platform for heterogeneous intelligent robot fleets** , rather than focusing on a single robot or robotics application. You will work on production engineering problems connecting **cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, edge computing, simulation, AI, and robotics** . You’ll have the opportunity to work with emerging technologies such as VLMs, VLAs, embodied AI, and continuous\-learning systems while building the infrastructure required to operate them at enterprise scale. You’ll also work in an **AI\-native engineering environment** , using emerging AI tools and development workflows to move rapidly from ideas and specifications to production\-quality software.

The ideal candidate possesses strong technical expertise in AWS, Node.js, React, PHP, HTML, MySQL and CSS, experience with AI application development, including integrating large language models (LLMs), AI APIs, and AI\-powered features into web applications is highly preferred. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain high\-quality web applications and software solutions. * Collaborate with IT and cross\-functional teams to gather requirements, identify technical solutions, and deliver projects that align with business objectives. * Develop and maintain front\-end and back\-end applications using technologies such as Node.js, React, PHP, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. * Build, deploy, and maintain applications and services within AWS cloud environments. * Design, develop, and integrate RESTful APIs and third\-party services to support business operations. * Optimize website performance, scalability, security, and responsiveness across different devices and browsers. * Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues to ensure application stability and reliability. * Collaborate with internal stakeholders to continuously enhance website functionality, usability, and customer experience. * Maintain technical documentation, including application architecture, system integrations, and development procedures. * Research and evaluate emerging technologies, including AI\-assisted development tools, to improve software quality and development productivity. * Ensure applications follow security best practices and comply with organizational IT policies. Requirements: **Education and Experience** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field. * Minimum of 2 years of professional web development experience, including experience with full\-stack application development. * Demonstrated experience designing, developing, and maintaining complex web applications. * Strong portfolio of completed projects demonstrating technical proficiency, problem\-solving abilities, and software development expertise. **Technical Skills** * Strong proficiency in JavaScript, Node.js, React, PHP, HTML5, and CSS3\. * Hands\-on experience with AWS cloud services, application deployment, and cloud infrastructure. * Experience developing and integrating RESTful APIs and third\-party systems. * Solid understanding of relational databases, such as MySQL or PostgreSQL. * Proficiency with Git and modern version control workflows. * Knowledge of responsive web design, cross\-browser compatibility, and web accessibility standards. * Experience with application performance optimization, debugging, and troubleshooting. * Understanding of web application security principles and secure coding practices. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with eCommerce platforms, particularly Adobe Commerce (Magento). * Familiarity with cloud infrastructure management, monitoring, and performance optimization. * Experience integrating enterprise applications, including ERP, CRM, and third\-party business systems. * Knowledge of modern front\-end frameworks and component\-based architecture. * Familiarity with AI technologies, large language models (LLMs), and AI\-assisted software development tools. * Experience with automated testing, application monitoring, and DevOps practices. * Understanding of SEO best practices and website performance optimization.

jobs.title: AI Solutions Architect
jobs.description: Owens \& Minor is a global healthcare solutions company providing essential products, services and technology solutions that support care delivery in leading hospitals, health systems and research centers around the world. For over 140 years, Owens \& Minor has delivered comfort and confidence behind the scenes, so healthcare stays at the forefront, helping to make each day better for the hospitals, healthcare partners, and communities we serve. Powered by more than 14,000 teammates worldwide, Owens \& Minor exists because every day, everywhere, Life Takes Care™. **Global Reach with a Local Touch** * 140\+ years serving healthcare * Over 14,000 teammates worldwide * Serving healthcare partners in 80 countries * Manufacturing facilities in the U.S., Honduras, Mexico, Thailand and Ireland * 40\+ distribution centers * Portfolio of 300 propriety and branded product offerings * 1,000 branded medical product suppliers * 4,000 healthcare partners served **Benefits** * **Comprehensive Healthcare Plan** \- Medical, dental, and vision plans start on day one of employment for full\-time teammates. * **Educational Assistance** \- We offer educational assistance to all eligible teammates enrolled in an approved, accredited collegiate program. * **Employer\-Paid Life Insurance and Disability** \- We offer employer\-paid life insurance and disability coverage. * **Voluntary Supplemental Programs** – We offer additional options to secure your financial future including supplemental life, hospitalization, critical illness, and other insurance programs. * **Support for your Growing Family** – Adoption assistance, fertility benefits (in medical plan) and parental leave are available for teammates planning for a family. * **Health Savings Account (HSA) and 401(k)** \- We offer these voluntary financial programs to help teammates prepare for their future, as well as other voluntary benefits. * **Paid Leave** \- In addition to sick days and short\-term leave, we offer holidays, vacation days, personal days, and additional types of leave – including parental leave. * **Well\-Being** – Also included in our offering is a Teammate Assistance Program (TAP), Calm Health, Cancer Resources Services, and discount programs – all at no cost to you. * The anticipated salary range for this position is $180,000 USD Annual with potential 15% annual bonus. The actual compensation offered may vary based on job related factors such as experience, skills, education and location The AI Solutions Architect is a senior hybrid business\-and\-technology role responsible for identifying, designing, governing and scaling AI\-enabled solutions across the enterprise. The role combines business solution architecture, AI platform architecture and responsible AI governance into one accountable function. This architect partners with business leaders to identify high\-value AI opportunities and works closely with IAM, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure/Cloud, Enterprise Architecture, Data \& Analytics and Enterprise Applications teams to ensure each AI solution is feasible, secure, compliant, supportable and aligned to enterprise standards. This role is fully remote. Applicants are welcome to apply anywhere within the United States. **Role Mission** ================ * Turn Claude Enterprise and related AI capabilities into measurable business outcomes, not just platform adoption. * Create a governed intake\-to\-delivery path for AI use cases across business functions. * Translate business opportunities into practical AI designs that technical teams can implement safely. * Ensure AI solutions have proper access controls, security review, data governance, operational readiness and responsible AI oversight. * Scale repeatable AI patterns across Supply Chain, Procurement, Operations, Finance, Sales, Customer Service and IT. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **AI Business Value \& Use Case Portfolio** ------------------------------------------- * Facilitate business ideation workshops and discover high\-value AI opportunities. * Prioritize AI use cases based on business value, feasibility, adoption readiness, risk and strategic alignment. * Develop business cases, define KPIs and track value realization after deployment. * Maintain an enterprise AI use case roadmap for Claude Enterprise and related governed AI capabilities. **Business Solution Design** ---------------------------- * Translate business needs into future\-state AI\-enabled workflows, user journeys and operating\-model impacts. * Define human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, data needs, exception handling and adoption requirements. * Create solution briefs that are understandable to business stakeholders and actionable for technical teams. * Partner with product, process and functional leaders to move from experimentation to governed adoption. **Technical Architecture \& Platform Enablement** ------------------------------------------------- * Define Claude Enterprise usage patterns, solution te ches. * Support MCP integration pattern design for enterprise systems, APIs and approved data sources. * Assess integration complexity, data dependencies, technical feasibility and operational readiness. * Coordinate with Infrastructure/Cloud, Enterprise Architecture, Data Engineering and application teams to ensure designs are scalable and supportable. **Governance, Responsible AI \& Compliance** -------------------------------------------- * Prepare use cases for AI governance review and maintain required documentation. * Coordinate risk classification, policy alignment, human oversight, auditability and exception management. * Ensure business teams understand approved, restricted and prohibited AI usage patterns. * Report on adoption, value realization, risk posture and control maturity. **IAM, Cybersecurity \& Control Partnership** --------------------------------------------- * Work closely with IAM on RBAC, SSO, provisioning, access reviews and privileged access considerations. * Work closely with Cybersecurity on data protection, audit logging, vendor risk, prompt/data handling and security architecture review. * Ensure IAM and Security remain accountable for their domains while this role validates that AI solutions align with their controls. * Escalate unresolved control gaps before production deployment or scaled adoption. **Adoption, Change \& Value Realization** ----------------------------------------- * Create AI playbooks, business adoption guides, use case templates and champion enablement materials. * Track active usage, stakeholder satisfaction, productivity benefits, cycle\-time reduction and lessons learned. * Promote reuse of proven AI patterns across business functions. * Help leaders establish practical, responsible and measurable AI adoption habits. **Required Qualifications** =========================== * 8\+ years of experience across business transformation, solution architecture, enterprise applications, cloud/platform architecture, digital transformation or related roles. * Practical knowledge of GenAI platforms, Claude Enterprise, Platform, API and its usage patterns, LLM capabilities, agentic workflows and MCP\-style integration concepts. * Strong business acumen with ability to translate operating challenges into AI\-enabled outcomes, business cases and measurable KPIs. * Sufficient technical depth to lead design conversations with IAM, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Data Engineering and Enterprise Applications teams. * Working knowledge of API integration, enterprise architecture, identity/access controls, security review processes, data governance and operational readiness practices. * Strong facilitation and executive communication skills across business leaders, governance committees, architects, engineers and vendor partners. **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * Experience standing up AI governance, AI adoption programs, LLMOps or enterprise AI operating models. * Experience with Supply Chain, Procurement, Operations, Distribution, Healthcare, Finance, Sales or Customer Service use cases. * Experience creating reusable solution patterns, playbooks, adoption guides, scoring frameworks or intake processes. * Familiarity with tools and platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Snowflake, Smartsheet, API gateways or workflow automation platforms. **Required Education Qualifications** ===================================== . Masters Degree or PHD in Computer Engineering/Data Science If you feel this opportunity could be the next step in your career, we encourage you to apply. This position will accept applications on an ongoing basis. Owens \& Minor is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, genetic information, religion, disability, age, status as a veteran, or any other status prohibited by applicable national, federal, state or local law.

jobs.title: Tooling Engineer, Aerospace
jobs.description: PPG's Aerospace Business is looking for a **Tooling Engineer** to join our team onsite in Huntsville, AL! As a Tooling Engineer, you will plan, organize, and manage multiple tooling projects of varying degrees of complexity to meet the tooling needs of the plant. You will support tool\-up of new programs and work cross\-departmentally with Program Managers, Engineers, and the tool shop. This is an onsite position in Huntsville, AL and reporting to the Tooling, Facilities, and Maintenance Manager. **Key Responsibilities**: * Establish tooling requirements for programs, including cost estimates and schedules. Identify all resources (in\-house and outsourced) necessary to support tooling fulfillment and schedule attainment. * Coordinate with Project Managers, Design and Production Engineers to support all tooling aspects of ongoing/future projects and manufacturing process improvements. * Collaborate with Tooling Shop to define all aspects of tool fabrication. Ensure that all materials and documentation needed for fabrication are ready at the start of projects. * Manage the transition of legacy program documentation into digital format. Improve control and documentation methods using Solidworks PDM. * Coordinate with Sourcing and Vendors concerning outsourced jobs\- providing technical expertise as required. Manage outside vendors with on\-time and on\-budget delivery of tooling projects. * Design master, gage, and process tooling to meet all quality and product definition requirements. Generate 2D/3D CAD along with detailed drawings to ASME standards. * Explore and introduce new methods of tool design/fabrication for time, cost and quality improvements. * Implement tooling solutions to production processes that improve ergonomic function and first\-time yield. * Use additive manufacturing for rapid prototyping and streamlining of production point\-of\-use and process tooling. **Qualifications**: * Bachelor's Degree in Engineering required, Mechanical Engineering or similar technical discipline preferred. * 4\+ years of work or project experience with the design and construction of tooling fixtures for manufacturing, assembly, and testing. * Prior mechanical design experience using 2D \& 3D CAD tools required. jobs.title: Plant Optimization Engineer (Chicago, IL)
jobs.description: As a Fortune 500 company, Packaging Corporation of America (PCA) is an ideas and solutions company. Our corrugated packaging business seeks to be the leader in helping our customers — large and small — package, transport and display products of all kinds. Our white paper business delivers Paper With Purpose by providing the highest level of customer service and operational excellence. We have approximately 15,000 team members in more than 100 locations in the United States that strive to meet the local needs of our customers. Our mission is to serve the needs of our customers, today and tomorrow, with products and services that exceed expectations for performance and environmental responsibility. People • Customers • Trust PCA is currently recruiting for a Plant Optimization Engineer based at the Chicago, IL corrugated box plant facility. **Description of role:** The Plant Optimization Engineer Position (POE) is a developmental program which focuses on hiring recent college graduates with degrees in engineering (0\-2 years experience) into a rotational training experience with the goal of developing them into well\-rounded employees and future leaders at PCA. This is a full\-time, salaried position with benefits. What is PCA’s POE Program? The POE Program is a 2\-year rotational training program designed to give recent engineering graduates in depth, hands\-on technical training in the Maintenance and Production departments of a corrugated box plant, and a well\-rounded understanding of the corrugated packaging industry as a whole. In addition, POEs will complete engineering process optimization projects throughout the box plant, typically in areas of scrap reduction, throughput improvements, downtime reduction, etc., and will provide engineering support to all plant functions as needed. Upon successful completion of the program, the Plant Optimization Engineer will transition into a new full\-time role in the chosen career path either at their current plant, or another plant or paper mill that has an opening that aligns with their skills and interests. Typical career paths for those who have completed the POE Program include box plant leadership/management positions in Production or Maintenance. **Principle Accountabilities:** * Rotate through all departments at a corrugated plant, completing assigned learning objectives and technical training in each area. * Organize and implement moderate to large process improvements, problem elimination and capital/expense projects focusing on asset health and overall improved reliability. * Recommend and help drive, or implement innovative solutions to improve equipment, facility, and plant operations. * Attend and participate in POE program conferences and assigned off\-site training. * Collaborate with other Plant Optimization Engineers, the plant leadership team, and machine and maintenance operators to complete projects. * Work with the POE Mentor/manager to conceptualize a career path to follow the POE program. * Know and follow policies and procedures of the company, share information that would benefit other members of the team and find ways to improve the delivery of service to our customers. * Strive to continually strengthen PCA’s business philosophy of meeting needs and exceeding expectations for customers specifically supporting PCA’s Commitment to Service that involves doing what is right for our customers, focusing on strategies that add value and support growth, and keeping the promises that we make. **Basic Qualifications:** * A Bachelor of Science degree in engineering is required prior to starting the position. * 0\-2 years previous engineering experience, including internships and co\-ops, providing technical support in a manufacturing plant or industrial environment. * Ability to work first, second, or third shift during the production department rotation as needed. * Must be self\-driven and passionate about working in a hands\-on, manufacturing environment. * Must be able to travel as necessary and possess valid documents for travel via air and car. **Preferred Qualifications:** * A minimum of one Internship or Co\-op is preferred, especially in a manufacturing environment. * Obtaining a Bachelor of Science degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Paper Engineering, Industrial \& Systems Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or Engineering Technology is preferred. Other engineering majors will be considered depending on experience. * Experience with programs such as AutoCAD, Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook as well as experience with manufacturing systems like shop floor software, maintenance work order systems, etc. is preferred. * Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing or Statistical Process Control (SPC) experience preferred. The successful candidate MUST possess the following Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities: * Solid interpersonal skills to effectively communicate with production team and management. * Ability to learn quickly and put new knowledge into practice. * Solid verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate with individuals throughout the company on departmental procedures, policies, practices, and requests for information. * Strong listening, evaluating, and problem\-solving skills. Ability to create alternative solutions and meet deadlines. * Leadership experience or strong leadership skills with the drive to lead others. * Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to network and build relationships with individuals of various experiences and professional levels both within and outside of the company. * Previous work experience as a member of a team, or a strong understanding of the importance of open communication and information sharing between team members. COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS * Starting salary range for position: 83,000\-87,000\. * Bonus: Annual – Based upon individual contribution and overall, Company performance. * Paid Vacation: Three (3\) weeks per calendar year. The plan offers both pre\-tax and Roth contribution options along with employer provided matching contributions. * Disclaimer: The Compensation and Benefits information in this posting represents PCA’s good faith and reasonable estimate of what it may pay for this position. jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer - Data Connectors
jobs.description: **A World\-Changing Company** Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data\-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more. **The Role** The Connectivity team builds the software that connects Palantir’s platform to customer systems. Our connectors integrate databases, enterprise applications, cloud storage, web services, and streaming systems, enabling customers to bring data into Foundry and write back to their operational systems. From large datasets to real\-time events and user\-driven interactions, these connections underpin the applications and AI workflows customers build with Foundry and AIP. You’ll build and maintain Foundry’s first\-class connector suite and the shared infrastructure behind it. You’ll work across the stack, taking ownership of connector implementations, developer SDKs, and the systems that build, test, distribute, and run our connectivity software. A central part of this work is evolving and scaling a large, established codebase. You’ll move integrations from bespoke infrastructure onto shared platform capabilities, design SDKs that enable other teams and customers to build integrations independently, and safely retire older implementations. You’ll also build observability and diagnostic tools that help users understand, monitor, and troubleshoot their connections. You’ll own improvements from design through production and use what you learn from operating connectors to strengthen the platform they share. ### **Technologies We Use** * Java and Python for connectors, backend services, and developer SDKs * Open\-source technologies like Kafka, Kubernetes, Flink, Debezium, Iceberg * Industry\-standard build tooling, including Gradle and GitHub * Shared job orchestration, streaming, serverless execution, and compute deployment platforms ### **Core Responsibilities** * Build and maintain Foundry’s first\-class connectors, improving performance and extending support for imports, exports, change data capture, interactive queries, and writeback as external systems and customer needs evolve. * Improve the infrastructure that builds, tests, packages, and distributes connectors and shared libraries, including tooling across our connector monorepo. * Design and maintain connectivity SDKs for internal teams and end users, with clear APIs, documentation, testing utilities, and development workflows that make integrations easy to author and maintain. * Collaborate with product teams to integrate connector execution with job orchestration, streaming, and serverless platforms. * Lead incremental migrations onto shared infrastructure, manage compatibility, and retire older implementations while preserving the workflows customers depend on. * Develop reusable security frameworks and tooling that make secure connectivity a consistent part of connector development and execution. * Debug production issues and performance problems across the stack, turning recurring support problems into durable fixes, automated tests, and better observability. * Establish shared testing frameworks, compatibility checks, and release practices that keep a large connector portfolio reliable and maintainable. * Help prepare and maintain Palantir connectivity software for open\-source use, including its APIs, packaging, documentation, and contributor experience. ### **What We Value** * An ownership mindset and a high bar for correctness, security, and automated testing, including responsibility for how software behaves in production. * Pride in building and maintaining integrations over time, including the detailed work required to keep them reliable as upstream systems change. * Engineering judgment that balances delivering new capabilities with simplifying existing systems and reducing operational burden. * Empathy for developers and end users, reflected in usable SDKs, clear configuration, actionable errors, and useful diagnostics. * Curiosity about unfamiliar systems and persistence in debugging problems across languages, APIs, services, networks, and execution environments. ### **What We Require** * 4\+ years of professional software engineering experience developing external system connectors, with depth in areas such as developing batch and streaming data ingestion systems, third\-party integration development, or monorepo and asset distribution frameworks. Operating on top of these technologies alone does not qualify. * Deep expertise in Gradle, including developing custom plugins, managing multi\-project builds, and optimizing build performance. * Demonstrated ability to diagnose complex reliability and performance problems and improve systems through measured, incremental changes. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively across teams, incorporate feedback, and hold a high bar for quality. **Salary** The estimated salary range for this position is estimated to be $135,000 \- $200,000/year. Total compensation for this position may also include Restricted Stock units, sign\-on bonus and other potential future incentives. Further note that total compensation for this position will be determined by each individual’s relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other factors. This estimate excludes the value of any potential sign\-on bonus; the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long\-term incentives. ### **Life at Palantir** We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well\-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region. In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in\-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade\-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the city and or country in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office. If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process*,* please reach out and let us know how we can help. *Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US* *FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3\)**.*

noise. * You will streamline how cybersecurity issues are triaged, tracked, and remediated, making findings actionable, well\-prioritized, and integrated into the tools engineers already use (GitLab, Orca, AWS GuardDuty, Jira, Bugbounty). * You will collaborate with product, infrastructure, machine learning, and IT teams to secure our cloud\-native SaaS platform on AWS and Kubernetes. * You will drive and uphold high engineering standards, bringing consistency to the codebases and pipelines you encounter and ensuring security controls are adequately reviewed, tested, and integrated. * You will foster a culture of continuous learning by mentoring teammates, delivering secure coding guidance and training, and sharing technical knowledge. * You will contribute to a SaaS platform ensuring reliability, data integrity, protection of sensitive health data, and compliance with industry standards. * You will collaborate with clinical, QA, and regulatory teams to ensure security activities closely related technical field. * You have 5\+ years of full life cycle development and/or application security engineering experience. * You have a strong, hands\-on understanding of secure coding practices and common vulnerability classes (e.g., OWASP Top 10, CWE), and can explain both the risk and the fix to developers. * You have demonstrated experience building tools and automation that improve developer workflows, ideally in Python. * You have demonstrated experience integrating security tooling (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning, container scanning) into CI/CD pipelines. * You have demonstrated the ability to take on complex tasks, learn quickly and work in a proactive manner. * You have a demonstrated ability to collaborate with a distributed team and to work autonomously on projects; You have demonstrated problem\-solving skills and the ability to work in a fast\-paced, agile environment. * You have strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to attend client\-facing meetings and explain technical concepts to non\-experts. * You have demonstrated cloud platform experience (AWS). **Preferred:** * You have experience managing cybersecurity and risk in a controlled or regulated environment (e.g., FDA\-regulated medical device software, IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 27001, NIST, SOC 2, HIPAA). * You have an advanced degree or relevant security certification (e.g., OSCP, GWAPT, CSSLP, CISSP). * You have experience working in the healthtech industry, including working with HL7, HL7 FHIR, or DICOM. * You have experience with threat modeling, vulnerability management programs, and risk\-based prioritization of findings. * You have hands\-on experience with CI/CD tools, e.g. GitLab CI. * You have demonstrated knowledge of containerization technologies like Docker and container orchestration tools like Kubernetes, including securing them. * You have knowledge of some IaC framework (e.g., Terraform) and experience applying policy\-as\-code or IaC security scanning. * You have experience with cloud security tooling and practices (IAM, network segmentation, logging and monitoring, CSPM). * You have excellent organizational skills and the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects efficiently. jobs.description: **About Perry Weather** Perry Weather is the weather safety standard for organizations that operate outdoors. We combine on\-site weather hardware with a software platform that automates alerts, siren activations, and safety decisions for more than 3,000 organizations — from the PGA of America, the NFL, and MLB to Turner Construction, thousands of school districts, cities, and golf courses. We've grown 80%\+ annually for five consecutive years, and are continuing to grow. We're headquartered in Dallas at The Centrum, in the Oak Lawn neighborhood, where our teams work together every day to help organizations make faster and safer decisions when weather puts people, assets, and operations at risk. **About the Role** You will lead the team that builds and improves the systems deciding when weather is unsafe at a stadium, a school, or a job site, and what happens next. You set technical direction, write production code most weeks, and lead through designs, reviews, and coaching. You will move the team toward one shared rule for when conditions are unsafe, alerts that reach the right siren exactly once, and closed deals that reach the ERP without manual entry. The team owns the policy engine, the policy templates customers configure, the sirens and strobes that act on each decision, partner integrations such as Singlewire, and the HubSpot to Acumatica sync for closed deals. Hardware, support, sales, and finance all depend on these systems. Stack: C\# and .NET on Azure Kubernetes, Azure SQL, Azure Service Bus, React and React Native, and Terraform. You will build with AI coding agents every day. **Responsibilities** * Make one source of truth for "conditions are unsafe." Several services keep their own copy of that rule today, and the copies can disagree. Pick the version, move callers to it one at a time, and delete the rest. * Make the message paths reliable end to end. When a command to a siren is sent twice or never, or a partner webhook carries the wrong trigger, find the shared cause and fix it in the design so that whole class of failure stops. * Co\-own the service that sends commands to field hardware with our hardware team, from the software decision to the device that acts on it. * Finish the HubSpot to Acumatica sync so every closed deal reaches the ERP on its own, failures alert and can be replayed, and manual order entry goes away. * Write designs that other teams review, push back on, and build on. * Bring down reliability numbers several teams share (incidents customers find before we do, pages per day, time to detect) and keep them down after you move on. * Coach senior engineers until they own systems and designs of their own. * Review closely, take your turn on call, and help set how the team works with AI agents. **Requirements** * 8\+ years shipping production software, including time as technical lead for four to six engineers while you still wrote code. * Event\-driven systems you designed and ran in production: services that talk through queues, consumers that handle the same message twice safely, retries, and dead\-letter queues. * A system you split into services along domain lines. You can say where each boundary sits and why. * Backend depth in a statically typed language. We use C\#; strong Java, Go, or Kotlin carries over. * Judgment with AI\-generated code. Agent output often looks right when the logic is wrong. You check it against the requirement and can explain every line you ship. * Willingness to be on call. Our customers get alerts during severe weather, and a dropped alert can put someone at risk. **Nice to have:** Azure Service Bus or MassTransit, Kubernetes, SQL Server, IoT or field\-deployed hardware, real\-time weather or geospatial data, and React or React Native. **Benefits** * **You'll want to come into the office.** Our Oak Lawn office isn't just a place to sit — it's where ideas move fast and culture stays strong. The whole team is here Monday through Friday, which means real collaboration, no chasing people down over Slack, and a genuinely fun place to spend your work days. * **Your wellbeing is covered.** Competitive health insurance, 401(k) with employer matching, and a full suite of voluntary benefits, because you shouldn't have to think twice about the basics. * **Good people, good times.** Monthly All\-Hands, Office Olympics, happy hours, and more. We take the work seriously and the culture seriously too. * **You're getting in early, and that matters.** We're growing fast, but the biggest opportunities are still ahead. The people joining now will help shape what Perry Weather becomes.

jobs.title: Design Verification Engineer, New Grad (AI-Driven)
jobs.description: Who we are: Persimmons is building the infrastructure that will power the next decade of AI. Founded in 2023 by veteran technologists from the worlds of semiconductors, AI systems, and software innovation, We're on a mission to enable smarter devices, more sustainable data centers, and entirely new applications the world hasn't imagined yet. Why join us: We're growing fast and looking for bold thinkers, builders, and curious problem\-solvers who want to push the limits of AI hardware and software. If you're ready to join a world\-class team and play a critical role in making a global impact \- we want to talk to you. What you'll do: As a Design Verification Engineer, New Grad (AI\-Driven), you will be responsible for running and sharpening the tools that check our RTL designs against physical implementation, catching issues early and helping the team move with confidence. Your primary duties and responsibilities include: * Run daily RTL\-to\-physical\-design verification checks using our design tool suite, flagging discrepancies before they become costly problems downstream. * Leverage AI\-powered tools to speed up error detection, root\-cause analysis, and iteration cycles across design checks. * Partner with senior RTL and physical design engineers to understand what correct looks like for each block, building judgment that goes beyond a checklist. * Investigate unfamiliar problems by pulling together documentation, team knowledge, and AI tooling to find the fastest path to a working answer. * Build lightweight scripts and automations that make the next design check faster and more reliable than the last one. * Communicate clearly with the design and verification teams about what you found, why it matters, and what should happen next. * Grow into broader RTL and verification responsibilities as you build hands\-on fluency with our toolchain and design flow. **Requirements** What You Bring To The Table: * + Educational Foundation: Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Math, or a related technical field, and a track record of picking up new tools or subjects quickly and running with them. + Problem\-Solving Mindset: A track record of picking up new tools or subjects quickly and running with them, whether that came from coursework, personal projects, research, or somewhere else entirely. You like testing yourself on new kinds of problems, whether they turn out to be electrical, algorithmic, or software. We care much less about which specific tool or language you’ve already used and much more about how fast you can get up to speed on the next one. + AI Tool Fluency: Genuine comfort and curiosity using AI\-assisted tools to work through unfamiliar problems; you don’t just use AI, you know how to get real answers out of it. + Technical Foundation: Exposure to digital logic design, computer architecture, or hardware description languages. + Systems Comfort: Working familiarity with SystemVerilog. Nice\-to\-have experience with Linux/bash environments and basic scripting. **Benefits** * Competitive salary and benefits package * Flexible PTO * 401k Please note: Our organization does not accept unsolicited candidate submissions from external recruiters or agencies. Any such submissions, regardless of form (including but not limited to email, direct messaging, or social media), shall be deemed voluntary and shall not create any express or implied obligation on the part of the organization to pay any fees, commissions, or other compensation. Direct contact of employees, officers, or board members regarding employment opportunities is strictly prohibited and will not receive a response.

jobs.title: .Net Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Team** It’s an exciting time in technology, and that buzz is felt throughout PetSmart! We are continuing to grow at a faster pace and we want to continue to provide best\-in\-class experiences for pets and pet parents. Our **Technology team**has 6 different departments: Information Security, Service Delivery, Business Enabling Systems, eCommerce \& Marketing Technology, Data and Stores, Services \& Supply Chain. Whether it’s online or in our stores, the work that the IT team does is instrumental in PetSmart’s success. We have a strategic and actionable plan underway and are looking for associates who are just as excited about it as we are. **About the Location** **Collaborative Work Environment:** At PetSmart, teamwork and connection are core to how we thrive. This role is based at our Phoenix Home Office, with an expectation of working a minimum of four days in the office each week. In a standard work week, associates may work up to one remote “flex day” (with leader approval). Our hybrid approach is designed to foster strong collaboration while also supporting flexibility and individual success. **About the Job** The .NET Engineer develops, maintains, and enhances PetSmart’s custom applications and Point of Sales/Cash Register (POS) integrations, working on a mix of existing solutions and future capabilities. The role includes front\-end development and responsibility for application uptime, reliability, security, and maintainability. This engineer partners with the SRE and other technology teams to deliver dependable applications and resolve production issues across the supported environment. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * Lead analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of custom C\#/.NET applications and POS integrations, including workloads in GCP. * Develop and maintain application front ends and backend functionality, translating business needs into usable, maintainable solutions. * Enhance existing applications and build new solutions; address defects, technical debt, dependency updates, and supported runtime upgrades. * Own application\-level diagnosis, code fixes, uptime, and reliability improvements; complete monitoring work identified by the SRE and collaborate on service recovery. * Develop and troubleshoot APIs, workers, services, and integrations, including GCP workloads using Kubernetes, Apigee, Cloud SQL, service mesh, Pub/Sub, and Gemini AI. * Support the team’s application landscape, which includes .NET web applications, React/JavaScript, Node.js services, SQL databases, and MongoDB. * Write and maintain automated tests, conduct code reviews, and establish application design and coding practices with the engineering team. * Review and approve releases with senior engineers; validate application quality, plan safe deployments and rollback procedures, and support POS lab testing. * Lead monitoring and observability across POS applications, integrations, store\-device signals, cloud workloads, and vendor\-hosted services; develop actionable dashboards and alerts. * Lead reliability practices, service health measurement, and coordination of recovery across systems. * Provide Level 3 incident response, coordinate technical diagnosis and recovery with internal teams and vendors, and communicate service impact and recovery progress. * Lead root cause analysis, identify recurring failure patterns, and drive corrective actions that prevent incidents and reduce operational risk. * Automate repetitive operational work and improve health checks, troubleshooting procedures, and incident runbooks. * Improve recovery readiness and identify monitoring work for application engineers; guide implementation and validate that resulting monitoring supports reliable operations. * Mentor associate engineers, document application behavior and dependencies, and share knowledge with analysts, engineers, and support partners. * Use ServiceNow as the primary incident management and ticketing system, and Jira and Confluence for project management, work tracking, and documentation. **Required Qualifications** =========================== * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, with at least five years of C\# software development experience. * Experience developing and maintaining C\#/.NET web applications, including front\-end functionality, APIs, and SQL databases. * Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or an equivalent cloud platform. * Experience troubleshooting production applications and improving uptime, performance, reliability, and maintainability. * Strong object\-oriented programming, application design, automated testing, code review, and software development lifecycle skills. * Ability to provide technical guidance, collaborate across teams, and communicate clearly through technical documentation and incident updates. **Desired Qualifications** ========================== * Experience with React or JavaScript, Node.js, MongoDB, and existing .NET Framework/MVC applications, and messaging platforms is highly desired. **Nice to Have** ================ * Experience with retail/POS systems. **Location and Work Schedule** ============================== This role is remote within Costa Rica. Primary working hours align with Mountain Standard Time (MST) in Phoenix, Arizona. On\-site attendance is required as needed for POS lab testing and during visits by company vice presidents; there is no fixed on\-site schedule. Participation in a rotating on\-call schedule is required, providing 24/7 coverage for one week, currently estimated at approximately once per month. Additional after\-hours work may be required based on business needs. Opportunities to work voluntarily on holidays will be offered. **About Technology Operations** =============================== This role is part of Technology Operations, which keeps PetSmart’s systems within our area of responsibility reliable, available, and running efficiently so store and home office associates can do their work. You will navigate ambiguity, balance competing priorities, and help teams move issues toward resolution. At times, you will lead discussions about unfamiliar systems or problems, ask focused questions, and coordinate internal teams and external partners with urgency. Restoring service may require occasional work outside regular hours, including evenings, weekends, and participation in the required on\-call rotation. **About the Culture** Our associates are the heart of Team PetSmart. Together, we’re building the best team in retail through our values\-based culture, connection, and teamwork. Our goal is to create a culture where associates learn and grow together, thrive as effective teams and challenge each other to be the best they can be. Our Costa Rica office offers outstanding amenities in a fun and rewarding workplace including: * You will be able to bring your pets to work! * Free access to UltraPark gym facility * Learn more about \#Life AtPetSmart here: https://www.lifeatpetsmart.com/life\-at\-petsmart/ * Check out Associate stories and share in some celebrations at PetSmart: https://www.blog.lifeatpetsmart.com/ * Will have medical, dental \& vision benefits for all associates * Offer paid time off including holidays and discretionary days PetSmart provides an equal opportunity for all associates and job applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or other legally protected characteristics.

Work independently while seeking input when complexity, risk, or dependencies call for it. * **Help shape achievable plans.** Analyze requirements, contribute informed estimates, break stories into practical tasks, and explain technical constraints and trade\-offs. * **Make thoughtful design decisions.** Produce feature\-level technical designs that fit established architecture and conventions. Partner with senior engineers and a Lead Engineer on decisions with broader impact. * **Connect mobile experiences with supporting systems.** Integrate APIs and third\-party services, working with partner teams to clarify contracts, dependencies, and failure scenarios. * **Build quality into delivery.** Write maintainable code and appropriate automated tests, contribute to code and design reviews, and collaborate with QA on customer journeys and edge cases. * **Improve reliability.** Diagnose issues independently, add useful logging and validation, use monitoring to understand production behavior, and address underlying causes to reduce repeat defects. * **Contribute to team practices.** Participate in planning, refinement, reviews, and retrospectives. Suggest practical improvements and evaluate or prototype tools and approaches when useful. * **Communicate and support others.** Keep progress, risks, and dependencies visible. Share knowledge, pair on challenging work, provide constructive feedback, and mentor junior engineers. You’ll make decisions within the features and components you own, with support from senior engineers and the Lead Engineer for broader architecture and project direction. **What you’ll bring*** Professional experience building and shipping native Android applications, with the ability to deliver meaningful features independently. Around three or more years of relevant experience is a useful guide; demonstrated skills and equivalent experience matter. * Strong proficiency in native Android development using Kotlin. * Experience building Android interfaces with Jetpack Compose, including managing UI state and integrating with existing Android Views. * Experience handling asynchronous work and data updates using Kotlin coroutines and Flow, including cancellation, error handling, and safe UI updates. * An understanding of the Android application lifecycle, navigation, and state management, with experience structuring features into maintainable, testable components. * Experience integrating APIs and handling loading states, errors, and local data persistence. * Experience writing automated tests and using Android debugging and profiling tools to investigate defects and performance issues. * Familiarity with Git, pull requests, continuous integration, automated builds, and Android release workflows. * Experience working in an Agile team and contributing to refinement, estimation, and delivery. * The ability to understand business requirements, explain technical choices clearly, and collaborate with engineering and non\-engineering partners. * A practical approach to balancing delivery needs with maintainability and longer\-term technical direction. * Relevant software engineering knowledge gained through professional experience, education, or a combination of both. **Helpful experience**These are additional strengths, rather than requirements for every candidate: * Experience building native Android applications with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. * Building accessible mobile interfaces and supporting assistive technologies. * Working with app store submissions, release automation, and staged rollouts. * Using crash reporting, analytics, and performance monitoring to improve released features. * Building retail, e\-commerce, loyalty, or appointment\-booking experiences. * Working on applications with a large customer base or integrations across multiple enterprise systems. * Improving development practices, evaluating new technologies, or mentoring junior engineers. **Bring your perspective**Great mobile experiences come from people with different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of thinking. Even if you don’t meet every preferred qualification, if you can independently deliver quality mobile software, enjoy collaborating, and want to make everyday experiences better for pet parents, we’d love to hear from you. **About the Culture** Our associates are the heart of Team PetSmart. Together, we’re building the best team in retail through our values\-based culture, connection, and teamwork. Our goal is to create a culture where associates learn and grow together, thrive as effective teams and challenge each other to be the best they can be. Our Costa Rica office offers outstanding amenities in a fun and rewarding workplace including: * You will be able to bring your pets to work! * Free access to UltraPark gym facility * Learn more about \#Life AtPetSmart here: https://www.lifeatpetsmart.com/life\-at\-petsmart/ * Check out Associate stories and share in some celebrations at PetSmart: https://www.blog.lifeatpetsmart.com/ * Will have medical, dental \& vision benefits for all associates * Offer paid time off including holidays and discretionary days PetSmart provides an equal opportunity for all associates and job applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or other legally protected characteristics.
