jobs.title: Performance & Debug Software Engineer – AI Inference
jobs.description: **About Positron AI** ===================== Positron AI is building next\-generation AI inference accelerators designed from the ground up for low\-latency, high\-throughput large language model inference. Our first\-generation ASIC, Asimov, is a cutting\-edge accelerator targeting frontier AI workloads, with additional generations already underway. **Role Overview** ================= This engineer will improve end\-to\-end large language model (LLM) inference performance on Positron's custom AI accelerators, including our FPGA\-based Atlas systems and our Titan systems built on the Asimov ASIC. The work spans hardware\-accelerated attention, accelerator tuning, distributed KV cache, and scalable inference serving architectures. It covers profiling, algorithms, GPU\-side data preparation, host\-to\-device data movement, runtime behavior, and measurement on production\-relevant models. You will join a small, performance\-focused team that is expected to optimize the whole stack, and not merely tune isolated kernel interfaces. The goal is to sustain a repeatable path from observing workload symptoms to identifying root causes and creating measured improvements. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **Performance Profiling and Optimization** * Profile and optimize latency, throughput, utilization, and efficiency across hardware\-accelerated attention, accelerator configuration, the device runtime, host software, and on\-device execution. * Use performance counters, hardware and software traces, telemetry, and simulation to isolate regressions and validate fixes. ### **Distributed Inference and KV Cache** * Develop and optimize distributed inference capabilities, including efficient KV cache management and data movement across heterogeneous hardware. ### **Benchmarking and Test Infrastructure** * Build representative benchmarks and workload traces that expose bottlenecks in compute, memory, chip\-to\-chip interconnect, networking, scheduling, and model loading. * Partner with test engineers embedded in the team to turn performance findings into durable regression tests and release gates. ### **Architecture Influence** * Influence hardware and software architecture and interfaces where measured performance reveals a structural limitation. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Strong C\+\+ and Python skills, with hands\-on experience profiling and optimizing complex systems that exercise Linux VFIO interfaces.. * Deep understanding of memory hierarchy, concurrency, data movement, batching, scheduling, and performance measurement. * Hands\-on experience using profilers, counters, traces, and statistical methods to distinguish signal from noise. * Demonstrated ability to debug across application, runtime, driver, firmware, and hardware boundaries. * Experience bringing up software on new silicon, and debugging and analyzing performance optimizations in customer production deployments. * Enthusiasm for AI\-accelerated software development, including using coding agents and orchestrating subagents to move faster without compromising engineering outcomes. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with CUDA, HIP, Triton, GPU kernel development, distributed inference, or KV cache systems. * Familiarity with transformer inference, mixture\-of\-experts (MoE) models, model serving, FPGA or ASIC accelerators. * Working knowledge of Perfetto, Linux perf, eBPF, simulation, or hardware performance counters. ### **Leveling \& Scope** While this role is currently posted at a specific level, we are a growth\-oriented organization and are open to hiring at a more senior level for the right candidate. Please note that this job description serves as a focused but generalized overview of the role; specific responsibilities and impact expectations will be tailored to the experience and seniority of the final hire. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- Within the first 12 months: * A baseline performance scorecard exists for priority workloads, with repeatable measurement and clearly identified bottlenecks. * At least one major bottleneck in hardware\-accelerated attention, accelerator tuning, or distributed inference has been removed, with an automated regression guard in place. * A key distributed inference data path has a working implementation with quantified end\-to\-end cost. **Why Join Us?** ---------------- * Work on a small, high\-leverage performance team with the mandate to debug and improve the full stack, from application code down to firmware and hardware, rather than being confined to a single layer. * Help shape the distributed inference architecture and KV cache strategy for a custom inference accelerator at a formative stage, with direct influence over interfaces and system design. **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- The base salary range for this role is $200,000 – $300,000\. Please note that the figures provided represent the base salary range only and do not include other elements of our total compensation package, equity, or comprehensive benefits. At Positron AI, we value the unique expertise each candidate brings. While the range above reflects our typical expectation for the position, we reserve the flexibility to exceed this range for candidates whose specialized skills, significant experience, or unique qualifications fall outside the standard scope of the role. Final offers are determined based on a variety of factors, including internal equity, and individual impact. **Benefits \& Perks** --------------------- We want you to do your best work and feel confident that you and your family are taken care of. That means comprehensive coverage, real time to rest, and support for your future. **Health and wellness** * Fully company\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents. * Company\-paid life and disability coverage, with voluntary options to add more. * Supplemental hospital, critical illness, and accident coverage available. **Time off and flexibility** * Unlimited paid time off; we encourage everyone to truly unplug and recharge. * 13 paid company holidays. * Remote\-first culture with a company\-provided computer and home office setup. **Compensation and future** * Competitive salary and equity. * 401(k) with company matching, eligible from day one. **Visa Support** ---------------- This position is open to candidates currently authorized to work in the U.S. We cannot provide new visa sponsorship for this role but are open to facilitating H\-1B visa transfers for eligible candidates. Equal Opportunity Employer. If you're excited about the role but don't meet every bullet, we'd still love to hear from you.

jobs.description: **About Prime Data Centers** Prime Data Centers develops, acquires, and operates data centers for some of the world's largest enterprises. The QA Engineer role owns the verification chain that confirms every piece of Owner Furnished / Contractor Installed (OFCI) equipment is built, tested, documented, tagged, installed, and turned over exactly as specified in the approved submittals and drawings. **What you'll do** Working in close partnership with Procurement, Engineering, Commissioning, Construction, the General Contractor (GC), and Site Engineering, the QE manages the factory witness and acceptance test program, performs audits of documentation, drives Root Cause Analysis and enforces accountability against the construction and commissioning plans. The position is fundamentally an Objective Quality Evidence (OQE) role: findings must be documented, traceable, and pursued to 100% closure — not observed and set aside. jobs.title: Founding AI Engineer
jobs.description: Provn is helping Envorso Sports recruit a Founding AI Engineer. Please apply on our home page on Provn and take the challenge to stand\-out from competition. **About Envorso Sports** ------------------------ Envorso Sports is building the platform that runs a professional sports team's entire fan\-facing business: ticketing, website, mobile app, and increasingly commerce, CRM, and marketing, from one system instead of six disconnected vendors. Today, most teams run a fragmented stack: a website vendor, a ticketing provider, a separate mobile app, CRM tools, marketing automation, and game\-day engagement solutions bolted together. Teams don't want to pay five vendors and contractors to stitch the data together. That creates a disconnected fan journey and leaves revenue on the table. Our platform is live today with the Seattle Seawolves of Major League Rugby, and the league itself is now on the platform, with individual teams onboarding through the season. Ticketing, website, and mobile app are shipped and in production with paying customers. CRM, marketing automation, personalization, and revenue operations are what we build next, AI\-native from the start. We want candidates to know exactly where the product stands before they join. **About the Founding Engineer Role** ------------------------------------ You'll be our first in\-house engineer. This is a founding role: you'll own the fan data platform for the long term and help shape how we grow engineering, not ship one feature and move on. The problem is simple to state. Our teams and the league sit on a large fan database: ticket transactions, web and app activity, shop purchases, and email engagement. Today almost none of it is used. One salesperson calls season\-pass holders; one marketer sends a broadcast email and sees who bites. Your job is to turn that data into revenue: unify what we know about each fan across ticketing, web, app, shop, and email; decide which fans should get which offer; and deliver it through email and in\-app offers or push. Offers are concrete: a promo code for an abandoned cart, a season pass or match pass, a merch bundle, a seat upgrade. Getting the wrong offer to the wrong fan costs real money and real trust with a small, loyal fan base. You'll build for a three\-to\-five\-year horizon, not just this quarter. We need someone who thinks like an architect (data model, scale, failure handling, consent, cost) while still shipping something a team can use in weeks. You'll also be the engineer closest to our customers' front offices. Part of the job is understanding how a team's revenue and marketing operations actually work, and helping decide what we build first based on impact and effort. You'll report to Gopal Rao and work alongside our five\-engineer team in Argentina as one small group. Expect real overlap\-hours collaboration, and expect to take a problem, make the call, and ship without waiting on someone else. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Own the fan data platform end to end: a unified fan record across ticketing, web, app, and email, designed to hold up as we grow from one team's list to a whole league's * Ship fan segmentation and a targeted offers engine that decides which fans get which offer, and delivers it by email reactivation and in\-app offers or push * Build marketing ops and revenue ops driven by agentic AI: fan identity, segments, campaign builder and automation, and propensity, churn, and pricing models * Bring commerce into the fan record: shop purchases alongside tickets, so offers can cross\-sell merch, passes, and seat upgrades * Build the surfaces people use, in TypeScript and Next.js on web and in our mobile app, so offers are something a marketer reviews and a fan acts on, not just an API response * Design for production from day one: consent and opt\-in enforcement, no duplicate sends, failures that are visible instead of silent, and costs you can explain * Work with team front offices to understand their revenue goals, and sequence the roadmap by impact and effort * Make AI how we ship: build an AI\-native product where models change the outcome for a marketer or a fan, and run an agentic development process (AI\-SDLC) with coding agents, specs and tests as guardrails, and human review before anything reaches a fan * Help decide how engineering grows: how we scale with our Argentina team, what we build in\-house, and who we hire next **How We Hire** --------------- Apply through Provn by completing a short challenge and video walkthrough. If your submission clears the bar, you'll move straight to a conversation with our team. We don't wait to batch candidates. The process: a screen with Gopal, a technical interview, then a panel with engineering and product leaders. **Work Authorization** ---------------------- Must be authorized to work in the US. No employer\-sponsored visas for this role.

jobs.title: Optical Engineer
jobs.description: **Description** **Optical Engineer** **Title: Optical Engineer** **Location: Cartersville, GA (Qcells Cartersville Factory)** **Department: Smart Intelligence Team** The Optical Engineer will design, install, and own the optics of every vision inspection across Qcells’ solar manufacturing line, spanning ingot, wafer, cell, and module processes at the Cartersville (CTV) and Dalton (DLT) plants. The first assignment is optical design and installation: specifying illumination, lens, and camera for each defect type, building the setup on the line, and proving that it reveals what it is meant to reveal. Detection performance is set by the optics before any algorithm sees the image. The role also builds the software that runs around the optics, including camera control and image acquisition, the interface to the AI inference server, and the on\-floor viewer used by operators and engineers. Deep learning detection models are developed by dedicated AI engineers on the same team, so this role owns the optics, the application around them, and the measurement of inspection performance rather than model development. **Responsibilities** * Design inspection optics for each defect type, covering illumination (wavelength, angle, uniformity), lens, field of view, resolution, and camera or sensor selection, and finalize installation specifications with mechanical and controls engineering * Install and commission inspection systems on the production line, including mounting, alignment, focus and lighting setup, and acceptance criteria for image quality * Lead proof\-of\-concept evaluation of new inspection capability, including vendor technical assessment, bench trial design, detection\-limit measurement, and production readiness decisions * Own optical specifications for new inspection lines from the ground up, including vendor selection, incoming acceptance testing, and commissioning * Quantify and track inspection performance in production (over\-kill rate, miss rate, and detection coverage), and design the evaluation sample set and labels required to measure them, including known\-good labels * Set and maintain detection thresholds and judgment criteria together with process and quality engineering * Monitor and correct image quality on equipment already in production: focus and brightness drift, field\-of\-view alignment, tool\-to\-tool variation, and line\-to\-line standardization * Determine root\-cause attribution when over\-kill or miss rates rise, separating optical, process, and model causes, working with AI, process, and equipment engineering * Develop the vision application that runs around the optics, covering camera control, triggering, image acquisition and preprocessing, and the interface to the AI inference server at line speed * Build and maintain the on\-floor viewer used by operators and engineers, covering live inspection images and results, defect review and re\-judgment, lookup of past inspections by product or tool, and threshold configuration * Support inspection across EL, front\-end and back\-end AOI, string and solder joint inspection, final visual inspection, wafer surface and saw\-mark inspection, and real\-time image metrology on crystal growth, spanning visible, near\-infrared, and laser\-based measurement **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Optical Engineering, Optical Sciences, Photonics, Imaging Science, Applied Physics, or Electrical Engineering with an optics or imaging emphasis * 3\+ years of relevant experience * Professional experience in machine vision optical design, covering selection and validation of illumination, lenses, and cameras for defect inspection * Hands\-on experience installing, aligning, and commissioning inspection systems on a production line, and sustaining them afterward * Experience specifying requirements and working directly with industrial camera and illumination suppliers * Demonstrated experience quantifying inspection performance, including over\-kill and miss rates, threshold setting, and before\-and\-after verification of changes * Working proficiency in C\#, C\+\+, or Python, sufficient to build and modify vision applications and operator screens * Ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues, customers, suppliers, and stakeholders from different technical backgrounds **Preferred Qualifications** * High\-volume inspection experience in semiconductor, display, or solar manufacturing * Electroluminescence (EL) inspection experience * 3D metrology experience such as laser triangulation, structured light, or confocal measurement * Measurement systems analysis (Gage R\&R) or inspection capability studies * Experience with optical design and simulation tools such as Zemax * Hands\-on use of machine vision SDKs (Halcon, Cognex VisionPro, OpenCV) and camera interface standards (GigE Vision, USB3 Vision, GenICam) * Experience integrating vision systems with external systems over network protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP/REST, or gRPC) * Experience developing operator\-facing GUI applications (WinForms/WPF or Qt) * Experience interfacing vision systems with manufacturing equipment, PLC, or MES *Hanwha Qcells provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics.*

jobs.description: **Title: Sr Solution Architect (AI / Cybersecurity) \- Irving, TX (Hybrid)** Role Overview We are seeking a Senior Solution Architect to lead the technical design and execution of a strategic, AI\-driven cybersecurity initiative. This program aims to automate the remediation of enterprise cryptographic vulnerabilities across a portfolio of \~200 applications using autonomous LLM agents. Operating initially within an isolated InfoVision AWS Sandbox before scaling to enterprise production, you will be the definitive technical authority driving this initiative. You will architect the multi\-agent orchestration pipeline, integrate Large Language Models (LLMs), and ensure the seamless translation of enterprise security rules into executable Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) templates. This role requires a hands\-on architectural leader who can bridge the gap between DevSecOps, Cloud Infrastructure, and Generative AI to deliver a scalable, long\-term solution. Day\-to\-Day Responsibilities 1\. AI \& Agentic Orchestration Architecture Design the Agent Pipeline: Architect the cyclic graph state machines using LangGraph on AWS ECS Fargate, defining the exact hand\-offs between the Scan, Classify, Plan, and Execute agents. LLM Integration: Oversee the integration of Amazon Bedrock (Claude/Gemini APIs), designing the prompt structures and context\-handling logic required to parse complex Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) and Cryptography Bill of Materials (CBOM) outputs. RAG Implementation: Architect a Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) vector system using OpenSearch to dynamically map scan findings against the established North Star rule dictionary. 2\. Cloud Infrastructure \& Security Design Infrastructure Architecture: Design and govern the secure AWS environment (VPC, IAM, CloudWatch) to initially isolate the development sandbox and eventually scale into production pipelines. State \& Approval Management: Architect the state\-management layer using DynamoDB to track remediation checkpoints \[cite: 3]. Design the "Reviewer Dashboard" using API Gateway, AWS Lambda, and Amazon Cognito to enforce human\-in\-the\-loop approval gates. CI/CD \& DevOps Integration: Oversee the offshore AWS Cloud/DevOps engineers building the automated execution pipelines (AWS CodeBuild, SSM, Git PR automation). 3\. Technical Strategy \& Template Governance Rule\-to\-Template Mapping: Own the baseline mapping table. Translate the characteristic maps (provided by the on\-site data analysis team) into the logical frameworks required for the IaC remediation templates. Vulnerability Simulation \& Testing: Guide the engineering team on how to accurately inject industry\-standard cryptographic vulnerabilities (e.g., TLS 1\.2, AES\-128, hardcoded secrets) into reference applications to simulate real\-world conditions during the initial build phase. Cross\-Functional Technical Alignment: Act as the technical bridge between the on\-site secure analysis teams and the offshore AI engineering teams, ensuring the AI agents are being built to solve the correct enterprise constraints. Required Qualifications Experience: 10\+ years of progressive experience in Cloud and Software Architecture. AWS Mastery: Deep, demonstrable expertise in AWS networking, compute (ECS/Fargate), and serverless data stores (DynamoDB, OpenSearch, API Gateway, Lambda) \[cite: 3]. AWS Solutions Architect Professional certification is highly preferred. Generative AI: Hands\-on architectural experience with Generative AI orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain) and LLM APIs (Amazon Bedrock, Claude, Gemini). DevSecOps: Strong foundation in DevSecOps practices, Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform), and automated remediation pipelines. Security Acumen: Ability to understand complex enterprise encryption standards (TLS, IPsec, AES\-256\) and how they translate to infrastructure configurations. Pay: $60\.00 \- $65\.00 per hour Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Quality Engineer
jobs.description: RapidAI is the trusted leader in deep clinical AI, helping hospitals deliver faster, more informed care through intelligent imaging and integrated workflows. The Rapid Enterprise™ Platform supports disease states across the care spectrum, but it’s our clinical depth that drives the most meaningful impact — improving decision\-making, patient outcomes, and health\-system performance. Used by more than 2,500 hospitals in over 100 countries and backed by 700\+ clinical studies, including research that helped expand national stroke\-treatment guidelines, RapidAI is the most clinically validated AI platform in healthcare. As a **Senior Quality Engineer** at RapidAI, you will serve as an essential guardian of patient safety, compliance, and product excellence across our industry\-leading Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) portfolio. You will embed directly with Engineering, Clinical, and Product teams to ensure our cutting\-edge AI diagnostic and workflow solutions meet the highest standards of safety, efficacy, and regulatory compliance from initial concept through global release. In this role, you will champion robust design controls, lead risk management initiatives, oversee verification and validation (V\&V) activities, and continuously refine our Quality Management System (QMS). Working in an agile, AI\-first environment, you understand that rapid product iteration must go hand\-in\-hand with uncompromising regulatory rigor (IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, and FDA QMSR / 21 CFR Part 820\). **Work Location:**This role requires a hybrid work location arrangement. You will be required and expected to be present and work in the Golden office (1120 Washington Ave, Golden,CO 80401\)up to 3 days per week, and as needed for department or functional project meetings. On days when you are not required to be in the office, you will have the flexibility to work remotely, subject to the needs of the team and business. ### **How You Help Us Grow!** **Position Duties and Responsibilities:** * **Lead Software Quality Assurance for SaMD:** Establish, implement, and maintain software quality engineering processes across the complete software development life cycle (SDLC) in alignment with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, and FDA regulations. * **Design Controls \& Requirement Traceability:** Review and evaluate software product requirements, architecture specifications, and user stories to ensure complete bidirectional traceability, objective testability, and appropriate risk mitigations. * **Risk Management Leadership:** Drive product risk analysis in accordance with ISO 14971, ensuring that software hazards, failure modes (dFMEA), and risk controls are systematically identified, mitigated, and verified. * **Verification \& Validation (V\&V) Oversight:** Review, audit, and approve software test plans, automated and manual test protocols, V\&V execution reports, and clinical evaluation deliverables to guarantee compliance with global regulatory submissions. * **Defect \& Deviation Management:** Oversee and track software problem reports, anomalies, bug escalations, and non\-conformances from triage through root cause analysis (RCA), corrective actions, and verified closure. * **Test Tool \& Automated Infrastructure Validation:** Support the development, update, validation, and documentation of internal and third\-party software tools utilized in testing and qualifying SaMD (CSV / Software Tool Validation according to ISO/TR 80002\-2\). * **Cross\-Functional Quality Partnership:** Act as the primary Quality Engineering liaison to R\&D, Platform Engineering, Clinical Affairs, and Regulatory, advising teams on design controls without impeding sprint momentum. * **Continuous QMS Enhancement:** Participate in internal audits, support external regulatory audits (FDA, Notified Bodies/MDR), and drive continuous improvements across our quality management procedures. ### **What You Bring!** **Required Qualifications:** * **Experience:** 5\+ years of software quality engineering experience within the medical device, digital health, or life sciences industry. * **Education:** Bachelor of Science degree in Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. * **SaMD \& Standards Expertise:** In\-depth, hands\-on working knowledge of Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) standards including IEC 62304 (Medical Device Software Life Cycle Processes), ISO 13485, ISO 14971 (Risk Management), and FDA 21 CFR Part 820 / QMSR. * **Design Controls \& Traceability:** Demonstrated track record managing end\-to\-end design history files (DHF), requirement traceability matrices (RTM), risk documentation, and V\&V reports for commercial releases. * **Problem Solving \& Root Cause Analysis:** Proven experience managing software defect lifecycles, CAPA, non\-conformances, and driving rigorous root cause investigations with engineering teams. * **Communication \& Collaboration:** Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; ability to hold cross\-functional collaborators accountable to strict delivery milestones while maintaining collaborative, trusted relationships. * **Results\-Driven:** Relentless attention to detail with the ability to thrive under tight sprint cycles and shifting priorities in a high\-growth environment. **Preferred Qualifications:** * **Clinical AI \& Machine Learning:** Experience qualifying or testing AI/ML\-based algorithms, computer vision pipelines, or diagnostic decision support software. * **Cloud \& Agile Environments:** Familiarity with modern cloud\-native architectures (AWS), CI/CD automated validation pipelines, and Agile/Scrum development methodologies. * **Tool Validation:** Direct experience with Software Tool Validation (CSV) under ISO/TR 80002\-2, including validation of ALM/QMS tools such as Jira, GitHub, Propel, or TestRail. * **Regulatory Submissions:** Direct experience participating in FDA 510(k), De Novo, or EU MDR technical documentation submissions and external audits. * **Certifications:** ASQ Certified Software Quality Engineer (CSQE) or Certified Quality Engineer (CQE). $95,000 \- $115,000 a year * Compensation also includes bonus and equity * **Work Authorization:** Candidates must be currently authorized to work in the United States without restriction. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. RapidAI is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type in regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. jobs.description: San Mateo, CA, United StatesEngineeringID: 49613 Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators. Our north star is that all movement of value on Roblox is tracked on the Ledger, and that every unit of value — virtual currency, fiat, or digital asset — is accurately tracked, perfectly balanced, and fully auditable. That makes the Ledger the trusted foundation for our users, creators, and economy. We are the source of truth for the economy in both directions: every write of value, and every read of it. The same authoritative record that settles a transaction also has to answer the questions people ask about it — balances, history, statements, reconciliation, and analytics — so that read paths do not drift from the book of record. Robux already runs entirely on our zero\-balanced, double\-entry ledger, and Creator Wallets launch in December 2026\. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, build, and scale the systems that make this true, in a domain where correctness is the product rather than a feature. **You Have:** * 4\+ years of backend software engineering experience, demonstrating proficiency in designing, building, and maintaining robust and scalable systems (e.g., microservices, APIs). * Strong problem\-solving skills and experience debugging complex issues in distributed systems. * Experience in managing projects, planning and executing work across different workstreams. * Strong collaboration skills, ability to work across teams and organizations, mentoring and guiding junior engineers. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a similar technical field. * Experience in financial infrastructure, ledgers, accounting, or another domain where accuracy is non\-negotiable is highly desirable. Experience building a ledger or double\-entry system at another company is a strong plus. * Experience with large\-scale data or analytical systems (OLAP, event\-driven pipelines, or similar) is a plus but not a requirement. **You will**: * Work closely with Finance, product, and other economy engineering teams to make every movement of value correct at the source. * Architect, design, implement, and operate the ledger services that record every movement of value on Roblox. * Proactively identify and address correctness, performance, auditability, and operational risks in systems where a single bad entry is a financial incident. * Design idempotent, exactly\-once write paths, plus the reconciliation that proves the books balance and the precision guarantees other teams build on. * Own both sides of the ledger: the write path that records value, and the read path that serves balances, history, and analytics from the same source of truth. * Uphold high standards for code quality, test coverage, and maintainability, fostering the culture of engineering excellence. Metro Area.** **You should apply if:** * **You want to impact the industries that run our world:** Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster. * **You thrive the most when solving problems:** Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. Build automated test suites that cover real\-world scenarios, edge cases, and known failure modes. * **Deploy:** Own the deployment, versioning, and rollback plan for every agent. Ensure agents are production\-ready before they reach CSMs or customers. * **Monitor:** Track agent performance in production — monitor accuracy, latency, failure rates, and customer outcomes. Detect drift before anyone has to tell you something's wrong. * **Maintain \& Iterate:** Update agents continuously as Samsara's product evolves, Customer Success playbooks change, and real\-world data indicates what needs improvement. * **Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles** (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices **WHAT YOU'LL ACCOMPLISH** **In your first 30 days** * Embed with the Commercial Customer Succes systems * Familiarity with Salesforce, Gainsight, or similar CRM and Customer Success platforms **WHY THIS ROLE, WHY NOW** * **You'll be first:** This function doesn't exist yet. You'll define the role, the standard, and the playbook for ing in Customer Success * **The problem is real:** A Customer Success Manager managing 350\+ accounts can't do everything manually. AI agents aren't a nice\-to\-have — they're what makes this motion sustainable at Samsara's scale. * **The timing is right:** The models have caught up to the use cases. Samsara has the customer data, the platform context, and the Customer Success team to make these agents genuinely powerful. **Total Rewards** At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high\-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above\-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance\-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high\-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above\-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long\-term success: a flexible, employee\-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. **Flexible Working** At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in\-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: We're seeking a **Senior Machine Learning Infrastructure Engineer** to join us in our mission to transform the discovery of therapeutics and materials. As a member of the Machine Learning team, you'll play a key role in building and maintaining the systems that put ML models and AI agents to work in drug discovery. LiveDesign ML trains and serves models on live project data, both in our own clusters and in customers' LiveDesign environments. Bunsen is an agentic platform where every session runs an AI agent in its own isolated Kubernetes pod. We also run locked\-down environments for federated\-learning collaborations with pharma partners. You'll own the infrastructure behind these products, across our own clusters and customer clouds on GCP and AWS. Today, ML engineers handle it alongside feature work. You'll make it your focus: repeatable customer deployments, strong isolation for AI\-generated code, and reliable, cost\-efficient GPU systems. **Who will love this job:** * A Terraform or OpenTofu and Helm writer who has shipped with GitOps * A solid Python and shell scripter * A security\-minded engineer who defaults to least privilege, managed secrets, and segmented networks * A clear communicator who enjoys working closely with ML engineers and scientists **What you'll do:** * Turn customer installs and upgrades into versioned, GitOps\-driven releases (Helm, OpenTofu, Argo CD) with automated verification * Design isolation for multi\-tenant agent sandboxes: network policy, workload identity, runtime sandboxing, and egress control * Secure CI/CD and the software supply chain with keyless auth, ephemeral runners, and pinned, signed images * Build and operate locked\-down partner environments with private networking, default\-deny egress, just\-in\-time access, and audit logging * Keep GPU\-heavy training and inference reliable and cost\-efficient, backed by observability, SLOs, and on\-call **What you should have:** * At least six years of infrastructure, platform, or SRE experience * In\-depth understanding of Kubernetes operation (not just deployment) * Robust background with GCP (and some familiarity with AWS) **We'd prefer to hire someone who has experience with:** * Running GPU workloads and model serving (vLLM, Knative) on Kubernetes * Sandboxing untrusted code (gVisor, Kata Containers, Cilium) * Shipping software into customer\-owned or restricted\-egress clouds * Argo Workflows or batch/HPC scheduling * Regulated environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GxP) * Operating LLM or agent platforms **Pay** **and perks:** Schrödinger understands it's people that make a company great. Because of this, we're prepared to offer a competitive salary, equity\-based compensation, and a wide range of benefits that include healthcare (with dental and vision), a 401k, pre\-tax commuter benefits, a flexible work schedule, and a parental leave program. We have a company culture that is relaxed, but engaged, and over a month of paid vacation time. Our Office Management team also plans a myriad of fun company\-wide events. New York is home to our largest office, but we have teams all over the world. Schrödinger is honored to have been included in Crain's New York Best Places to Work, BuiltIn's NYC Best Place to Work, and Newsweek's list of America's 100 Most Loved Workplaces. Estimated base salary range: $110,000 \- $160,000\. Actual compensation package is dependent on a number of factors, including, for example, experience, education, degrees held, market data, and business needs. If you have any questions regarding the compensation for this role, do not hesitate to reach out to a member of our Strategic Growth team. Sound exciting? Apply today and join us! *As an equal opportunity employer, Schrödinger hires outstanding individuals into every position in the company. People who work with us have a high degree of engagement, a commitment to working effectively in teams, and a passion for the company's mission. We place the highest value on creating a safe environment where our employees can grow and contribute, and refuse to discriminate on the basis of race, color, religious belief, sex, age, disability, national origin, alienage or citizenship status, marital status, partnership status, caregiver status, sexual and reproductive health decisions, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. To us, "diversity" isn't just a buzzword, but an important element of our core principles and key business practices. We believe that diverse companies innovate better and think more creatively than homogenous ones because they take into account a wide range of viewpoints. For us, greater diversity doesn't mean better headlines or public images \- it means increased adaptability and profitability.*

engineering and context management * LLM application development **LLM Evaluation \& Testing** * DeepEval * LLM‑as‑a‑Judge techniques * Evaluation metrics and benchmarking * Automated evaluation and regression testing * Assessment of hallucination, faithfulness, relevance, and response quality * Hands‑on experience with RAGAS, DeepEval, or equivalent frameworks * Strong understanding of RAG evaluation metrics (Faithfulness, Answer Relevancy, Context Precision, Context Recall, Answer Correctness) * Experience building automated evaluation pipelines for RAG‑based applications **AI Observability \& Monitoring** * OpenTelemetry * LangSmith * Langfuse * LLM tracing, debugging, and performance monitoring **Production Engineering** * Deploying and operating production‑grade GenAI applications * API integration and backend engineering * CI/CD and automated testing integration * Scalability, reliability, security, and performance optimization * Strong hands‑on programming We're building AI that makes customers feel understood, seen, and remembered. We are the omnichannel AI agent platform enterprises choose to elevate customer experience. Trusted by 4,000\+ of the world's most popular apps—including industry leaders like Match Group, Rakuten, Yahoo, and Coupang—Sendbird powers over 7 billion conversations every month. We're looking for a GTM Engineer to help realize Sendbird's vision of connecting businesses and individuals and empowering them to achieve more than ever before. As the Sales Operations Manager on the Revenue Operations team, you will be responsible for the systems, processes, and data behind our go\-to\-market motion, while driving global cross\-functional projects with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Product. You will report to the Head of Revenue Operations. Revenue Operations consists of Marketing Operations, Sales Operations, Customer Success Operations, and Data Insights. We ensure full\-funnel accountability by aligning processes, platforms, and people. ***This role requires 3\+ days per week in the San Mateo, California, office.*** **Who You Are** * You have successfully improved internal sales operations, positively impacting the information GTM teams use to drive revenue. * You are comfortable communicating with a variety of stakeholders and driving consensus on processes across the GTM functions. You absorb large amounts of information, distill it to the essentials, and communicate with stakeholders up, down, and across. * You have experience implementing AI solutions and turn to AI first when approaching your work. You can "AI pill" our GTM processes. * You have excellent organizational, planning, and project management skills. You bring order and resolve to a fast\-paced environment, juggle several projects concurrently, and shift priorities as needed. * You are a driver, not a passenger: you operate autonomously, take charge, get it done, and have demonstrated this repeatedly. * You stay calm and collected, approaching problems with a forward\-thinking mindset. * You pay close attention to detail and have successfully delivered on complex projects which improved business outcomes. **What You Will Do** * Partner with our field leaders and their team members to: * + Improve our processes and methodology. + Build scalable workflows and rules of engagement within and across teams. + Provide reports, dashboards, and data insights critical to understanding performance. + Structure variable compensation plans to correctly incentivize the right motions and playbooks. * You will have responsibility for Salesforce, LeanData, and Gainsight, including the design and deployment of solutions, process documentation, and enablement. * You will work effectively with AI technologies such as Claude and Vercel. * You will create solutions that utilize our tech stack to the optimal solution, including how systems work together. * Procure, implement, and administer other GTM systems as needed by the business. **What You Bring** * 6\+ years in Sales Operations. * 3\+ years at a B2B AI/SaaS growth company. * Active Salesforce Administration certification required; LeanData or Gainsight certification a plus. * Demonstrated domain expertise in the GTM tech stack (e.g. HubSpot, RingLead/ZoomInfo, Clay, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Nooks, Gong, etc). * Hands\-on and detailed understanding of playbooks for B2B AI/SaaS. * Experience working in a Google Workspace environment * Exceptional verbal, presentation, and communication skills, with the ability to align multiple stakeholders. * Proven track record of interacting effectively with senior leadership, solving problems proactively, and thinking critically. * Bachelor's Degree required; a STEM degree is a plus, as is an advanced degree or MBA. **What we offer** We take care of the people who build the future. Here's some of what you can expect when you join delight.ai: * Medical, dental, and vision coverage, on us. delight.ai covers 100% of the premium for our employees and roughly 80% for their dependents. * Generous time off.20 days PTO, 13 company holidays, 7 sick days, 2 rest \& rejuvenation days, 1 volunteer day, and your birthday off. * $3,500 annual "Be Your Best Self"boost**.** Spend it on anything that helps you grow. Gym memberships, therapy, books, courses, massages, and more. * Parental leave for all new parents. Time to be present for the moments that matter most. * 401(k) from day one.Auto\-enrollment, flexible contributions, and access to Vanguard's investment platform. * HSA \& FSA options.Pre\-tax accounts to cover healthcare, dependent care, and commuter expenses. * Life \& disability coverage, fully paid. Life insurance and AD\&D at 2x your salary, plus short\- and long\-term disability at no cost to you. Please note that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role. **Pay Transparency** For cash compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function, level, and geographic location. To determine our ranges, we utilize a variety of compensation data benchmarked against similar\-stage growth companies. A reasonable estimate of the current salary range for this role is$150,000 \- $170,000\. This range is specific to the San Francisco Bay market. We consider several factors when making final compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skill sets, experience and training, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs which may cause your specific offer to vary from the amount listed above. **Flexible Work Policy** We offer a flexible work schedule at Sendbird. Sendbird is a place where everyone can learn and grow. We respect, promote, and encourage diversity for equal employment opportunities, and encourage you to apply if this role excites you. **About Sendbird** Combining omnichannel AI and battle\-tested, award\-winning communication APIs, Sendbird enables businesses to build AI agents and meaningful customer connections at scale. Trusted by 4,000\+ leading apps, including DoorDash, Match Group, Noom, and Yahoo Sports, Sendbird powers over 7 billion conversations every month, offering exceptional reliability, security, and compliance that meet enterprise\-level demands. Headquartered in San Mateo, California, Sendbird is backed by ICONIQ, SoftBank, Tiger Global, Y Combinator, and other reputable investors.

jobs.title: AI Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: **Job Title:** Forward Deployed AI Engineer **Location:** Hybrid, Dallas/Las Colinas office (approximately 10% travel) **Department:** Information Technology, Data \& AI **Reports To:** Sr. Director, Data \& AI**Job Overview** ---------------- We are hiring a **Forward Deployed AI Engineer** to embed with Shermco business units, find where AI can change how work gets done, and build the solutions that prove it. You will spend real time with teams in field operations, estimating, sales, finance, HR, and other functions, learning how their work actually happens before deciding what to build. This is a builder role, not an advisory one. You will move quickly from discovery to a working solution, put it in front of users, and iterate until it delivers measurable value. You take low\-code and configuration solutions built on Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Microsoft Fabric all the way to production, each with a named business owner. Work that needs extensive custom code or a complex agent goes to the AI Product Engineer. You will be judged on adoption and business outcomes, not on the number of demos produced. The role sits on the Data \& AI team and reports to the Sr. Director, Data \& AI. You will work closely with the AI Product Engineer, who builds the solutions that need custom code or complex agents, and with data engineering, analytics, and governance colleagues who provide the platform, data, and controls your work depends on. In short, you find the problem, prove the value, and ship most solutions yourself; the AI Product Engineer takes on what needs custom engineering. Your customers are internal Shermco teams. Success means business units seek you out because your work has made their jobs measurably easier. **Work Authorization Requirement:** Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship. Shermco does not provide visa sponsorship for this position. Responsibilities: **Embedded Discovery*** Work with stakeholders at every level, from technicians and field crews to managers and directors to VPs and executive leadership, to understand day\-to\-day workflows, team needs, and larger organizational initiatives. * Turn vague requests into scoped, written problem statements, and identify and size AI opportunities by the time, cost, risk, or revenue they could affect, and recommend where AI is not the right answer. * Build trusted working relationships with business leaders and front\-line users so the team hears about problems early. **Build and Delivery*** Build solutions quickly using Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform, Claude, Python, and other approved AI tools and models. * Integrate with operational systems such as Salesforce, on\-premises Business Central, Dayforce, and field service platforms to put AI where work already happens. * Put solutions in front of real users early, gather feedback, and iterate toward measurable outcomes. * Agree on success measures with business owners before building, track results after launch, and recommend changing course or stopping work that is not delivering value. **Production Ownership and Handoff*** Take low\-code and configuration solutions on Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Fabric all the way to production, each with a named business owner, documentation, and evaluation cases, and support them in production, including a light shared support rotation for business\-critical solutions. * Hand off solutions that need extensive custom code or a complex agent to the AI Product Engineer, packaged with documentation, known limitations, and data and access requirements. * Partner with the Data \& AI Governance Engineer so every solution follows data access, security, and responsible AI standards from the start. **Adoption and Enablement*** Own adoption after launch through training, office hours, champions in the business unit, and follow\-up on usage. * Teach business users to recognize good AI use cases and to use approved AI tools effectively and safely. * Bring field insight back to the Data \& AI team to shape the roadmap, reusable components, and priorities. **Team Practice*** Use AI\-assisted development throughout your own work while remaining accountable for accuracy, security, and maintainability. * Contribute reusable patterns, prompts, templates, and lessons learned to team standards. * Share knowledge, provide peer review, and help shape Shermco's broader AI strategy. Qualifications: * 5\+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, applied machine learning, solutions engineering, or a related technical role, including 2\+ years building AI or LLM\-based solutions used in production. * Strong Python and SQL skills, plus experience integrating with REST APIs and enterprise systems. * Hands\-on experience building with LLMs, including prompt design, retrieval\-augmented generation, tool use, and basic evaluation. * Experience with a cloud AI platform such as Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI. * Demonstrated ability to run discovery with stakeholders from front\-line staff to executive leadership and translate ambiguous problems into scoped, buildable solutions. * A track record of shipping quickly, measuring results, and iterating based on user feedback. * Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining AI capabilities, limits, and risks to non\-technical audiences. * Comfort working independently, traveling to business unit locations (approximately 10%), and managing several engagements at once. **Preferred*** Experience in a forward deployed, solutions engineering, internal consulting, or embedded product role. * Experience with Copilot Studio, Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform, or Microsoft Foundry. * Experience with agent frameworks and protocols such as Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, or Model Context Protocol (MCP). * Practical experience using Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, or comparable AI tools to accelerate development. * Experience with Salesforce, on\-premises Business Central, Dayforce, or field service management platforms. * Experience with document intelligence, unstructured data, or speech and image use cases. * Light front\-end or low\-code app building experience for prototypes. * Background in construction, electrical, field services, or another operations\-heavy industry. * Microsoft certification such as AI\-102 or AI\-900\. **What We Offer** ----------------- * A fast\-growing Data \& AI department where you will shape how AI is applied across the company * A small, senior team with real ownership and direct access to leaders in every business function * Current AI tooling across the Microsoft stack and Claude, with an operating model that favors speed and enabling governance over process for its own sake * Work that shows up in how a real\-world business estimates, schedules, and delivers **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER \| DRUG\-FREE WORKPLACE** Shermco is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status. Shermco is a drug\-free workplace.**NO AGENCIES PLEASE** Pay Range: USD $130,000\.00 \- USD $140,000\.00 /Yr.

jobs.description: At Shutterfly, we make life's experiences unforgettable. We believe there is extraordinary power in the self\-expression. That's why our family of brands helps customers create products and capture moments that reflect who they uniquely are. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) with a strong passion for building high\-quality, scalable user experiences backed by reliable backend services. While this role spans the full stack, the primary focus is on designing, implementing, testing, and evolving complex frontend systems that power rich, interactive applications \- with meaningful contributions to the backend services that support them. Ideal split for the role will be 80% frontend and 20% backend. The ideal candidate brings deep knowledge of modern UI architecture alongside solid backend experience, strong engineering fundamentals, and a firm computer science foundation \- including data structures, algorithms, and performance considerations relevant to large\-scale client and server applications. You will work on sophisticated single\-page applications that require careful state management, rendering performance, and seamless integration with the backend services you help build and maintain. You are expected to work independently, take ownership of features end\-to\-end across the stack, and contribute to technical design decisions. You should have excellent problem\-solving and organizational skills, along with hands\-on experience with Test\-Driven Development (TDD) and Agile development practices. Required Qualifications: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field. * 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience with a primary focus on frontend development and meaningful backend experience. * Expertise in React, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6\+), HTML5, CSS3, and GraphQL. * Working knowledge in Java, Spring Boot, Python or similar technologies for backend development. * Comprehensive understanding of frontend architecture, single\-page application (SPA) design, and modern rendering patterns. * Hands\-on experience with canvas rendering, custom UI engines, or performance\-critical frontend components. * Strong computer science foundation, including data structures, algorithms, and performance analysis. * Experience designing and integrating with RESTful and GraphQL APIs. * Proven track record in Test\-Driven Development and automated testing using tools like Jest. * Familiarity with cloud\-based deployments, especially AWS. * Excellent problem\-solving skills and ability to work independently with minimal supervision. * Demonstrated success in building maintainable, scalable, and cost\-effective solutions across the stack. * Adaptable to evolving product requirements and technical constraints while balancing user experience, engineering excellence, and long\-term maintainability. * A mindset of continuous improvement \- bringing forward ideas that promote modern engineering standards, tooling, and best practices. Preferred Qualifications: * Experience with AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar. * Experience working with LLMs (Large Language Models) and generative AI applications, including prompt engineering and fine\-tuning strategies. * Experience building frontend build, deployment, and CI/CD workflows. * Experience with message brokers such as RabbitMQ. * Experience with workflow engines. * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as Terraform. We welcome all applicants and evaluate them based on their qualifications. Learn more about our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion on our Career Site. jobs.title: Principal/Staff Technical Program Manager, Engineering
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: Simbe builds Tally, an autonomous shelf\-scanning robot deployed at fleet scale in enterprise grocery and retail. Tally is a ROS\-based robotics platform paired with edge and cloud AI/computer vision, a cloud data platform, and retailer\-facing reporting systems, spanning multiple hardware generations and product lines (mobile, fixed, RFID). Delivering a release means coordinating hardware, on\-robot software, AI models, and cloud systems simultaneously, on a schedule where the finish line is a working robot in a real store, not a demo. We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to be the connective tissue across this system: the person who can see the full dependency graph, from a hardware decision through the robot's software stack, through the AI model, through the cloud pipeline, to what a retail partner sees on their dashboard, and make sure nothing falls through the seams between teams. ### **What you'll own** * The cross\-functional schedule for Simbe's highest\-stakes programs: new Tally generation launches, fleet\-wide software/hardware migrations, and large retail rollouts with hard external dates * Integration checkpoints wherever domains meet: hardware\-to\-ROS (on\-robot software), CV model deployment onto the robot (edge inference, with real\-time and compute constraints on the robot itself) alongside cloud\-side model updates and data pipeline flow, and backend\-to\-retailer\-facing reporting. For each, you define what "done" means, who owns it, and what happens when it slips * Deployment readiness end to end: a program isn't complete when engineering ships it, it's complete when it's live and stable in stores. You own the handoff from build to field. * Visibility into risk before it's a crisis: dependency mapping, a standing cross\-functional review cadence, and a top\-risks list that leadership actually trusts because you can defend it technically ### **Your first 30 days** * Build a single dependency graph spanning hardware, embedded software, cloud/data platform, and AI/CV for the two highest\-priority programs * Identify and document the top risks to the nearest hard external date, with enough specificity that engineering leads agree it's accurate * Stand up a lightweight cross\-functional review cadence with real inputs from each function, not a status meeting ### **What you bring** * Hands\-on technical experience: you've personally built, integrated, or debugged a complex product that spans physical hardware and robotics software, not just managed a team that did. * Depth in at least one of hardware/robotics software (ROS or comparable middleware) or cloud/data platforms, real fluency across the others. * Comfort driving a room of engineers who don't report to you. You guide decisions and shape estimates through technical insight and collaborative problem\-solving. * A track record on programs where a hardware or software slip has real\-world consequences, a customer site, a fleet in the field, a fixed external date, not just an internal roadmap * The instinct to build only as much process as removes friction. This role exists because delivery today depends heavily on a small number of people going above and beyond. The job is to build the systems and cadence that make that unnecessary, not to add processes that slow down people who are already delivering. ### **What this role is not** * Not a project coordinator tracking a spreadsheet someone else fills in * Not scoped to hardware alone: you're equally at home in a conversation about a ROS navigation stack issue, an edge CV model that's missing its inference budget on\-robot, and a cloud data pipeline delay * Not a substitute for engineering leadership: you drive cross\-functional execution, you don't own the technical roadmap or make architecture calls The base salary offered is based on market location, and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations. Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including equity compensation, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment. At Simbe, you will be at the forefront of retail innovation, working with cutting\-edge AI and robotics technologies to transform retail operations. Our culture is dynamic, inclusive, and driven by a passion for improving the way retailers operate and serve their customers. Join us to be a part of a team that is not only reshaping the future of retail but also offering immense value to our clients worldwide. Simbe Values: R. E. T. A. I. L. Result Driven \- We are customer\-centric and results\-driven. We strive to create immense value for our team, partners, customers, and investors. Empathetic \- We are sensitive and mindful. We support each other in challenging times, both professionally and personally. Transparent \- We highly value open communication internally, and with our partners and customers. We are receptive to feedback. Agile \- We are agile and always eager to learn. We quickly adapt to changes and customer needs. Innovative \- We are bold and innovative, with an intense focus on product design and user experience. Leaders \- We strive for excellence. We are accountable, the best at what we do, and leaders in our field. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. As a **Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, Applied AI** on our Cortex AI team, you will be a hands\-on technical leader and trusted partner to our most strategic customers. *You* *will own the end\-to\-end delivery of enterprise AI programs, leading a team of 2–4 engineers while staying deeply technical yourself**.* You will set the technical direction for your customer engagements, mentor your team, and serve as the senior technical voice at the intersection of product, engineering, and customer success. ***Note: This is a customer facing role \& require frequent travelling within USA mostly*** **IN THIS ROLE AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:** ---------------------------------------- **Lead Customer Programs**: Own the full lifecycle of complex, multi\-engineer AI engagements – from scoping and architecture through deployment, monitoring, and handoff. Be accountable for delivery quality and customer outcomes for the projects you lead. **Own AI Quality**: Define what "good" means for each engagement. Translate ambiguous customer goals into measurable quality metrics, evaluation frameworks, and golden datasets – then run systematic eval loops to hill\-climb on agent quality, catch regressions before customers do, and continuously raise the bar on accuracy, faithfulness, and safety. Set the standard for how the team measures and improves AI systems in production. **Grow and Mentor Engineers**: Provide day\-to\-day technical leadership and mentorship to a team of 2–6 Applied AI Engineers. Review designs and code, unblock teammates, and actively develop their skills and careers. **Deliver with Velocity**: Remain a hands\-on contributor – designing, iterating, and shipping high\-quality ML pipelines and agentic AI solutions alongside your team. Translate ambiguous business objectives into robust, scalable, and performant solutions. **Productionize AI at Scale**: Own the full implementation lifecycle for AI solutions, from prototype through deployment, monitoring, and optimization in secure, large\-scale production environments. Build the safety guardrails, observability, and human\-review workflows that keep AI applications reliable and trustworthy – and close the loop from production traces and user feedback back into your evals so quality compounds over time. **Be a Strategic Technical Advisor**: Serve as a senior technical advisor to customer data science and engineering leadership. Set the standard for how Snowflake AI is deployed and articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and executive stakeholders. **Collaborate to Innovate**: Work cross\-functionally with Snowflake's Product and Engineering teams, bringing real\-world patterns and feedback from the field to directly shape the future of Snowflake's AI platform. **Drive Compounding Outcomes**: Identify recurring deployment patterns and turn them into reusable assets – reference architectures, evaluation harnesses, and product feedback that scale Snowflake's impact across customers. **Have the opportunity to travel**: Spend at least 25% of your time onsite, working closely with Snowflake's most strategic customers. **WE'RE LOOKING FOR CANDIDATES WHO HAVE:** ------------------------------------------ * Demonstrated experience leading technical projects or teams, including setting technical direction, reviewing others' work, and driving delivery to completion. * Proven experience building and productionizing applications using LLMs, especially with technologies like RAG and agentic workflows. * Hands\-on experience defining quality metrics and evaluation frameworks for LLM or agent systems, and using evals to systematically improve quality over time. * Excellent problem\-solving and communication skills, with an ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and executive stakeholders. * Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to independently structure and execute on complex, open\-ended problems. * 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * Experience in **a customer\-facing technical role.** * **Willingness to travel.** ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building eval sets from production traces and synthetic data, and running structured experimentation (A/B tests, ablations, offline evals) to compare prompts, models, or agent architectures. * Familiarity with eval and observability tooling (e.g., Braintrust, LangSmith, Arize, Weave, Promptfoo) or experience building custom eval harnesses. * Experience with failure\-mode analysis on agent or RAG systems – categorizing errors (hallucination, retrieval miss, planning failure, tool misuse) and driving each down with targeted evals. * Hands\-on experience with the MLOps lifecycle, including model deployment, monitoring, and evaluation in a cloud environment (AWS, Azure, or GCP). * Familiarity with core data science libraries and tools (e.g., pandas, numpy, Snowpark). * Startup experience or experience in a high\-growth, fast\-paced environment. *Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. jobs.title: Staff Backend Graph Engineer
jobs.description: **Why Socure?** --------------- Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day. We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading. **About the Job** ----------------- Build the graph that decides who’s real. Every day, Socure’s Identity Graph helps businesses decide whether to trust the person on the other side of a screen. It links billions of signals (names, addresses, devices, emails, phones) into one picture of identity, and it does this in milliseconds. Fraudsters move fast. The graph has to be faster. As a Staff Engineer on this team, you’ll set the technical direction for the platform behind that decision. You’ll own hard problems end to end, work across Engineering, Data Science, Product, and Security, and see your work shape the products that protect millions of people. **What You Will Do** -------------------- * Shape the graph. Define the schemas, relationships, and ontology that make identity data consistent and extensible. * Own entity resolution at scale. Decide how records, people, devices, and addresses connect, and how confident we are, across data that is messy, sparse, and sometimes adversarial. * Build for speed and volume. Design batch and real\-time pipelines, low\-latency APIs, and serving systems that hold up under heavy load. * Power fraud intelligence. Ship the production systems behind our ML features, model inference, and graph analytics. * Move the numbers. Improve performance, reliability, and cost, and prove it with measurements. * Set the direction. Lead architecture decisions, document the tradeoffs, and carry initiatives from first design through production rollout. * Raise the bar. Mentor engineers and set the standard for design reviews, testing, CI/CD, and operations. * Protect identity data. Build privacy, security, and PII protection into every system from day one. * Your toolkit:Java, Scala, or Python. Spark, Kafka, Flink, Airflow, and AWS, including EMR. Graph technologies like Neo4j and Amazon Neptune. **What You Will Bring** ----------------------- * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field * 7\+ years building and running distributed systems in the cloud, with at least 2 at Staff or Senior Staff scope, or the equivalent * Production scale you can quantify. You can tell us what you built, how big it was, and how much you improved latency, reliability, or cost * Deep Spark, Kafka, or Flink experience in both batch and streaming, including debugging them in production * Low\-latency serving. You have built and tuned APIs where milliseconds matter * Graph or entity\-resolution experience. You have modeled connected data, matched records across noisy sources, or built an identity graph. Fraud or identity verification is a strong plus * Cloud and operations fluency. AWS, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and real production observability * ML data pipelines on Databricks, SageMaker, or similar, plus orchestration with Airflow or equivalent * Technical leadership. You have led ambiguous, cross\-team work, mentored engineers, and changed the direction of a system through design docs and influence, not authority **What This Job is Not** ------------------------ * It’s not a role for someone who hasn’t owned a system end to end in production, including being on call for it. * It’s not feature work on platforms someone else designed. * It’s not a defined backlog. You’ll frame ambiguous problems yourself. * It’s not a place to treat data privacy as a compliance checkbox. *Socure is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity in all its forms within our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.* *If you need an accommodation during any stage of the application or hiring process—including interview or onboarding support—please reach out to your Socure recruiting partner directly.* **Follow Us!** YouTube \| LinkedIn \| X (Twitter) \| Facebook Compensation Range: $225K \- $250K
