jobs.title: Operations Data Engineering Analyst
jobs.description: **JOB SUMMARY** This position will function as part of the Southern Power Monitoring \& Diagnostics (M\&D) Center, which provides remote monitoring and diagnostic support to the SPC fleet of gas, solar, wind, and energy storage assets. The Operations Data Engineering Analyst supports both operational data infrastructure and AI/ML data readiness. The role assists the PI System Administrator with daily operation, maintenance, and expansion/migration of SPC’s AVEVA PI and AspenTech IP.21 historian environments, including tag management, Asset Framework (AF) configuration, analytics deployment, PI Vision development, data quality monitoring, and proactive remediation. The role also extracts, transforms, curates, and delivers clean, structured datasets from PI and IP.21 into downstream data engineering platforms such as Databricks to support M\&D’s growing AI and machine learning portfolio, including iSight anomaly detection, predictive analytics models, and AI agents. ***In short, this role owns the data journey from raw sensor ingestion in PI through curated, AI\-ready datasets — ensuring the M\&D team always has trusted, high\-quality, well\-engineered data to power both real\-time monitoring and advanced analytics.*** This position will closely interface with the Aveva PI/ AspenTech IP.21 System Administrator, M\&D Analysts, AI/ML Analysts, Renewable Performance Engineers, Renewable, Gas, and Commercial Operations, the SPC Technology Organization, SCADA teams, and plant personnel. **MAJOR JOB RESPONSIBILITIES** **PI/IP.21 System Support** * **Tag Management —** Support the PI/IP.21 Administrator in the creation, modification, scaling, and decommissioning of PI/IP.21 tags across gas, solar, wind, and energy storage assets. Ensure tag naming conventions, point types, and compression settings are consistent with fleet\-wide standards. * **Asset Framework (AF) Configuration —** Create, modify, and delete AF elements, attributes, templates, and hierarchies to reflect fleet changes (new sites, equipment swaps, decommissions). Maintain AF structure integrity across all OEMs (solar inverters, wind turbines, gas turbines, batteries, and BOP equipment). * **AF Analytics Deployment —** Develop, test, and deploy PI AF Analytics (calculated attributes, rollup expressions, event frames) in test and production environments. Validate analytic outputs against expected results prior to production deployment. * **Data Quality Monitoring \& Proactive Remediation —** Continuously monitor data quality across PI and IP.21 platforms — identifying stale tags, flatlined signals, bad values, communication failures, scaling errors, and missing data. Proactively remediate issues before they impact downstream analytics, dashboards, or AI models. Support data surrogation processes where needed. * **PI Vision Development \& Maintenance —** Design, develop, and maintain real\-time PI Vision screens and dashboards for fleet monitoring, equipment health, data quality, and KPI tracking. Update displays as new sites are onboarded or fleet configurations change. * **Site Onboarding Support —** Assist the PI/IP.21 Administrator with integrating new generation and storage sites into the PI/IP.21 System, including interface/connector configuration, tag provisioning, AF buildout, initial data validation, and PI Vision screen creation. * **Data Query Support for Other Teams —** Serve as a resource for operations, performance, and analytics teams who need to extract data from PI/IP.21\. Provide support and guidance using PI DataLink , IP.21 Excel Connector, Python, SQL, PI Web API, and PI Connect to enable self\-service data access and integration with downstream tools. * **Troubleshooting —** Assist in diagnosing and resolving data flow issues, interface communication failures, archive gaps, and system errors within the PI and IP.21 environments. Escalate infrastructure\-level issues to the PI/IP.21 Administrator or IT as appropriate. **Data Engineering \& AI/ML Data Readiness** * **Dataset Curation \& Cleaning —** Build and maintain repeatable data curation pipelines that clean, validate, deduplicate, align timestamps, handle missing values, and resolve data quality issues — producing trusted, well\-documented datasets for AI/ML model training and inference in Databricks. * **AI/ML Data Requirements Engineering —** Partner directly with the AI/ML Analyst to understand model input requirements, feature definitions, labeling schemas, data frequency needs, and quality thresholds. Translate these requirements into actionable data engineering tasks and deliver datasets that meet model specifications. * **Model\-Ready Data Validation —** Validate curated datasets against AI model input specifications — checking for completeness, balance, feature drift, outliers, and schema compliance in/outside Databricks. Flag and resolve data issues before they enter training or inference pipelines. * **Pipeline Monitoring \& Maintenance —** Monitor health and performan :** Experience with AspenTech IP.21, dataPARC , eDNA etc. * **SCADA Systems:** Familiarity with Ignition/other SCADA systems. * **Communications Protocols:** OPC DA/UA, DNP3, Modbus protocols and data acquisition architectures. * **PI Accreditation:** AVEVA / OSIsoft PI System accreditation. **BEHAVIORAL ATTRIBUTES** * Must be able to make timely decisions, apply seasoned judgment , and display personal responsibility. * Demonstrate Southern Company Values: Safety First, Intentional Inclusion, Act with Integrity, and Superior Performance. * Be a team player — able to quickly build good, productive working relationships with the PI Administrator, AI/ML team, operations teams, and technology partners. * Detail\-oriented and proactive — anticipate data quality issues before they impact downstream consumers. * Results\-oriented self\-starter that can work independently while contributing to team objectives. * Creatively solve issues, think outside the box, and find innovative ways to bridge operational data and AI/ML requirements. * Intellectually curious — eager to learn new tools, platforms, and methodologies across both PI System administration and data engineering domains. **Southern Power** , a subsidiary of Southern Company, is a leading U.S. wholesale energy provider meeting the electricity needs of municipalities, electric cooperatives, investor\-owned utilities, and other energy customers. Southern Power and its subsidiaries own 55 facilities operating or under construction in 14 states with more than 12,500 MW of generating capacity in Alabama, California, Delaware, Georgia, Kansas, Maine, Nevada, New Mexico, North Carolina, Oklahoma, South Dakota, Texas, West Virginia, and Washington. Southern Company (NYSE: SO ) is a leading energy provider serving 9 million customers across the Southeast and beyond through its family of companies. Providing clean, safe, reliable and affordable energy with excellent service is our mission. The company has electric operating companies in three states, natural gas distribution companies in four states, a competitive generation company, a leading distributed energy solutions provider with national capabilities, a fiber optics network and telecommunications services. Through an industry\-leading commitment to innovation, resilience and sustainability, we are taking action to meet customers' and communities' needs while advancing our goal of net\-zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050\. Our uncompromising values ensure we put the needs of those we serve at the center of everything we do and are the key to our sustained success. We are transforming energy into economic, environmental and social progress for tomorrow. Our corporate culture has been recognized by a variety of organizations, earning the company awards and recognitions that reflect Our Values and dedication to service. To learn more, visit www.southerncompany.com . Southern Company invests in the well\-being of its employees and their families through a comprehensive total rewards strategy that includes competitive base salary, annual incentive awards for eligible employees and health, welfare and retirement benefits designed to support physical, financial, and emotional/social well\-being. This position may also be eligible for additional compensation, such as an incentive program, with the amount of any bonus/awards subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan(s). A summary of the benefits offered for this position can be found here https://seo.nlx.org/southernco/pdf/SOCO\-Benefits.pdf . Additional and specific details about total compensation and beneﬁts will also be provided during the hiring process. Southern Company is an equal opportunity employer where an applicant's qualifications are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other basis prohibited by law.

The ideal candidate is a hands\-on engineer who can translate complex workflows into intuitive, visually compelling, and functional digital experiences—and independently build the solutions they design. The engineer will initially focus on enhancing existing digital platforms, improving usability, performance, and mobile responsiveness while helping establish a consistent, scalable user experience across the University's broader application ecosystem. The role will also contribute to the design and development of new student\-facing applications and emerging digital initiatives. As our platforms evolve, this position will play an important role in expanding our mobile capabilities, including developing native or cross\-platform applications for iOS and Android. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to progressively assume greater technical ownership, including independently architecting, developing, and deploying complete mobile applications. We are seeking a versatile builder who thrives in a collaborative, fast\-moving environment, embraces AI\-assisted development, and takes ownership of solutions from concept through deployment. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Mobile Application \& Front\-End Development** ------------------------------------------------ * Design, develop, and maintain responsive, mobile\-first web applications and interfaces. * Contribute to the architecture, development, and deployment of student\-facing mobile applications for iOS and Android. * Build reusable, scalable front\-end components that support consistent functionality across multiple platforms. * Translate product requirements, wireframes, and design concepts into production\-ready applications. * Optimize applications for performance, responsiveness, accessibility, and usability across devices. * Integrate front\-end applications with APIs, authentication systems, and existing backend services. **UI/UX Design \& Product Experience** -------------------------------------- * Own the design and implementation of intuitive, engaging user interfaces and experiences. * Develop wireframes, interactive prototypes, user flows, and high\-fidelity interface designs. * Establish and maintain shared design systems, reusable components, and visual standards. * Identify usability challenges and implement practical improvements based on user feedback and product requirements. * Ensure consistency in navigation, accessibility, responsiveness, and visual design across the University's digital platforms. * Balance design quality with technical feasibility, maintainability, and delivery timelines. **Product Engineering \& Execution** ------------------------------------ * Collaborate directly with engineering and product stakeholders to deliver enhancements across existing and emerging digital platforms. * Take ownership of assigned features from initial design through development, testing, deployment, and iteration. * Troubleshoot application issues, improve existing functionality, and contribute to ongoing product optimization and stability. * Collaborate with backend engineers and other technical teams to deliver integrated solutions. * Participate in code reviews, technical planning, architectural discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives. * Contribute as a hands\-on individual engineer in a collaborative, AI\-enabled development environment. **AI\-Assisted Engineering \& Innovation** ------------------------------------------ * Leverage modern AI\-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity, prototyping, debugging, and delivery. * Apply sound engineering judgment when evaluating, validating, and integrating AI\-generated code. * Explore emerging technologies and development approaches that improve the student experience. * Help establish efficient, repeatable development practices without compromising quality, security, or maintainability. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Approximately 4–7\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial hands\-on front\-end development and experience contributing to mobile application development. * Demonstrated experience in front\-end software engineering and building production\-quality user interfaces. * Strong proficiency in JavaScript and/or TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and modern front\-end development frameworks. * Experience with React, Vue, Angular, or comparable component\-based frameworks. * Hands\-on experience  - * A job\-related assessment may be required during the interview process. * Must be able to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation. * **Employment Authorization and Sponsorship:** Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Stanbridge University does not provide employment\-based immigration sponsorship for this position, now or in the future. * Employment verification will be conducted to validate relevant work experience in accordance with applicable accreditation standards and University requirements. * Offers of employment are contingent upon successful completion of a background check, consistent with applicable law. * Official transcripts may be required prior to hire when applicable to the position's educational qualifications. Degrees earned outside the United States may require evaluation by a recognized credential evaluation service to establish U.S. degree equivalency. * Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions. **Work Environment** -------------------- * Standard professional and technology\-focused work environment. * Duties are primarily performed at a desk or computer workstation. * Extensive use of computers, software development environments, cloud services, AI\-assisted development tools, and related technology platforms. * Regular collaboration with cross\-functional teams in an environment involving evolving technical requirements and project deadlines. **Physical Demands** -------------------- * Ability to work at a computer workstation for extended periods, with or without reasonable accommodation. * Regular use of electronic keyboards, computers, and standard office equipment. * Ability to communicate effectively through electronic, verbal, and written channels. * Ability to review and interpret information presented through computer systems and related technologies. * May occasionally be required to lift, carry, or move materials weighing up to 25 pounds, with reasonable accommodation as appropriate. **Employee Benefits** --------------------- * Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * Retirement Plan (401k) * Exciting University Events * Seasonal Motivational Health and Wellness Challenges * Work/Life Balance Initiatives * Onsite Wellness Program / Staff Chiropractor * Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary \& AD\&D) * Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& Public Holidays) * Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity) *Benefits are subject to eligibility requirements and applicable University policies.* **Institutional Values** ------------------------ **Diversity and Inclusion** --------------------------- Stanbridge University's motto, **"Strength through Diversity,"** reflects our commitment to honoring the diverse backgrounds of our students, faculty, staff, and surrounding communities. We strive to build an inclusive learning environment and uphold anti\-discrimination practices in all aspects of University life. **Innovation and Technology** ----------------------------- We embrace innovative technologies to enhance student learning through interactive, hands\-on experiences, including virtual reality and simulation\-based education, preparing students for the demands of modern healthcare practice. **Community Engagement** ------------------------ Through initiatives such as Stanbridge outREACH, students are empowered to give back to local and global communities, cultivating compassion, civic responsibility, and social awareness. **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ Stanbridge University is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other status protected by applicable law. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Staff Firmware Engineer - AMR
jobs.description: **About Standard Bots** ----------------------- Standard Bots' mission is to significantly lower the barrier to entry to real\-world automation, bringing the power of bits to the world of atoms and unlocking productivity for entire new industries and users. Bolt is our mobile manipulation platform: two of our robot arms on an upper body, riding an autonomous mobile base that we are designing and building in\-house. Control systems and embedded engineering are the basis of the entire company's mission, and the mobile base is built on them. **What you'll do** ------------------ We're looking for an exceptional Staff Firmware Engineer to lead the firmware of Bolt's mobile base. This role sets the firmware architecture for that base from the first prototype: drive and motor control, power and battery systems, sensors and I/O, and the communication that ties them to the robot's compute. Your impact will be measured by how quickly the first AMRs come to life on the bench and the test floor, how reliably they run once they leave it, and how strong the firmware team around you becomes. ### **Responsibilities** **Bring\-up and architecture** * **Define the Architecture:** Own the firmware architecture across every controller on the base: partitioning, communication buses, timing, update paths, and diagnostics * **Bring Up the Fleet:** Lead firmware bring\-up for each prototype build with the electrical and mechanical teams, on a hardware schedule that doesn't move. That includes board support packages, drivers, and bootloaders * **Pragmatic Trade\-Offs:** Make clear, pragmatic calls on what each build needs now and what can wait, balancing long\-term vision with timely delivery * **Shape the Hardware:** Partner with electrical engineers from schematic review onward, so every board is easy to bring up, test, and debug * **Standard Setter:** Set the coding standards, review practices, test expectations, and release process for all AMR firmware **Motion, power, and sensors** * **Motion Foundations:** Own firmware for the drive modules and their motor control. That covers current, velocity, and steering loops, encoder feedback, and coordinated control of all wheels * **Power and Batteries:** Own firmware for power sequencing, battery management communication, charging and docking, and battery swap * **Sensors and I/O:** Integrate the sensors and peripherals on the base, and deliver their data reliably to the robot's compute * **Cross\-Team Interfaces:** Define the interfaces between firmware and the navigation, fleet, and safety software, and between the base and Bolt's upper body **Quality and leverage** * **Debug Across Boundaries:** Root\-cause problems that span firmware, electrical, mechanical, and component behavior. Drive them to closure and turn them into prioritized work that prevents recurrence across the fleet * **Systemic Quality:** Build hardware\-in\-the\-loop tests, fault injection, production test firmware, and diagnostic tools that catch problems before they reach a robot * **Technical Multiplier:** Mentor the AMR embedded engineers, review their designs, and help grow the team ### **Software Stack and Ownership Areas** This role owns board bring\-up, motor control, power and battery systems, sensors and I/O, and firmware test tooling for Bolt's mobile base. **Tech Stack** * **Embedded:** STM32 or similar, C / C\+\+, FreeRTOS or similar * **Communications:** CAN, EtherCAT, Ethernet * **Infrastructure \& Tooling:** Python, GitHub Actions, CI/CD, hardware\-in\-the\-loop rigs **Location** ------------ This is an on\-site role at our new Boston\-area office, where Bolt's mobile base is designed, built, and tested. There's some flexibility on days in the office once you're up to speed. The build area, electronics lab, test floor, and robots are steps from your desk. **Who you are** --------------- We're looking for a firmware leader who has taken a battery\-powered robot or vehicle from first boards to a fielded fleet. You lead by writing the hard parts yourself, and you know what it takes for firmware to survive thousands of hours on a factory floor. You're comfortable operating with complete independence. ### **Skills you'll bring** * **Experience:** 8\+ years of embedded firmware development, including leading firmware for a battery\-powered product with motors through production * **Motor Control:** Hands\-on motor control firmware experience (FOC, current sensing, encoders), ideally for traction or steering drives * **Embedded Depth:** Mastery of C / C\+\+ on microcontrollers, RTOS design, real\-time scheduling, interrupts and DMA, and peripheral drivers * **Bring\-Up Skills:** Fluent with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, DMMs, and schematics. You diagnose timing, signaling, and electrical issues at the bench * **Power Systems:** Experience with power sequencing, BMS communication, and charging * **Leadership:** You've led engineers through an NPI cycle and made them better * **Cross\-Functional Influence:** Proven ability to influence technical direction without direct authority and successfully partner with hardware engineering, motion planning, safety, and executive leadership * **Clarity of Communication:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, capable of synthesizing complex technical risks and strategies for non\-technical leadership * **Impact Driven:** You relentlessly seek user impact and value execution over technical idealism * **Proactive Simplicity:** A relentless drive to reduce complexity, improve operational simplicity, and proactively identify organizational\-level technical risks and address them before they become crises * **Excelling in Ambitious Environments:** Your best work happened where hardware deadlines were real and the plan changed weekly ### **Nice to have** * Prior work on mobile robots, AGVs, or autonomous vehicles * Swerve, omnidirectional, or other multi\-wheel steering drive control * Functional safety development (ISO 13849, IEC 61508\) * Over\-the\-air firmware update systems for fielded fleets **Compensation** ---------------- The base salary range for this role is \[$200,000 to $230,000], depending on experience. Base salary is just one part of the overall compensation at Standard Bots. All full\-time employees are eligible for employee stock options. We also offer paid time off, medical, dental, and vision insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, and a 401(k) to regular full\-time employees. Compensation Range: $180K \- $215K

jobs.description: **About the role** ================== Charles River Development (CRD), the FinTech division of State Street, provides cloud\-based front\-office technology that, together with State Street's middle\- and back\-office services, forms the State Street Alpha platform. CRD is modernizing and expanding its platform with cloud\-native technologies. As a UI Developer II, you will contribute to the design, development, testing, and maintenance of user\-facing applications across one or more Charles River or Alpha platform modules. You will work as part of an Agile engineering team, partnering with engineers, business analysts, product managers, and other teams to deliver clear, reliable solutions to complex business problems. This individual\-contributor role works with moderate supervision and provides engineering support to customer\-support and development teams when needed. **Responsibilities** ==================== * Design, develop, test, debug, and maintain user interfaces and single\-page applications, primarily using React, JavaScript, and TypeScript. * Contribute to small\- and medium\-sized enhancements and solutions within the platform's business and technical domains. * Collaborate with engineers, business analysts, and product partners to turn requirements into practical, maintainable software. * Write and maintain unit and automation tests; conduct manual testing to help ensure product quality. * Participate in code reviews, offering constructive feedback and incorporating feedback on your own work. * Troubleshoot software issues and help resolve problems reported by customer\-support or other development teams. * Participate in the Agile development process, including stand\-ups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives. * Coordinate with teammates across functions as needed to complete assignments. * Keep current with relevant UI engineering practices and technologies. **Required qualifications** =========================== * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field; a master's degree is a plus. * 2–5 years of progressively responsible professional software engineering experience. * Demonstrated experience building and maintaining web user interfaces with JavaScript or TypeScript; professional React experience is strongly preferred. * Working knowledge of object\-oriented programming, data structures, and software development fundamentals. * Experience developing, debugging, and testing software, and contributing to projects of small\-to\-medium scope with moderate supervision. * Effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate in a team environment. **Preferred qualifications** ============================ * Experience with React application architecture, reusable component or package development, and state\-management approaches such as Redux or RxJS. * Familiarity with front\-end testing tools such as Jest, Cypress, or Jasmine. * Familiarity with Node.js and package managers such as npm or Yarn. * Experience with Agile software development and code\-review practices. * Familiarity with relational databases and SQL. * Exposure to cloud\-native development, especially Microsoft Azure, or to technologies such as Kafka, Kubernetes, or Snowflake. * Experience in financial technology or knowledge of investment\-management workflows such as portfolio management, trading, compliance, post\-trade, IBOR, or wealth management. * Familiarity with Java or C\#/.NET. **Salary Range:** $70,000 \- $118,750 Annual The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ. *Employees are eligible to participate in State Street’s comprehensive benefits program, which includes: our retirement savings plan (401K) with company match; insurance coverage including basic life, medical, dental, vision, long\-term disability, and other optional additional coverages; paid\-time off including vacation, sick leave, short term disability, and family care responsibilities; access to our Employee Assistance Program; incentive compensation including eligibility for annual performance\-based awards (excluding certain sales roles subject to sales incentive plans); and, eligibility for certain tax advantaged savings plans.* *For a full overview, visit* *https://hrportal.ehr.com/statestreet/Home* *.* **About State Street** ====================== Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. jobs.description: **Description** --------------- Our vision is to ensure that "Washington state's children and youth grow up safe and health\-thriving physically, emotionally and academically, nurtured by family and community" **Job Title:** IT System Administration – Senior Specialist **Location:** Olympia WA, Thurston County (Flexible/Hybrid) **Closes:** November 19th, 2026 **Salary:** $94,620\- $127,248\.00 Annually As a DevOps Engineer, you will help DCYF modernize and improve how technology is delivered by creating automation that makes systems more reliable, secure, and efficient. jobs.title: Jr. Staff Android Engineer
jobs.description: Job ID: 2022704 Career Area: Software Electric \& Electronics Position Type: Salaried Location: Headquarters \& Technology Center – Auburn Hills 48326, US Date Posted: November 4, 2026 Brand: FCA Group **The Mission:** We are building the next generation of connected digital cockpits, bridging high\-performance vehicle hardware with intuitive, cloud\-connected experiences. In this role, you will initially tackle critical platform security and connectivity challenges: establishing hardware\-backed trust with Qualcomm silicon, securing backend communication channels, and tuning network routing inside a virtualized Android environment. At the same time, we don’t believe in rigid silos. While your initial focus will be anchoring these core platform and security foundations, you will be part of an adaptable engineering team. As the platform matures, you will have plenty of room to flex across the broader Android stack—collaborating on core system services, framework features, and user\-facing capabilities across the digital cockpit. **What You Will Work On:** Initial Platform \& Security Focus: * **Hardware\-Backed Trust \&** **mTLS****:** Connect Android’s Keystore / KeyMint layer with Qualcomm TrustZone hardware to safely manage certificates, keys, and token lifecycles for secure mutual TLS (mTLS) communication with the backend. * **Network \& Multi\-APN Routing:** Configure Android networking pipelines, cellular APN policies, and DNS whitelisting to cleanly route private telematics, cloud APIs, and consumer traffic through their intended channels. * **Hypervisor Network Integration:** Work with virtual network interfaces (virtio\-net, bridging) spanning the host hypervisor and the guest Android OS to ensure reliable, high\-throughput data transport. * **Platform Hardening \&** **SELinux****:** Write and refine SELinux policies (sepolicy) and define clean Binder IPC boundaries to keep platform services secure, stable, and compliant. * **Identity \& Secure Transport:** Support user profile isolation (IAM), secure storage for JWTs and session tokens, and reliable telemetry messaging using protocols like MQTT over TLS. Looking Ahead (Generalist \& Platform Evolution): * Build, extend, and maintain Android framework services and system applications that power core cockpit experiences. * Collaborate across teams on modern Android development—from IPC and background services to application logic and developer tooling. * Help shape architecture, code quality, and engineering standards as our software footprint continues to grow. **What We Are Looking For:** * **Strong Android Foundations:** Solid, hands\-on experience developing in Android—comfortable working with Kotlin, Java, and navigating the Android framework. * **Platform \& Systems Curiosity:** Practical experience with, or a strong desire to dive deep into, AOSP internals, native C/C\+\+ services, and Binder/AIDL IPC. * **Security \& Crypto Awareness:** Familiarity with TLS/mTLS, PKI/certificates, token\-based authentication (JWT, OAuth2\), and leveraging Android’s KeyStore or hardware security modules (Qualcomm TrustZone / KeyMint). * **Networking Fundamentals:** A solid grasp of IP networking, DNS, routing concepts, and socket communications in Linux or Android environments. * **Pragmatic Generalist Mindset:** You enjoy solving tough infrastructure and security puzzles, but you’re equally excited to pivot and build feature\-level Android code as team priorities evolve. **EOE/Disability/Veteran** At Stellantis, we assess candidates based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We welcome applications from all people without regard to sex, age, ethnicity, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any characteristic protected by law. We believe that diverse teams reflect our identity as a global company, enabling us to better address the evolving needs of our customers and care for our future. As a global company, our employee packages will vary by country, customary norms and the legal entity into which you are hired. We care about your privacy. jobs.title: Director, Project Engineering
jobs.description: **About Stem** \- *Driven by human and artificial intelligence – Stem is unlocking energy intelligence.* Stem is a global leader reimagining technology to support the energy transition. We help asset owners, operators and stakeholders benefit from the full value of their energy portfolio by enabling the intelligent development, deployment, and operation of clean energy assets. Meant to tackle challenges as seamlessly as possible, Stem shows the information needed clearly and accurately and helps harness raw data to inform actionable insight. At our core, Stem is at the momentous intersection of clean energy and software technology where diverse ideas, experiences, and professional skills converge to make the inclusive culture we have today. Together, we are turning old school thoughts about software and energy into progressive, collaborative, and innovative solutions. By joining our team, you will be collaborating with data scientists, energy experts, skilled salespeople, thought\-leading executives and more from a range of backgrounds. This intersection of ideas, beliefs, and skills is what makes us unique enough to lead the world’s largest network of digitally connected energy storage systems. **Position Overview:** ---------------------- As Director, Project Engineering – Americas, you will lead the Americas engineering organization and own the technical design and implementation of Data Acquisition Systems (DAS), SCADA, Power Plant Controllers (PPC), Energy Management Systems (EMS), and site networking for solar, energy storage, and hybrid projects across BTM and FTM, C\&I, and utility\-scale work. You will ensure engineering deliverables are technically correct, built to standard, and released on time and within budget, and you will scale the organization by turning custom engineering into standard designs and repeatable workflows. This role is the engineering counterpart to the Director of PMO. The PMO owns schedule, scope, and customer delivery. This role owns technical design, engineering quality, and engineering standards. Together, the two roles form the Americas delivery leadership team. The ideal leader is a hands\-on technical expert who can also run an organization. This is someone who enjoys solving hard controls and SCADA problems, and who wants to build the processes, standards, and people that let the team deliver more projects at higher quality. **Organizational Scope:** ------------------------- ### **Direct reports (all based in Broomfield, CO)** * **Manager, Drafting \& Design:** Single\-line diagrams, IFC packages, panel layouts, communication schematics, BOMs, and as\-builts * **Manager, Project Engineering – C\&I:** DAS and monitoring, BTM storage, and C\&I controls and export limiting * **Manager, Project Engineering – Utility:** Utility SCADA, PPC, EMS, FTM BESS, interconnection and grid code compliance, and substation integration ### **Key partners (no direct reporting line)** * Sales, Technical Sales Engineering, PMO, Field Services, Support, and Project Delivery – EMEA **Key Responsibilities:** ------------------------- * **Technical escalation:** Act as the engineering escalation point for complex sites, non\-standard configurations, and technical customer issues, working with Development on advanced product issues. Stay current on grid technology, grid codes, and microgrid architectures, and translate them into design standards. * **Global alignment:** Align engineering procedures and best practices with the EMEA, India, and Japan engineering teams to support a consistent global delivery model. * **Sales support:** Provide engineering review during the sales process, including intake forms, SOWs, risk identification, and budgetary proposals, and gate non\-standard scope before contract. * **Cross\-functional handoffs:** Define clear handoffs with partner teams: field learnings into Product roadmaps, BOM accuracy and engineering change notices with Production, resource loading and engineering hour estimates with the PMO, and Tier 3 escalation paths with Support and Field Services. Measure process performance and improve the highest\-cost handoff points. * **Drafting \& Design:** Maintain drawing standards, symbol libraries, and design templates, and drive automation and reuse of standard design blocks to increase throughput. * **C\ t engineering in business reviews, acting on the SVP’s behalf as delegated. * **Team development:** Lead, mentor, and develop engineering managers, and build growth tracks that develop entry\-level engineers and drafters into senior and leadership roles. **Qualifications:** ------------------- ### **Required** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering field. * 12\+ years of engineering experience in solar, energy storage, or a related power industry. * 5\+ years directly managing engineers, including managers of engineering teams, plus experience managing departmental budget and headcount. * 5\+ years designing or delivering utility\-scale SCADA, PPC, or EMS solutions. * Experience overseeing drafting and design teams producing SLDs, IFC packages, and BOMs. * Knowledge of grid stability, interconnection requirements, and grid codes such as IEEE 1547, IEEE 2800, and NERC IBR requirements. * Demonstrated experience with closed\-loop control design, tuning, and troubleshooting, including PID and feed\-forward architectures. * Working knowledge of Modbus, DNP3, IEC 61850, and OPC protocols; serial, fiber, and Ethernet standards; and OT networking (switches, modems, firewalls, VPNs, LANs, VLANs). * Experience working within a quality management system (design control, change management, RCA/corrective action) and building scalable processes in a growing organization. * Strong communication skills with technical and non\-technical audiences, from field engineers to executives and customers. ### **Preferred** * Experience supporting ISO 9001 or supplier quality audits; internal auditor or ASQ certification. * Experience with Inductive Automation Ignition, SEL controllers, or IEC 61131 programming; Python or C\# scripting. * Background in BESS and hybrid solar\-plus\-storage projects, including OEM integration. * Familiarity with market and regulatory frameworks (CAISO, ERCOT, PJM) and OT cybersecurity standards (NERC CIP, IEC 62443\). * Experience with new market entry or international deployments, especially LATAM; Spanish or Portuguese skills; experience leading globally distributed teams. * Knowledge of PowerTrack, NetSuite, Jira, Confluence, and AutoCAD Electrical. **Location \& Travel** ---------------------- **Location:** Broomfield, CO (Hybrid, 2–3 days per week in office) **Travel:** 10–20%, including customer sites, commissioning, the production facility, and new market development To learn more about Stem, visit our stem.com where you’ll find information about our solutions, technology, partners, case studies, resources, latest news and more. Here are some relevant links: * Company Overview * Newsroom * Insights * LinkedIn **What We Offer:** **At Stem,** you will work in a growing, innovative, mission\-driven company with talented colleagues that have a passion for building renewable energy systems. Stem offers competitive compensation as well as a comprehensive set of benefits to support the health and wellness of our employee including: * A competitive compensation package, including eligibility for a bonus or commission based on the role. * Full health benefits on the first day of employment (several medical plan options\-HDHP and PPO, dental plans, FSA/HSA\-with employer contribution, employer paid vision/LTD/STD/Life, variety of voluntary coverage) * 401k (pre\- or post\-tax) on first day of employment * 12 paid calendar holidays per year * Flexible time\-off **Stem, Inc**. is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity in the workplace and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, pregnancy, religion, national origin, ethnicity, citizenship, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, disability, genetic information, military status, protected veteran status or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. **The pay range for this role is:** 162,480 \- 243,720 USD per year(US National)

jobs.title: Staff Customer Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: At Sysdig, we believe cloud security isn't a compromise \- it's a promise. From the start, our mission has been clear: to help organizations secure innovation in the cloud, the right way. We created Falco, the open standard for cloud threat detection, and continue to lead the cloud security market with runtime insights, open innovation, and agentic Al. Creators of technology trusted by over 60% of the Fortune 500, Sysdig gives teams the real\-time clarity to move fast and defend what matters most. Culture matters here. We believe diversity fuels stronger ideas, and open dialogue drives sharper decisions. Recognized as a Best Place to Work and one of Deloitte's fastest\-growing companies for the past 5 years, we're here to raise the standard for what cloud security and workplace culture should be. If you have the passion to dig deeper, the desire to challenge convention, and the curiosity to build something better, Sysdig is the right place for you. ### **What you will do** * Act as the senior technical owner for the most complex, high\-severity, and strategically important customer issues. * Diagnose difficult problems across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, Linux, networking, identity and access management, observability, integrations, and distributed systems. * Establish and improve standards for troubleshooting, escalation quality, incident readiness, case ownership, and technical documentation. * Build automation, diagnostics, runbooks, and other operational mechanisms that reduce repeat escalations and improve time to resolution. * Coach and mentor CREs through complex case reviews, incident retrospectives, technical training, and day\-to\-day technical guidance. * Develop reusable technical content and enablement that increases the independence and effectiveness of the broader CRE and Support organizations. * Work closely with Escalation Management and account teams on high\-touch customers and customer\-impacting reliability risks. * Participate in the CRE on\-call rotation and provide technical leadership during critical incidents. * Communicate clearly with engineers, executives, customer technical teams, and other stakeholders, adapting the level of detail to the audience. ### **What you will bring with you** * 7\+ years experience in technical support, customer reliability engineering, site reliability engineering, solutions architecture, or a related production engineering discipline. * Expert\-level experience with Kubernetes and Linux in production environments. * Hands\-on experience troubleshooting and operating workloads across one or more major public cloud platforms, such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. * Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language, such as Python, Bash, or Go, with a track record of using automation to improve operational outcomes. * Demonstrated experience leading complex incidents, technical escalations, problem management, or post\-incident improvement efforts. * A track record of converting individual customer problems into scalable improvements, such as product changes, automation, standards, or enablement. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Experience working with enterprise customers in complex, hybrid\-cloud, multi\-cloud, regulated, or highly integrated environments. * Ability to balance urgent customer needs with durable technical solutions and long\-term reliability goals. ### **What we look for** * Work with a technically strong team focused on delivering measurable value to customers. * Help shape how a growing cloud security company operates at enterprise scale. * Collaborate with globally distributed teams across Customer Reliability, Support, Product, Engineering, and SRE. * Contribute to open source technologies that are widely used by cloud\-native teams. * Work in an environment that values diverse perspectives, open dialogue, and continuous learning. ### **When you join Sysdig, you can expect** * Extra days off to prioritize your well\-being * 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with a 3% company match * Maternity and Parental Leave * Mental health support for you and your family through the Modern Health app * Full health benefits package for you and your family The U.S. annual salary range for this full\-time position is between 125,000 and 156,200 USD/year. Actual offers may be higher or lower than this range based on a variety of factors, including your work location, job\-related experience and education. We would love for you to join us! Please reach out even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the job description. We can always explore other options after starting the conversation. Your background and passion will set you apart, especially if your career path is different. *Sysdig values a diverse workplace and encourages women, people of color, LGBTQIA\+ individuals, people with disabilities, members of ethnic minorities, foreign\-born residents, and veterans to apply. Sysdig is an equal\-opportunity employer. jobs.title: Manager, Software Development
jobs.description: **Join the future of news** =========================== We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most. **About Our Team** ------------------ The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award\-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand \& Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering \& Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing \& Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales. **Why This Role Matters** ------------------------- The Washington Post is seeking a Manager, Software Development to lead the engineering team responsible for our iOS app, the foundation for personalization, ads, sections, articles, App Store subscription management, analytics, audio, video and more, and one of The Post’s most important channels for reader engagement. This role provides dedicated people and delivery leadership for the team while partnering closely with Android, Staff Engineering, Product, and shared engineering teams to deliver high\-quality mobile experiences quickly and predictably. This is a hands\-on engineering management role. The Manager, Software Development will set priorities and assignments, develop engineers, remove blockers, identify delivery risks early, and establish clear accountability for delivering approved work to readers, while remaining close enough to the technology to guide difficult engineering decisions. The manager is expected to write code, build prototypes, and review pull requests on a regular basis, and will partner with Staff Engineers and feature leads to verify progress, identify misalignment, and follow work through to release. The ideal candidate combines strong people leadership with deep iOS engineering knowledge, sound technical judgment, and a disciplined approach to execution. This manager will help the team ship faster while maintaining the architecture, performance, reliability, quality, and technical health readers expect from The Washington Post’s flagship mobile experience. The role is data\-driven: priorities, estimates, improvements, and results are tracked against agreed baselines and measured by evidence, such as time to users, commitments met, blocker resolution time, and app stability and performance, not by activity or opinion. **What Motivates You** * You want to help bring The Washington Post’s journalism to readers through high\-quality mobile experiences. * You measure success by the value delivered to users and how quickly it reaches them. * You develop engineers through direct feedback and clear expectations, and you judge your impact by their growth. * You care about predictable execution. You know the real remaining work, test whether estimates and status reports are credible, and surface risk before it becomes a missed commitment. * You want to stay technically hands\-on, writing code, prototyping, and reviewing pull requests to solve problems, evaluate approaches, and stay connected to the systems your team builds. * You care deeply about mobile architecture, application quality, performance, reliability, and maintainability. * You enjoy removing blockers and working across engineering and product teams to move complex work forward, while leaving ownership with the people who hold it. * You hold yourself to the standard you set for others: you own your commitments, communicate risk early, and confirm that issues are closed. * You look for wasted effort and ways to improve how teams work, and you measure whether those improvements create value. * You enjoy building AI agents and automation that solve real mobile engineering problems, and you care about proving that they work and that people actually use them. * You stay current on the iOS ecosystem, including new Apple platform releases, Swift language and concurrency changes, and AI\-assisted development in Xcode, and you know which changes are worth adopting and when. **How You’ll Support the Mission** * Lead and develop the software engineers responsible for The Washington Post’s iOS app, providing timely feedback, career development, performance management, and coaching that builds independent ownership and accountability. * Establish priorities and assignments, set delivery baselines, and track progress against estimates through to availability for users. Report on measures such as time to users, commitments met by the agreed date, and blocker resolution time, and surface material delivery risks early with clear facts, tradeoffs, and decisions needed. * Address performance concerns promptly and directly, set clear expectations, and confirm that behavior and results improve. * Partner with the Android Manager, Staff Engineers, Product, feature leads, and shared teams to se e changes. * Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, version control, and software delivery practices for production mobile applications. * Strong communication and problem\-solving skills, with experience partnering effectively with Product, senior technical contributors, other engineering teams, and cross\-functional stakeholders, including escalating material risks promptly. * Experience defining and using engineering metrics and delivery data, including baselines and targets, to identify bottlenecks, make decisions, and demonstrate improvement in team effectiveness. * Working knowledge of the current iOS platform, Swift, and Xcode tooling. **Preferred Qualifications** * Deep experience developing and releasing large\-scale consumer iOS applications to the App Store. * Experience with modern iOS technologies such as SwiftUI, UIKit, Swift Concurrency, App Intents, Apple’s latest design system, on\-device AI frameworks, or comparable technologies; familiarity with Objective\-C and Kotlin Multiplatform. * Experience with mobile performance optimization, debugging, memory management, and application reliability. * Experience integrating RESTful APIs, third\-party SDKs, or other services into native mobile applications. * Experience leading teams responsible for the full mobile application lifecycle, including architecture, development, automated testing, CI/CD, release, observability, and production support. * Experience coordinating engineering work across iOS, Android, backend, platform, or other shared technical teams. * Experience improving engineering productivity, delivery predictability, or development processes and measuring the impact of those improvements. * Experience mentoring engineers across career levels and partnering effectively with Staff\-level or other senior technical contributors. * Hands\-on experience building AI agents or automation that solve real iOS or mobile engineering problems, with verification of the output and measured benefit. * Experience with agentic development workflows in Xcode and with connecting agents to engineering tools such as issue trackers, CI, crash reporting, and source control, for example through Model Context Protocol (MCP). **Collaboration makes us stronger. That’s why our offices are designed with open layouts, modern technology, and easy access to transportation. With certain exceptions for newsgathering and business travel, we work on\-site five days a week.** --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- Wherever you are in your life or career, The Washington Post offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits for every step of your journey: * Competitive medical, dental and vision coverage * Company\-paid pension and 401(k) match * Three weeks of vacation and up to three weeks of paid sick leave * Nine paid holidays and two personal days * 20 weeks paid parental leave for any new parent * Robust mental health resources * Backup care and caregiver concierge services * Gender affirming services * Pet insurance * Free Post digital subscription * Leadership and career development programs *Benefits may vary based on the job, full\-time or part\-time schedule, location, and collectively bargained status.* The salary range for this position is: $144,600 \- $241,100 Annual The actual salary within this range will depend on individual skills, experience, and qualifications as they relate to specific job requirements. This position may be eligible for a bonus or incentive program, and a member of the Talent Acquisition team will discuss bonus payment terms and conditions during the interview process. **Your story awaits. Apply today!** =================================== Learn more about The Post at careers.washingtonpost.com.

jobs.title: Principal Real-Time Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Thea Energy:** Thea Energy is leveraging recent breakthroughs in stellarator physics and engineering to create a faster and simpler approach to commercializing fusion energy. The company is reinventing the stellarator using computer\-controlled arrays of planar coils thereby replacing the intricate, complex modular magnets required in all other stellarator architectures. Thea Energy is on a mission to create a limitless source of zero emission energy for a sustainable future. **Position Overview:** We are seeking a Principal Real\-Time Software Engineer to design, develop, and deploy the real\-time software framework supporting the Eos Control System. Working with the controls and physics teams, you will develop the common execution environment, interfaces, and engineering practices that allow plasma control, magnet and power supply control, real\-time diagnostics, and other time\-critical applications to operate as an integrated system. This role combines substantial hands\-on software development with architecture, hardware integration, verification, commissioning, and operational support. You will work closely with controls engineers, plasma physicists, diagnostic specialists, electrical engineers, and subsystem owners to turn experimental and plant requirements into reliable, maintainable real\-time software. ### **Key Responsibility Areas:** * Develop the architecture and implementation of the Eos real\-time framework in collaboration with controls and subsystem engineers, including execution services, component interfaces, configuration, deployment, diagnostics, and integration across control subsystems. * Evaluate MARTe2 and other established fusion real\-time frameworks against Eos requirements. Develop prototypes and performance measurements to support engineering decisions on reuse, adaptation, and custom development. * Translate control and diagnostic needs into measurable requirements for cycle times, end\-to\-end latency, jitter, synchronization accuracy, throughput, availability, and resource margins. Define timing budgets and acceptance criteria by application. * Establish modular boundaries between control algorithms, hardware interfaces, operating\-system services, and supervisory functions so components can be tested independently and reused across Eos. Build deterministic execution services * Develop production\-quality C/C\+\+ framework components for multirate execution, scheduling, interprocess communication, shared memory, signal exchange, and controlled application lifecycle transitions. * Engineer and tune real\-time Linux platforms, including CPU and interrupt affinity, memory locking, NUMA placement, scheduling policies, and bounded concurrency. Identify and remove sources of unpredictable latency. * Develop reusable hardware abstraction and I/O interfaces for digitizers, FPGA systems, timing hardware, power supply controllers, and diagnostic equipment; address drivers, DMA, buffering, and data movement where required. * Design distributed data exchange and timing interfaces, selecting shared memory, deterministic networks, PCIe, RDMA, or other technologies according to measured latency and reliability needs. * Work with physics and controls specialists to deploy control algorithms, observers, estimators, and real\-time diagnostic processing. Support interfaces to model\-based development and generated code where appropriate. * Define interfaces with supervisory control, PLCs, interlocks, machine protection, and independent safety systems. Document command authority, permissives, fault propagation, and responsibility for safe responses. * Integrate time stamps, data quality indicators, configuration provenance, and data capture with the Eos data infrastructure to support reproducible experiments and fault investigation. * Provide simulation, software\-in\-the\-loop, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop interfaces that allow the framework and subsystem applications to be exercised before integrated plant operation. * Develop automated functional, integration, regression, and timing tests on representative hardware. Assess worst\-case execution behavior, latency distributions, jitter, and deadline compliance under realistic workloads. * Create fault\-injection, endurance, and recovery tests covering device failures, dropped or delayed data, process and network faults, and loss of timing synchronization. * Participate directly in laboratory integration and commissioning. Diagnose issues across application software, operating systems, networks, and hardware, and turn operational findings into durable improvements. * Contribute to architecture and design reviews, develop coding and interface standards, and produce clear architecture documents, interface specifications, developer guidance, and operating procedures. * Engage with fusion laboratories, framework maintainers, research collaborators, and suppliers to assess technology maturity and incorporate relevant experience into the Eos  urrency, atomic operations, memory models, resource ownership, and techniques for controlling execution time and memory use. * Deep practical experience with Linux\-based real\-time systems, such as RedHawk Linux or PREEMPT\_RT, and diagnosing latency across application code, the kernel, hardware, and I/O. * Experience with an established fusion real\-time framework or plasma control infrastructure, such as MARTe2, ITER real\-time infrastructure, or an equivalent deployed system. * Experience integrating high\-speed data acquisition and hardware I/O, along with distributed communication, timing, and synchronization for feedback control. * Strong software engineering practices, including version control, code review, automated testing, reproducible builds, configuration management, and technical documentation. * Ability to translate scientific and engineering requirements into implementable software, communicate architectural tradeoffs clearly, and carry complex technical work through deployment. ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Direct MARTe2 development experience, including Generic Application Modules, DataSources, brokers, real\-time states and threads, custom components, and integration with external systems. * Experience with stellarators, superconducting magnet systems, high\-current power supplies, plasma heating systems, or coordinated control across multiple fusion subsystems. * Familiarity with EPICS, MDSplus, ITER CODAC, or comparable supervisory control and scientific data environments. * Experience with NI PXI or CompactRIO, Speedgoat, MATLAB/Simulink, LabVIEW Real\-Time, FPGA interfaces, or integration of automatically generated control code. * Experience with PTP, hardware triggers, event timing systems, PCIe/DMA, RDMA, or high\-performance diagnostic data paths. * Experience deploying AI/ML inference or computationally intensive physics algorithms within measured timing and resource limits, including CPU/GPU integration where appropriate. * Contributions to reusable scientific software, real\-time frameworks, open\-source projects, or relevant fusion controls publications. ### **Company Benefits:** * Salary Range: $200,000 \- $230,000 per year * Comprehensive health benefits (e.g. medical/dental/vision) * Employee equity stock options * 20 days PTO ### **Requirements:** * Ability to occasionally lift up to 50 lbs. * Ability to perform activities such as typing, standing, or sitting for extended periods of time. * Willingness to occasionally travel or work required nights/weekends/on\-call. * Ability to work in a facility that contains industrial hazards including heat, cold, noise, fumes, strong magnets, high voltage, high current, pressure systems, and cryogenics. It’s not necessary to meet all of the skillsets outlined above. Please feel free to send us a note and tell us why you would still be a great fit for this role or Thea Energy. **Diversity and Inclusion:**Thea Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a company of diverse backgrounds. By creating a diverse environment, we will bring new ideas and approaches to solving some of the world’s hardest (and most important) problems. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, family or marital status, age, disability, veteran’s status, or other characteristic protected by applicable laws and regulations. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.description: ### **Our Mission** As humans, there are few things more exciting than meeting someone new. At Tinder, we’re inspired by the challenge of keeping the magic of human connection alive. With tens of millions of users, hundreds of millions of downloads, 2\+ billion swipes per day, 20\+ million matches per day, and a presence in 190\+ countries, our reach is expansive—and rapidly growing. We work together to solve complex problems. Behind the simplicity of every match, we think deeply about human relationships, behavioral science, network economics, AI and ML, online and real\-world safety, cultural nuances, loneliness, love, sex, and more. ### **Our Values** * **Take the Lead:** We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down. * **Move Fast:** We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today. * **Better Together:** We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate. * **Real Talk:** We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect Team Tinder to do the same. * **Safety First:** We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us. * **Spark Fun:** We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters. **The Team or Role** -------------------- Agents now do real work at Tinder. They review code, security risks, accessibility, make UI improvements, help marketing teams with their workflows, and run inside engineers' coding tools and in Slack. Every one of them reaches our internal systems through our agent platform: a gateway, a growing set of MCP connectors, and the identity, policy and observability layers around them. We're hiring the engineer who owns that platform's design and functions by closely collaborating with internal teams on real use cases. You'll make it safe by default for agents that can read sensitive data and take consequential actions, fast and reliable enough that teams want to build on it, and simple enough that the next connector or agent takes days, not weeks. **Where you’ll work:** ---------------------- This is a hybrid role and requires in\-office collaboration three times per week in our Palo Alto, California office. ### **In this role, you will:** * Work closely with internal teams to build real solutions for challenges they are facing day to day. * Own the design of the agent platform across gateway, connectors, identity, policy, guardrails, observability and cost, and write the roadmap for how it evolves. * Design identity and delegation for agents: acting on behalf of a user, agent\-owned identities for unattended jobs, short\-lived scoped credentials, and every action traceable to a responsible human. * Build access control beyond tool allowlists: per\-action, per\-argument and per\-data\-class policy, human approval for irreversible actions, and policy that's reviewable and tested. * Build guardrails enforced at the tool boundary, not in prompts, against prompt injection through tool output, confused\-deputy access, data exfiltration and over\-broad scopes. * Make agent behavior observable: traces of tool calls and decisions, audit trails investigators can use, evals that catch regressions when models or prompts change, and per\-team cost attribution. * Set the bar for connectors and third\-party MCP servers: onboarding, review, versioning, sandboxing and safe defaults. * Run the platform as production and own its on\-call: latency budgets, failure modes, rate limits and quotas, kill switches and incident response. * Partner with Security, our forward deployed engineers and platform teams, and mentor the engineers who build on and contribute to the platform. ### **You'll need:** * Great communication and collaboration skills, experience working with real challenges of customer * 8\+ years building backend, infrastructure or platform systems that other teams depend on, with recent hands\-on work on LLM agents, tool use or MCP. * Experience shipping identity or authorization systems: OAuth 2\.0 and OIDC, token exchange or delegation, service identity, and policy models (RBAC, ABAC or relationship\-based). * An attacker's mindset about agent systems, and the ability to explain why prompt\-level defenses aren't enough. * Experience operating gateways, proxies or other services in the critical request path, including on\-call, observability and incident response. * Strong skills in Python or TypeScript, and daily use of AI coding tools with a clear sense of where they fail. * A track record of working well with security teams and impatient internal customers, turning "no" into a safe "yes, like this." ### **Nice to have:** * Experience with policy engines or workload identity. * Built or operated an LLM gateway, model router or MCP server in production. * Familiarity with OpenTelemetry and tracing for non\-deterministic systems. * Contributions to agent identity or MCP authorization standards. * Engineering background in application protection, identity and access management, or threat detection and incident response. $225,000 \- $265,000 a year The salary range for this position is $225,000 \- $265,000\. Factors such as scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/training, job\-related skills, internal peer equity, as well as market and business considerations may influence base pay offered. This salary range is reflective of a position based in Palo Alto. This salary will be subject to a geographic adjustment (according to a specific city and state), if an authorization is granted to work outside of the location listed in this posting. ### **As a full\-time employee, you’ll enjoy:** * Flexible Vacation, 10 Sick Days * Time off to volunteer and charitable donations matched up to $15,000 annually * Comprehensive health, vision, and dental coverage * 100% 401(k) employer match up to 10%, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) * 100% paid parental leave (including for non\-birthing parents) and family forming benefits * Investment in your development: mentorship through our MentorMatch program, access to 6,000\+ online courses through Udemy, and an annual $3,000 stipend for your professional development * Investment in your wellness: access to mental health support via Modern Health, paid concierge medical membership, pet insurance, fitness membership subsidy, and commuter subsidy * Free subscription to Tinder Gold **Commitment to Inclusion** At Tinder, we don’t just accept difference, we celebrate it. We strive to build a workplace that reflects the rich diversity of our members around the world, and we value unique perspectives and backgrounds. Even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications, we invite you to apply and show us how your skills could transfer. Tinder is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace where we welcome people of all sexes, gender identities, races, ethnicities, disabilities, and other lived experiences. reliability, and cost. * Collaborate \& mentor: Share expertise with peers, lead code reviews, and contribute to team standards and technical roadmaps. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related field. * 7\+ years of professional data engineering experience, preferably supporting manufacturing or industrial environments. * tight deadlines. * Experience integrating and modeling data from Microsoft Dynamics 365 / AX / NAV or other ERP systems. * Familiarity with manufacturing domain data sources (PLC historians, MES, quality, supply\-chain). * Power BI report development and DAX optimization skills. * Exposure to DevOps practices: CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps/GitHub), Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Bicep/Terraform). * Knowledge of data governance frameworks (Purview, data cataloging, lineage). * Excellent communication—able to explain technical concepts to non\-technical audiences. * Collaborative mindset and willingness to mentor junior engineers. * Self\-starter with strong organizational skills and attention to detail. * Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and best practices. * Data governance leadership. * RPA experience. **What We Expect of Our Applicants and Future Employees:** * Honesty — you tell the truth, even when it's uncomfortable, and you don't hide mistakes or shortcuts. * Integrity — you do the right thing, even when no one is watching or when it would be easier not to. * Diversity — you respect people who look, think, and work differently than you do. * Quality — you take pride in your work and hold yourself to a high standard, no matter the task. * Respect — you treat everyone with courtesy, from the person next to you on the line to the person in the corner office. * Responsibility — you follow through on what you say you'll do, without needing to be reminded. * Accountability — when you make a mistake, you own it, learn from it, and help fix it. **Hours and Pay:** We offer a competitive base pay rate and comprehensive benefits package for full\-time employees. This role works standard business hours Monday – Friday with night and weekend hours as needed to meet business needs. **Physical and Mental Demands:** * While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit, hear, use hands to type data, use a personal computer and telephone. This employee may occasionally have to operate business machines and lift and/move up to 50 pounds. * Specific vision abilities required in this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * Mental demands include multi\-tasking, decision making, problem solving, comparing, copying, computing, compiling, analyzing, coordinating, and synthesizing data. * Potential for exposure to chemicals, heights, loud noises, mechanical equipment, wet environments, and other potential hazards exists. **Safety Statement:** At Trilliant and Horseshoe, safety is every employee’s first responsibility. All personnel may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed. * Responsible for following food safety/regulatory policies and procedures, executing responsibilities as identified in standard operating procedures, and reporting food safety/regulatory concerns to the Production or Quality Manager. * Trilliant Food \& Nutrition and Horseshoe Beverage Company are Drug Free Workplaces. jobs.description: **About Trimark Associates** **Trimark Associates** is a leader in SCADA software, metering services, and system integration for the U.S. power industry. This position is not eligible for employment\-based visa sponsorship now or in the future, including participation in STEM OPT training plans (Form I\-983\). **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** * Experience with **SQL Server** (writing queries, data analysis and troubleshooting; performance tuning and database management are a plus) * Understanding of **relational database fundamentals** (transactions, indexing, ACID, DML/DDL) * Experience troubleshooting **web applications and RESTful APIs** * Exposure to **Windows Server** environments and administration * Ability to read and understand **C\#/.NET code** for debugging and issue analysis * Working knowledge of **HTML and JavaScript** for troubleshooting front\-end issues * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills in complex systems * Ability to support **time\-sensitive, high\-availability environments** * Clear communication skills for working across technical and non\-technical teams We don’t expect candidates to have deep expertise in all areas, but strong fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly are essential. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with **PostgreSQL and time\-series data** (e.g., TimescaleDB) * **Linux system administration** experience * Familiarity with **Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized environments** * Understanding of **TCP/IP networking fundamentals** * Experience with **Azure**, especially relational database services and monitoring (e.g., Application Insights) * Development experience with **.NET/C\#** or other modern languages (JavaScript/TypeScript, Java) * Familiarity with **Git/source control** and Agile development practices * Understanding of **object\-oriented design principles** * Experience with **SCADA systems or energy/utilities environments** * Familiarity with industrial protocols such as **Modbus and DNP3** **Why This Role** * Work on **high\-impact systems** that support the electrical grid. jobs.description: **The Opportunity** * *This position is based out of our Greenwood Village, Colorado office and requires regular, in‑person attendance.* Ulteig is looking for a Software Engineer who is a Computer Science graduate seeking their first professional software engineering role and who is excited to build with modern AI technologies. This position is within Digital Transformation; Ulteig defines digital transformation as: The deliberate use of digital technologies to modify or create business processes, customer experiences, and enable organizational culture in response to or anticipation of changes in the market, customer insights, and business needs. This role is ideal for graduates who are AI builders—engineers who actively leverage AI tools such as agents, large language models, and modern AI frameworks to create software, while also understanding the core computer science principles, patterns, and practices that make solutions reliable, scalable, and safe.
