AI Builder Mindset * Leverage AI coding assistants and techniques to accelerate development while understanding *why* the generated code works. * Apply emerging AI patterns (such as prompt design, retrieval, and tool‑use concepts) in practical, supervised settings. * Learn when AI is the right tool—and when traditional software patterns are more appropriate. * Develop an ethical, secure, and responsible approach to using AI in real business workflows. Collaboration \& Growth * Collaborate with software engineers, product partners, and business stakeholders in a team‑based environment. * Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and sprint ceremonies. * Ask thoughtful questions, seek feedback, and continuously improve your technical skills. * Engage in training, workshops, and learning opportunities focused on AI, cloud, and modern software development. **What We Expect from You** Education \& Early Experience * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a closely related field. * This role is intended for new or recent graduates (internships, co‑ops, academic projects, or personal projects are great). * Demonstrated interest in AI and modern software development through coursework, projects, hackathons, research, or self‑directed learning. Technical Foundations * Working knowledge of at least one programming language, such as C\#, Python, Java, or similar. * Solid understanding of core computer science concepts, including: * + Data structures and data handling + APIs and basic system design + Basic design patterns * Introductory exposure to AI / Machine Learning or Generative AI concepts is strongly preferred (academic or hands‑on). * Familiarity with using AI tools (copilots, chat‑based assistants, etc.) for coding or problem\-solving is a requirement. Mindset \& Potential * Strong curiosity and enthusiasm for building, experimenting, and learning. * Comfortable using AI to accelerate work while valuing engineering fundamentals and good design. * Growth mindset with openness to coaching, feedback, and continuous improvement. * Responsible and thoughtful approach to using AI technologies. * Motivated self‑starter who takes ownership of learning and assigned work. * Demonstrates openness to innovation by embracing and applying evolving technology and AI tools to enhance workflows, solve problems, and drive continuous improvement. * Must have authorization to work permanently in the U.S. Why This Role This role is intentionally designed as a launchpad. Working at Ulteig is more than a job, opening opportunities to make an impact by creating and solving for a sustainable future. We recognize our success relies heavily on the dedication and focus of our workforce; this is why we make investing in our employees a top priority. jobs.title: AI Software Engineer
jobs.description: Description: **Who We Are** United Imaging is a leading global medical device developer and supplier with a diversified portfolio of advanced medical products, digital healthcare solutions, and intelligent solutions that cover the entire process of imaging diagnosis and treatment. Join our innovative team with the mission of developing and supplying advanced technologies and improving patient care worldwide. As part of our global team, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with talented and dedicated colleagues while developing and expanding your career. **Company Page:** http://www.united\-imaging.com/en/home/ **Benefits \& Compensation** When joining our team, we offer the following benefits: medical, dental, vision, short\- \& long\-term disability insurance, employee assistance program, company paid basic life insurance, 401(k) with employer match, paid time off, sick leave, and (12\) paid holidays. Compensation decisions are based upon the candidate level of skill, qualifications, geographical location and experience, and it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the posted pay range. Additionally, the position may also be eligible to earn performance\-based incentive compensation (such as cash bonus(es)). **Job Description** The AI Software Engineer designs, develops, and maintains AI\-powered software that supports United Imaging’s business operations, combining strong software engineering skills with hands\-on experience applying large language models. The engineer works with business users across quality, manufacturing, finance, HR, and R\&D to translate operational needs into reliable software solutions, ensuring stability, security, and maintainability. Responsibilities include gathering requirements, defining system functionality, developing algorithms, and writing production code, primarily in Python and TypeScript. In this role, you will focus on applied AI for Speed, United Imaging’s in\-house AI workspace platform. Speed gives employees an AI assistant and AI agents that work across company files, collaboration tools such as Lark and Microsoft Outlook, and business systems: answering questions, analyzing documents and spreadsheets, running Python analyses in a secure sandbox, automating approval and reporting workflows, and supporting quality reviews of manufacturing records. You will design, build, evaluate, and ship the large language model (LLM) capabilities behind these features, working end to end from use\-case discovery with business users to production deployment and measurement of impact. **Key Responsibilities:** * Understanding of the business operational process and providing software solutions. * Develop flowcharts, layouts and documentation to identify requirements and solutions. * Produce specifications and determine operational feasibility, integrate software components into a fully functional software system, develop software verification plans and quality assurance procedures * Document and maintain software functionality, comply with project plans and process requirements, deploy programs, evaluate feedback and upgrade software. * Design and build LLM\-powered features for Speed, including tool\-calling AI agents, multi\-step workflow automation, and conversational assistants grounded in company documents and business systems. * Develop retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) and knowledge\-base capabilities: document parsing (PDF, Word, Excel, scanned forms), chunking, embeddings, vector search, and answers that cite their sources. * Apply AI to document review in regulated workflows, such as AI\-assisted review of medical device manufacturing and quality records (e.g., Device History Records), with human\-in\-the\-loop sign\-off and full traceability. * Build evaluation pipelines for AI features (labeled datasets, offline replay of real runs, precision/recall and task\-success metrics, regression checks for prompt and model changes) and use them to drive measurable quality improvements. * Integrate and operate commercial LLM APIs and self\-hosted open\-weight models, balancing quality, latency, and token cost through model routing, context management, and prompt caching, while meeting enterprise data\-privacy and security requirements. * Partner with business users in quality, manufacturing, finance, HR, and R\&D to identify high\-value AI use cases, prototype quickly, ship to production, and measure adoption and impact. Requirements: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related fields * Proficient in Python and TypeScript, with experience using source code management tools such as Git. * Hands\-on experience building and shipping applications on large language models (e.g., OpenAI GPT, or open\-weight models such as Qwen or Llama), including prompt engineering, function/tool calling, structured outputs, and streaming. * Experience with retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG): embeddings, vector search (e.g., pgvector or a dedicated vector database), and evaluating retrieval quality. * Strong Python skills, including building backend services and REST APIs (e.g., FastAPI, asynchronous programming). * Experience designing quantitative evaluations for AI/ML systems (test sets, metrics, error analysis) and using the results to guide improvements. * Complex problem\-solving skills and Critical thinking, strong interest in technology and strong IT skills * Communications skills and professional proficiency in written and spoken English **Preferred Skills \& Experience:** * Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field. * Experience building AI agents (multi\-step planning, tool use, sub\-agents, memory) or with the Model Context Protocol (MCP). * Experience serving open\-weight models on premises (e.g., vLLM, GPU inference, quantization). * Experience with document AI: OCR, layout and table extraction, and vision\-language models for PDFs, spreadsheets, and scanned forms. * Full\-stack experience with TypeScript, React/Next.js, PostgreSQL, and Redis. * Experience integrating enterprise platforms such as Lark or Microsoft 365 (Graph API) through OAuth and REST APIs. * Experience with Medical Imaging related projects * Passion for solving complex technical challenges with innovative ideas **Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion** United Imaging is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Diversity, equity, and inclusion matter. United Imaging provides equal employment opportunities to all applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type regarding race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. **Working Conditions:** *Magnetic Environment Exposure:* This position requires working in an environment where strong magnetic fields may be present. Employees may be exposed to powerful magnets, electromagnetic equipment, or other devices that generate magnetic fields. *Risk to Ferrous Metals in the Body:* Due to the nature of the magnetic environment, employees must **not** wear or carry ferrous metals on their person while in the designated work area. This includes, but is not limited to, metal objects such as steel, iron, and other ferrous materials. Additionally, employees with implants, medical devices, or foreign objects containing ferrous metals within their body (e.g., certain surgical implants, pacemakers, or metal pins) may be at risk and must disclose any such conditions to their supervisor prior to starting work. **Are You Looking for Something Different?**To learn more about United Imaging, visit our company page (https://www.united\-imaging.com/en) and check us out on LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/company/united\-imaging\-healthcare/)

jobs.title: Lead Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. UMG workloads use GCP and BigQuery; experience with services such as Vertex AI, Dataflow, or Cloud Composer is valuable, while equivalent AWS or cloud\-agnostic experience is also relevant. * Experience building and operating data pipelines, distributed systems, APIs, services, workflow orchestration, model serving, batch or online inference, and refresh or retraining processes. * Ability to collaborate across technical and business disciplines, communicate tradeoffs clearly, take ownership without formal authority, and choose a simpler reliable solution when it is better than a more complex model. **Especially valuable** ----------------------- * Experience in music, media, entertainment, streaming marketplaces, advertising, or another industry where culture, consumer behavior, and business conditions change rapidly. * Experience working with complex non\-tabular data, such as audio, text, images, or video. * Experience building decision\-support products and automated workflows rather than standalone models or static dashboards. * Experience establishing model governance, data provenance, copyright safety protocols, or human\-in\-the\-loop review systems. * Experience building systems for artist discovery, catalog understanding, fan marketing, rights management, fraud detection, or trust and safety. **Perks Playlist:** Join an entrepreneurial, global organization where authenticity, boldness, creativity, connection, drive, and insight aren’t just values—they’re how we work every day. Here are some of the ways we support you along the way (and just a few of the benefits we offer): * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * Including 100% coverage for out\-patient in\-network mental health services * Fertility coverage for eligible medical plan participants * Wellbeing reimbursements for fitness classes, spa treatments, meal services, travel, and so much more (up to $720/year) * Student Loan Repayment Assistance and Tuition Reimbursement * **401(k) with 100% immediate vesting** on the first 5% of your contributions, plus an additional UMG contribution A variety of ways to prioritize much\-needed time away from work including: * Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) for exempt employees * 3\-weeks PTO for non\-exempt employees * 2\-weeks paid Winter Break * 10 Company Holidays (including Juneteenth and Wellbeing Day) * Summer Fridays (between Memorial Day and Labor Day) * Generous paid parental leave for every type of parent Check out our full overview of benefits on the Perks Playlist page of the career site. **Disclaimer: This job description only provides an overview of job responsibilities that are subject to change.** **Universal Music Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer** We are an E\-Verify employer in Alabama, Arizona, Georgia, Mississippi, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, and Utah. Please note, UMG is not enrolled in E\-Verify in California and New York, and cannot support employment of candidates whose employer must enroll in E\-Verify, for example candidates on STEM\-OPT. jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Products - MCP Manager
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Hybrid: New York, NY (2\-3 days per week in office). The office is located in Midtown West, less than a 10\-minute walk from Port Authority and under 5 minutes from Penn Station and Herald Square. **SHAPE THE FUTURE OF AI GOVERNANCE WITH USERCENTRICS** ------------------------------------------------------- Usercentrics is a global leader in consent management, and now we're bringing that same mission of trust and control into the AI era. MCP Manager (MCPM) is our newest product: a governance and management platform for Model Context Protocol (MCP), the emerging standard that connects AI agents to business systems like Salesforce, Confluence, Slack, and GitHub. As AI adoption accelerates, enterprises face a new and urgent challenge: how do you give teams the power of AI agents while maintaining visibility, security, and control over what those agents can access and do? MCP Manager is the answer, serving as the trust and control layer for AI agent connections. This is a category\-creation opportunity. MCP is being compared to the invention of the USB connector for AI: a universal standard that changes everything. We're looking for a Software Engineer who wants to be on the ground floor of defining that category and to build the product enterprises rely on to govern their AI agents. **THE ROLE** ------------ As a Software Engineer on the MCP Manager team, you will build the features customers use to govern their AI agents, such as gateway configuration, identity and access policies, and audit logging. You will split your time evenly between our Vue.js front end and our Python/Django and TypeScript back end, all running on Google Cloud Platform. You will work closely with our Product Manager, our designer, and your fellow engineers to take features from spec to production, and you will own the quality of what you ship. You will join a small, high\-ownership engineering team that operates like a startup inside a larger company, with a short path from customer feedback to shipped code. The role exists now because buyers are moving from AI experiments to production agent rollouts, and they need the governance layer beneath those agents to keep pace with new MCP servers, clients, and security requirements. **YOUR TASKS** -------------- ### **Feature Development** * Design, build, and ship features across the full stack, from Vue.js interfaces to Python/Django and TypeScript services. * Turn product specs and designs into working software, raising questions and tradeoffs early with product and design. * Design clear APIs and data models that other engineers can understand and extend. ### **Quality \& Reliability** * Write automated tests alongside your code and help keep the test suite fast and reliable. * Review teammates' pull requests thoughtfully and respond constructively to feedback on your own. * Investigate and fix bugs, including issues escalated from customers, by tracing problems across the front end, back end, and infrastructure. ### **AI\-Assisted Development** * Use Claude Code and other AI coding assistants every day to plan, write, test, and review code, while taking full ownership of everything you ship. * Share techniques that make the team faster and help refine how we use AI tooling in our engineering practices. ### **Collaboration \& Growth** * Contribute to planning and technical discussions with honest estimates and early warnings about risk. * Build a working understanding of MCP and of how enterprises connect AI agents to their business systems. * Document what you build so that teammates and future engineers can pick it up quickly. **Requirements** * 3 or more years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping production web applications. * Strong proficiency in TypeScript and experience with a modern front\-end framework, ideally Vue.js. * Experience building back\-end services and APIs in Python, ideally with Django. * A solid understanding of relational databases, schema design, and query performance. * Experience deploying and operating software in a cloud environment, ideally Google Cloud Platform. * Daily, hands\-on use of Claude Code and other AI coding assistants, with the judgment to review, test, and stand behind AI\-generated code. * Ideally, experience with the Model Context Protocol, AI agent tooling, or AI gateways, or a background in developer tools, security, or governance software. * Comfort operating in an early\-stage, category\-creation environment where the playbook is still being written. * Clear written and spoken communication in English, and a habit of giving and asking for feedback directly. **Benefits** * 401(k) plan contribution with employer match * Commuter allowance (transit stipend) * 18 paid vacation days (PTO) * Health insurance * Personal development budget for every employee * Hybrid workplace * Online wellness sessions * Team events including team buildings, happy hours, company breakfasts/lunches, in\-person and virtual * Refreshments: snacks, fruit, coffee, and drinks in the office Salary Range: $170,000 \- $185,000 The annual base salary range is determined based on a variety of factors, including geographic location, role\-specific skills, relevant experience, and internal equity. Usercentrics is committed to transparent and equitable compensation practices. Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of colour are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Usercentrics we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. **WHY JOIN USERCENTRICS?** -------------------------- * Joining Usercentrics means becoming part of a fast\-growing, diverse, and international team of tech enthusiasts and entrepreneurially\-minded people who build our success story together. * Company culture is important to us. We strive to continuously develop a positive, vibrant, and inspiring environment that enables everyone to thrive both personally and professionally. * Get involved! We have plenty of initiatives and love seeing people from all departments enthusiastically participating in cross\-department projects and shaping our future. * Your work\-life balance matters. We offer flexible working hours, hybrid working, and the possibility of workcations (in accordance with our company policy). * We always remember to have fun, both in our day\-to\-day work and at our regular team events in our offices across Munich, Prague, Lisbon, Copenhagen, Odense, Buenos Aires, and New York, or online. * You are our most valuable asset. We offer a personal development budget, job\-related language courses, and much more to support your wellbeing and growth.

jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About Vibes** Vibes’ mobile\-first platform creates personal, revenue\-driving and long\-term mobile engagement between consumers and the world\-class brands they love. Industry leaders like **Chipotle**, **Kohl’s** and **Polo Ralph Lauren** use Vibes to grow customer relationships with relevant, high\-volume mobile messaging and mobile wallet marketing on a global scale. Vibes enables marketers to seamlessly connect with their customers using a data\-rich and API\-packed solution that beautifully optimizes and unifies their SMS, MMS, RCS and Mobile Wallet campaigns. To learn more about Vibes, visit www.vibes.com. Vibes is building a security program that covers the whole company: our cloud environment, our applications, our workforce, and the AI tools and agents we increasingly rely on. As a Security Engineer, you'll build, run, and improve the controls that protect all of these. You'll work hands\-on in cloud infrastructure and code, partner closely with engineering, IT Support, and GRC, and help shape how we adopt AI securely and use it to make security work faster. This is a generalist role with real ownership. You'll do the engineering work and also explain risk and drive remediation across teams. This role will report to the Senior Security Engineer. ### **What you'll do:** ### ***Cloud and infrastructure security*** * Engineer, operate, and improve controls that protect our cloud environment, including network, identity, logging, encryption, and configuration baselines * Improve security tooling coverage so every active project and account reports into a single view, and track and close coverage gaps * Define guardrails and secure defaults that make the safe path the easy path for engineering teams ### ***Vulnerability management*** * Run vulnerability management end to end: ingestion, triage, prioritization by real\-world risk, assignment, and closure * Work with remediation owners to agree on timelines, unblock fixes, and handle exceptions * Report on SLA performance, backlog age, and risk trends to security leadership ### ***Detection and incident response*** * Tune detections to improve signal and reduce noise, and respond to security events as they arise * Write, maintain, and rehearse incident response runbooks * Plan and run tabletop exercises, and turn lessons learned into concrete improvements * Take part in the security on\-call rotation \[if applicable] ### ***Identity and access management*** * Build and improve how access is granted, reviewed, and removed, including group\-based access, provisioning automation, and periodic access reviews * Own the security steps in joiner, mover, and leaver processes, working with GRC and IT Support * Apply least privilege, role\-based access, and SSO consistently across people, service accounts, and agent identities ### ***Secure development and code review*** * Review code and infrastructure\-as\-code changes for security risk before they reach production * Turn recurring findings into reusable patterns, secure templates, and automated checks (for example, in CI/CD) * Coach engineers on why a finding matters and how to fix it ### ***AI security and AI\-enabled security*** * Use language models and agents within the company to strengthen workforce security, such as triage, investigation support, and policy and access workflows * Support securing an agentic, AI\-leaning software development lifecycle, including controls around AI\-generated code, agent permissions, and review gates * Assess the security of AI tools and agents, whether bought or built, including how models and agents reach company systems and data (access scope, data handling, credential management, logging, and prompt\-injection and data\-exfiltration risk) ### ***Communication and partnership*** * Explain risk clearly and credibly to engineers, executives, and auditors, adjusting depth and framing for each * Support audits and compliance evidence requests in partnership with GRC \[e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001] ### **What you'll bring:** ### ***Required*** * 3\+ years of cybersecurity experience at a SaaS company, or equivalent * Hands\-on security engineering experience in a cloud environment; AWS preferred * Comfort reading code and infrastructure as code (e.g., \[Terraform/CloudFormation]; \[Python/Go/TypeScript]), spotting security issues, and giving constructive review feedback * Practical experience with vulnerability management and incident response * Solid understanding of IAM principles: least privilege, RBAC, SSO, access reviews, and the joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle, as applied to people, service accounts, and agent identities * Working knowledge of where AI systems introduce risk and where they reduce work * Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain a risk to any audience ### ***Preferred*** * Relevant certification, such as CISSP or an AWS security certification * Experience with \[SIEM / EDR / CSPM / vulnerability scanning / IdP] tooling * Experience automating security workflows with scripting or APIs * Hands\-on experience evaluating or building LLM\-based applications or agents * Familiarity with frameworks such as NIST CSF, CIS Benchmarks, OWASP (including the LLM Top 10\), or MITRE ATT\&CK * Experience running tabletop exercises or leading incidents ### **Our Core Values:** * Respect, honesty, and integrity for all stakeholders * Always be learning * Relentless focus on the customer * Never be satisfied * Create value * Seek accountability and ownership ### **Compensation and Benefits** The base salary for this role is $110,000 \- $120,000 annually. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate's relevant work experience, skills and certifications. Vibes offers employees a full slate of benefits including competitive salaries, options, medical, dental and vision coverage, short and long term disability, life insurance, 11 paid holidays, flexible vacation, commuter benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, and a paid parental leave program. ### **Equal Opportunity Employe****r** Vibes is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, parental or pregnancy status, marriage and civil partnership, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Reasonable accommodations will be made to meet the requirements of the Americans with Disabilities Act and will be provided as requested by candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

jobs.title: Data Engineer & Insights Analyst
jobs.description: Remote The client is looking for a Data Engineer \& Insights Analyst to join its team of analytics professionals to support the client Longitudinal Data System (LDS). This position will be responsible for transforming complex data into trusted, usable information to support program delivery, operational improvements, and executive decision\-making in state government agencies. The Data Engineer \& Insights Analyst will understand policy\-relevant research questions, evaluate available data sources, and develop analytics products to deliver actionable insights. Additionally, the Data Engineer \& Insights Analyst will design and build data pipelines, integrate and transform data from multiple sources, identify and address data quality issues, and establish controls to support responsible use of data. This role requires both technical depth and strong analytical judgment, including the ability to work with large, complex, and confidential datasets. The successful candidate must be self\-directed and comfortable supporting the data needs of multiple teams, systems, and products. They must also be comfortable with supporting data conversions associated with system modernization and/or replacement efforts. The right candidate will be excited by the prospect of optimizing the Commonwealth's longitudinal data architecture to support our next generation of data initiatives. Responsibilities: Create and maintain optimal data pipeline architecture. Design and implement cloud\-based data solutions using AWS services such as S3, Glue, Redshift, EMR, Athena, Kinesis, and Lambda. Build and maintain data orchestration workflows using tools such as Apache Airflow, AWS Step Functions, or similar services. Assemble large, complex data sets that meet functional / non\-functional business area requirements. Engineer analytical data environments that support advanced statistical analysis, predictive modeling, machine learning, and evidence\-building activities. Partner with data scientists, research analysts, and policy analysts to ensure enterprise data assets support reproducible research and statistical modeling. Identify, design, and implement internal process improvements: e.g. automating manual processes, optimizing data delivery, re\-designing infrastructure for greater scalability. Build the infrastructure required for optimal extraction, transformation, and loading of data from a wide variety of data sources using SQL and 'big data' technologies. Build analytics tools that utilize the data pipeline to provide actionable insights into education and workforce outcomes, operational efficiency, and other key business performance metrics. Develop and maintain data pipeline monitoring, alerting, and logging frameworks. Implement data quality checks and validation frameworks across pipelines. Develop dashboards, reports, analytical models, and/or other decision\-support products. Work with stakeholders including the Executive, Data, Design, and Support teams to assist with data\-related technical issues and support their data infrastructure needs. Ensure compliance with applicable Commonwealth policies, data governance standards, privacy requirements, security controls, and interagency data\-sharing agreements. Create data tools for analytics and data scientist team members that assist them in building and optimizing data products needed to support ongoing operations and data\-informed decision\-making. Work with data and analytics professionals to strive for greater functionality in our data systems. Required Qualifications: Advanced SQL knowledge and proficiency working with relational databases, query authoring (SQL), as well as working familiarity with a variety of databases. Experience building and optimizing 'big data' data pipelines, architectures, and data sets. Advanced knowledge and proficiency designing, building, and refining dashboards, reports, analytical models, and decision\-support products for executive and non\-technical users. Experience working with student\-level higher education data, including establishing linkages to other sources (e.g. employment and wage data) to measure outcomes and/or generate insights for decision\-making). Experience performing root\-cause analysis on internal and external data and processes to answer specific business questions and identify opportunities for improvement. Strong analytic skills related to working with unstructured datasets. Experience building processes supporting data transformation, data structures, metadata, dependency, and workload management. A successful history of manipulating, processing, and extracting value from large, disconnected datasets. Working knowledge of message queuing, stream processing, and highly scalable 'big data' data stores. Strong project management and organizational skills. Experience supporting and working with cross\-functional teams in a dynamic environment. Skill \- Required / Desired \- Amount of Experience Hands\-on experience with cloud\-based data services such as AWS (e.g. S3, EC2, Glue, EMR, RDS, Redshift, Athena, Lambda, DynamoDB) \- Required \- 5 Years Proficiency in object\-oriented/object function scripting languages: e.g. Python, R, Java, C\+\+, Scala \- Required \- 5 Years Proficiency in relational SQL and NoSQL databases, including Oracle, MS SQL Server, Postgres, Cassandra. \- Required \- 5 Years Experience with version control systems such as Git and CI/CD pipelines \- Required \- 5 Years Knowledge of data modeling techniques including dimensional modeling, data vault, and star/snowflake schemas. \- Required \- 5 Years Familiarity with data cataloging and metadata management tools such as AWS Glue Data Catalog. \- Required \- 5 Years Understanding of data governance, data lineage, and data quality frameworks. \- Required \- 5 Years Knowledge of REST API design and integration patterns. \- Required \- 5 Years Experience with big data tools: e.g. Hadoop, Spark, Kafka. \- Required \- 5 Years Experience with data pipeline and workflow management tools: e.g. Azkaban, Luigi, Airflow. \- Required \- 5 Years Experience with data integration services solutions from vendors such as Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, and TIBCO. \- Required \- 5 Years Experience with stream\-processing systems: e.g. Storm, Spark\-Streaming. \- Required \- 5 Years Notes: Work will be remote. jobs.title: Azure AI Document Intelligence Engineer
jobs.description: Role: **Senior Azure AI Document Intelligence Engineer (OCR Experience)** We are seeking a **Senior Azure AI Document Intelligence Engineer** responsible for designing, training, and optimizing AI\-powered contract and invoice OCR solutions using **Azure AI Document Intelligence, Azure Databricks, Azure Machine Learning, MLflow, Azure AI Search, OpenAI/GenAI, Python, and SQL**, driving **98\-99%\+ extraction accuracy** across complex supply\-chain and procurement documents through advanced machine learning, document classification, validation frameworks, and intelligent automation. **Roles and Responsibilities:** Analyse invoice and contract variations across suppliers, countries, languages, formats, and scan\-quality levels. Define the document taxonomy and extraction schema for: Invoice headers Contract metadata Purchase\-order references Supplier and customer information Dates, currencies, taxes, discounts, and totals Payment terms, renewal dates, obligations, and termination clauses Tables and invoice line items Evaluate Azure AI Document Intelligence prebuilt invoice, layout, custom neural, custom template, classification, and composed\-model capabilities. Build and train custom document classifiers and extraction models. Prepare, label, clean, balance, and version training and evaluation datasets. Implement document preprocessing for rotation, skew, noise, resolution, page separation, and scan\-quality issues. Develop confidence\-scoring and validation strategies using field\-level and OCR\-level confidence signals. Implement deterministic validation rules, including Subtotal, tax, and total reconciliation Currency and date validation Purchase\-order and supplier matching Duplicate\-document detection Required\-field and cross\-field consistency checks Establish confidence thresholds and human\-review rules for uncertain extractions. Perform error analysis by document type, supplier, field, language, and scan quality. Create automated evaluation pipelines reporting exact\-match accuracy, precision, recall, F1 score, false\-positive rates, and false\-negative rates. Monitor model drift and retrain models when document formats or business requirements change. Document model versions, training data, experiments, limitations, and release decisions. Collaborate with supply\-chain, procurement, accounts\-payable, legal, and engineering teams. **Experience: \-**Min 10\+ Years **Location: \-** Irving, TX and Chicago, IL(Locals required\- Hybrid 3 days' Work from Office) **Educational Qualifications: \-** Engineering Degree BE/ME/BTech/MTech/BSc/MSc. Technical certification in multiple technologies is desirable. **Skills: \-** **Mandatory skills** Min 4\+ years of experience in machine learning, OCR, computer vision, NLP, or intelligent document processing. Hands\-on experience with Azure AI Document Intelligence or a comparable enterprise document\-processing platform. Strong Python development skills. Experience with REST APIs, JSON, Azure SDKs, and asynchronous processing. Experience training and evaluating document classification and field\-extraction models. Strong understanding of accuracy, precision, recall, F1 score, confidence calibration, and test\-set design. Experience extracting complex tables and variable\-length line items. Experience creating labelled datasets and maintaining data\-quality standards. Familiarity with invoices, purchase orders, contracts, or supply\-chain documents. Strong analytical, debugging, and technical\-documentation skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Azure Machine Learning, MLflow, Azure AI Search, or Azure OpenAI. Experience with multilingual documents. Familiarity with contract clause extraction and legal\-document processing. Knowledge of ERP or procurement systems such as SAP, Oracle, Dynamics 365, Coupa, or Ariba. Experience implementing active learning, model\-drift monitoring, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows. Knowledge of data privacy and document\-retention requirements. Success Measures 99% exact\-match accuracy for approved critical fields. 98% exact\-match accuracy across all agreed fields. Accuracy maintained across suppliers, formats, and document\-quality categories. Measurable reduction in manual corrections and review time. Documented improvement process for fields that miss their thresholds. No production model deployed without passing the approved evaluation suite. **Skills** Azure (Bigdata Azure) Azure AI Document Intelligence, Azure Databricks, OpenAI, GenAI, Azure Machine Learning, MLflow, Azure AI Search SQL, Contract and Invoice OCR VeeRteq Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Fullstack with Rust
jobs.description: Veeva Systems is a mission\-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest\-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead. At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors. As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment. Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.### **The Role** We are looking for a Fullstack Sr. Software Engineer who is energized by building a new agent first CRM platform from 0 to 1\. You will have a high degree of ownership over the entire stack: from crafting responsive, component\-driven interfaces in React to architecting robust, scalable backend logic in Rust. We need a builder who enjoys the challenge of creating a clean, scalable application from the ground up. ### **What You'll Do** * You will be part of a small group of engineers building an AI\-first CRM platform * End\-to\-End Development: Take full ownership of features by writing clean, maintainable code across the entire stack * Frontend Excellence: Translate UI/UX designs into high\-performance user interfaces using React * Backend Logic: Build efficient and accurate server\-side logic and APIs powered by Rust running in our platform environment * Platform Integrations: Build highly scalable integrations to common applications that integrate with CRM ### **Requirements** * We need good team players * 7\+ years of fullstack development experience * Proficiency with Rust and server side languages * Experience with SQL * Applicants must have the unrestricted right to work in the United States. Veeva will not provide sponsorship at this time ### **Interviewing with Veeva** We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect. * Follow the application process and submit your resume. * Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party, unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously. * Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision. * If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows: + A conversation with the hiring manager + A technical/coding skills exercise + A final panel interview with team members and senior leaders * Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision. ### **Perks \& Benefits** * Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance * Flexible PTO and company paid holidays * Retirement programs * 1% charitable giving program ### **Compensation** * Base pay: $110,000 \- $270,000 * The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus. ###### **\#LI\-Remote** ###### **\#LI\-MidSenior** Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world. Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Cloud Infrastructure
jobs.description: ### **Who We Are** Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy\-sensitive AI\-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. We've got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100\+ of the Fortune 500\), a $5\.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it. You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform's impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI\-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that's alerted to a threat in real\-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We're rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170\+ countries. ### **About the Role** As a member of our Cloud Infrastructure High Availability team, you will help design, build and maintain tooling to ensure Verkada operates reliably at global scale. jobs.title: Application Security Engineer
jobs.description: Vestwell is the financial technology company powering the new savings economy. The New York City\-based fintech platform redefines how people save for the critical aspects of life across retirement, education, and healthcare savings needs. Today, Vestwell enables over 790,000 businesses and more than 2\.75 million active savers, with over $57 billion in assets saved across all 50 United States. Vestwell offers a range of products, including workplace\-delivered retirement plans, employer\-offered student loan repayment benefits, and various savings accounts for education, emergencies, and individuals with disabilities. Vestwell's platform serves a diverse clientele, including financial advisers, employers, third\-party administrators, financial institutions, payroll providers, government agencies, and individual savers. To learn more, visit vestwell.com **Who Are We Looking For?** We are looking for an Application Security Engineer to help secure the applications and identity integrations that power our products. This role will focus on analyzing and protecting our NestJS applications, applying strong application security practices across the software development lifecycle, and supporting the security of our identity capabilities as both an identity provider (IdP) and a relying party (RP) in OIDC integrations and internal application usage. You will work closely with software engineering, platform, infrastructure, and product teams to identify risk, implement practical mitigations, and make secure\-by\-default development easier. The ideal candidate combines solid hands\-on application security skills with a working knowledge of modern authentication and authorization protocols, and is eager to grow deeper expertise in identity security. **What Will You Be Doing?** * Analyze NestJS and TypeScript applications for authentication, authorization, input validation, injection, session, API, business\-logic, and data\-protection vulnerabilities. * Apply and help refine secure development patterns for NestJS, including guards, interceptors, middleware, decorators, validation, error handling, logging, configuration, and dependency management. * Contribute to the security of our OIDC integrations and identity platform capabilities when we operate as: * + An identity provider, including authorization, token, user\-info, discovery, key\-set, and logout endpoints. + A relying party, including client registration, redirect handling, authorization\-code flows, token exchange, session establishment, and logout. * Review OAuth 2\.0 and OpenID Connect flows, including authorization code with PKCE, refresh tokens, client authentication, scopes, consent, state, nonce, redirect URI validation, and token lifetimes, under guidance from senior team members for more complex cases. * Help apply and maintain authorization models using RBAC and, where appropriate, claims\-based or policy\-based access control. * Review access\-control boundaries across services, APIs, tenants, users, roles, permissions, and administrative functions. * Participate in threat modeling, security design reviews, architecture reviews, and secure code reviews. * Contribute to security requirements, reusable libraries, reference implementations, and developer guidance that reduce recurring risk. * Support security testing and detection efforts, including SAST, DAST, software composition analysis, secret scanning, API testing, dependency monitoring, and targeted security testing. * Partner with engineering teams to remediate vulnerabilities, help prioritize findings by exploitability and business impact, and verify fixes. * Monitor relevant application and identity security signals, support incident investigations, and help maintain playbooks for account takeover, token compromise, authorization bypass, credential abuse, and related events. * Help maintain security documentation, standards, risk exceptions, and evidence needed for audits and customer assurance. * Stay current on application security, identity, OAuth/OIDC, browser security, API security, cloud security, and emerging attack techniques. **Requirements** The Necessities * 2\-4 years of professional experience in application security, product security, software engineering, or a closely related discipline. * Experience securing Node.js and TypeScript applications; familiarity with NestJS is a strong plus. * Working knowledge of OAuth 2\.0 and OpenID Connect concepts and common implementation pitfalls. * Exposure to IdP and/or RP implementations, integrations, or security assessments. * Solid understanding of authentication and authorization concepts, including RBAC, least privilege, claims, scopes, permissions, sessions, and tokens. * Ability to review code across APIs, web applications, and background jobs, with support from senior engineers on more complex architectural or distributed\-systems questions. * Familiarity with web and API security risks, including OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, broken access control, SSRF, injection, XSS, CSRF, insecure deserialization, and misconfiguration. * Basic understanding of secure token handling, JWT validation, JWKS, signing algorithms, and token storage considerations. * Some experience working with CI/CD and developer workflows, or a willingness to learn how to integrate security into them with minimal friction. * Good communication skills and the ability to explain security findings and risk to technical teammates. * A pragmatic, collaborative approach: eager to learn, ask good questions, and work with more senior engineers to propose and implement proportional controls. The Extras * Exposure to identity platforms or libraries such as Auth0, Okta, Keycloak, Cognito, Azure AD/Entra ID, or comparable systems. * Familiarity with SAML integrations for single sign\-on solutions. * Exposure to API gateways, microservices, event\-driven systems, and cloud\-native deployments. * Familiarity with containers, infrastructure as code, secrets management, and cloud IAM basics. * Experience with security tooling such as Burp Suite, Semgrep, CodeQL, Snyk, Dependabot, OWASP ZAP, or equivalent tools. * Familiarity with security standards such as OWASP ASVS or NIST SSDF. * Interest in pursuing relevant security certifications. This role will be based in either the New York City, Austin, King of Prussia, or Scottsdale office, and will be part of Vestwell's hybrid in\-office operation. The expected base salary range for this position is $140K \- $150K base. This position is eligible to participate in the Company Bonus Pool and is eligible to receive new hire equity in the Company. Please note that salary bands are based on NY and other similar metro areas and may differ based on where the role is ultimately hired. **Full\-Time Employee Benefits** We're an innovative, high\-growth company with an exciting future ahead. At Vestwell, we prioritize employee wellbeing through comprehensive health benefits, generous time off, and a dedicated Employee Wellbeing Committee. Our hybrid work model offers flexibility while providing access to our collaborative offices in Midtown Manhattan, Austin, King of Prussia, and Scottsdale. And, of course, as a company focused on helping people save for the future, we offer a competitive 401(k) plan. **Interview Process** Our interview process starts the same for every candidate with 1\-2 introductory conversations to learn more about your background, interests, and what you're looking for, while also giving you the opportunity to learn more about Vestwell and the team. From there, the process varies by role but typically includes a skills or experience\-based assessment, such as a coding interview, portfolio review, or deeper discussion of your relevant experience. Successful candidates then move on to a virtual or in\-person interview panel. Before extending an offer, we complete a reference check with a current or former manager and a peer. Throughout the process, we prioritize transparency, clear communication, and minimizing surprises. For your awareness you will only receive correspondence from recruiting@vestwell.com any other domain not ending in vestwell.com is not our Recruitment team. *Vestwell's* *Privacy Policy.* *Attention California residents: In the course of conducting our business and complying with federal, state, and local government regulations governing such matters as employment, tax, insurance, etc., we must collect Personal Information from you. Should you accept employment with Vestwell you may view our California Privacy Rights Act here:* *Vestwell's California Privacy Rights Policy.*

jobs.description: Join Vetcove and help modernize the future of veterinary software and the pet parent healthcare experience. Our suite of platforms features a market\-leading procurement marketplace, an ultra\-modern home delivery ecommerce experience, and a next\-generation practice management system. More than 25,000 hospitals across all 50 states rely on Vetcove daily, supporting tens of thousands of veterinarians who care for tens of millions of pets each year. We are modernizing the 50 billion dollar plus animal health industry by giving veterinary organizations the tools to focus more on patient care. Backed by Y Combinator and top venture investors in Silicon Valley, New York and Miami, Vetcove is a fast\-growing, mission\-driven company. We are searching for talented and passionate people who want to help shape the future of veterinary care. **Developer Experience Engineer (Staff Level)** Vetcove is seeking a Staff Engineer to help us build 10x faster. AI is changing how software gets built, and we want someone who sees the opportunity and can make it real across Vetcove. You’ll own the tools, infrastructure, and workflows that let our engineers ship faster and give teams across the company the power to build. You should be someone who is already experimenting with the latest coding agents, trying new developer tools, and constantly thinking, “Why are we still doing this manually?” This is a hands\-on role with room to experiment, introduce new tools, and rethink how we work. You’ll work directly with our engineering leadership and teams across the business. We operate in a fully remote environment, giving you the flexibility to do your best work while staying deeply connected to a fast\-moving, highly collaborative team. What you’ll do * Build the development workflow you’d want to join a company to use. Rethink how we go from an idea to working software with AI at every step. * Put coding agents to work. Give them the context, tools, environments, and feedback loops to take on increasingly ambitious tasks. * Make CI and deployments fly. Own the path from code change to production and relentlessly cut slow tests, flaky builds, manual steps, and unnecessary waiting. * Turn repetitive engineering work into automations. Build agents and workflows for triage, code review, testing, documentation, releases, and whatever else should stop eating engineering time. * Give everyone at Vetcove the power to build. Set up the connections, infrastructure, and deployment paths that let non\-engineering teams create and maintain their own apps and automations. * Find and introduce tools that change how we work. Experiment with new models, coding agents, and developer infrastructure, bring the best into Vetcove, and own the rollout so the whole team benefits. * Make the fastest path a reliable one. Build testing, permissions, sandboxing, and observability into our workflows so people and agents can move quickly with confidence. * Get the team building differently. Work alongside engineers, share what’s working, and make better ways of building easy to adopt. * Own the impact. Find the biggest bottlenecks across our team, remove them, and measure whether we’re shipping faster with less friction. You enjoy pairing with teammates, understanding where they get stuck, and building things they want to use. **Your primary job is to find the biggest bottlenecks within our team and go remove them. jobs.title: ML Production Engineer, Sr Consultant
jobs.description: **About Us** Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. **Job Description** As a Machine Learning Production Engineer at the Senior Consultant level, you will design and develop integrated software algorithms to structure, analyze, and leverage data in product and systems applications across both structured and unstructured environments. You will use machine language and statistical modeling techniques such as decision trees, logistic regression, Bayesian analysis, and others to develop and evaluate algorithms that improve product/system performance, quality, data management, and accuracy. Rigorous validation and identification of logical flaws via sound machine learning practices are essential to support the post\-deployment phase integrity and accuracy of solutions. jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Forward Deployed
jobs.description: **Member of Technical Staff, Forward Deployed** =============================================== At Wafer, we are building AI systems that automatically optimize inference workloads across silicon. Wafer is well funded and serves trillions of tokens a month for mission\-critical workloads at fast\-growing AI startups. Forward deployed Members of Technical Staff are the engineers our customers work with. You'll take each customer from first benchmark to production, and keep their workloads fast and healthy after that. Our performance engineers and optimization agents do most of the tuning. You make sure it lands for each customer and stays that way. This is its own track, with the same bar as the rest of our technical staff. Sales finds customers and closes them. You are the engineer beside them from the first benchmark onward, not a salesperson. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Run the technical evaluation on the customer's own workload: understand their traffic and latency targets, run the benchmark and explain the result to their engineers. * Get each customer into production on Wafer, working with our performance engineers and agents to hit their targets. * Own the health of your accounts. Watch latency, errors and usage, catch problems before the customer does, and be who they hear from. * When a problem needs a fix in the engine, the kernels or the agents, scope it and bring the right engineer everything they need to solve it. * Build the tools, integrations and runbooks that make each new deployment faster than the last. * Tell engineering and sales what customers need next, based on what you see in production. **What we look for** -------------------- * You are a strong engineer who has shipped and operated production systems. You can read a trace, open a profiler and find the problem yourself. * Experience with LLM inference or serving, such as vLLM, SGLang or TensorRT\-LLM, is a big plus. * You want to work with customers. You have owned a technical customer relationship and can explain results to a skeptical engineering team. * You are credible in a room full of engineers. You can defend a benchmark methodology and concede the point when they are right. * You work without a spec. The problem arrives half\-defined and you come back with a scoped answer rather than a list of questions. **How we evaluate** ------------------- We score every candidate on seven values: * Infinitely Resourceful * Exceptionalism * Unreasonable Standards * Company Over Self * High EQ * Learns Quickly * First Principles Thinker **Benefits** ------------ * Fully covered medical, dental, and vision insurance. * Daily lunch and dinner, unlimited PTO, and parental leave. * $1K/month housing stipend (post\-tax) if you live within walking distance (0\.5 miles) from the office. * Relocation allowance and benefits. * Covered Uber/Waymo from/to office. * Visa sponsorship available. **How we work** --------------- On\-site in San Francisco, five days a week. Small team with massive surface area and ownership. You operate with complete autonomy of how to solve problems. Your success is measured by customers who move their production traffic to Wafer and stay because it keeps getting faster.

VoltAIre spans **Google Cloud and on\-premises cloud (OCP)** and supports workloads including SAST and DAST vulnerability scanners, knowledge assistants, AI\-enabled applications, and other emerging Cyber AI capabilities. This role combines **platform architecture, distributed systems, application architecture, cloud infrastructure, and hands\-on software engineering**. The Principal Engineer will help determine how applications should be designed, where workloads should run, and the appropriate infrastructure, isolation, resiliency, scalability, and technology patterns for each workload. **In this role, you will:** * Act as an advisor to leadership to develop and influence architecture across applications, cloud infrastructure, networking, information security, data platforms, Kubernetes, and distributed systems for highly complex Cyber AI workloads. * Provide technical leadership for the evolution of **VoltAIre**, establishing reusable platform capabilities and architectural patterns for Cyber AI workloads across cloud and on\-premises environments. * Design and influence Cyber AI applications, including vulnerability scanners, knowledge assistants, security services, and AI\-enabled applications, from application architecture through production deployment and operation. * Evaluate workload characteristics and make fit\-for\-purpose architecture decisions across security, isolation, availability, scalability, resiliency, performance, operational complexity, and cost. * Define workload deployment and isolation patterns spanning shared Kubernetes clusters with namespace\-based isolation, dedicated clusters, separate regions, and separate infrastructure or cloud providers. * Design highly available and resilient architectures supporting elastic scaling, active/active, active/passive, and disaster recovery patterns appropriate to workload requirements. * Provide architectural direction across Kubernetes, load balancing, application networking, compute, storage, SQL and NoSQL technologies, observability, and distributed application design. * Design and re\-engineer critical software components where performance, security, concurrency, reliability, or resource efficiency require deeper systems\-level engineering * Establish and evolve platform capabilities for logging, monitoring, telemetry, observability, security, adaptive runtime optimization, and intelligent workload routing. * Lead the strategy and resolution of highly complex and unique technical challenges requiring evaluation across applications, infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, and enterprise technology environments. * Translate advanced technology experience and business requirements into long\-term, scalable engineering solutions while clearly articulating architectural alternatives and trade\-offs. * Drive solutions from architecture and prototyping through implementation, production deployment, troubleshooting, and continuous optimization. * Maintain knowledge of emerging technologies and engineering practices across cloud\-native platforms, distributed systems, cybersecurity, Generative AI, Agentic AI, and systems engineering, and recommend innovations that advance platform capabilities. * Strategically engage with engineers, architects, product teams, cybersecurity partners, and leadership across the enterprise and serve as an expert technical advisor. * Mentor senior and staff engineers and help establish reusable engineering patterns and practices across platform and application engineering. **Required Qualifications:** * 7\+ years of Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education. * 7\+ years of senior engineering experience, including architecture and hands\-on delivery of large\-scale platforms, distributed applications, and production systems. * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience with cloud architectures, including Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure, AWS, or comparable enterprise cloud technologies. * Demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating applications and services on **Kubernetes or comparable container orchestration platforms**. * Experience with distributed systems and application architecture, including networking, load balancing, APIs, data flows, concurrency, persistence, scalability, and failure handling. * Experience designing solutions using **SQL and/or NoSQL data technologies** and evaluating technology choices based on workload and production requi urity scanners, AI/ML platforms, or compute\-intensive distributed workloads**. * Strong organizational savvy and customer centricity, with the ability to navigate complex enterprise environments and align technology decisions to business and cybersecurity outcomes. * Financial services or other highly regulated industry experience is beneficial. **Job Expectations:** * This position offers a hybrid work schedule. * This position is not eligible for Visa sponsorship. * Demonstrate proficiency in using AI‑assisted development and analysis tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot and approved code‑centric agents) * Leverage AI to accelerate system design, coding, testing, analysis, and troubleshooting * Apply strong technical judgment when validating and integrating AI‑assisted outputs into solutions * Understand and account for model limitations, security risks, and operational considerations * Apply AI responsibly in development and production environments * Ensure AI usage aligns with security, compliance, privacy, and ethical standards **Salary Ranges:** * $159,000 \- $254,000 \- Charlotte, NC * $191,000 \- $305,000 \- Menlo Park, CA **Pay Range** Reflected is the base pay range offered for this position. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic. Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance\-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements. **Applicants with Disabilities** To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo. **Drug and Alcohol Policy** Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace.
