jobs.title: Manufacturing Systems Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Why Work Here?** Help shape the systems and technology behind WPI's manufacturing operations. The Manufacturing Systems Engineer is a hands\-on technical role that turns operational needs into practical, scalable, and supportable solutions. ### **About the Role** Reporting to the Operations Systems Manager, the Manufacturing Systems Engineer designs, builds, integrates, supports, and improves applications and workflows used by WPI's manufacturing teams. This hands\-on role serves as technical owner for assigned applications, with QuickBase as the primary platform. The successful candidate will configure applications, build workflows and integrations, troubleshoot issues, and move solutions from requirements through production support. Success requires understanding WPI's operations and delivering solutions that are adopted, documented, reliable, and supportable. ### **What You'll Do** #### **Manufacturing Execution System Engineering and Solution Delivery** * Design, configure, test, deploy, and improve applications and workflows supporting manufacturing operations. * Translate operational requirements into practical system designs, data models, workflows, reports, automations, and integrations. * Serve as technical owner and subject matter expert for QuickBase and other assigned manufacturing execution systems applications. * Simplify processes, reduce manual effort, and improve data quality and reliability. * Deliver solutions from discovery through production support while balancing usability, security, maintainability, cost, and long\-term value. #### **Application and Platform Ownership** * Own and continuously improve assigned manufacturing execution system applications. * Manage data models, access, workflows, automations, dashboards, and reports. * Troubleshoot application, integration, performance, and data issues, correcting recurring root causes. * Maintain appropriate development, testing, validation, change management, and release practices. * Apply WPI standards for access, data handling, change management, documentation, and support in partnership with Information Technology. * Monitor application health, data quality, automation, and integration reliability, with clear ownership and support procedures. #### **Integration and Automation** * Develop and support integrations among QuickBase, Procore, Viewpoint Vista, Microsoft 365, and other WPI systems. * Use APIs, connectors, webhooks, scripting, and low\-code tools to connect systems and automate processes. * Diagnose integration and data\-flow failures with attention to exception handling, permissions, data integrity, and supportability. * Favor practical, maintainable solutions over unnecessary technical complexity. #### **Documentation, Training, and Support** * Maintain technical documentation, system diagrams, data mappings, test plans, release records, and support procedures. * Develop user guidance and training for application and process changes. * Provide advanced support and establish clear escalation paths with Information Technology and the Help Desk. * Address recurring support issues through system, process, documentation, or training improvements. * Transition new solutions into sustainable operational support. ### **How Success Will Be Measured** * Solutions are adopted by operational teams and reduce manual work, errors, or process delays. * Assigned applications and integrations are reliable, documented, secure, and supportable. * Projects move predictably from discovery through deployment and production support. * Data quality, workflow consistency, and visibility improve across supported manufacturing processes. * Recurring support issues are reduced through root\-cause correction, automation, documentation, or training. ### **What We're Looking For** * Three or more years of related experience in business applications, manufacturing technology, workflow automation, systems integration, or a comparable role. Equivalent education and practical experience will be considered. * QuickBase development or administration experience is strongly preferred. Comparable low\-code platform experience will be considered, especially in manufacturing, specialty contracting, engineering, field services, or another project\-based industry. * Experience with application configuration, workflow design, data modeling, automation, reporting, testing, troubleshooting, and support. * Working knowledge of APIs, connectors, authentication, JSON, webhooks, or related integration concepts. * Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify root causes rather than simply address symptoms. * Strong communication skills with technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * Ability to manage competing priorities and move work from concept through operational use. * Commitment to documentation, standardization, reliability, and responsive internal service. ### **Nice to Have** Experience with one or more of the following is beneficial; expertise across the full stack is not expected. * Experience with Autodesk Forma \& Procore * Experience with Viewpoint Vista or comparable enterprise resource planning platforms. * Experience with Microsoft 365, Fabric, Power Automate, Power BI, SharePoint, or related tools. * Experience supporting integrations using APIs, middleware, integration platforms, or scripting. * Working knowledge of SQL, PowerShell, Python, JavaScript, or similar technologies. * Experience with manufacturing data, document control, estimating, preconstruction, project management, BIM, engineering, or safety systems. ### **Work Environment** * Primarily office\-based with responsibilities across the organization. * Occasional evening or weekend work may be required to support maintenance, upgrades, releases, or operational needs. * Travel approximately once per quarter to manufacturing offices. ### **Compensation** Compensation is commensurate with experience, qualifications, and demonstrated skills. ### **Career Growth** This role offers growth across manufacturing technology, enterprise applications, integration, automation, data, business\-process improvement, and solution engineering. ### **Benefits** At WPI our employees are our greatest asset. We put our people first and are proud to provide a comprehensive benefits package designed to meet the needs of our employees at every stage of life. In our commitment to fostering an environment where everyone can thrive personally and professionally, we offer: * Competitive pay * Incentive bonus plan * 401(k) retirement savings plan with match * Medical, prescription drug, dental and vision insurance plans with flexible spending account option * Life insurance, accidental death, and disability benefits * Flexible paid time off policy and paid holidays * Professional development opportunities and certifications ### **About Western Partitions, Inc.** Western Partitions, Inc. is a specialty contractor serving multiple regions, with a strong emphasis on safety, quality, integrity, innovation, customer service, and employee development. WPI provides equal employment and affirmative action opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability. WPI is a background screening, drug\-free workplace. This job description is intended to outline the general nature and level of work being performed by employees. It is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive list of responsibilities, duties, or skills required of the employee of this job. Furthermore, this description is subject to change at the discretion of the company, with or without notice.

jobs.title: Security Engineer, Red Team
jobs.description: **Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!** --------------------------------------------- Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops. As a remote co\-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact. We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the \#1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce. **Role** -------- * Plan and run authorized red team operations across cloud (AWS), Kubernetes, networks, identity systems, SaaS, and internal applications, under written rules of engagement. * Build and maintain AI\-assisted testing harnesses: agent loops that run recon, attack\-path discovery, fuzzing, and exploit validation with logging, scoping controls, and human approval gates. * Use LLMs and agentic tools to speed up vulnerability research, payload and test\-case generation, code review, and report drafting, and measure where they help and where they mislead. * Red team our own AI systems: prompt injection, tool and connector abuse, data exfiltration, model and agent permission boundaries, and supply chain risk in AI dependencies. * Emulate realistic adversaries using MITRE ATT\&CK and ATLAS, chaining findings into end\-to\-end attack paths rather than isolated bugs. * Run purple team exercises with detection engineering and incident response, and tune detections based on what your tests evade. * Write clear findings with reproduction steps, impact, and recommended fixes; track remediation to closure and retest. * Automate regression tests so fixed weaknesses stay fixed, and feed results into CI/CD pipelines. * Document and share techniques, tooling, and lessons learned with engineering teams. * Work collaboratively with Whatnot’s Blue Team on Purple Team engagements to help strengthen Whatnot’s overall security posture. **You** ------- Curious about who thrives at Whatnot? We’ve found that low ego, a growth mindset, and leaning into action and high impact goes a long way here. As our next Red Team Engineer you’ll find weaknesses in our infrastructure before real attackers do. You will use AI tools and agents to scale offensive testing, build the harnesses that run it, and turn findings into fixes across cloud, network, application, identity and CI/CD layers. * 3\+ years in offensive security, red teaming, or penetration testing, with real engagements against production\-scale environments. * Strong programming skills in Python; you write your own tooling instead of only running others. * Hands\-on experience building LLM\-powered workflows or agents (tool use, orchestration, evaluation, guardrails), not just prompting a chat window. * Deep knowledge of at least two areas: cloud security and IAM abuse, Active Directory or identity attacks, Kubernetes and container escapes, web and API exploitation, CI/CD and supply chain attacks. * Working knowledge of AI\-specific risks: prompt injection, insecure tool use, data leakage, excessive agent permissions, and model supply chain issues. * Sound judgment on scope, safety, and blast radius; you know how to test production\-adjacent systems without causing outages. * Clear written communication: reports an engineer can act on and an executive can skim. **Benefits** ------------ * Generous Holiday and Time off Policy * Health Insurance options including Medical, Dental, Vision * Work From Home Support + Home office setup allowance + Monthly allowance for cell phone and internet * Care benefits + Monthly allowance for wellness + Annual allowance towards Childcare + Lifetime benefit for family planning, such as adoption or fertility expenses * Retirement; 401k offering for Traditional and Roth accounts in the US (employer match up to 4% of base salary) and Pension plans internationally * Monthly allowance to dogfood the app + All Whatnauts are expected to develop a deep understanding of our product. We're passionate about building the best user experience, and all employees are expected to use Whatnot as both a buyer and a seller as part of their job (our dogfooding budget makes this fun and easy!). * Parental Leave + 16 weeks of paid parental leave \+ one month gradual return to work \*company leave allowances run concurrently with country leave requirements which take precedence. **Please note: Whatnot will only contact you through official @whatnot.com email addresses. If you see an email impersonating a Whatnot recruiter, please disregard and report it as spam.** **EOE** ------- Whatnot is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, parental status, disability status, or any other status protected by local law. We believe that our work is better and our company culture is improved when we encourage, support, and respect the different skills and experiences represented within our workforce. Compensation Range: $210K \- $290K

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Workato** ----------------- Workato is the leading Control and Execution Platform for Enterprise AI — the neutral platform enterprises trust to put AI to work across their business. Workato unifies data, applications, and processes into a single platform so AI can reliably orchestrate business processes in production at enterprise scale. Built on more than a decade of running mission\-critical processes for over half the Fortune 500 — including Nasdaq, Amazon, Cisco, Vodafone, Atlassian, and Lucid Motors — Workato turns over 14,000 enterprise systems AI needs to act on into one governed execution layer. For more information, visit workato.com. **Why join us?** ---------------- Ultimately, Workato believes in fostering a **flexible, trust\-oriented culture that empowers everyone to take full ownership of their roles**. We are driven by **innovation** and looking for **team players** who want to actively build our company. But, we also believe in **balancing productivity with self\-care**. That's why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment along with a multitude of benefits they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives. If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you! Also, feel free to check out why: * Business Insider named us an "enterprise startup to bet your career on" * Forbes' Cloud 100 recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world * Deloitte Tech Fast 500 ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America * Quartz ranked us the \#1 best company for remote workers **Responsibilities** ==================== We're looking for an exceptional Senior Software Engineer to help build the distributed backend that powers our AI agent platform and the developer\-facing products around it — the event\-driven services, real\-time integrations, and APIs that let agents reliably do real work. You'll be building the systems that need to stay correct and available on our path to 1M users over the next year. In this role, you will also be responsible to: * Build event\-driven, horizontally\-scalable backend services that process work reliably and correctly even when parts of the system fail. * Build real\-time surfaces and integrations — streaming connections, gateways, and CLIs — that hold up under load. * Integrate LLMs and agentic harnesses into production systems. * Drive features end\-to\-end — from ideation and architecture through deployment, observability, and iteration. * Raise the engineering bar through clean, well\-tested code, thoughtful reviews, and mentorship. **Requirements** ================ ### **Qualifications / Experience / Technical Skills** * 5\+ years shipping and operating production backend systems at scale. * Strong proficiency in Python, and the judgment to write clean, well\-tested, maintainable code under it. * Deep distributed\-systems fundamentals: you know how to keep systems correct and available under partial failure, backpressure, and load — and you design for it by default. * Hands\-on experience with event\-driven, streaming, or real\-time systems (queues, pub/sub, long\-lived connections). * Comfortable operating services in production on Kubernetes in the cloud — and instrumenting them with metrics, tracing, and dashboards so you can debug what you ship. * Solid API and software\-architecture instincts; you make and defend sensible trade\-offs in ambiguity. * LLM/agentic and developer\-facing product experience (MCP, RAG, APIs, SDKs, CLIs) a strong plus. Our stack: Python, FastAPI, Postgres, Kubernetes, AWS. You don't need prior experience with all of it — we care that you can pick it up fast. ### **Soft Skills / Personal Characteristics** * High agency and ownership: You drive work end\-to\-end, from ambiguity to shipped and iterated, without waiting to be told. * A reliability mindset: You design for failure, not just the happy path. * Product\-minded: You care about the users using what you build, not just the system behind it. * AI\-native: You use modern AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code) in your daily workflow and stay at the cutting edge of what it can do. * Excellent written communication: We work async and write things down. **(REQ ID: 3006\)**

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **Your work days are brighter here.** We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too. **About the Team** The Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) organization sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and customer execution across Agent Factory, Sana, Data Cloud, and the Developer Platform. When Workday launches new AI agents and platform capabilities, early deployments surface complex real\-world challenges, from unstructured tenant data and intricate configurations to edge\-case enterprise workflows. The Developer Platform FDE team focuses on agent development: custom AI agents and agentic apps that run on Workday rails and surface anywhere. We work with the customers building their own agents on the Workday Developer Platform, using the same infrastructure Workday uses to power its own agents. Every agent we help ship inherits the security model, business process controls, and audit trail of the system of record for people and money at some of the world’s largest organizations, and thanks to open protocols, those agents can show up in Workday, in Sana, or inside the AI tools people already use every day. FDEs also serve as a critical feedback engine for Product and Engineering. On the Developer Platform team, you’ll build production agents with Developer Agent, Agent\-Ready Tools, and the Agent Harness, and work directly with the product and engineering teams behind those tools. Field insights, recurring customer friction, and proven build patterns become scalable, out\-of\-the\-box capabilities that reach every developer building on Workday. It’s a team where deep technical skill meets real customer impact every day, with direct influence over where the platform goes next. **About the Role** As a Forward Deployed Engineer on the Developer Platform FDE team, you’ll combine hands\-on agent engineering with direct customer work. Working alongside senior FDEs, you’ll help enterprise customers build, deploy, and optimize custom AI agents and agentic apps inside live customer environments. You’ll work with the full Workday Developer Platform stack. You’ll run custom agents on the Workday Agent Harness, the same agent runtime and infrastructure Workday uses internally. You’ll build agents, apps, and orchestrations in plain language with Developer Agent, from the Workday Developer Site, a VS Code–compatible IDE plug\-in, or any other MCP\-compatible agentic tool, such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex. You’ll wire agents into hundreds of governed, LLM\-native Agent\-Ready Tools for HR and finance data over MCP, and build with industry\-leading ADKs and agent frameworks. You’ll connect agents to each other and to the places people work using open standards like MCP, A2A, and A2UI, alongside REST APIs. And you’ll do it with governance built in, not bolted on, through Workday Extend AI, the Agent System of Record, Agent Passport, and Workday Data Cloud. You’ll work across the full deployment lifecycle alongside senior FDEs, AI Deployment Architects, Product Managers, and Workday Services leads. You’ll help drive immediate customer success while building deep expertise in enterprise agent engineering, and every engagement will sharpen both your technical skills and your sense of what makes a platform great to build on. **What you'll do:** * **Agent Engineering \& Deployment:** Build, configure, test, and debug custom AI agents and agentic apps inside live enterprise tenants, working against live data, business processes, and security configurations. * **Customer Discovery \& Solution Support:** Participate in technical discovery sessions with customer stakeholders, and help translate business requirements into product configurations, POCs, and integration specs. * **Developer Toolkit Feedback:** Be a hands\-on, everyday user of Developer Agent, Agent\-Ready Tools, and the Agent Harness. Document bugs, edge\-case failures, and friction points with h Model Context Protocol (MCP) or Agent2Agent (A2A), including building or consuming MCP servers. * Experience with one or more agent development kits or orchestration frameworks. * Familiarity with evaluating and testing LLM\-powered systems. * Experience with Workday Extend, Workday Orchestrate, or Workday Integrations. Open\-source contributions, side projects, or hackathon work involving AI agents or developer tooling. * **Workday Pay Transparency Statement** The annualized base salary ranges for the primary location and any additional locations are listed below. Workday pay ranges vary based on work location. As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role\-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants. Recruiters can share more detail during the hiring process. Each candidate’s compensation offer will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, geography, experience, skills, job duties, and business need, among other things. For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please click here . Primary Location: USA.CA.Pleasanton Primary Location Base Pay Range: $148,000 USD \- $222,000 USD Additional US Location(s) Base Pay Range: $123,900 USD \- $222,000 USD **Our Approach to Flexible Work** With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter. jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ We blend best practices from outsourcing to deliver services that feel in\-house. Our strengths: low‑risk project delivery with high quality, stable cross‑functional teams of in‑house specialists, and a business‑oriented approach. We invest in people, business development, and communication. Domain expertise includes healthcare, automotive, education, fintech, and media/entertainment. Our mission is to automate business processes and bring technological innovation into clients’ products. We encourage continuous learning and certifications, apply modern technologies to build scalable solutions, and serve both SMBs and enterprises. **Current focus:** we are building DAIIL, an AI‑native platform that sits above existing enterprise software and gives users a unified, intelligent interface. Our working POC connects two very different systems (healthcare and aviation) to prove the architecture works across industries. **Target layers:** AI Workspace Context Engine Semantic Layer Application Adapter Framework APIs/Browser/DB/Legacy. The DAIIL Core stays independent of any single application; app‑specific behavior lives in standardized adapters. **The role** ------------ **Role purpose:** Turn the POC into a scalable, reliable platform. Design clean contracts and an Adapter/Driver SDK so two unrelated enterprise apps can run equivalent workflows through one DAIIL Core. **Work setup:** Remote, Full‑time **Responsibilities:** --------------------- * **Product and solution design** * Translate business needs into platform contracts, requirements, and a clear milestone roadmap * Define success for “One Core, Two Apps, One Interaction Model” and track progress * **Architecture/engineering** * Design and implement DAIIL Core, the Application Adapter/Driver SDK, Context Engine, Semantic Layer, and tool/action orchestration * Build secure, testable integrations (REST/SOAP/DB/legacy/browser). Set quality gates, versioning, and compatibility rules * **Data/analytics/automation** * Model semantic data and actions; define schemas, validation, and reconciliation * Instrument metrics and dashboards (reliability, latency, success/error rates); automate regression checks * **Stakeholder management** * Work with internal engineers, solution architects, and client SMEs to understand systems and constraints * Align with security, infra, and product leads; present trade‑offs and decisions clearly * **Process and improvement** * Establish coding standards, adapter guidelines, and documentation * Mentor contributors; run design reviews, incident reviews, and post‑release learnings **Requirements:** ----------------- * Experience: 4\+ years in Python platform/back‑end engineering with emphasis on architecture and integrations * Skills: API and SDK design, clean interfaces and contracts, data modeling, strong SQL and database design, browser automation (Playwright or similar), authN/Z * Architecture and integrations: building adapters/drivers for REST/SOAP/DB/legacy systems; jobs.title: Head of AI and ML
jobs.description: **Company Description** At Xplor, we believe that helping people make the most of each day is the most rewarding way to spend ours. We give small and medium\-sized businesses cloud\-based, intuitive technology solutions that enable them to manage all the hassles of running and growing a business, so business owners can get back to doing what they love. With Xplor Pay, we help businesses get paid quickly and securely – without hidden fees. We built the tech ourselves, and our platform delivers secure, transparent, fast, and accurate payments. We are unified by our purpose of helping people to succeed. So, when you become part of our team, you also become part of the personal connection that strengthens the relationship people have with Xplor products. **Job Description** **Position overview** The Head of AI/ML R\&D decides, with evidence, whether an AI system works, how well, for whom, and at what cost. They come from data science and machine learning, and they build today with AI\-native tools and agentic development. The role owns the science of evaluation across every agent, the predictive and decision models behind the shared agents (churn, demand, payment recovery, fraud), and the experiment design that lets Finance count AI value once, against a holdout. The role is hands\-on. At least 50% of time goes to building models, evals and experiments; the rest to setting methods, reviewing, and growing a small team. This role makes what engineers ship measurable, cheaper and trustworthy, and supplies the models where an LLM alone is the wrong tool. **Key responsibilities** **1\. Evaluation science for every agent** o Set the enterprise eval methodology: golden\-set design, sampling, labelling and inter\-rater agreement, LLM\-as\-judge validation, slice analysis and statistical thresholds. o Own the quality signals in the minimum telemetry contract: task success, groundedness, hallucination and escalation rates. o Re\-run evals per BU and tenant on every agent\-core upgrade; catch regressions before customers do. **2\. Predictive and decision models behind the shared agents** o Build and run the models the horizontal pods need: churn and retention uplift, payment\-recovery propensity and timing, demand and capacity forecasting, later fraud and onboarding risk. o Choose the right tool per task: classical ML, a small or fine\-tuned model, retrieval, or a frontier LLM. o Ship models to production on the golden path, with monitoring for drift and feedback loops. **3\. Model economics** o Build the evidence behind model routing: accuracy, cost and latency per task, so routing is a measured decision. o Drive cost per successful task down through distillation, caching strategy, smaller models and prompt and context optimization. **4\. AI\-native R\&D and horizon scanning** o Prototype varied techniques (agent memory, planning, multi\-agent patterns, synthetic data) against real Xplor problems. o Turn what works into reference implementations in the golden path; retire what doesn't. o Bring a monthly view of what has changed in models and methods, and what it means for our roadmap. **5\. Data science for Data\-as\-a\-Service** o Shape the statistical design of benchmarks and indices: cohort minimums, anonymization, and comparability across businesses. o Lead entity\-resolution modeling with the data team. 6\. Raise the ML fluency of the whole R\&D organization o Teach evals, experimentation and probabilistic thinking through the AI\-P/SDLC training and office hours. o Pair with BU engineers on hard model problems in lighthouse BUs; review eval designs for R2 and R3 agents. **Hands\-on expectations** * Writes production code, notebooks and eval harnesses; uses AI coding and agent tools daily at "platform contributor" fluency. * Builds the first eval suite and the first predictive model for each golden\-path exemplar (conversational analytics, booking agent, retention and churn). * Reviews model and eval pull requests from pods and BUs. * Decides on a demo, an eval or a metric, not a deck. **Qualifications** **Required** * 12\+ years in data science, machine learning or applied research, with 4\+ years leading teams of scientists or ML engineers. * Grew up in ML: has trained, evaluated, deployed and maintained models in production, not only consumed APIs. * Has shipped LLM or agentic systems to production in the last two years, including the eval suite that gated them. * Deep experimental design and causal inference: A/B tests, holdouts, uplift modelling, matched cohorts, and knowing when each is valid. * Strong statistics: sampling, confidence intervals, calibration, multiple\-comparison traps. * Builds with AI\-native tools today (agentic coding assistants, MCP, agent frameworks) and can show recent work. * Writes production\-quality Python and SQL; reviews others' code credibly. * Has worked on SaaS or marketplace data at scale: multi\-tenant, messy, many products. * Explains model trade\-offs and uncertainty to executives in business terms (revenue, margin, risk). **Preferred** * Churn, retention, propensity or pricing models in subscription or SMB software. * Payments ML: recovery, dunning optimization, fraud or risk scoring. * Fine\-tuning, distillation or small\-model work to cut inference cost. * LLM\-as\-judge design and validation; red\-teaming of model behavior. * Snowflake (or similar) and feature stores; Datadog or OpenTelemetry for model monitoring. * Familiar with NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001 and the EU AI Act, and with privacy rules for analytics across AU, NZ, US, UK and EU. * Published research or open\-source work is a plus, not a requirement. **Competencies and behaviors** * Evidence first. Picks the simplest model that clears the bar; says no to research that has no BU sponsor. * Teacher. Grows ML judgement in engineers who don't report to them. * Security\- and privacy\-minded. jobs.title: Cybersecurity Cryptography/Solution Architect AWS
jobs.description: **Job Overview** **Must start on Monday.** About the Role: We are looking for a Senior Solution Architect to design an end\-to\-end Agentic AI pipeline for an enterprise cybersecurity POC. You will be the technical authority responsible for architecting a multi\-agent workflow that detects, plans, and remediates cryptographic vulnerabilities using Large Language Models and AWS infrastructure. Key Responsibilities: ● Architect a multi\-agent LangGraph workflow hosted on AWS ECS Fargate. ● Design the LLM integration layer utilizing Amazon Bedrock (Claude/Gemini APIs) for automated vulnerability remediation logic. ● Architect a Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) vector system using OpenSearch to map security scan findings against enterprise rule dictionaries. ● Design a robust state\-management layer using DynamoDB to track remediation checkpoints. ● Design a secure "Reviewer Dashboard" using API Gateway, AWS Lambda, and Amazon Cognito for human\-in\-the\-loop approval gates. Required Qualifications: ● Senior\-level expertise in Cloud and Software Architecture (AWS Solutions Architect Professional certification highly preferred). ● Deep, demonstrable expertise in AWS networking, compute (ECS/Fargate), and serverless data stores (DynamoDB, OpenSearch). ● Hands\-on architectural experience with Generative AI orchestration frameworks, specifically LangGraph and LangChain. ● Strong foundation in DevSecOps practices and automated remediation pipelines. 2\. Senior Cybersecurity SME \& Data Analyst (Cryptography) About the Role: We are seeking a Senior Cybersecurity SME to act as the primary intelligence layer for a cutting\-edge AI remediation project. Working in a highly secure environment, you will analyze proprietary Cryptography Bill of Materials (CBOM) data across a massive portfolio of legacy and modern applications, translating raw security data into actionable patterns for AI engineers. Key Responsibilities: ● Parse and analyze raw JSON/SBOM/CBOM vulnerability scans across complex enterprise applications. ● Identify critical deviations from modern encryption standards, including TLS migrations (1\.0/1\.2 to 1\.3\), cipher suite upgrades (AES\-128 to AES\-256\-GCM), and SSH host key hardening. ● Map complex infrastructure characteristics (e.g., hardware load balancers, IoT constraints) to technical remediation requirements. ● Identify unencrypted secrets and keys in codebases, architecting mappings for secure KMS integration. Required Qualifications: ● Senior\-level expertise in Cybersecurity, Cryptography, and Security Data Analysis. ● Deep technical mastery of enterprise encryption protocols including TLS 1\.3, IKEv2 IPsec, AES\-256, and Post\-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) standards. ● High proficiency in parsing and analyzing raw security data logs (JSON, SBOM formats). Must clear expedited enterprise security onboarding and strictly adhere to secure data\-handling protocols. Pay: $100\.00 \- $120\.00 per hour Benefits: * Health insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Irving, TX 75038

jobs.title: Principal Data Scientist
jobs.description: **About the team** ------------------ At Zillow Group, our mission is to help more people get home. The CoreTech Org delivers on this mission by building the foundational platforms, data, and developer capabilities that power every consumer, partner, and employee experience at Zillow. You will work most closely with the Connections Platform (CP) — the engine that turns consumer interest into a connection with the right partner, owning the conversational experience, the lead funnel and follow\-up workflows, and the shared agent services that sit underneath both. Increasingly, that experience is powered by LLM\-based and agentic systems: agents that qualify leads, summarize and extract intelligence from conversations for partner teams, and drive proactive outreach. Beyond CP, you will be a measurement partner for the broader CoreTech Org — the foundational platforms every consumer, partner, and employee experience at Zillow is built on — wherever a hard data science problem needs an owner. These are platforms with hundreds of touchpoints and dozens of dependent teams — and they have historically been among the hardest places at Zillow to measure well. CP itself is mid\-transformation, shifting from NLP to LLM and agent\-based systems, with agents increasingly built and relied on in production but no rigorous way to evaluate them yet. That combination — high dependency, hard\-to\-measure, and changing fast — is exactly where rigorous measurement creates the most leverage. **About the role** ------------------ We are seeking a **Principal Data Scientist** to be a measurement and impact partner in CoreTech. This is a senior individual\-contributor role embedded with the Data \& Infrastructure Platform team and who will partner tightly with Product leadership. You will own four outcomes: (1\) make the impact of platform work legible — quantifying what shipped, what moved, and what didn’t, in terms leaders can act on; (2\) define the metrics that matter for CP and the other platforms you take on — what belongs on a progress dashboard, what is a leading vs. lagging indicator, and what is vanity; (3\) build the evaluation layer CP is missing — standing up rigorous, repeatable evals for its LLM and agentic systems (including LLM\-as\-a\-judge) so the team can tell whether an agent actually works, not just that it shipped; and (4\) operationalize and instrument those metrics and evals in partnership with engineering — getting the events emitted, the pipelines stable, the dashboards live, and the data trusted. The defining challenge of this role is twofold. The first is **measuring causal impact** : CP has live, expensive, executive\-facing questions that hinge on making a credible impact claim when a clean A/B test isn’t available — conversational and agent\-driven flows that span a lead’s journey across sessions and channels, and changes that roll out to everyone at once. The second is **establishing an** **evaluation feedback loop** : much of CP now runs on LLM\-based and agentic systems that were built by engineers with no rigorous way to measure whether they actually work. You will own how we evaluate these systems — defining the signals that matter, standing up eval and experimentation frameworks (including LLM\-as\-a\-judge), and separating activity and adoption from genuine quality and outcomes. The same question recurs across CoreTech in many different areas, and you will need to help prove whether new features or infrastructure actually pay off, rather than trusting activity or adoption as proof. Owning these questions is the heart of the job. This is a high\-leverage, cross\-Zillow role: your work will set the measurement bar for platforms every product team at Zillow depends on, and your point of view will directly shape how Data \& Infrastructure Platform OKRs are written and reviewed at the executive level. **You will:** * Define and operationalize the measurement strategy for the Connections Platform and the broader Data \& Infrastructure Platform team — owning the throughline from raw events to executive dashboards and causal inference attribution. * Own the evaluation of CP’s LLM\-based and agentic systems: design the evals, define the quality signals, and build the frameworks (including LLM\-as\-a\-judge and using tooling such as Braintrust) that tell us whether an agent is actually working. * Own the causal inference and experimentation program for these teams: design and analyze A/B tests where you can, and where you can’t, build the quasi\-experimental causal inference design (switchbacks, difference\-in\-difference, synthetic control, interrupted time\-series) that produces a defensible estimate of impact. Know which method the situation calls for, what assumptions it rests on, and make the call for the best method to answer each hard question. * Be the credible authority on “what to measure” and “what to experiment on” for these teams — pushing back on vanity metrics, identifying the leading indi s, Econometrics, Data Science, User Experience Research, Machine Learning, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field. * Direct experience measuring complex, production user\-facing systems – for example, non\-deterministic ones such as conversational, LLM\-based, or agentic products (chat and voice assistants, lead or conversation funnels, agent\-driven workflows). * Fluency with modern evaluation methods and the judgment to know which signals to trust – approaches like LLM\-as\-a\-judge and offline/online eval harnesses, or adjacent evaluation experience. * Experience measuring the impact of AI or agentic tooling on real outcomes — separating adoption and activity from genuine productivity or quality gain, and reasoning about ROI against spend. * Experience operating inside a Platform\-as\-a\-Product model with internal teams as customers. * Fluency with quasi\-experimental and causal inference methods for when randomization isn’t possible — difference\-in\-difference, synthetic control, interrupted time\-series, and switchback or interleaved designs — including the discipline to state assumptions explicitly and be clear about what you can and cannot measure. **Get to know us** ------------------ At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most\-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality. How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise. Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list , reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow. No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together. *Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.* *Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.* *Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Full-Stack / AI-Native)
jobs.description: **About ZLayt AI** ZLayt AI is building the next generation of AI\-powered software for the legal industry. Our mission is to transform how law firms operate by replacing inefficient, manual processes with intelligent, automated workflows. We're building a modern, scalable platform that combines legal workflows, automation, and artificial intelligence to help law firms operate faster, smarter, and more efficiently. We're looking for exceptional engineers who want to build something meaningful from the ground up. **The Opportunity** We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer who is an exceptional individual contributor, enjoys solving difficult technical problems, and knows how to turn ideas into working software quickly. This is not a role for someone who wants to spend most of their time managing developers, attending meetings, or debating architecture. We want a builder. You'll work directly with engineering and product leadership to design, develop, and ship core features of our AI\-powered legal technology platform. You'll have meaningful ownership, significant autonomy, and the opportunity to help shape the architecture and engineering standards of a growing software company. **Our philosophy is simple: Build with a small team of exceptional engineers, leverage AI aggressively, and ship great software quickly.** **What You'll Own** 1\. Full\-Stack Product Development * Design, build, and maintain production\-ready frontend and backend applications. * Take features from requirements through architecture, development, testing, and deployment. * Develop intuitive interfaces and reliable backend services. * Build and maintain APIs, integrations, databases, and application infrastructure. * Write clean, maintainable, well\-documented code. 2\. AI\-Native Engineering * Use modern AI development tools to accelerate coding, debugging, testing, and documentation. * Integrate large language models and AI\-powered capabilities into production applications. * Develop AI\-powered workflows and automation features. * Evaluate new AI technologies and recommend practical applications. * Maintain engineering quality while increasing development velocity. 3\. Architecture and Scalability * Help design a secure, scalable, multi\-tenant SaaS platform. * Make thoughtful decisions around performance, reliability, security, and maintainability. * Build systems that can support a growing customer base. * Collaborate on technical architecture and infrastructure decisions. * Identify and eliminate technical bottlenecks. 4\. Quality and Execution * Own the quality of the features you deliver. * Implement automated testing and participate in code reviews. * Diagnose and resolve production bugs quickly. * Maintain high standards for security and data integrity. * Deliver committed work on time and communicate blockers early. 5\. Startup Collaboration * Work closely with product managers, engineering leadership, and business stakeholders. * Translate complex business problems into simple technical solutions. * Challenge unnecessary complexity and recommend better approaches. * Take initiative without waiting for detailed instructions. * Help establish practical engineering standards as the company scales. **Must\-Have Qualifications** * **5\+ years** of professional software engineering experience, including significant full\-stack development experience. * Proven experience building and shipping production SaaS applications. * Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript and modern frontend frameworks such as React or Next.js. * Strong backend development experience using Node.js, Python, or comparable technologies. * Experience designing REST APIs, working with relational databases, and building integrations. * Experience with cloud infrastructure such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. * Demonstrated ability to independently own features from concept through production. * Hands\-on experience using AI\-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or comparable solutions. * Strong understanding of testing, debugging, security, and performance optimization. * Experience working in fast\-paced environments with changing priorities. * Excellent problem\-solving and communication skills. **Strongly Preferred** * Experience working at an early\-stage SaaS startup. * Experience building multi\-tenant software platforms. * Experience integrating LLM APIs, AI agents, or workflow automation. * Experience with AI orchestration, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), or tool calling. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated QA, and infrastructure as code. * Familiarity with HIPAA, SOC 2, or other data\-security and compliance frameworks. * Experience building legal technology, healthcare technology, or other complex workflow products. * Experience working directly with founders or small product teams. **Who Thrives Here** You're likely a great fit if you: * Love building software more than talking about building software. * Are naturally curious about AI and use it regularly. * Prefer ownership and accountability over layers of management. * Can make pragmatic technical decisions without overengineering. * Enjoy working with talented people in a small team. * Move quickly while maintaining high standards. * Are excited about building a product from an early stage. * Want your contributions to have a direct impact on the success of the company. **Why Join ZLayt AI?** **Build something from the ground up.** You'll help shape the architecture, product, and engineering culture of an emerging AI company. **Work on meaningful problems.** We're tackling complex operational challenges in the legal industry with modern technology. **Small team, big ownership.** We believe exceptional engineers equipped with AI can accomplish what previously required much larger teams. **Move fast.** We value practical solutions, rapid iteration, and shipping working software. **Help define the future.** You'll have the opportunity to influence how AI is applied to real\-world legal workflows. We're looking for engineers who want to do the best work of their careers and help build a category\-defining company.

jobs.title: Mobile App Developer
jobs.description: **FT \- Mobile App Developer (Closes November 16, 2026\)** We're looking for a skilled Mobile App Developer to join our team and help build the next generation of AI\-powered mobile experiences. All of our mobile applications, including our Pocket Discipleship platform, are built around embedded AI features, from personalized content delivery to conversational AI and predictive engagement tools. This role requires deep native and cross\-platform mobile expertise, combined with hands\-on experience building, integrating, and optimizing AI\-driven features inside production mobile apps. You'll be responsible for building and maintaining both the mobile client experience and its connection to the AI models and services that power it. **Essential Duties** **Core Mobile Development** * Develop and maintain mobile applications for iOS and Android platforms. * Build new features for Pocket Discipleship, including user\-facing interfaces, local data handling, offline support, and integration with backend and AI services. * Conduct bug fixes and refactor code to improve app performance, stability, and responsiveness. * Consume and help design robust APIs to facilitate communication between the mobile app, backend services, and AI models. * Work closely with product managers and designers to translate product requirements into technical specifications and a polished mobile user experience. * Participate in the entire mobile development lifecycle, from concept and design to app store deployment and maintenance. **AI Integration** * Collaborate closely with our AI team to integrate AI models and services directly into the mobile experience, including LLM\-powered chat and conversational features, recommendation engines, and personalization systems. * Build mobile\-side logic to consume AI model outputs in real time, including handling streaming responses, latency, and graceful fallback when AI services are unavailable. * Optimize on\-device performance for AI\-powered features, balancing responsiveness, battery usage, and data consumption. * Implement and maintain prompt\-based or model\-driven UI states, ensuring the interface can adapt to dynamic, AI\-generated content. * Work with the AI team to test, validate, and iterate on AI feature behavior from the mobile client's perspective, including edge cases and unexpected model outputs. * Stay current on mobile\-specific AI tooling and SDKs (such as on\-device inference frameworks, Core ML, ML Kit, or similar) and recommend where they can improve app performance or reduce dependency on server calls. **Qualifications, Knowledge, and Skills** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. * 5\+ years of professional experience in mobile application development. * Proficiency in mobile frameworks such as Swift/SwiftUI, Kotlin/Jetpack Compose, React Native, or Flutter. * Demonstrated, hands\-on experience integrating AI/ML models or AI\-powered services into mobile applications, not just backend or web systems. * Familiarity with consuming LLM APIs (such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) from a mobile client, including handling streaming responses and token\-based interactions. * Working knowledge of on\-device machine learning tools such as Core ML, ML Kit, TensorFlow Lite, and an understanding of when on\-device versus server\-side inference makes sense. * Expertise in consuming backend APIs built with languages such as Python, Node.js, or Java. * Strong experience with local and remote database technologies (SQLite, Core Data, Realm, and cloud\-backed SQL/NoSQL). * Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, including AI/ML services offered by those platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure AI, or similar). * Manage app store deployment pipelines, CI/CD automation, and mobile release processes for reliability and scalability. * Experience writing and maintaining unit tests, UI tests, and automated test suites, including tests that account for non\-deterministic AI outputs. * Competence in mobile monitoring and crash reporting tools (Sentry, Firebase Crashlytics, Datadog) to ensure uptime and performance, including monitoring for AI service latency/failures. * Deep knowledge of secure coding practices, vulnerability mitigation, and encryption techniques on mobile platforms, including secure handling of data sent to and from AI models. **Preferred Qualifications** * Prior experience shipping a consumer\-facing mobile app with a chat\-based or conversational AI feature. * Experience with vector databases or retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) patterns as consumed from a mobile client. * Familiarity with prompt engineering fundamentals, even if primarily working on the client side. * Experience with A/B testing or feature flagging systems specifically for iterating on AI\-driven features. **Other Specifications:** This job description conveys the scope, qualifications, and duties of this role; however, it is not an exhaustive list of the responsibilities or working conditions. **About:** It is the mission of **Zion Church** to help people **EXPERIENCE**God, **ENGAGE**in connections, be **EQUIPPED** through training, and **EMPOWERED**to serve. **Zion Church** offers a generous benefits package for its full\-time team which includes health, vision, dental, and life insurances; many of which are funded at 90\-100% by the organization, a selection of elective benefits; along with education reimbursements for upskilling, degree pursuit and certifications. Also included is a 401K plan for full and part\-time team members with company matches; unlimited PTO for full\-time team\-members; and 60\-hours of PTO for part\-time team members prorated depending upon a start date. All new team members at **Zion Church** complete a **90\-day probationary period**. During this time, supervisors assess performance, job readiness, and alignment with Zion’s employment standards, while team members also determine whether the role is a good fit. At the end of the 90 days, performance will be reviewed. Based on management’s judgment, employment may continue as regular status, the probationary period may be extended, or employment may be ended. Completion of the probationary period does not alter the team member’s at\-will employment status. **EEO Statement:** **Zion Church** is an equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants for employment. Zion prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. *\*\* Background Check Required \*\**

jobs.title: Sr. Production Engineer
jobs.description: Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200\+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE\-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world's largest in\-line cloud security platform. We believe the future of work is Human \+ AI and are building an AI\-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world's hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler. **Role** We are looking for a Sr. Production Engineer to join our team. This is a hybrid (3 days a week in San Jose, CA) or Bellevue, WA role, reporting to the Senior Manager, Site Reliability Engineering in the Cloud Infrastructure \& Operations department. Join Zscaler to be a force multiplier for the reliability of a global platform protecting over 15 million users. In this role, you will provide the technical vision and hands\-on execution to drive an "automation\-first" culture across the company. By maturing our observability and architectural standards, you will directly reduce our Mean Time to Mitigate (MTTM) and shape the scalability of our globally distributed, multi\-cloud infrastructure. **What you'll do (Role Expectations)** * Design and implement highly available, scalable infrastructure across AWS, Azure, GCP, and bare\-metal environments * Drive an "automation\-first" culture by writing code (Python/Go) to eliminate manual toil and build self\-healing systems * Implement and maintain sophisticated observability (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry), define SLIs/SLOs, and establish error budgets * Act as a lead Incident Commander (TDO on\-call), develop response playbooks, and conduct deep\-dive post\-incident analyses * Partner with Engineering and partner teams to conduct operability reviews **Who You Are (Success Profile)** * You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful. * You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high\-level strategy and hands\-on execution. * You are a problem\-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser\-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact. * You are a high\-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust. * You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose. **What We're Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)** * Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI\-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain * 4 years of experience managing reliability, scalability, and availability for large\-scale production services with deep expertise in programming (e.g., Python, Go, or C/C\+\+) * Strong background in networking protocols, Linux/FreeBSD systems, and distributed architecture * Experience in high\-stakes incident management and participation in a 24/7 on\-call rotation * Proficiency in leveraging ITIL frameworks and incident data to drive service maturity through systematic problem management and technical operability reviews **What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)** * Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency * Experience implementing AI\-driven AIOps tools, machine learning models for anomaly detection, or predictive capacity planning to optimize infrastructure reliability and automate incident response * Extensive experience with public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Ansible, Terraform), and chaos engineering or disaster recovery planning at scale * Expertise in global routing (BGP), traffic tunneling (GRE, IPSec), L7 proxy architectures (HAProxy), DNS at scale, and OS networking stack internals \#LI\-CM3 \#LI\-Remote At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure. Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including: * Various health plans * Time off plans for vacation and sick time * Parental leave options * Retirement options * Education reimbursement * In\-office perks, and more! Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits here. By applying for this role, you adhere to applicable laws, regulations, and Zscaler policies, including those related to security and privacy standards and guidelines. Zscaler is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. We strive to create a workplace where employees are treated with respect and have the chance to succeed. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy or related medical conditions), age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. *See more information by clicking on the* *Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal* *link.* Pay Transparency Zscaler complies with all applicable federal, state, and local pay transparency rules. Zscaler is committed to providing reasonable support (called accommodations or adjustments) in our recruiting processes for candidates who are differently abled, have long term conditions, mental health conditions or sincerely held religious beliefs, or who are neurodivergent or require pregnancy\-related support.

Do you thrive in a collaborative, innovative environment where your contributions drive real impact? If so, Acre Security is the place for you. Join us in making the world a safer place — one innovation at a time.** **About Acre** **At Acre, we're not just building security solutions — we’re empowering security professionals to adapt and thrive in a rapidly changing world. Since our inception in 2012, Acre has been at the forefront of innovation in access control, visitor management, and intrusion software. Our solutions are trusted by organizations in over 25 countries, delivering smarter, more adaptable, and easier\-to\-use security technologies that protect what matters most.** **Your Impact** **We’re looking for a** **Technical Support Engineer** **to join our global Support team, supporting customers across the Western US region. This role is critical to ensuring a high‑quality customer experience by providing technical expertise across Acre’s software platforms and partner integrations. You’ll build deep product knowledge while supporting customers through timely, accurate, and professional technical assistance.** **What You’ll Do** **In addition to the above, your key responsibilities will include:** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- * Learn and maintain strong knowledge of Acre’s software products, partner integrations, and supported technologies * Provide technical support to customers via phone, ticketing systems, and other support channels * Troubleshoot software, networking, and system‑level issues with a strong focus on customer experience * Continuously test Acre software and integrations to support quality assurance and product reliability * Respond to incoming customer calls and technical inquiries requiring assistance * Participate in an after‑hours on‑call rotation to support customers 24/7/365 * Maintain accurate documentation and records within support and ticketing systems * Continuously build professional, technical, and product knowledge to improve issue resolution and customer outcomes * Create and maintain weekly or monthly reports as directed by leadership. **What You’ll Bring** To succeed in this role, you’ll need:* Strong customer service and communication skills * Excellent analytical and troubleshooting abilities * Fluency in English (written and verbal) * Strong organizational skills and attention to detail * Ability to learn quickly and perform effectively in a fast‑paced jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Gravitee** ------------------ Recognized in Gartner's inaugural 2026 Magic Quadrant for AI Agent Management Platforms and named a Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for API Management for three consecutive years, Gravitee brings AI agents and the APIs they rely on under one unified control plane. We provide a platform for managing and securing APIs, event streams, and AI agent interactions. Organizations including Michelin, Roche, and Blue Yonder use Gravitee to control and observe systems their businesses depend on. **Why join us?** * **The mission:** Help define how enterprises securely adopt AI agents, alongside the APIs and event streams they already rely on. * **The momentum:** Join a high\-growth market leader that combines proven technology and customer trust with the pace of a scale\-up. * **The culture:** We hire pragmatic builders who take ownership, collaborate openly, and Hold Nothing Back. **The Role \& Why It Exists** ----------------------------- We are looking for Senior Software Engineers to build Gravitee's core products and the next\-generation product surface in Gamma. You will join one of three areas: API Management (APIM) and the gateway runtime, Access Management (AM), or the Event Gateway for Kafka. The work sits where API governance, identity, event streaming, and AI agent management meet. These are new roles in the US. Today, most core platform engineering is based in Europe. These hires build US\-hours ownership of Level 3 and Level 4 escalations for our products, and add delivery capacity toward parity in Gamma and the AI Agent Management roadmap. You will split your time roughly 80% feature delivery and 20% L3/L4 support and bug fixing (it varies week to week), working as an embedded member of a product team based in Europe. We will match you to the area that best fits your experience. This is a hands\-on role for an engineer who is comfortable moving between services, APIs, data models, and technical design. **Location:** Denver, Colorado preferred. Elsewhere in the US is acceptable, with monthly travel to the Denver hub. **What You Will Be Doing** -------------------------- **In this role, you will:** * Design and deliver features end to end, from technical design through implementation, testing, release, and iteration, on one of Gravitee's product areas: API Management and the gateway runtime, Access Management, or the Event Gateway for Kafka. * Build and evolve Java services and APIs, including performance\-sensitive, asynchronous code in the runtime. * Contribute to the customer experience in the Gamma console, across backend APIs and TypeScript and Angular interfaces, as your team needs. * Keep security behavior and upgrades safe: secure defaults, certificate and secret handling, audit logs, safe migrations, and backward compatibility. * Own US\-hours Level 3 and Level 4 escalations for your product as part of the L3 pager duty rotation. * Help bring AI agent management to the platform, including AI Gateways, MCP, and agent\-to\-agent interactions. * Use LLMs and AI\-assisted development tools thoughtfully for prototyping, implementation, testing, and debugging, applying sound engineering judgment to validate AI\-generated work. * Write meaningful automated tests and contribute to reliable delivery, across Gravitee's open\-source platform and Enterprise Edition. * Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers, including teams based in Europe, and improve solutions through code and design reviews. **Essential Skills** -------------------- **We are looking for evidence that you can succeed in the role, whether gained through employment, open\-source work, or equivalent practical experience:** * 5\+ years building and operating production software, on a team that ships and supports its own product; you have personally resolved production incidents. * Strong Java experience, including maintainable REST APIs and backend services. Strong C\# with the same object\-oriented depth is also considered. * A solid understanding of API design, data modeling, distributed systems, and asynchronous workflows. * Experience with relational or document data stores, including safe migrations and backward compatibility. * A security\-first mindset: authentication and authorization fundamentals, secure defaults, and certificate and secret handling. * Experience with automated testing, Git\-based development, code review, and iterative product delivery. * Hands\-on experience using LLMs or AI coding assistants as part of an engineering workflow, combined with the judgment to review and improve their output. * Clear communication, and the ability to take an ambiguous problem through to production. * Willingness to join an L3 pager duty rotation in US hours. **Desired Skills** ------------------ **You do not need to match every item. We would be especially interested in experience with:** * Gateways and runtimes: reactive Java (Vert.x, RxJava, Netty), or an API gateway, proxy, or service\-mesh vendor or platform team (for example Kong, Google Apigee, MuleSoft, Tyk, Solo.io, Traefik, WSO2\). * Identity: implementing OAuth 2\.0 and OIDC flows, SAML 2\.0, SCIM, MFA, WebAuthn/FIDO2, or FAPI, CIBA, and UMA profiles. * Event streaming: Kafka internals, binary protocols, backpressure, and performance under load. * Frontend: TypeScript with Angular or another component\-based framework, including data\-rich interfaces. * Cloud native: Docker, Kubernetes, operators and CRDs, and Elasticsearch or OpenSearch. * AI: MCP, Agent2Agent (A2A), tool calling, LLM proxies, or building LLM\-powered applications. Prior production experience is not required. * Open\-source software or enterprise developer platforms. **Who Thrives at Gravitee** --------------------------- Our growth is powered by people who bring passion to what they build, professionalism to how they work, and a commitment to doing things well**.** **You will thrive here if you:** * Bring energy and a constructive attitude to the team. * Adapt quickly and enjoy learning unfamiliar technologies and domains. * Take ownership, communicate clearly, and follow through with urgency. * Balance delivery speed with thoughtful engineering judgment. * Start with the customer problem and care about the quality of the experience you create. * Enjoy working in a fast\-moving, collaborative, international environment. **Life at Gravitee** -------------------- At Gravitee, we invest in humans, not just roles. **You'll get:** * Competitive medical coverage. * Pension / 401(k) program options. * Stock options \- you build it, you own it. * 25 days of holiday plus in\-country national holidays. * Three mental health days and a wellness allowance. * Your birthday off. * A professional development budget to support your growth. * A hybrid work culture with hubs across regions. * Quarterly team events and an annual company offsite. * A collaborative, international company culture. * Opportunities to grow your scope and career as Gravitee grows. *At Gravitee, we believe diverse perspectives make better products and stronger teams.* *No employee or applicant will be treated less favorably on the grounds of sex, marital status, race, color, nationality, ethnic or national origin, disability, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, pregnancy or maternity, marital or civil partner status, religion, or belief.* *By applying, you consent to Gravitee storing and processing the personal information you submit as part of the recruitment process.*

familiarity collaborating with architects to translate architectural designs into actionable engineering roadmaps * Recognized depth in engineering implementations, combined with breadth to assess system\-wide implications; proven ability to make rapid, high\-confidence judgements on when to engage directly with engineers versus delegating * Demonstrated ability to influence product strategy and investment decisions through technical insights on feasibility, risk, and business impact * Experience defining enterprise semantic layers and canonical models — including taxonomies, ontologies, and knowledge graphs — used across multiple product teams and business domains * Exposure to AI\-driven systems including optimization, predictions, and Agents;
