jobs.description: ### **About Mecka AI** Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI. We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware\-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems. We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real\-world data, simulation, learning\-based systems, and deployed hardware. **The role** You'll take arms we buy off the shelf and make them safely, precisely controllable by an operator thousands of kilometers away. Many of these arms ship with no teleop stack and no teleop input device, so you'll choose and integrate the operator hardware, write the mapping from human motion to robot motion, and own everything that runs on the robot. You'll also be the person who makes sure every frame of data we record is correctly timestamped and synchronized. **What you'll do** * Integrate new commercial arms and grippers: vendor SDKs, drivers, calibration, and a common control interface. * Evaluate and integrate operator input devices (leader arms, VR controllers, 6\-DoF mice, haptics). * Write and tune inverse kinematics and Cartesian/joint controllers for high DOF robotic arms for teleoperation and manipulation. * Design for latency you can't remove: local safety limits, workspace and collision constraints, graceful handling of dropped or late packets, and safe stop when the link degrades. * Prototype shared\-autonomy features (assisted grasping, motion smoothing, task\-level primitives) that make long\-distance teleop faster and less tiring. * Own sensor integration: cameras, depth, wrist cams, joint state, force/torque. Get time synchronization right across all of them. * Work with a Teleop Platform Engineer on the end\-to\-end latency budget and on what we record, at what rate, in what format. * Go to robot sites when needed to bring up hardware and debug in person. **What we're looking for** * 3\+ years writing production level software that runs real robot hardware (arms strongly preferred), in industry or a serious research lab. * Strong in C\+\+ and/or Python; comfortable with Linux, real\-time considerations, and debugging at the hardware boundary. * Solid grasp of manipulator kinematics: forward/inverse kinematics, Jacobians, singularities, joint limits, and at least one way of doing Cartesian control well. * Experience with a robotics middleware stack (e.g., ROS 2\) or a good reason you chose not to use one. * You've integrated a robot from a vendor SDK, not just in simulation. * Comfortable owning safety\-relevant code and being careful about it. **Nice to have** * Built a teleoperation system before, especially over unreliable or long\-distance networks. * Experience with impedance/admittance control, force feedback, or haptics. * Familiarity with robot learning data: demonstration collection, imitation learning, episode formats. * Experience with motion planning libraries, simulation, or calibration tooling. * Some networking or systems performance experience: you can read a packet capture and profile a control loop. * Experience with VR/XR If you don't check every box above but believe you can do the job, we encourage you to apply — we're looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, we will partner with you to meet your needs. We may use AI\-assisted tools to help evaluate applications against the requirements of this role. These tools support our recruiting team in identifying qualified candidates but do not replace human judgment or limit which applications may be reviewed or considered. Compensation Range: $200K \- $240K

jobs.description: ### **About Mecka AI** Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI. We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware\-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems. We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real\-world data, simulation, learning\-based systems, and deployed hardware. **The role** Our operators control robots across countries and oceans. You'll own the link between them: getting multiple camera streams to the operator and commands back to the robot with as little delay and jitter as physics allows, and building the interface operators use all day. Because every byte you stream is also training data, you'll own recording it on\-site and getting it reliably off\-site too. **What you'll do** * Build the real\-time transport between robot sites and operator stations: low\-latency video (multiple cameras, possibly depth), robot state, and control commands over the public internet. * Own the end\-to\-end latency budget. Instrument glass\-to\-glass and command\-to\-motion latency, find where every millisecond goes, and cut it: encoding settings, transport choice, routing, jitter buffers, relay placement. * Make the link robust: NAT traversal, congestion and packet loss, bandwidth adaptation, reconnection, and clear signals to the operator and robot when quality degrades. * Design and build the operator interface: camera layouts, robot state and health, task instructions, latency and connection indicators, and fast workflows for starting, labeling, and ending episodes. * Build operator\-facing tooling: queueing operators to robots across sites, session handoff, and basic fleet visibility. * Own on\-site recording: capture synchronized streams and metadata into a well\-defined episode format, buffer locally, and upload reliably over constrained site networks. * Set up the infrastructure for data storage and access of robot teleop episodes. **What we're looking for** * 3\+ years building production level real\-time networked systems: video streaming, video conferencing, cloud gaming, remote desktop, live broadcast, or similar. * Hands\-on experience with low\-latency media transport (e.g., WebRTC, RTP/SRTP, QUIC/UDP\-based protocols) and video encoding trade\-offs. * You've measured and reduced latency in a production system and can explain where the time went. * Comfortable building a polished interface yourself, web or native, with good product instincts for people who use a tool eight hours a day. * Strong in at least one of TypeScript, Go, Rust, C\+\+, or Python; comfortable across client, server, and edge devices. * Comfortable deploying and debugging software on remote Linux machines you can't physically touch. **Nice to have** * Experience with robotics, teleoperation, drones, or other remote\-control systems. * Hardware video encode/decode on edge devices; multi\-camera synchronization. * Built data pipelines that move large volumes of sensor or video data from the edge to cloud storage. * Experience with global network deployment: relays/TURN, choosing regions, measuring paths between countries. * Game development, VR/XR, or other latency\-sensitive interaction design. jobs.title: People Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** ------------------ Nscale is building an AI\-native People function. As a People Systems Engineer, you'll build the custom tools, integrations, and AI agents that make our People platforms work as one system and help our teams support a growing global workforce. This is a greenfield opportunity to shape how we build. You'll have meaningful ownership of technical design, tooling, and delivery, with room to experiment with frontier AI capabilities and take promising ideas into production. Your scope includes extending Workday and Greenhouse, connecting systems, and independently developing applications and services beyond existing platforms. Working alongside the People Systems Product Manager and Corporate Engineering partners, you'll build agentic workflows that answer questions, complete tasks, and bring people in when judgment is needed. Trusted workforce data and permission\-aware access are foundations for this work, allowing agents to act under the user's identity and within applicable permissions, business rules, and approval requirements. Our engineering principles are straightforward: use proven platforms where the problem is solved, build where we need something new, and make agentic workflows a core part of how we scale. Everything we deploy must be something we can support. **What You'll Be Doing** ------------------------ * Independently design, build, and support custom People tools, applications, and services * Develop agentic workflows and People capabilities for Nscale's shared employee agent, taking emerging models and AI tooling from experimentation into production * Build integrations and automations across Workday, Greenhouse, and adjacent systems, connecting employee lifecycle processes around authoritative data sources * Partner with Security and Corporate Engineering on reusable access services for applications and agents, enforcing user permissions and business approval requirements, and capturing audit evidence * Make technical design and build\-versus\-buy decisions through shared architecture and security reviews, accounting for existing capabilities and total cost of ownership * Own delivery from design through business acceptance, release, evaluation, and ongoing support, retiring redundant tools and manual processes as capabilities mature **What You Bring** ------------------ * A track record of independently shipping and supporting custom applications, enterprise integrations, or automation solutions * Strong technical skills across application development, APIs, data flows, and automation tooling, with judgment about when to configure, integrate, or build * Demonstrated ability to build production\-grade LLM applications and tool\-using AI agents, with hands\-on experience using integration protocols such as MCP to integrate agents with enterprise systems * Practical Workday expertise across integrations, security, business processes, and workforce data, supported by a working knowledge of the employee lifecycle * Ability to translate ambiguous needs into maintainable solutions, secure access patterns, and achievable delivery commitments * Clear communication with engineers, People partners, and senior stakeholders about architecture, trade\-offs, total cost of ownership, and risk **Outcomes You'll Own** ----------------------- * Greater operational capacity through custom tooling, automation, and agent\-led self\-service, measured by successful task completion and reduced manual effort * Useful AI capabilities in production, with performance measured against defined success criteria, appropriate guardrails, and effective human escalation * Trusted workforce data and secure access across connected systems, with clear authority, enforced permissions, and traceable actions * Reliable services and predictable delivery, measured against published service levels, agreed dates, and measurable business impact * A simpler, supportable technology estate, with reusable capabilities, fewer redundant tools, understood operating costs, and clear ownership **What we can offer you** ------------------------- At Nscale, you'll find a collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment where your contributions spark real impact. We're building something extraordinary, and we want you at the core. Highly competitive US compensation package (base \+ bonus \+ equity), with performance reviews every 12 months. Join one of the fastest\-growing AI infrastructure companies — your chance to directly shape how global AI capacity is planned and deployed. ✨ Expect a dynamic progression plan tailored to your ambitions. Grow by leading critical cross\-functional initiatives and shaping capital strategy — always with our full support. Human\-First Flexibility: We treat you as humans first. Our flexible workplace trusts Nscalers to deliver, giving you the autonomy to shape your day around life's moments. **Equal Opportunities Statement** --------------------------------- We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ\+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio\-economic backgrounds. If there's anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know. The employee may be required to perform additional duties, tasks, and responsibilities as assigned by management, consistent with the skills and qualifications required for the role. *For information on how Nscale handles candidate personal data, please see our Employee \& Candidate Privacy Notice:* *Here.* *Nscale does not accept unsolicited candidate submissions from recruitment agencies.*

jobs.title: Senior Manufacturing Test Engineer
jobs.description: Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award\-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles. Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office. We are seeking a Senior Manufacturing Test Engineer to lead end\-to\-end test strategy, design, development, and deployment of production test solutions for ŌURA products, working closely with internal cross\-functional teams and global Contract Manufacturers (CMs). As a Senior Manufacturing Test Engineer at ŌURA, you will own the design, development, and optimization of manufacturing test solutions across the full product lifecycle — from early concept through mass production. You will be a technical leader responsible for test architecture, test software, CM execution, data analytics, and continuous quality improvement. This role requires strong hands\-on engineering skills, systems thinking, and the ability to operate effectively across design, operations, quality, and external manufacturing partners. **This is a hybrid role requiring 2\-3 days a week in our San Francisco office.** ### **What You Will Do:** * Drive early and ongoing Design for Testability (DFT) engagement with Hardware, Systems, and Product teams to ensure robust, scalable, and cost\-effective product testing. * Define test requirements aligned with product specifications and quality targets, incorporating DFMEA/PFMEA, engineering specifications, and test coverage analysis into product development. * Own test engineering across the full product lifecycle, from POC and prototype through EVT, DVT, PVT, production ramp, and mass production. * Architect, design, and deploy manufacturing test stations, equipment, fixtures, and processes to support high\-volume production. * Develop and maintain test software and automation using Python, TestStand, and LabVIEW, including instrument control, data acquisition, test sequencing, error handling, and factory data integration. * Build modular, scalable, and maintainable test frameworks that support manufacturing efficiency, repeatability, and long\-term production needs. * Apply statistical methods including GR\&R, SPC, Cp/Cpk, correlation analysis, and DOE to validate test capability, drive process improvements, and ensure production readiness. * Lead failure analysis, root cause investigations, and resolution of complex production issues, including yield excursions, test coverage gaps, and correlation discrepancies across internal labs and external factories. Drive continuous improvement in product quality, manufacturing yield, and test cost. * Serve as the primary technical interface to Contract Manufacturers (CMs) and test equipment vendors, leading test development, qualification, deployment, sustaining, and technical issue resolution. * Partner cross\-functionally with Hardware, Firmware, Quality, Operations, Supply Chain, and Program teams; communicate test readiness, production risks, and technical recommendations to leadership and executive stakeholders. ### **What you'll bring** * 5\+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, test engineering, or automation (assembly, inspection, test station design, or factory deployment). * Hands\-on experience developing manufacturing test software in Python, C, C\+\+, Rust. * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline. * Experience supporting development builds and mass production with global manufacturing partners. * Willingness to travel upto 25% across domestic and international factory sites. ### **Nice to have:** * Experience working with wearables, consumer electronics, sensors, or embedded systems. * Strong background in test station qualification and correlation (calibration, GR\&R, Cp/Cpk, DOE). * Experience working cross\-functionally with hardware, firmware, systems, quality, and operations teams. * Familiarity with optical, RF, or semiconductor\-based test methodologies. * Proven ability to operate effectively in a global, fast\-paced manufacturing environment. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills across cultures and time zones. ### **What Success Looks Like:** * First 90 Days: You've completed a DFT review on at least one active program, built working relationships with CM test teams and cross\-functional partners (Hardware, Quality, Operations), and audited existing test stations, fixtures, and software for coverage gaps. * 6 Months: You've architected and deployed a production test station or major test software release, closed at least one significant correlation or test gap between internal labs and CM factories, and shown measurable improvement in yield or false\-call rate on an owned product line. * 12 Months: You're the recognized technical authority for test engineering on your product line(s), CM teams can sustain your test solutions independently, and you've contributed reusable test frameworks or playbooks adopted by other programs. ### **Benefits** At Ōura, we care about you and your well\-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health. What we offer: * Competitive salary and equity packages * Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources * An Ōura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends \& family * 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off * Paid sick leave and parental leave Ōura takes a market\-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. US locations are categorized into tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. * **San Francisco Salary Range: $172,550 \- $203,000** A recruiter can determine your Region based on your US location. We are not considering candidates residing in the following states: Alaska (AK), Delaware (DE), Iowa (IA), Mississippi (MS), Nebraska (NE), South Dakota (SD), West Virginia (WV), and Wisconsin (WI). ŌURA is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Individuals seeking employment at ŌURA are considered without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, race, religion (including beliefs and practices or the absence thereof), sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Disclaimer: Beware of fake job offers! We’ve been alerted to scammers posing as ŌURA recruiters, especially for remote roles. Please note: * Our jobs are listed only on the ŌURA Careers page and trusted job boards. * We will never ask for personal information like ID or payment for equipment upfront. * Official offers are sent through Docusign after a verbal offer, not via text or email. Stay cautious and protect your personal details. To all recruitment agencies: ŌURA does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, ŌURA employees, or any other organization's location. ŌURA is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

operational needs with sustained investments in prevention, automation, and platform protections. * Guide the design and delivery of systems that detect phishing, malicious workloads, payment fraud, and appeals. * Lead the team’s response to significant fraud and abuse incidents, coordinating with other Security teams, Infrastructure, Support, Finance, and Legal. * Establish sustainable on\-call and response practices, including clear ownership, runbooks, escalation paths, and learning from incidents. * Partner with Product and Engineering to introduce protections at the right points in the customer lifecycle, balancing prevention with onboarding friction and false positives. * Turn knowledge of attacker behavior and recurring abuse campaigns into improvements that protect ence managing and developing engineers, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and building a healthy, inclusive team. * A strong background in software and security engineering, with the ability to guide system design, review technical proposals, and make pragmatic architectural tradeoffs. * Experience building or operating systems for fraud prevention, abuse detection, Trust \& Safety, or adversarial security problems. * Experience leading teams with on\-call or incident response responsibilities, and sound judgement when decisions must be made with incomplete information. * The ability to translate ambiguous threats and business needs into clear priorities, incremental milestones, and shipped improvements. * Experience using data to evaluate detection quality, understand operational problems, and measure whether interventions work. * Clear communication and effective collaboration across engineering and business teams, including explaining risks and tradeoffs to hosting, account compromise, or coordinated abuse campaigns. * Experience building threat intelligence pipelines, linking related malicious accounts, or integrating external reputation signals. * jobs.title: Associate Product Manager
jobs.description: **About weavix** **Connected by our Shared vision** Our purpose is to improve work through disruptive innovation. We believe the frontline workforce is the greatest asset an enterprise has, and we’re here to support them. Guided by our founding principles, weavix™ is pioneering the future of work to create advanced technologies that empower and connect the worker, not just things. **Building Each Other Up** We’re bringing entire enterprises closer together, and you can’t do that alone. Our offices offer a dynamic community full of opportunity, empowerment and dedication to grow and refine your talents. weavix™ isn’t just your next job. What you’ll find is a team encouraging you every step of the way as you become part of the next generation of industry leaders. **The Good Stuff** When you’re part of the weavix™ team, you’re given the tools and freedom to succeed. We offer competitive salaries, flexible time off and comprehensive benefits packages to attract the best talent out there. Plus, we encourage continuing development to stay sharp and current as you grow into tomorrow’s industry leader. Our people deserve the best, so we give it to them. Simple as that. **Position Summary** The Associate Product Manager joins the Product \& Engineering organization and works alongside experienced Product Managers to turn what weavix hears from the field into features that ship. This is a hands\-on role built to grow into a full Product Manager position. The role owns well\-scoped features end to end, keeps engineering unblocked, and ensures every release lands cleanly with customers, Customer Success, and Sales. The team works AI\-first, using AI daily to research, write, and build working prototypes that show engineering exactly what to build. **Key Responsibilities** **Customer \& Field Insight** * Join customer calls, site visits, and ride\-alongs with Customer Success and Field Solutions to see how crews use Walt on plant floors and job sites. * Turn field tickets, support trends, usage data, and sales feedback into clear problem statements the team can prioritize. * Track competing radio and frontline communication products and summarize what matters for the roadmap. **Execution \& Engineering Alignment** * Write user stories, acceptance criteria, and lightweight specs for owned features, and keep them current in Jira. * Attend Scrum ceremonies with the assigned pod, answer product questions quickly, and escalate trade\-offs to the Product Team and the Engineering Manager before they affect a milestone. * Understand how each feature touches Walt firmware, Cloud, Mobile, and Data so nothing ships half\-integrated. * Test features in development, join QA reviews, and confirm that what shipped matches what the customer needed. **Launch \& Adoption** * Prepare release notes, internal enablement, and FAQs for features as they are released. * Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success so they can explain and sell what ships. * Define success metrics with the Product Manager and report on adoption after launch. **AI\-Powered Product Work** * Use AI tools to research customers, markets, and competitors, synthesize field feedback, and draft PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria; validate the output and own the final document. * Build clickable or working prototypes of specific features with AI coding and design tools, such as Claude Code, to test ideas before engineering commits. * Package each prototype with the user flow, features demonstrated, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and known gaps so engineers can build the production version without guesswork. **Qualifications** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 2\+ years in product management, business analysis, QA, software engineering, technical support, solutions consulting, or a similar role. * Technical fluency: understands the basics of how software is built, tested, and released, and is comfortable reading API documentation or asking engineers the right follow\-up questions. * Clear writing: able to write a user story, a release note, and a short decision memo that people read. * Analytical habits: comfortable pulling and interpreting data; SQL is a plus. * AI fluency: demonstrated history of using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) daily to research, write, and analyze, with the judgment to check AI output for accuracy. * Able to build a working prototype of a feature with AI\-assisted coding or design tools. * Follows through without being chased, raises risks early, and stays calm when priorities shift. * Willing to travel to customer sites (manufacturing plants, job sites, distribution centers) up to 25% of the time. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in industrial or frontline sectors (manufacturing, construction, logistics, oil and gas), or firsthand familiarity with how work gets done on a plant floor or job site. * Exposure to products that combine hardware and software, or to IoT, telecom, or mobile apps. * Experience with Jira, Confluence, or similar tools, and with Agile/Scrum teams. * Familiarity with enterprise B2B SaaS concepts such as SSO, admin permissions, APIs, and integrations. * Bilingual, especially in Spanish. * Side projects or internal tools built with AI coding assistants, or working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or React. * Experience prompting LLM APIs or shipping simple AI\-powered features. *The above statements are not an exhaustive list of job duties and responsibilities of this position. jobs.title: Senior Manufacturing Test Engineer
jobs.description: Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award\-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles. Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office. We are seeking a Senior Manufacturing Test Engineer to lead end\-to\-end test strategy, design, development, and deployment of production test solutions for ŌURA products, working closely with internal cross\-functional teams and global Contract Manufacturers (CMs). As a Senior Manufacturing Test Engineer at ŌURA, you will own the design, development, and optimization of manufacturing test solutions across the full product lifecycle — from early concept through mass production. You will be a technical leader responsible for test architecture, test software, CM execution, data analytics, and continuous quality improvement. This role requires strong hands\-on engineering skills, systems thinking, and the ability to operate effectively across design, operations, quality, and external manufacturing partners. **This is a hybrid role requiring 2\-3 days a week in our San Francisco office.** ### **What You Will Do:** * Drive early and ongoing Design for Testability (DFT) engagement with Hardware, Systems, and Product teams to ensure robust, scalable, and cost\-effective product testing. * Define test requirements aligned with product specifications and quality targets, incorporating DFMEA/PFMEA, engineering specifications, and test coverage analysis into product development. * Own test engineering across the full product lifecycle, from POC and prototype through EVT, DVT, PVT, production ramp, and mass production. * Architect, design, and deploy manufacturing test stations, equipment, fixtures, and processes to support high\-volume production. * Develop and maintain test software and automation using Python, TestStand, and LabVIEW, including instrument control, data acquisition, test sequencing, error handling, and factory data integration. * Build modular, scalable, and maintainable test frameworks that support manufacturing efficiency, repeatability, and long\-term production needs. * Apply statistical methods including GR\&R, SPC, Cp/Cpk, correlation analysis, and DOE to validate test capability, drive process improvements, and ensure production readiness. * Lead failure analysis, root cause investigations, and resolution of complex production issues, including yield excursions, test coverage gaps, and correlation discrepancies across internal labs and external factories. Drive continuous improvement in product quality, manufacturing yield, and test cost. * Serve as the primary technical interface to Contract Manufacturers (CMs) and test equipment vendors, leading test development, qualification, deployment, sustaining, and technical issue resolution. * Partner cross\-functionally with Hardware, Firmware, Quality, Operations, Supply Chain, and Program teams; communicate test readiness, production risks, and technical recommendations to leadership and executive stakeholders. ### **What you'll bring** * 5\+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, test engineering, or automation (assembly, inspection, test station design, or factory deployment). * Hands\-on experience developing manufacturing test software in Python, C, C\+\+, Rust. * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline. * Experience supporting development builds and mass production with global manufacturing partners. * Willingness to travel upto 25% across domestic and international factory sites. ### **Nice to have:** * Experience working with wearables, consumer electronics, sensors, or embedded systems. * Strong background in test station qualification and correlation (calibration, GR\&R, Cp/Cpk, DOE). * Experience working cross\-functionally with hardware, firmware, systems, quality, and operations teams. * Familiarity with optical, RF, or semiconductor\-based test methodologies. * Proven ability to operate effectively in a global, fast\-paced manufacturing environment. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills across cultures and time zones. ### **What Success Looks Like:** * First 90 Days: You've completed a DFT review on at least one active program, built working relationships with CM test teams and cross\-functional partners (Hardware, Quality, Operations), and audited existing test stations, fixtures, and software for coverage gaps. * 6 Months: You've architected and deployed a production test station or major test software release, closed at least one significant correlation or test gap between internal labs and CM factories, and shown measurable improvement in yield or false\-call rate on an owned product line. * 12 Months: You're the recognized technical authority for test engineering on your product line(s), CM teams can sustain your test solutions independently, and you've contributed reusable test frameworks or playbooks adopted by other programs. ### **Benefits** At Ōura, we care about you and your well\-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health. What we offer: * Competitive salary and equity packages * Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources * An Ōura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends \& family * 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off * Paid sick leave and parental leave Ōura takes a market\-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. US locations are categorized into tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. * **San Francisco Salary Range: $172,550 \- $203,000** A recruiter can determine your Region based on your US location. We are not considering candidates residing in the following states: Alaska (AK), Delaware (DE), Iowa (IA), Mississippi (MS), Nebraska (NE), South Dakota (SD), West Virginia (WV), and Wisconsin (WI). ŌURA is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Individuals seeking employment at ŌURA are considered without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, race, religion (including beliefs and practices or the absence thereof), sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Disclaimer: Beware of fake job offers! We've been alerted to scammers posing as ŌURA recruiters, especially for remote roles. Please note: * Our jobs are listed only on the ŌURA Careers page and trusted job boards. * We will never ask for personal information like ID or payment for equipment upfront. * Official offers are sent through Docusign after a verbal offer, not via text or email. Stay cautious and protect your personal details. To all recruitment agencies: ŌURA does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, ŌURA employees, or any other organization's location. ŌURA is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
